"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said 'If anyone gives something from what he has to his wife or slave-girl for cooking food in her hand without specifying a price, then it is not permissible for the husband to take anything out of that until she asks him.' "

chapter: Detailed Rules of Law about the Prayer during Journey - كتاب صلاة السفر
ground_truth_en: Narrated Imran ibn Husayn:                     I went on an expedition with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and I was present with him at the conquest. He stayed eighteen days in Mecca and prayed only two rak'ahs (at each time of prayer). And he said: You who live in the town must pray four; we are travellers.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا موسى بن إسماعيل، حدثنا حماد، ح وحدثنا إبراهيم بن موسى، أخبرنا ابن علية، - وهذا لفظه - أخبرنا علي بن زيد، عن أبي نضرة، عن عمران بن حصين، قال غزوت مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وشهدت معه الفتح فأقام بمكة ثماني عشرة ليلة لا يصلي إلا ركعتين ويقول ‏"‏ يا أهل البلد صلوا أربعا فإنا قوم سفر ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that a man asked Anas b. Malik about prayer while travelling so he (Anas) told him to ask Abu Hurairah, and when the latter was informed of it, he came out running till he caught up with us at Al-Batha'. He then related:
The Messenger of Allah said on behalf of his Companions who were present there: "Our Lord! Increase our numbers." So they increased them. Then the Prophet (peace be upon him) again asked for their increase, and he also supplicated in that regard till I saw sweat dropping from his forehead like pearls falling down on a string.
Then Allah said: "O Muhammad! You have been granted what you requested."

chapter: Prayer (Kitab Al-Salat) - كتاب الصلاة
ground_truth_en: ‘Amr b. Shu’aib, on his father’s authority, quoted his grandfather as saying:                      There is no short or long surah in al-Mufassal which I have not heard the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) reciting when he led the people in the prescribed prayer.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أحمد بن سعيد السرخسي، حدثنا وهب بن جرير، حدثنا أبي قال، سمعت محمد بن إسحاق، يحدث عن عمرو بن شعيب، عن أبيه، عن جده، أنه قال ما من المفصل سورة صغيرة ولا كبيرة إلا وقد سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يؤم الناس بها في الصلاة المكتوبة ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What kind of prayer is best?" He replied," The one which is performed between the adhan (call to prayers) Iqama and the compulsory congregational Prayer."

chapter: Prescribed Punishments (Kitab Al-Hudud) - كتاب الحدود
ground_truth_en: Al-Auza’i said:                      The word shukkta means tied, meaning her clothes were tied on her.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن الوزير الدمشقي، حدثنا الوليد، عن الأوزاعي، قال فشكت عليها ثيابها ‏.‏ يعني فشدت ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud said that a man came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) who was in seclusion with his wives at home and asked him for an Islamic ruling, so he sent one of the women from among them. The woman went out and brought water which she gave to the person asking about the Islamic Rulings.

chapter: Types of Blood-Wit (Kitab Al-Diyat) - كتاب الديات
ground_truth_en: Narrated 'Amr b. Shu'aib:                     On his father's authority, said that his grandfather told that a A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) crying for help. He said: His slave-girl, Messenger of Allah! He said: Woe to you, what happened with you ? He said that it was an evil one. He saw the slave-girl of his master; he became jealous of him, and cut off his penis. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Bring the man to me. The man was called, but people could not get control over him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then said: Go away, you are free. He asked: Messenger of Allah! upon whom does my help lie? He replied: On every believer, or he said: On every Muslim.Abu Dawud said: The name of the man who was emancipated was Rawh b. DinarAbu Dawud said: The man who cut off the penis was Zinba'Abu Dawud said: The Zinba' Abu Rawh was master of the slave.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن الحسن بن تسنيم العتكي، حدثنا محمد بن بكر، أخبرنا سوار أبو حمزة، حدثنا عمرو بن شعيب، عن أبيه، عن جده، قال جاء رجل مستصرخ إلى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال جارية له يا رسول الله ‏.‏ فقال ‏"‏ ويحك ما لك ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال شرا أبصر لسيده جارية له فغار فجب مذاكيره ‏.‏ فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ على بالرجل ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فطلب فلم يقدر عليه فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اذهب فأنت حر ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فقال يا رسول الله على من نصرتي قال ‏"‏ على كل مؤمن ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أو قال ‏"‏ كل مسلم ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال أبو داود الذي عتق كان اسمه روح بن دينار ‏.‏ قال أبو داود الذي جبه زنباع ‏.‏ قال أبو داود هذا زنباع أبو روح كان مولى العبد ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar...

chapter: Knowledge (Kitab Al-Ilm) - كتاب العلم
ground_truth_en: Narrated Anas ibn Malik:                     The Prophet (ﷺ) said: That I sit in the company of the people who remember Allah the Exalted from morning prayer till the sun rises is dearer to me than that I emancipate four slaves from the children of Isra'il, and that I sit with the people who remember Allah from afternoon prayer till the sun sets is dearer to me than that I emancipate four slaves.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن المثنى، حدثني عبد السلام، - يعني ابن مطهر أبو ظفر - حدثنا موسى بن خلف العمي، عن قتادة، عن أنس بن مالك، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لأن أقعد مع قوم يذكرون الله تعالى من صلاة الغداة حتى تطلع الشمس أحب إلى من أن أعتق أربعة من ولد إسماعيل ولأن أقعد مع قوم يذكرون الله من صلاة العصر إلى أن تغرب الشمس أحب إلى من أن أعتق أربعة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Ibn Abbas said that a man asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) "What is more loved to me than my own self?" He replied, "(Your wife)." The man asked for his next of kin and he was told the same. Then again he asked about it thrice."

chapter: Types of Blood-Wit (Kitab Al-Diyat) - كتاب الديات
ground_truth_en: Narrated Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-'As:                     The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Blood-wit for every wound which lays bare a bone is five camels.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو كامل، فضيل بن حسين أن خالد بن الحارث، حدثهم قال أخبرنا حسين، - يعني المعلم - عن عمرو بن شعيب، أن أباه، أخبره عن عبد الله بن عمرو، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ في المواضح خمس ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud said that a man came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) who had killed ninety-nine persons and asked him what he could save his life from being taken, while every time the apostles of former nations sent as an emissary by their people.
He replied: "Slay one person."

chapter: The Book of Manumission of Slaves - كتاب العتق
ground_truth_en: The tradition mentioned above by Rawh b. 'Ubadah from Sa'id b. Abu 'Arubah. In this version he did not mention the words "the slave should be required to work." If has also been transmitted by Jarir b. Hazim and Musa b. Khalaf from Qatadah through the chain of Yazid b. Zurai' and to the same effect. In this version they mentioned the words "the slave should be required to work"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن بشار، حدثنا يحيى، وابن أبي عدي، عن سعيد، بإسناده ومعناه ‏.‏ قال أبو داود ورواه روح بن عبادة عن سعيد بن أبي عروبة، لم يذكر السعاية ورواه جرير بن حازم وموسى بن خلف جميعا عن قتادة، بإسناد يزيد بن زريع ومعناه وذكرا فيه السعاية ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) with his slave who was standing beside him asking (at what price the slave should be freed). He fixed up some dried barley for one hibeka and asked (the slave) "Earn like this much". The Prophet said, "Do you see anyone more obedient to you than he is?" Then he ordered the man to free his slave.

chapter: Prayer (Kitab Al-Salat) - كتاب الصلاة
ground_truth_en: Narrated Abdullah ibn Mas'ud:                     AbuUthman an-Nahdi said: When Ibn Mas'ud prayed he placed his left hand on the right. The Prophet (ﷺ) saw him and placed his right hand on his left one.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن بكار بن الريان، عن هشيم بن بشير، عن الحجاج بن أبي زينب، عن أبي عثمان النهدي، عن ابن مسعود، أنه كان يصلي فوضع يده اليسرى على اليمنى فرآه النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فوضع يده اليمنى على اليسرى ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba'ah Al-Ansari (Allaahu `alayhi wa Salaam) said that he heard Rasoolullaahe Salallaho Aleyhissallame say, "The most beloved of all deeds to me are those which are done with the greatest love and purity."

chapter: Detailed Injunctions about Witr - كتاب الوتر
ground_truth_en: Narrated Ali ibn AbuTalib:                     The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say at the end of his witr: "O Allah, I seek refuge in Thy good pleasure from Thy anger, and in Thy forgiveness from Thy punishment, and I seek refuge in Thy mercy from Thy wrath. I cannot reckon the praise due to Thee. Thou art as Thou hast praised Thyself."Abu Dawud said: Hisham is the earliest teacher of Hammad. Yahya b. Ma'in said: No one is reported to have narrated traditions form him except Hammad b. Salamah.Abu Dawud said: Ubayy b. Ka'b said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited supplication in the witr before bowing.Abu Dawud said: This tradition has also been narrated by 'Isa b. Yunus through a different chain of narrators from Ubayy b. Ka'b. He also narrated it through a different chain of narrators on the authority of Ubayy b. Ka'b that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited the supplication in the witr before bowing.Abu Dawud said: The chain of narrators of the tradition of Sa'id from Qatadah goes: Yazid b. Zurai' narrated from Sa'id, from Qatadah, from 'Azrah, from Sa'id b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abza, on the authority of his father, from the Prophet (ﷺ). This version does not mention the supplication and the name of Ubayy. This tradition has also been narrated by 'Abd al-A'la and Muhammad b. Bishr al-'Abdi. He heard the traditions from 'Isa b. Yunus at Kufah. They did not mention the supplication in their version.This tradition has also been narrated by Hisham al-Dastuwa'i and Shu'bah from Qatadah. They did not mention the supplication in their version. The tradition of Zubaid has been narrated by Sulaiman al-A'mash, Shu'bah, 'Abd al-Malik b. Abi Sulaiman, and Jarir b. Hazim; all of them narrated on the authority of Zubaid. None of them mention the supplication in his version, except in the tradition transmitted by Hafs b. Ghiyath from Mis'ar from Zubaid; he narrated in his version that he (the Prophet) recited supplication before bowing.Abu Dawud said: This version of tradition is not well know. There is doubt that Hafs might have narrated this tradition from some other narrator than Mis'ar.Abu Dawud said: It is reported that Ubayy (b. Ka'b) used to recited the supplication )in the witr) in the second half of Ramadan.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا موسى بن إسماعيل، حدثنا حماد، عن هشام بن عمرو الفزاري، عن عبد الرحمن بن الحارث بن هشام، عن علي بن أبي طالب، رضى الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان يقول في آخر وتره ‏"‏ اللهم إني أعوذ برضاك من سخطك وبمعافاتك من عقوبتك وأعوذ بك منك لا أحصي ثناء عليك أنت كما أثنيت على نفسك ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال أبو داود هشام أقدم شيخ لحماد وبلغني عن يحيى بن معين أنه قال لم يرو عنه غير حماد بن سلمة ‏.‏ قال أبو داود روى عيسى بن يونس عن سعيد بن أبي عروبة عن قتادة عن سعيد بن عبد الرحمن بن أبزى عن أبيه عن أبى بن كعب أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قنت - يعني في الوتر - قبل الركوع ‏.‏ قال أبو داود روى عيسى بن يونس هذا الحديث أيضا عن فطر بن خليفة عن زبيد عن سعيد بن عبد الرحمن بن أبزى عن أبيه عن أبى عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم مثله وروي عن حفص بن غياث عن مسعر عن زبيد عن سعيد بن عبد الرحمن بن أبزى عن أبيه عن أبى بن كعب أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قنت في الوتر قبل الركوع ‏.‏ قال أبو داود حديث سعيد عن قتادة رواه يزيد بن زريع عن سعيد عن قتادة عن عزرة عن سعيد بن عبد الرحمن بن أبزى عن أبيه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم لم يذكر القنوت ولا ذكر أبيا وكذلك رواه عبد الأعلى ومحمد بن بشر العبدي وسماعه بالكوفة مع عيسى بن يونس ولم يذكروا القنوت وقد رواه أيضا هشام الدستوائي وشعبة عن قتادة ولم يذكرا القنوت وحديث زبيد رواه سليمان الأعمش وشعبة وعبد الملك بن أبي سليمان وجرير بن حازم كلهم عن زبيد لم يذكر أحد منهم القنوت إلا ما روي عن حفص بن غياث عن مسعر عن زبيد فإنه قال في حديثه إنه قنت قبل الركوع ‏.‏ قال أبو داود وليس هو بالمشهور من حديث حفص نخاف أن يكون عن حفص عن غير مسعر ‏.‏ قال أبو داود ويروى أن أبيا كان يقنت في النصف من شهر رمضان ‏.‏
llm_response: Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad about what should be recited in Witr (the odd numbered Rak'ahs of Salat al-Tarawih). The Hadith text is as follows:\n\nNarrated Abu Hurayra, the Messenger of Allah said: "Recite Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad."

chapter: Voluntary Prayers - كتاب التطوع
ground_truth_en: Narrated Abdullah ibn Abbas:                     The Prophet's (ﷺ) recitation was loud enough for one who was in the inner chamber to hear it when he was in the house.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن جعفر الوركاني، حدثنا ابن أبي الزناد، عن عمرو بن أبي عمرو، مولى المطلب عن عكرمة، عن ابن عباس، قال ‏:‏ كانت قراءة النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم على قدر ما يسمعه من في الحجرة وهو في البيت ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar...

chapter: Battles (Kitab Al-Malahim) - كتاب الملاحم
ground_truth_en: Al-nawwas b. Sim’an al-Kilabi said:                      The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) mentioned the Dajjal (Antichrist)  saying: If he comes forth while I am among you I shall be the one who will dispute with him on your behalf, but if he comes forth when I am not among you, a man must dispute on his own behalf, and Allah will take my place in looking after every Muslim. Those of you who live up to his time should recite over him the opening verses of Surat al – Kahf, for they are your protection from his trial. We asked: How long will he remain on the earth ? He replied : Forty days, one like a year, one like a month, one like a week, and rest of his days like yours. We asked : Messenger of Allah, will one day’s prayer suffice us in this day which will be like a year ? He replied : No, you must make an estimate of its extent. Then Jesus son of Marry will descend at the white minaret to the east of Damascus. He will then catch him up at the date of Ludd and kill him.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا صفوان بن صالح الدمشقي المؤذن، حدثنا الوليد، حدثنا ابن جابر، حدثنا يحيى بن جابر الطائي، عن عبد الرحمن بن جبير بن نفير، عن أبيه، عن النواس بن سمعان الكلابي، قال ذكر رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم الدجال فقال ‏"‏ إن يخرج وأنا فيكم فأنا حجيجه دونكم وإن يخرج ولست فيكم فامرؤ حجيج نفسه والله خليفتي على كل مسلم فمن أدركه منكم فليقرأ عليه فواتح سورة الكهف فإنها جواركم من فتنته ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قلنا وما لبثه في الأرض قال ‏"‏ أربعون يوما يوم كسنة ويوم كشهر ويوم كجمعة وسائر أيامه كأيامكم ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فقلنا يا رسول الله هذا اليوم الذي كسنة أتكفينا فيه صلاة يوم وليلة قال ‏"‏ لا اقدروا له قدره ثم ينزل عيسى ابن مريم عند المنارة البيضاء شرقي دمشق فيدركه عند باب لد فيقتله ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (Allah be pleased with them): The Messenger of Allaah (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said to me while I was playing with the children at my home, "O son of Khunays! Go and get us a date."

chapter: Fasting (Kitab Al-Siyam) - كتاب الصوم
ground_truth_en: Abu Hurairah said:                      The Prophet (ﷺ) used to observe I'tikaf during ten days of Ramadan every year. But when the year in which he died, he observed I'tikaf for twenty days.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا هناد، عن أبي بكر، عن أبي حصين، عن أبي صالح، عن أبي هريرة، قال كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يعتكف كل رمضان عشرة أيام فلما كان العام الذي قبض فيه اعتكف عشرين يوما ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (RA): The Messenger of Allaah(saw) said:"Fasting is to me as if I were fasting perpetually."

chapter: Divorce (Kitab Al-Talaq) - كتاب الطلاق
ground_truth_en: Sa’d bin Jubair said I asked Ibn ‘Umar A man accused his wife of adultery? He said “The Apostle of Allaah(ﷺ) separated the brother and the sister of Banu Al ‘Ajilan (i.e., husband and wife). He said Allaah knows that one of you is a liar, will one of you repent? He repeated these words three times, but they refused. So he separated them from each other.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أحمد بن محمد بن حنبل، حدثنا إسماعيل، حدثنا أيوب، عن سعيد بن جبير، قال قلت لابن عمر رجل قذف امرأته ‏.‏ قال فرق رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بين أخوى بني العجلان وقال ‏"‏ الله يعلم أن أحدكما كاذب ‏.‏ فهل منكما تائب ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يرددها ثلاث مرات فأبيا ففرق بينهما ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (Allah be pleased with them): The Messenger of Allaah (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said to me while I was playing with the children in his presence, "O son of my brother! Go and write down for us a writing containing divorce." So he dictated it.

chapter: Prayer (Kitab Al-Salat) - كتاب الصلاة
ground_truth_en: Muhammad b. 'Amr b. al-Hasan reported:                      We asked Jabir about the time of the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He said: He used to offer the Zuhr prayer in the midday heat, the 'Asr prayer when the sun was bright, the Maghrib prayer when the sun had completely set, the Isha prayer early when many people were present, but late if there were few, and the Fajr prayer in the darkness (of the dawn).
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا مسلم بن إبراهيم، حدثنا شعبة، عن سعد بن إبراهيم، عن محمد بن عمرو، - وهو ابن الحسن بن علي بن أبي طالب - قال - سألنا جابرا عن وقت، صلاة النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال كان يصلي الظهر بالهاجرة والعصر والشمس حية والمغرب إذا غربت الشمس والعشاء إذا كثر الناس عجل وإذا قلوا أخر والصبح بغلس ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What deeds are loved most by God?" He replied: "To love him." The man asked, "Should one person be loved more than another?" He (the Prophet) answered: "Is there any of you who would like to have only his father or mother loving him without having anyone else loving him?"

chapter: Wages (Kitab Al-Ijarah) - كتاب الإجارة
ground_truth_en: Narrated Jabir bin ‘Abdullah :                     That he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say in the year of the Conquest when he was in Mecca: Allah has forbidden the sale of wine, animals which have dead natural death, swine and idols. He was asked: Messenger of Allah, what do you think of the fat of animals which had died a natural death, for it was used for caulking ships, greasing skins, and making oil for lamps? He replies: No, it is forbidden. Thereafter, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: May Allah curse the Jews! When Allah declared the fat of such animals lawful, they melted it, then sold it, and enjoyed the price they received.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا قتيبة بن سعيد، حدثنا الليث، عن يزيد بن أبي حبيب، عن عطاء بن أبي رباح، عن جابر بن عبد الله، أنه سمع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول عام الفتح وهو بمكة ‏"‏ إن الله حرم بيع الخمر والميتة والخنزير والأصنام ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فقيل يا رسول الله أرأيت شحوم الميتة فإنه يطلى بها السفن ويدهن بها الجلود ويستصبح بها الناس فقال ‏"‏ لا هو حرام ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثم قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عند ذلك ‏"‏ قاتل الله اليهود إن الله لما حرم عليهم شحومها أجملوه ثم باعوه فأكلوا ثمنه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba'ah Al-Ansari said that he heard Anas bin Malik say to a man who asked him about his wages (for serving in the Prophet Muhammad's household): "I served them on the day of Uhud and I was not paid anything."

chapter: Shares of Inheritance (Kitab Al-Fara'id) - كتاب الفرائض
ground_truth_en: Narrated Buraydah ibn al-Hasib:                     A man came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: I have property left by a man of Azd. I do not find any man of Azd to give it to him. He said: Go and look for man of Azd for a year. He then came to him after one year and said: Messenger of Allah, I did not find any man of Azd to give it to him. He said: Look for a man of Khuza'ah whom you meet first and give it to him. When he turned away, he said; Call the man to me. When he came to him, he said: Look for the leading man of Khuza'ah and give it to him.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عبد الله بن سعيد الكندي، حدثنا المحاربي، عن جبريل بن أحمر، عن عبد الله بن بريدة، عن أبيه، قال أتى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم رجل فقال إن عندي ميراث رجل من الأزد ولست أجد أزديا أدفعه إليه ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ اذهب فالتمس أزديا حولا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال فأتاه بعد الحول فقال يا رسول الله لم أجد أزديا أدفعه إليه ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ فانطلق فانظر أول خزاعي تلقاه فادفعه إليه ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فلما ولى قال ‏"‏ على الرجل ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فلما جاء قال ‏"‏ انظر كبر خزاعة فادفعه إليه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (Allah be pleased with them): The Messenger of Allaah (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said to me when I was a boy, "O son of my brother! Ask for anything you wish." So I asked him that he should pray two rak'at before the noon prayer and then add another one. He did so until it became four raka't at midday; but later on they reduced them to three.

chapter: Medicine (Kitab Al-Tibb) - كتاب الطب
ground_truth_en: Narrated Anas ibn Malik:                     The Prophet (ﷺ) had himself cupped three times in the veins at the sides of the neck and on the shoulder. Ma'mar said: I got myself cupped, and I lost my memory so much so that I was instructed Surat al-Fatihah by others in my prayer. He had himself cupped at the top of his head.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا مسلم بن إبراهيم، حدثنا جرير، - يعني ابن حازم - حدثنا قتادة، عن أنس، أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم احتجم ثلاثا في الأخدعين والكاهل ‏.‏ قال معمر احتجمت فذهب عقلي حتى كنت ألقن فاتحة الكتاب في صلاتي ‏.‏ وكان احتجم على هامته ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that a man asked the Prophet (sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam): "What is there in my right hand?" He replied, "(It contains) an arrow."

chapter: Wages (Kitab Al-Ijarah) - كتاب الإجارة
ground_truth_en: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:                     I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sitting neat the Black stone (or at a corner of the Ka'bah). He said: He (the Prophet) raised his eyes towards the heaven, and laughed, and he said: May Allah curse the Jews! He said this three times. Allah declared unlawful for them the fats (of the animals which died a natural death); they sold them and they enjoyed the price they received for them. When Allah declared eating of thing forbidden for the people, He declares it price also forbidden for them. The version of Khalid b. 'Abd Allah al-Tahhan does not have the words "I saw". It has: "May Allah destroy the Jews!"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا مسدد، أن بشر بن المفضل، وخالد بن عبد الله، حدثاهم - المعنى، - عن خالد الحذاء، عن بركة، قال مسدد في حديث خالد بن عبد الله عن بركة أبي الوليد، ثم اتفقا - عن ابن عباس، قال رأيت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم جالسا عند الركن - قال - فرفع بصره إلى السماء فضحك فقال ‏"‏ لعن الله اليهود ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثلاثا ‏"‏ إن الله حرم عليهم الشحوم فباعوها وأكلوا أثمانها وإن الله إذا حرم على قوم أكل شىء حرم عليهم ثمنه ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ولم يقل في حديث خالد بن عبد الله الطحان ‏"‏ رأيت ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وقال ‏"‏ قاتل الله اليهود ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar...

chapter: Prayer (Kitab Al-Salat) - كتاب الصلاة
ground_truth_en: Abd Allah b. Abl Awfa said:                      The prophet (ﷺ) used to stand in the rak’ah of prayer so much so that no sound of steps heard.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عثمان بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا عفان، حدثنا همام، حدثنا محمد بن جحادة، عن رجل، عن عبد الله بن أبي أوفى، أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم كان يقوم في الركعة الأولى من صلاة الظهر حتى لا يسمع وقع قدم ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that his father Umara (radhiyallahu anhum) used to say : "Our Lord! Forgive us, and our parents, men and women."

chapter: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab) - كتاب الأدب
ground_truth_en: Narrated AbudDarda':                     The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Your love for a thing causes blindness and deafness.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا حيوة بن شريح، حدثنا بقية، عن أبي بكر بن أبي مريم، عن خالد بن محمد الثقفي، عن بلال بن أبي الدرداء، عن أبي الدرداء، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ حبك الشىء يعمي ويصم ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (RA) said that a man asked Allah's Messenger (SAW): "Which deeds are better?" He replied:"Asceticism in the pursuit of worldly objects."

chapter: Funerals (Kitab Al-Jana'iz) - كتاب الجنائز
ground_truth_en: Narrated Amir ar-Ram:                     We were in our country when flags and banners were raised. I said: What is this?  The (the people) said: This is the banner of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). So I came to him. He was (sitting) under a tree. A sheet of cloth was spread for him and he was sitting on it. His Companions were gathered around him. I sat with them.  The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) mentioned illness and said: When a believer is afflicted by illness and Allah cures him of it, it serves as an atonement for his previous sins and a warning to him for the future.  But when a hypocrite becomes ill and is then cured, he is like a camel which has been tethered and then let loose by its owners, but does not know why they tethered it and why they let it loose.  A man from among those around him asked: Messenger of Allah, what are illnesses? I swear by Allah, I never fell ill.  The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Get up and leave us. You do not belong to our number. When we were with him, a man came to him. He had a sheet of cloth and something in his hand.  He turned his attention to him and said: Messenger of Allah, when I saw you, I turned towards you. I saw a group of trees and heard the sound of fledglings. I took them and put them in my garment. Their mother then came and began to hover round my head. I showed them to her, and she fell on them. I wrapped them with my garment. They are now with me.  He said: Put them away from you. So I put them away, but their mother stayed with them.  The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to his companions: Are you surprised at the affection of the mother for her young?  They said: Yes, Messenger of Allah.  He said: I swear by Him Who has sent me with the Truth, Allah is more affectionate to His servants than a mother to her young ones. Take them back put them and where you took them from when their mother should have been with them. So he took them back.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عبد الله بن محمد النفيلي، حدثنا محمد بن سلمة، عن محمد بن إسحاق، قال حدثني رجل، من أهل الشام يقال له أبو منظور عن عمه، قال حدثني عمي، عن عامر الرام، أخي الخضر - قال أبو داود قال النفيلي هو الخضر ولكن كذا قال - قال إني لببلادنا إذ رفعت لنا رايات وألوية فقلت ما هذا قالوا هذا لواء رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فأتيته وهو تحت شجرة قد بسط له كساء وهو جالس عليه وقد اجتمع إليه أصحابه فجلست إليهم فذكر رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم الأسقام فقال ‏"‏ إن المؤمن إذا أصابه السقم ثم أعفاه الله منه كان كفارة لما مضى من ذنوبه وموعظة له فيما يستقبل وإن المنافق إذا مرض ثم أعفي كان كالبعير عقله أهله ثم أرسلوه فلم يدر لم عقلوه ولم يدر لم أرسلوه ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فقال رجل ممن حوله يا رسول الله وما الأسقام والله ما مرضت قط ‏.‏ فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ قم عنا فلست منا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فبينا نحن عنده إذ أقبل رجل عليه كساء وفي يده شىء قد التف عليه فقال يا رسول الله إني لما رأيتك أقبلت إليك فمررت بغيضة شجر فسمعت فيها أصوات فراخ طائر فأخذتهن فوضعتهن في كسائي فجاءت أمهن فاستدارت على رأسي فكشفت لها عنهن فوقعت عليهن معهن فلففتهن بكسائي فهن أولاء معي ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ ضعهن عنك ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فوضعتهن وأبت أمهن إلا لزومهن فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم لأصحابه ‏"‏ أتعجبون لرحم أم الأفراخ فراخها ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قالوا نعم يا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ فوالذي بعثني بالحق لله أرحم بعباده من أم الأفراخ بفراخها ارجع بهن حتى تضعهن من حيث أخذتهن وأمهن معهن ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فرجع بهن ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (Allah be pleased with them): The Messenger of Allaah (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said to me while I was carrying him on my back from al-'Abbas Mosque, "O son of Khunays! Do not carry your father upon the bier until he is put into it."

chapter: Funerals (Kitab Al-Jana'iz) - كتاب الجنائز
ground_truth_en: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:                     I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) say: If any Muslim dies and forty men associate nothing with Allah stand over his bier. Allah will accept them as intercessors for him.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا الوليد بن شجاع السكوني، حدثنا ابن وهب، أخبرني أبو صخر، عن شريك بن عبد الله بن أبي نمر، عن كريب، عن ابن عباس، قال سمعت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول ‏"‏ ما من مسلم يموت فيقوم على جنازته أربعون رجلا لا يشركون بالله شيئا إلا شفعوا فيه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that a man asked Allah's Apostle what he should say when one of his relatives dies? He replied:" Say Inna lillahi wa ina ilayh rajeun (To Allah we belong and to Him shall We return)."

chapter: Tribute, Spoils, and Rulership (Kitab Al-Kharaj, Wal-Fai' Wal-Imarah) - كتاب الخراج والإمارة والفىء
ground_truth_en: Narrated 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Laila:                     I heard 'Ali say: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) assigned me the fifth (of the booty). I spent it on its beneficiaries during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr and of 'Umar. Some property was brought to him ('Umar) and he called me and said: Take it. I said: I dod not want it. He said: Take it ; you have right to it. I said: We do not need it. So he deposited in the government treasury.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عباس بن عبد العظيم، حدثنا يحيى بن أبي بكير، حدثنا أبو جعفر الرازي، عن مطرف، عن عبد الرحمن بن أبي ليلى، قال سمعت عليا، يقول ولاني رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم خمس الخمس فوضعته مواضعه حياة رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وحياة أبي بكر وحياة عمر فأتي بمال فدعاني فقال خذه ‏.‏ فقلت لا أريده ‏.‏ قال خذه فأنتم أحق به ‏.‏ قلت قد استغنينا عنه فجعله في بيت المال ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying: "O Allah's Apostle! Which deeds are better?" He replied: "(Faithfulness and Good Manners)."

chapter: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab) - كتاب الأدب
ground_truth_en: Anas b. Malik said :                      I never saw the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) so happy about anything as I saw them happy about this thing. A man said : Messenger of Allah! A man loves another man for the good work which he does, but he himself cannot do like it. The Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) said: A man will be with those whom he loves.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا وهب بن بقية، حدثنا خالد، عن يونس بن عبيد، عن ثابت، عن أنس بن مالك، قال رأيت أصحاب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فرحوا بشىء لم أرهم فرحوا بشىء أشد منه قال رجل يا رسول الله الرجل يحب الرجل على العمل من الخير يعمل به ولا يعمل بمثله فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ المرء مع من أحب ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (Allah be pleased with him) said that his father Umir (Allah be please with him), who was amongst those present at Ghadar Lake when Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) came there, asked the people to get up and offer prayer.

chapter: Prayer (Kitab Al-Salat) - كتاب الصلاة
ground_truth_en: Abu al-Zahiriyyah said:                      We were in the company of 'Abd Allah b. Busr, the Companion of the Prophet (ﷺ), on a Friday. A man came and stepped over the people. 'Abd Allah b. Busr said: A man came and stepped over the people while the Prophet (ﷺ) was giving the sermon on Friday. The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Sit down, you have annoyed (the people).
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا هارون بن معروف، حدثنا بشر بن السري، حدثنا معاوية بن صالح، عن أبي الزاهرية، قال كنا مع عبد الله بن بسر صاحب النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يوم الجمعة فجاء رجل يتخطى رقاب الناس فقال عبد الله بن بسر جاء رجل يتخطى رقاب الناس يوم الجمعة والنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يخطب فقال له النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اجلس فقد آذيت ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that a man asked Anas b. Malik about prayer in his house? He replied "I have seen it (prayer) performed by Allah's Messenger."

chapter: The Book Of The Prayer For Rain (Kitab al-Istisqa') - كتاب الاستسقاء
ground_truth_en: Narrated Qabisah al Hilali:                     The solar eclipse took place... The narrator then narrated the tradition like that of Musa.  The narrator again said: Until the stars appear (in the heaven).
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أحمد بن إبراهيم، حدثنا ريحان بن سعيد، حدثنا عباد بن منصور، عن أيوب، عن أبي قلابة، عن هلال بن عامر، أن قبيصة الهلالي، حدثه أن الشمس كسفت بمعنى حديث موسى قال حتى بدت النجوم ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Aslami said that he heard Anas b. Malik say to his wife when she asked him about a dream which had come true or was it only an omen of something? He replied, "It is not so; but if you see anything like this in the future then do not tell anyone."

chapter: Commercial Transactions (Kitab Al-Buyu) - كتاب البيوع
ground_truth_en: Narrated Abu Hurairah:                     The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: Delay in payment (of debt) by a rich man is injunctive, but when one of you is referred to a wealthy man, he should accept the reference.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عبد الله بن مسلمة القعنبي، عن مالك، عن أبي الزناد، عن الأعرج، عن أبي هريرة، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ مطل الغني ظلم وإذا أتبع أحدكم على مليء فليتبع ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (RA): The Messenger of Allaah(saw) said:"If anyone sells a horse or an ox on credit to another person who is in need, then he should not take back the animal until it has been slaughtered."

chapter: Prescribed Punishments (Kitab Al-Hudud) - كتاب الحدود
ground_truth_en: Narrated Sahl ibn Sa'd:                     A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and made acknowledgment before him that he had committed fornication with a woman whom he named. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent someone to the woman and he asked her about it. She denied that she had committed fornication. So he gave him the prescribed punishment of lashes and left her.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عثمان بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا طلق بن غنام، حدثنا عبد السلام بن حفص، حدثنا أبو حازم، عن سهل بن سعد، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أن رجلا أتاه فأقر عنده أنه زنى بامرأة سماها له فبعث رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إلى المرأة فسألها عن ذلك فأنكرت أن تكون زنت فجلده الحد وتركها ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (Allah be pleased with him) said that a man asked Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him), "Masturbate?" He replied, "Is there anything else? If one of you is asleep and his hand goes to the private parts while he is unaware of it then no blame will fall on him."

chapter: Funerals (Kitab Al-Jana'iz) - كتاب الجنائز
ground_truth_en: Narrated Amir:                     Ali, Fadl and Usamah ibn Zayd washed the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and they put him in his grave. Marhab or Ibn AbuMarhab told me that they also made AbdurRahman ibn Awf join them. When Ali became free, he said: The People of the man serve him.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أحمد بن يونس، حدثنا زهير، حدثنا إسماعيل بن أبي خالد، عن عامر، قال غسل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم علي والفضل وأسامة بن زيد وهم أدخلوه قبره قال وحدثني مرحب أو ابن أبي مرحب أنهم أدخلوا معهم عبد الرحمن بن عوف فلما فرغ علي قال إنما يلي الرجل أهله ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid Al'Ansari said that he heard a man asking about the Messenger of Allaah (sallAllaahu alayhi wa sallam) saying, "What is his condition?" He asked him to come forward. The Prophet (sallaAllahu 'alaihi wa-salam) was sitting in front of us and he said:
"He who believes in Allah should not say that the Messenger of Allaah has died, but rather says, "If I were to die then indeed it would be a loss for me."

chapter: Purification (Kitab Al-Taharah) - كتاب الطهارة
ground_truth_en: This tradition has also been narrated by 'Aishah through a different chain of transmitters.Abu Dawud said:                      All the traditions (on this subject) transmitted by 'Adi b. Thabit and A'mash on the authority of Habib and Ayyub al-'Ala, all of them are weak; none of them is sound. This tradition indicates	the tradition reported by al-A'mash a a statement of Companion, i.e. 'Aishah. Hafs b. Ghayath has rejected the tradition transmitted by Habib as the statement (of the Prophet). And Asbat also reported it as a statement of 'Aishah.Abu Dawud said: Ibn Dawud has narrated the first part of this tradition as a statement (of the Prophet), and denied that there was any mention of performing ablution for every prayer. The weakness of the tradition reported by Habib is also indicated by the fact that the version transmuted by al-Zuhri from 'Urwah on the authority of 'Aishah says that she used to wash herself for every prayer; (these words occur) in the tradition about the woman who has a flow of blood. This tradition has been reported by Abu al-Yaqzan from 'Adi b. Thabit from his father from 'Ali, and narrated by 'Ammar, the freed salve of Banu Hashim, from Ibn 'Abbas, and transmitted by 'Abd al-Malik b. Maisarah, Bayan, al-Mughirah, Firas, on the authority of al-Sha'bi, from Qumair from 'Aishah, stating: You should perform ablution for every prayer. The version transmitted by Dawud, and 'Asim from al-Sha'bi from Qumair from 'Aishah has the words: She should take bath only once every day. The version reported by Hisham b. 'Urwah from his father has the words: The woman having a flow of blood should perform ablution for every prayer. All these traditions are weak except the tradition reported by Qumair and the tradition reported by 'Ammar, the freed slave of Banu Hashim, and the tradition narrated by Hisham b. 'Urwah on the authority of his father. What is commonly known from Ibn 'Abbas is bathing (for every prayer).
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أحمد بن سنان القطان الواسطي، حدثنا يزيد، عن أيوب أبي العلاء، عن ابن شبرمة، عن امرأة، مسروق عن عائشة، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم مثله ‏.‏ قال أبو داود وحديث عدي بن ثابت والأعمش عن حبيب وأيوب أبي العلاء كلها ضعيفة لا تصح ودل على ضعف حديث الأعمش عن حبيب هذا الحديث أوقفه حفص بن غياث عن الأعمش وأنكر حفص بن غياث أن يكون حديث حبيب مرفوعا وأوقفه أيضا أسباط عن الأعمش موقوف عن عائشة ‏.‏ قال أبو داود ورواه ابن داود عن الأعمش مرفوعا أوله وأنكر أن يكون فيه الوضوء عند كل صلاة ودل على ضعف حديث حبيب هذا أن رواية الزهري عن عروة عن عائشة قالت فكانت تغتسل لكل صلاة ‏.‏ في حديث المستحاضة وروى أبو اليقظان عن عدي بن ثابت عن أبيه عن علي - رضي الله عنه - وعمار مولى بني هاشم عن ابن عباس وروى عبد الملك بن ميسرة وبيان والمغيرة وفراس ومجالد عن الشعبي عن حديث قمير عن عائشة ‏"‏ توضئي لكل صلاة ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ورواية داود وعاصم عن الشعبي عن قمير عن عائشة ‏"‏ تغتسل كل يوم مرة ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وروى هشام بن عروة عن أبيه المستحاضة تتوضأ لكل صلاة ‏.‏ وهذه الأحاديث كلها ضعيفة إلا حديث قمير وحديث عمار مولى بني هاشم وحديث هشام بن عروة عن أبيه والمعروف عن ابن عباس الغسل ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud said that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying "The prayer is two Rakat."

chapter: Wages (Kitab Al-Ijarah) - كتاب الإجارة
ground_truth_en: 'Ata said:                      Blight means anything which obviously damages (the crop), by rain, hail, locust, blast of wind, or fire.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا سليمان بن داود المهري، أخبرنا ابن وهب، أخبرني عثمان بن الحكم، عن ابن جريج، عن عطاء، قال الجوائح كل ظاهر مفسد من مطر أو برد أو جراد أو ريح أو حريق ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar...

chapter: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab) - كتاب الأدب
ground_truth_en: Narrated AbuDharr:                     If anyone says in the morning: "O Allah! whatever oath I take, whatever word I speak, and whatever vow I take, Thine will precedes all that: whatever Thou willeth, occurs, and whatever Thou dost not will, dost not occur. O Allah! pardon me and disregard me for it. O Allah! whomsoever Thou sendest thine blessing, to him my blessing is due, and whomsoever thou cursest, to him my curse is due, " exemption from it will be granted to him that day.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا ابن معاذ، حدثنا أبي، حدثنا المسعودي، حدثنا القاسم، قال كان أبو ذر يقول من قال حين يصبح اللهم ما حلفت من حلف أو قلت من قول أو نذرت من نذر فمشيئتك بين يدى ذلك كله ما شئت كان وما لم تشأ لم يكن اللهم اغفر لي وتجاوز لي عنه اللهم فمن صليت عليه فعليه صلاتي ومن لعنت فعليه لعنتي كان في استثناء يومه ذلك أو قال ذلك اليوم ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (Allah be pleased with them): The Messenger of Allaah (peace_be_upon_him) said to me when I was a boy, "O young man! Offer the prayer at its proper time; for verily it is agreed upon that there will not pass away from you but ten nights. Verily during those days Satan comes down."
I asked: How does he come? He replied: "In the image of a deer, and then in the shape of a dog, and then in your own likeness."

chapter: Prayer (Kitab Al-Salat) - كتاب الصلاة
ground_truth_en: Abu hurairah said that the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) forbade putting hands on the waist during prayer.Abu Dawud said; The word Ikhtisar means to put one’s hands on one’s waist.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا يعقوب بن كعب، حدثنا محمد بن سلمة، عن هشام، عن محمد، عن أبي هريرة، قال نهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن الاختصار في الصلاة ‏.‏ قال أبو داود يعني يضع يده على خاصرته ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said "The most blessed of words are those with which a Muslim starts his day."

chapter: Signet-Rings (Kitab Al-Khatam) - كتاب الخاتم
ground_truth_en: Narrated Ali ibn AbuTalib:                     The Prophet (ﷺ) used to wear the signet-ring on his right hand.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أحمد بن صالح، حدثنا ابن وهب، أخبرني سليمان بن بلال، عن شريك بن أبي نمر، عن إبراهيم بن عبد الله بن حنين، عن أبيه، عن علي، - رضى الله تعالى عنه - عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ قال شريك وأخبرني أبو سلمة بن عبد الرحمن أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم كان يتختم في يمينه ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said "The best among you is he who is well-mannered to his wife."

chapter: Prayer (Kitab Al-Salat) - كتاب الصلاة
ground_truth_en: Abu Mahdhurah said that the apostle of Allah (May peace be upon him) taught him the call to prayer (adhan), saying:                       Allah is most great, Allah is most great; I testify that there is no god but Allah. He then narrated adhan like the one contained in the tradition transmitted by Ibn Juraij from ‘Abd al-aziz b. ‘abd al-Malik to the same effect. The version Malik b. Dinar has. I asked the son of Abu Mahdhurah, saying: Narrate to me the adhan of your father narrated from the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him). He said: Allah is most great, Allah is most great, that is all. Similar is the version narrated by Ja’far b. Sulaiman from the son of Abd Muhdhurah from his uncle on the authority of his grandfather, excepting that he said; Then repeat and raise your voice. Allah is most great. Allah is most great.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن داود الإسكندراني، حدثنا زياد، - يعني ابن يونس - عن نافع بن عمر، - يعني الجمحي - عن عبد الملك بن أبي محذورة، أخبره عن عبد الله بن محيريز الجمحي، عن أبي محذورة، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم علمه الأذان يقول ‏"‏ الله أكبر الله أكبر أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله أشهد أن محمدا رسول الله ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثم ذكر مثل أذان حديث ابن جريج عن عبد العزيز بن عبد الملك ومعناه ‏.‏ قال أبو داود وفي حديث مالك بن دينار قال سألت ابن أبي محذورة قلت حدثني عن أذان أبيك عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فذكر فقال ‏"‏ الله أكبر الله أكبر ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قط وكذلك حديث جعفر بن سليمان عن ابن أبي محذورة عن عمه عن جده إلا أنه قال ‏"‏ ثم ترجع فترفع صوتك الله أكبر الله أكبر ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said "The most blessed of all food is dates."

chapter: Purification (Kitab Al-Taharah) - كتاب الطهارة
ground_truth_en: Narrated Umm Salamah, Ummul Mu'minin:                     The woman having bleeding after delivery (puerperal haemorrhage) would refrain (from prayer) for forty days or forty nights; and we would anoint our faces with an aromatic herb called wars to remove dark spots.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أحمد بن يونس، أخبرنا زهير، حدثنا علي بن عبد الأعلى، عن أبي سهل، عن مسة، عن أم سلمة، قالت كانت النفساء على عهد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم تقعد بعد نفاسها أربعين يوما أو أربعين ليلة وكنا نطلي على وجوهنا الورس يعني من الكلف ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (RA): The Messenger of Allaah(saw) said:"If anyone keeps back anything from his brother without a right or with an evil intention then it will be mustard in his stomach, and he shall not accept any good on the Day of Resurrection."

chapter: Purification (Kitab Al-Taharah) - كتاب الطهارة
ground_truth_en: Narrated AbuBakrah:                     The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) began to lead (the people) in the dawn prayer. He then signalled with his hand: (Stay) at your places. (Then he entered his home). He then returned while drops of water were coming down from him (from his body) and he led them in prayer.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا موسى بن إسماعيل، حدثنا حماد، عن زياد الأعلم، عن الحسن، عن أبي بكرة، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم دخل في صلاة الفجر فأومأ بيده أن مكانكم ثم جاء ورأسه يقطر فصلى بهم ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Allah's Messenger what to say if he found himself alone with a woman who was unlawful (for him). He replied: "If any one of you is without a shield, and then finds an unmarried woman whom no other person claims as his wife or slave-girl, let him not lie down but stand up."

chapter: Model Behavior of the Prophet (Kitab Al-Sunnah) - كتاب السنة
ground_truth_en: The tradition mentioned above has again been transmitted by Simak through a different chain of narrators and to the same effect as this lengthy tradition.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أحمد بن حفص، قال حدثني أبي، حدثنا إبراهيم بن طهمان، عن سماك، بإسناده ومعنى هذا الحديث الطويل ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to offer two Rakat of Tahajjud prayer before sleeping.

chapter: Model Behavior of the Prophet (Kitab Al-Sunnah) - كتاب السنة
ground_truth_en: Abu Hurairah reported the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) as saying :                      When one commits fornication, one is not a believer ; when one steals, one is not a believer ; when one drinks, one is not a believer ; and repentance is placed before him.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو صالح الأنطاكي، أخبرنا أبو إسحاق الفزاري، عن الأعمش، عن أبي صالح، عن أبي هريرة، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لا يزني الزاني حين يزني وهو مؤمن ولا يسرق حين يسرق وهو مؤمن ولا يشرب الخمر حين يشربها وهو مؤمن والتوبة معروضة بعد ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba'ah Al-Bajali said to Abu Hurairah (may Allaah be pleased with him): "O Messenger of Allâh! What is more loved by you?" He replied, "That which is most liked by your Lord."

chapter: Drinks (Kitab Al-Ashribah) - كتاب الأشربة
ground_truth_en: Nazzal b. Samurah said :                      ‘Ali asked for water and he drank it while standing. He then said: some people disapprove of doing this (drinking while standing ), but I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) doing as I have done.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا مسدد، حدثنا يحيى، عن مسعر بن كدام، عن عبد الملك بن ميسرة، عن النزال بن سبرة، أن عليا، دعا بماء فشربه وهو قائم ثم قال إن رجالا يكره أحدهم أن يفعل هذا وقد رأيت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يفعل مثل ما رأيتموني أفعله ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying "The most blessed of all drinks is milk."

chapter: Clothing (Kitab Al-Libas) - كتاب اللباس
ground_truth_en: Narrated 'Amr b. Suh'aib:                     On his father's authority, said that his grandfather reported the Prophet (ﷺ) said: When one of you marries his female servant to his slave or to his employee, he should not look at her private part below the navel and above the knees.Abu Dawud said: The correct name is Sawwad b. Dawud al-Muzani al-Sairafi (and not Dawud b. Sawwad as mentioned in the chain). The narrator waki' misunderstood it.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا زهير بن حرب، حدثنا وكيع، حدثني داود بن سوار المزني، عن عمرو بن شعيب، عن أبيه، عن جده، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ إذا زوج أحدكم خادمه عبده أو أجيره فلا ينظر إلى ما دون السرة وفوق الركبة ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال أبو داود صوابه سوار بن داود المزني الصيرفي وهم فيه وكيع ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said "If anyone of you is fasting he should wash his teeth with miswak or snuff."

chapter: Hot Baths (Kitab Al-Hammam) - كتاب الحمَّام
ground_truth_en: Narrated AbuSa'id al-Khudri:                     The Prophet (ﷺ) said: A man should not look at the private parts of another man, and a woman should not look at the private parts of another woman. A man should not lie with another man without wearing lower garment under one cover; and a woman should not be lie with another woman without wearing lower garment under one cover.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عبد الرحمن بن إبراهيم، حدثنا ابن أبي فديك، عن الضحاك بن عثمان، عن زيد بن أسلم، عن عبد الرحمن بن أبي سعيد الخدري، عن أبيه، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ لا ينظر الرجل إلى عرية الرجل ولا المرأة إلى عرية المرأة ولا يفضي الرجل إلى الرجل في ثوب واحد ولا تفضي المرأة إلى المرأة في ثوب ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar...

chapter: Tribute, Spoils, and Rulership (Kitab Al-Kharaj, Wal-Fai' Wal-Imarah) - كتاب الخراج والإمارة والفىء
ground_truth_en: Explaining the relatives of the Prophet (ﷺ) al-Saddi said:                      They are Banu 'Abd al-Muttalib.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا حسين بن علي العجلي، حدثنا وكيع، عن الحسن بن صالح، عن السدي، في ذي القربى قال هم بنو عبد المطلب ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (Allah be pleased with them): The Messenger of Allaah (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said to me while I was a boy playing in his mosque, "O son of my brother! Go and ask your mother what she prepared for the evening meal."
I went on behalf of him. My mother replied: "Nothing has been cooked yet; it is still too early."

chapter: Prayer (Kitab Al-Salat) - كتاب الصلاة
ground_truth_en: Humaid reported :                      I asked Thabit al-Bunani whether it was permissible for a man to talk after the qamah had been pronounced. He narrated a tradition on the authority of Anas: (once) the Iqamah was pronounced, and a person came to the apostle of Allah (ﷺ) and detained him after the Iqamah had been pronounced.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا حسين بن معاذ، حدثنا عبد الأعلى، عن حميد، قال سألت ثابتا البناني عن الرجل، يتكلم بعد ما تقام الصلاة فحدثني عن أنس بن مالك، قال أقيمت الصلاة فعرض لرسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم رجل فحبسه بعد ما أقيمت الصلاة ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (Allah be pleased with him) said that Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) observed : "The prayer is two Rakat."

chapter: Tribute, Spoils, and Rulership (Kitab Al-Kharaj, Wal-Fai' Wal-Imarah) - كتاب الخراج والإمارة والفىء
ground_truth_en: Narrated Yazid ibn Abdullah:                     We were at Mirbad. A man with dishevelled hair and holding a piece of red skin in his hand came.  We said: You appear to be a bedouin.  He said: Yes.  We said: Give us this piece of skin in your hand. He then gave it to us and we read it. It contained the text: "From Muhammad, Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), to Banu Zuhayr ibn Uqaysh. If you bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, offer prayer, pay zakat, pay the fifth from the booty, and the portion of the Prophet (ﷺ) and his special portion (safi), you will be under by the protection of Allah and His Apostle."  We then asked: Who wrote this document for you?  He replied: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا مسلم بن إبراهيم، حدثنا قرة، قال سمعت يزيد بن عبد الله، قال كنا بالمربد فجاء رجل أشعث الرأس بيده قطعة أديم أحمر فقلنا كأنك من أهل البادية ‏.‏ فقال أجل ‏.‏ قلنا ناولنا هذه القطعة الأديم التي في يدك فناولناها فقرأناها فإذا فيها ‏"‏ من محمد رسول الله إلى بني زهير بن أقيش إنكم إن شهدتم أن لا إله إلا الله وأن محمدا رسول الله وأقمتم الصلاة وآتيتم الزكاة وأديتم الخمس من المغنم وسهم النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وسهم الصفي أنتم آمنون بأمان الله ورسوله ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فقلنا من كتب لك هذا الكتاب قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said "The most blessed of all food is dates."

chapter: The Book of Ghusl and Tayammum - كتاب الغسل والتيمم
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Jubair bin Mut'im that mention of Ghusl was made in the presence of the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said:                      "As for me, I pour water on my head three times."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عبيد الله بن سعيد، عن يحيى، عن شعبة، قال حدثنا أبو إسحاق، ح وأنبأنا سويد بن نصر، قال حدثنا عبد الله، عن شعبة، عن أبي إسحاق، قال سمعت سليمان بن صرد، يحدث عن جبير بن مطعم، أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ذكر عنده الغسل فقال ‏"‏ أما أنا فأفرغ على رأسي ثلاثا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ لفظ سويد ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that his father told us about a man who had been given some honey to eat but he did not know whether it was lawful or unlawful so he asked the Prophet (sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam). The Messenger of Allaah (peace and blessings be upon him) said: "Eat, for indeed I have seen honey being given to a man in Paradise."

chapter: The Book of The At-Tatbiq (Clasping One's Hands Together) - كتاب التطبيق
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Jabir said:                     "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to teach us the tashahhud just as he would teach us a surah of the Quran: "Bismillah, wa billahi. At-tahiyyatu lillahi was-salawatu wat-tayyibat, as-salamu 'alaika ayyuhan-Nabiyyu wa rahmatAllahi wa baraktuhu. As-salamu 'alaina wa 'ala 'ibad illahis-salihin, ashahdu an la illaha ill-Allah wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluhu. A'sal Allahal-jannah wa a'udhu Billahi min an-nar (Allah compliments, prayers and pure words are due to Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah (SWT) and his blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous slaves of Allah (SWT). I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger. I ask Allah for Paradise and I seek refuge with Allah from the Fire).'
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن عبد الأعلى، قال حدثنا المعتمر، قال سمعت أيمن، - وهو ابن نابل - يقول حدثني أبو الزبير، عن جابر، قال كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يعلمنا التشهد كما يعلمنا السورة من القرآن ‏"‏ بسم الله وبالله التحيات لله والصلوات والطيبات السلام عليك أيها النبي ورحمة الله وبركاته السلام علينا وعلى عباد الله الصالحين أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وأشهد أن محمدا عبده ورسوله أسأل الله الجنة وأعوذ بالله من النار ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid Al'Ansari said that he heard Anas b. Malik say to his wife when she asked him about a thing which had been forbidden by their Prophet (ﷺ) and they were not able to do it, "Do you know of any Hadith other than this?" She replied: No." So 'Abdullah bin Zaid went away from her.
Hadith Number 1175

chapter: The Book of Adornment - كتاب الزينة من السنن
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Anas said:                     "The Messenger of Allah [SAW] wanted to write to the Romans, and they (the Companions) said: 'They do not read any letter unless it has a seal.' So he took a ring of silver and it is as if I can see its whiteness on his hand, and engraved on it (were the words): 'Muhammad Rasul Allah.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا حميد بن مسعدة، عن بشر، - وهو ابن المفضل - قال حدثنا شعبة، عن قتادة، عن أنس، قال أراد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أن يكتب إلى الروم فقالوا إنهم لا يقرءون كتابا إلا مختوما ‏.‏ فاتخذ خاتما من فضة كأني أنظر إلى بياضه في يده ونقش فيه محمد رسول الله ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more loved to me than my offspring?" He replied, "(Our) Lord has forbidden (the love of) our wives for us."

chapter: The Book of Oaths and Vows - كتاب الأيمان والنذور
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that 'Umar had vowed -during the Jahiliyyah- to spend a day in 'Itikaf. He asked the Messenger of Allah about that, and he commanded him to perform the 'Itikaf.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا أحمد بن عبد الله بن الحكم، قال حدثنا محمد بن جعفر، قال حدثنا شعبة، قال سمعت عبيد الله، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر، أن عمر، كان جعل عليه يوما يعتكفه في الجاهلية فسأل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن ذلك فأمره أن يعتكفه ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that a man asked the Prophet (sallallaahu `alayhi wa sallam): "What is more important for me to do?" He replied, "(Swear by God), if you swear an oath and then break it."
Reference: 3822

chapter: The Book of Hajj - كتاب مناسك الحج
ground_truth_en: Urwah bin Mudarris bin Aws bin Harithah bin La'm said:                     "I came to the Prophet in Jam (Al-Muzdalifah) and said: 'Is there Hajj for me?' He said: 'Whoever offers this prayer with us and observed this standing until he departed, and he departed before that from Arafat by night or by day, then his Hajj is complete. And he has completed the prescribed duties.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا إسماعيل بن مسعود، قال حدثنا خالد، عن شعبة، عن عبد الله بن أبي السفر، قال سمعت الشعبي، يقول حدثني عروة بن مضرس بن أوس بن حارثة بن لأم، قال أتيت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم بجمع فقلت هل لي من حج فقال ‏"‏ من صلى هذه الصلاة معنا ووقف هذا الموقف حتى يفيض وأفاض قبل ذلك من عرفات ليلا أو نهارا فقد تم حجه وقضى تفثه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Anas b. Malik say to a man who asked him about the Messench (i.e., an animal which is neither camel nor horse) and its meat, "I do not know anything except what I have seen."

chapter: The Book of Financial Transactions - كتاب البيوع
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:                     "A man had lent a camel of a certain age to the Prophet and he came to get it back. He said: "Give it to him" But they could only find a camel that was older than it. He said: "Give it to him." He said: "You have repaid me well," The Messenger of Allah said; "The best of you is the one who is best in repaying"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عمرو بن منصور، قال حدثنا أبو نعيم، قال حدثنا سفيان، عن سلمة بن كهيل، عن أبي سلمة، عن أبي هريرة، قال كان لرجل على النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم سن من الإبل فجاء يتقاضاه فقال ‏"‏ أعطوه ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فلم يجدوا إلا سنا فوق سنه قال ‏"‏ أعطوه ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فقال أوفيتني ‏.‏ فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إن خياركم أحسنكم قضاء ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Yazid Al-Ansari said that he heard a man asking Ibn Abbas about something in which there was no sin or blame on him (in it) so as to be able to do what is better than the one who did not commit any sin. So, Ibn Abu'l-Mulaikah asked 'Abdullah bin Yazid Al Ansari and said: "What does he say?" He replied: The Messenger of Allaah (sallaahu alayhi wa sallam) used to do that which was better than what the one who did not commit any sin would have done.
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Yazid said, "I heard a man asking Ibn Abbas about something in which there is no blame or sin on him (in it), so as to be able to do that which was better than the one who did not commit any sin." So, he asked me and said: What does 'Abdullah bin Yazid say?
I replied: The Messenger of Allaah used to do what is better.

chapter: The Book of Oaths and Vows - كتاب الأيمان والنذور
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:                      "I heard the Messenger of Allah say: 'Whoever vows to obey Allah, let him obey Him, and whoever vows to disobey Allah, let him not disobey Him.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن العلاء، قال حدثنا ابن إدريس، عن عبيد الله، عن طلحة بن عبد الملك، عن القاسم، عن عائشة، قالت سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول ‏"‏ من نذر أن يطيع الله فليطعه ومن نذر أن يعصي الله فلا يعصه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba'ah Al-Ansari said that he heard a man from Quraish say to another of them who was sitting in his company : "I have been fasting for forty days and I am afraid lest my eyesight should be affected." The other one asked him, saying: What do you mean ? He replied (to the latter) : "O Al-Aswad !"
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba'ah said that he heard a man from Quraish say to another of them who was sitting in his company.

chapter: The Book of Forgetfulness (In Prayer) - كتاب السهو
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Abdullah that:                     The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "It is as if I can see the whiteness of his cheek, saying to his right: As-salamu 'alaykum wa rahmatullah (peace be upon you and the mercy of Allah) and to his left: As-salamu 'alaykum wa rahmatullah (peace be upon you and the mercy of Allah)." (Sahih
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا زيد بن أخزم، عن ابن داود، - يعني عبد الله بن داود الخريبي - عن علي بن صالح، عن أبي إسحاق، عن أبي الأحوص، عن عبد الله، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال كأني أنظر إلى بياض خده عن يمينه ‏"‏ السلام عليكم ورحمة الله ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وعن يساره ‏"‏ السلام عليكم ورحمة الله ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba said that he asked Anas b. Malik about a man who had been absent-minded in prayer so much as to forget his kneeling down (between two prostrations) and the like of it, but did not do anything else wrong; what is your opinion? He replied: "He should be flogged with eighty stripes."

chapter: The Book of Financial Transactions - كتاب البيوع
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Hakim bin Hizam said:                     The Messenger of Allah said: "The two parties to a transaction have the choice so long as they have not separated. If they are honest and open, their transaction will be blessed, but if they tell lies and conceal anything the blessing of their transaction will be lost."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا أبو الأشعث، عن خالد، قال حدثنا سعيد، - وهو ابن أبي عروبة - عن قتادة، عن صالح أبي الخليل، عن عبد الله بن الحارث، عن حكيم بن حزام، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ البيعان بالخيار ما لم يفترقا فإن بينا وصدقا بورك لهما في بيعهما وإن كذبا وكتما محق بركة بيعهما ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: 'Abdullah bin 'Umar said to me while he was on a camel saddle (riding) "O son of my sister! I heard Al-Hasan narrating from his father that the Messenger of Allaah(sallallaahu `alayhi wa sallam) had forbidden wine and pork.

chapter: The Book of Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah said:                     "Whoever spends the nights of Ramadan in prayer (Qiyam) out of faith and in the hope of reward, he will be forgiven his previous sins." '
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا قتيبة، عن مالك، عن ابن شهاب، عن حميد بن عبد الرحمن، عن أبي هريرة، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ من قام رمضان إيمانا واحتسابا غفر له ما تقدم من ذنبه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What should I say if my wife is sick?" The Prophet replied, "(Say), 'Allahu-Rabba wa bi-hamdhi (May Allah give thanks to Him for His blessing) and praise (her and extol her good qualities).'

chapter: The Book of Zakah - كتاب الزكاة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Ash-Shabbi said:                     "Jarir said: 'The Messenger of Allah said: When the Zakah collector comes to you, let him leave happy with you."'
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا زياد بن أيوب، قال حدثنا إسماعيل، - هو ابن علية - قال أنبأنا داود، عن الشعبي، قال قال جرير قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إذا أتاكم المصدق فليصدر وهو عنكم راض ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man came to Allah's Apostle with his son who had an eye disease which caused him blindness and he asked (the nobleman) whether he could look at it, so he put his hand on the boy's eyes till he became unconscious. Then he took out a date or two and rubbed his hands over them and placed his fingers in the child's eye and then removed one of its eyeballs with those fingers which were smeared by that fruit, whereupon the Prophet said: "Do not do so! Do you judge between me and others even though I am Allah's Apostle?"

chapter: The Book of Oaths and Vows - كتاب الأيمان والنذور
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Abdur-Rahman bin Samurah said:                      "The Prophet said to me: 'If you swear an oath, and you see something that is better, then do that which is better and offer expiation for your oath.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا زياد بن أيوب، قال حدثنا هشيم، قال أنبأنا منصور، ويونس، عن الحسن، عن عبد الرحمن بن سمرة، قال قال لي النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إذا آليت على يمين فرأيت غيرها خيرا منها فأت الذي هو خير وكفر عن يمينك ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba'ah Al-Dhuhli said that he heard Anas bn Malik say to his wife when she had a dispute with her husband : "O woman, if you have any right over your husband then come and talk to him. And O man, if you have any right over this woman who is disputing with you, then go and talk to her."
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba'ah Al-Dhuhli said that he heard Anas bn Malik say : "If a person has no claim on his wife or she has none upon him, they should not be separated from each other. And if one of them claims the right over another then let there be an arbitrator between them."

chapter: The Book of Qiyam Al-Lail (The Night Prayer) and Voluntary Prayers During the Day - كتاب قيام الليل وتطوع النهار
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Abdullah bin 'Amr said:                     "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me: 'O Abdullah do not be like so-and-so; he used to pray Qiyam Al-Lail and then he stopped.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا الحارث بن أسد، قال حدثنا بشر بن بكر، قال حدثني الأوزاعي، قال حدثني يحيى بن أبي كثير، عن عمر بن الحكم بن ثوبان، قال حدثني أبو سلمة بن عبد الرحمن، عن عبد الله بن عمرو، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لا تكن يا عبد الله مثل فلان كان يقوم الليل فترك قيام الليل ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid Al-'Ansari said that he heard Anas bin Malik say to his wife while they were on a journey: "O woman! If you find anything (in my possession) which I have not given away as Sadaqah, then take it and give it in charity."
She replied: "I will do so if Allah wishes.

chapter: The Book of Marriage - كتاب النكاح
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Aishah that the Prophet said:                      "What becomes unlawful (for marriage) through birth becomes unlawful through breast-feeding."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عبيد الله بن سعيد، قال حدثنا يحيى، قال أنبأنا مالك، قال حدثني عبد الله بن دينار، عن سليمان بن يسار، عن عروة، عن عائشة، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ ما حرمته الولادة حرمه الرضاع ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more loved to me than my parents?" He replied, "(Your) mother." The man asked (the same question), so he was repeated and then for the third time too. Then he asked again, but this time it was not repeated; instead he said, 'That which makes you a child in your house.'
The Hadith is found here: http://sunnah.com/nasai/26/1

chapter: The Book Of Faith and its Signs - كتاب الإيمان وشرائعه
ground_truth_en: Abu Hurairah narrated that:                     The Messenger of Allah [SAW] said: "Whoever stands (in the voluntary night prayer of) Ramadan out of faith and in the hope of reward, his previous sins will be forgiven. And whoever spends the night of Lailat Al-Qadr in prayer out of faith and in the hope of reward, his previous sins will be forgiven."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو الأشعث قال حدثنا خالد يعني ابن الحارث قال حدثنا هشام عن يحيى بن أبي كثير عن أبي سلمة بن عبد الرحمن قال حدثني أبو هريرة  أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال من قام رمضان إيمانا واحتسابا غفر له ما تقدم من ذنبه ومن قام ليلة القدر إيمانا واحتسابا غفر له ما تقدم من ذنبه
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more loved to me?" The Prophet replied, 'Your Lord knows."

chapter: The Book of Zakah - كتاب الزكاة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah said: 'It is not permissible to give charity to a rich man (or one who is independent of means) or to one who is strong and healthy."'
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا هناد بن السري، عن أبي بكر، عن أبي حصين، عن سالم، عن أبي هريرة، قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لا تحل الصدقة لغني ولا لذي مرة سوي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What is more loved to Allah?" He replied: "A slave who has control over himself in pleasures."

chapter: The Book of The At-Tatbiq (Clasping One's Hands Together) - كتاب التطبيق
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Mus'ab bin Sa'd said:                     "I bowed and put my hands together, and my father said: 'This is something that we used to do, then we brought them up to our knees.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عمرو بن علي، قال حدثنا يحيى بن سعيد، عن إسماعيل بن أبي خالد، عن الزبير بن عدي، عن مصعب بن سعد، قال ركعت فطبقت فقال أبي إن هذا شىء كنا نفعله ثم ارتفعنا إلى الركب ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Hudhaifa said to me while I was at my mast (ship) that he had heard Al-Bara' bn Azib saying, "I saw a man from Ansar with his knee on the ground and another person standing over him. He asked for something which he did not give so much as even look towards it."

chapter: The Book of Drinks - كتاب الأشربة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Ibn Sirin said:                     "A man came to Ibn 'Umar and said: 'Our families make drinks for us by soaking (fruits) at night, and in the morning we drink them.' He said: 'I forbid you to drink intoxicants whether in small amounts or large. May Allah bear witness that I forbid you to drink intoxicants whether in small amounts or large. May Allah bear witness that the people of Khaibar used to make drinks by soaking such and such, and they called it such and such but it was Khamr. The people of Fadak used to make drinks by soaking such and such, and they called it such and such but it was Khamr.' And he listed four things, one of which was honey."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا سويد بن نصر، قال حدثنا عبد الله، عن ابن عون، عن ابن سيرين، قال جاء رجل إلى ابن عمر فقال إن أهلنا ينبذون لنا شرابا عشيا فإذا أصبحنا شربنا ‏.‏ قال أنهاك عن المسكر قليله وكثيره وأشهد الله عليك أنهاك عن المسكر قليله وكثيره وأشهد الله عليك إن أهل خيبر ينتبذون شرابا من كذا وكذا ويسمونه كذا وكذا وهي الخمر وإن أهل فدك ينتبذون شرابا من كذا وكذا يسمونه كذا وكذا وهي الخمر حتى عد أشربة أربعة أحدها العسل ‏.‏

chapter: The Book of Purification - كتاب الطهارة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Ayyub that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:                      "Water is for Water." [1][1] That is, water for peforming Ghusl is obligatory when the ejaculation of water (semen)occurs.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عبد الجبار بن العلاء، عن سفيان، عن عمرو، عن عبد الرحمن بن السائب، عن عبد الرحمن بن سعاد، عن أبي أيوب، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ الماء من الماء ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid Al'Ansari said that he heard a man asking about the Messenhah (i.e., Menstruating woman) who has got her menses while she is in the state of Ihram, and whether it should be slaughtered or not?
Ibn 'Umar replied to him: "No."

chapter: The Book of Oaths and Vows - كتاب الأيمان والنذور
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Hammad and Qatadah, concerning a man who said to another man:                      "I will lease (something) from you until I reach Makkah for such and such a payment, and if I travel for a month or such and such -something that he named- I will give you such and such in addition." They did not see anything wrong with that, but they did not like it if he said: "If I travel for more than a month I will deduct such and such from your lease."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد، قال حدثنا حبان، قال أنبأنا عبد الله، عن معمر، عن حماد، وقتادة، في رجل قال لرجل أستكري منك إلى مكة بكذا وكذا فإن سرت شهرا أو كذا وكذا شيئا سماه فلك زيادة كذا وكذا فلم يريا به بأسا وكرها أن يقول أستكري منك بكذا وكذا فإن سرت أكثر من شهر نقصت من كرائك كذا وكذا‏.‏‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad(sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam): "What is an oath for you, O Messenger of Allaah?" He replied: "A falsehood."

chapter: The Book of Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah said:                     "Do not fast ahead of the month, except for a man who habitually fasts, and that day happenes to be one of his regular fasts." '
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا إسحاق بن إبراهيم، قال أنبأنا الوليد، عن الأوزاعي، عن يحيى، عن أبي سلمة، عن أبي هريرة، عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ لا تقدموا قبل الشهر بصيام إلا رجل كان يصوم صياما أتى ذلك اليوم على صيامه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that a man asked Anas b. Malik about fasting on Friday. He replied: "It was (obligatory) upon us and we could not but do it."

chapter: The Book of Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Abdullah bin Shaqiq said:                     'I said to Aishah: 'did the Messenger of Allah offer Duah prayer?' she said: 'No, unless he was returning from a journey.' I said: 'was the Messenger of Allah known to observe any fast regularly apart from Ramadan?'' She said: 'by Allah, he did not observe any fast regularly apart from amadan until he passed away, and he did not break his fast for a whole month, rather he would fast some of it (each month).""( '
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا أبو الأشعث، عن يزيد، - وهو ابن زريع - قال حدثنا الجريري، عن عبد الله بن شقيق، قال قلت لعائشة أكان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يصلي صلاة الضحى قالت لا إلا أن يجيء من مغيبه ‏.‏ قلت هل كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم له صوم معلوم سوى رمضان قالت والله إن صام شهرا معلوما سوى رمضان حتى مضى لوجهه ولا أفطر حتى يصوم منه ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated `Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that his father told me : The Messenger of Allaah(sallaahu alayhi wa sallam)( may Allaah exalt his mention )said, "Fasting is to Me as the Qur'an was to Moses. For both were given to a chosen servant so that he might act upon it and teach others."

chapter: The Book of Financial Transactions - كتاب البيوع
ground_truth_en: it was narrated from Isla'il bin Ibrahim bin 'Abdullah bin Abi Rabi'ah, from his father, that his grandfather said:                     "The Prophet borrowed forty thousand from me, then some wealth came to him, and he paid me back and said: 'May Allah bless your family and your wealth for you: the reward for lending is praise and repayment."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عمرو بن علي، قال حدثنا عبد الرحمن، عن سفيان، عن إسماعيل بن إبراهيم بن عبد الله بن أبي ربيعة، عن أبيه، عن جده، قال استقرض مني النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أربعين ألفا فجاءه مال فدفعه إلى وقال ‏"‏ بارك الله لك في أهلك ومالك إنما جزاء السلف الحمد والأداء ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar : The Messenger of Allaah (sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam) said to me while I was playing with my brothers in a garment that he had given us, "O son of Khunaisa! Do not wear this garment on your body. If you do so it will be an act of shirk."
I asked 'Abdullah bin Umar : What is the meaning of his saying to me while I was playing with my brothers in a garment that he had given us, "O son of Khunaisa! Do not wear this garment on your body. If you do so it will be an act of shirk."
He said: He (sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam) meant to say :"Do not use the garments that Allaah has given as a means for committing sinful acts, and if you wear them then they are like idols which prevent your heart from being obedient."

chapter: The Book of Hunting and Slaughtering - كتاب الصيد والذبائح
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Uthman that:                     a physician made mention of the use of frogs in a remedy in the presence of the Messenger of Allah and the Messengher of Allah forbade killing them. (sahih)
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا قتيبة، قال حدثنا ابن أبي فديك، عن ابن أبي ذئب، عن سعيد بن خالد، عن سعيد بن المسيب، عن عبد الرحمن بن عثمان، أن طبيبا، ذكر ضفدعا في دواء عند رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فنهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن قتله ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Ibn Abbas said that a man asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about hunting with dogs? The Messenger of Allah (sallaahu alayhi wa sallam) replied, "It is not permissible for you to hunt with them.

chapter: The Book of the Qiblah - كتاب القبلة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Ibn Umar said:                      "While the people were in Quba praying Subh prayer, someone came to them and said that revelation had come to Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) the night before, and he had been commanded to face Ka'bah. So face toward it. They had been facing toward Ash-Sham, so they turned to face toward Ka'bah."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا قتيبة، عن مالك، عن عبد الله بن دينار، عن ابن عمر، قال بينما الناس بقباء في صلاة الصبح جاءهم آت فقال إن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قد أنزل عليه الليلة قرآن وقد أمر أن يستقبل القبلة ‏.‏ فاستقبلوها وكانت وجوههم إلى الشام فاستداروا إلى الكعبة ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying a Hadith like which I have narrated to you before, except that in this one the words were "Allah guides him whoever He will towards Himself."

chapter: The Book of Financial Transactions - كتاب البيوع
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Jabir said:                     'The Messenger of Allah paid off what he owed me, and gave me more."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن منصور، ومحمد بن عبد الله بن يزيد، عن سفيان، عن مسعر، عن محارب بن دثار، عن جابر، قال قضاني رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وزادني ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade us to eat of seven animals which are called by other than their proper names, namely, the dog and its offspring, pig and all kinds of wild cats.

chapter: The Book of Financial Transactions - كتاب البيوع
ground_truth_en: Iya bin 'Abd, the companion of the Prophet said:                     "do not sell surplus water, for the Prophet forbade the sale of surplus water."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا إبراهيم بن الحسن، عن حجاج، قال قال ابن جريج أخبرني عمرو بن دينار، أن أبا المنهال، أخبره أن إياس بن عبد صاحب النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال لا تبيعوا فضل الماء فإن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم نهى عن بيع فضل الماء ‏.‏
llm_response: Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad about his debt to him which he had forgotten. The Prophet told him to write it down in writing so as to be able to read it later on and then forgive the person who owed money to you, for Allah will not punish anyone until He has forbidden them from doing something or commanded them with an action that they do not perform; therefore if a man does good deeds but forgets about his debt he is still rewarded.

chapter: The Book of Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: Abu Hurairah said:                     "I heard the Messenger of Allah say: 'Allah, the mighty and sublime, said: Every deed of the son of Adam is for him, except fasting; it is for me and I shall reward for it. By the one in whose hand is the soul of Muhmmad, the smell coming from the mouth of the fasting person is better before Allah than the fragrance of musk." '
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا الربيع بن سليمان، قال حدثنا ابن وهب، قال أخبرني يونس، عن ابن شهاب، قال حدثني سعيد بن المسيب، أن أبا هريرة، قال سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول ‏"‏ قال الله عز وجل كل عمل ابن آدم له إلا الصيام هو لي وأنا أجزي به والذي نفس محمد بيده لخلفة فم الصائم أطيب عند الله من ريح المسك ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What should I say if my wife dies?" He replied: "If your wife dies then cover her with a garment."

chapter: The Book of the Adhan (The Call to Prayer) - كتاب الأذان
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Al-Aswad that Bilal said:                      "The final words of the Adhan are: 'Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar; La ilaha illallah (Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, there is none worthy of worship except Allah.)'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن معدان بن عيسى، قال حدثنا الحسن بن أعين، قال حدثنا زهير، قال حدثنا الأعمش، عن إبراهيم، عن الأسود، عن بلال، قال آخر الأذان الله أكبر الله أكبر لا إله إلا الله ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari (may Allaah be pleased with him): The Messenger of Allaah(sallallaahu `alayhi wa sallam) said, "If anyone hears the Adhan and does not respond to it then his prayer will not be accepted until he repents."

chapter: The Book of Purification - كتاب الطهارة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:                      "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) performed Wudu', and he scooped up one handful (of water) and rinsed his mouth and nose.
