Then he scooped up another handful and washed his face. Then he scooped up another handful and washed his right hand, then another handful and washed his left hand. Then he wiped his head and his ears, the inside with his forefinger and the outside with his thumb. Then he scooped up a handful of water and washed his right foot, and scooped up another handful and washed his left foot."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا مجاهد بن موسى، قال حدثنا عبد الله بن إدريس، قال حدثنا ابن عجلان، عن زيد بن أسلم، عن عطاء بن يسار، عن ابن عباس، قال توضأ رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فغرف غرفة فمضمض واستنشق ثم غرف غرفة فغسل وجهه ثم غرف غرفة فغسل يده اليمنى ثم غرف غرفة فغسل يده اليسرى ثم مسح برأسه وأذنيه باطنهما بالسباحتين وظاهرهما بإبهاميه ثم غرف غرفة فغسل رجله اليمنى ثم غرف غرفة فغسل رجله اليسرى ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Abu Hurairah said : The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to us in a state of Ihram at Dhu-l Hulayfa as we were sitting with Salman bin Amir al-Ajurri. He asked for water and drank it, then he wiped over his head and beard saying : "Do not use oil or ointment on your heads (or hair) till you reach Mecca."
Hadith Number:  102

chapter: The Book of Ghusl and Tayammum - كتاب الغسل والتيمم
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:                      "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'While Ayyub, peace be upon him, was bathing naked, locusts of gold landed on him and he started to collect them in his garment. Then his Lord called him (saying): "O Ayyub, did I not make you rich?" he said: "Yes, O Lord, but I cannot do without Your blessing."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا أحمد بن حفص بن عبد الله، قال حدثني أبي قال، حدثني إبراهيم، عن موسى بن عقبة، عن صفوان بن سليم، عن عطاء بن يسار، عن أبي هريرة، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏‏"‏‏ بينما أيوب عليه الصلاة والسلام يغتسل عريانا خر عليه جراد من ذهب فجعل يحثي في ثوبه قال فناداه ربه عز وجل يا أيوب ألم أكن أغنيتك قال بلى يا رب ولكن لا غنى بي عن بركاتك ‏‏"‏‏ ‏‏.‏‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that a man asked the Messenger of Allaah (sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam): "What is more important for me?" He replied, "(The most important thing for you) is to perform ablution properly."
He then added: "If anyone does not do so and he has a wet dream or forgetfulness during the daytime (of Ramadan), let him complete his fast as it was done in the beginning. If someone dies, they should be buried at night time."

chapter: The Book of Oaths and Vows - كتاب الأيمان والنذور
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Sa'eed said:                      "The Messenger of Allah forbade Al-Muhaqalah." Sa'eed said: "And he narrated something similar." And Sufyan Ath-Thawri reported it from Tariq.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا أحمد بن سليمان، قال حدثنا عبيد الله بن موسى، قال أنبأنا إسرائيل، عن طارق، عن سعيد، قال نهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن المحاقلة قال سعيد فذكره نحوه‏.‏‏ رواه سفيان الثوري عن طارق‏.‏‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (RA) said that a man asked Allah's Apostle what to say if he wanted to make an oath or vow? He replied: Say "By Him Who glorifies Himself."

chapter: The Book of Adornment - كتاب الزينة من السنن
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri said:                     "The Messenger of Allah [SAW] forbade Ishtimal As-Samma' and wrapping oneself in a single garment (that did not cover the private parts)."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا الحسين بن حريث، قال أنبأنا سفيان، عن الزهري، عن عطاء بن يزيد، عن أبي سعيد الخدري، قال نهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن اشتمال الصماء وأن يحتبي الرجل في ثوب واحد ليس على فرجه منه شىء ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba said that he heard Abu Hurairah (radhiyallahu anho) say : The Messenhilah is a part of your prayer; so if you find anything in it, then remove it from the middle.

chapter: The Book of Zakah - كتاب الزكاة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that:                     Ibn 'Abbas said concerning Sadaqatul-Fitr. "A Sa' of wheat, or a Sa' of dates, or Sa of barley, or a Sa' of rye." (Sahih Mawquf)
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا علي بن ميمون، عن مخلد، عن هشام، عن ابن سيرين، عن ابن عباس، قال ذكر في صدقة الفطر قال صاعا من بر أو صاعا من تمر أو صاعا من شعير أو صاعا من سلت ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What should I say if my mother or father died?" He replied, "(Say), 'Allah! Nothing is given except from Him.'"

chapter: The Book of Hajj - كتاب مناسك الحج
ground_truth_en: Jafar bin Muhammad said:                     "My father told me: 'We came to Jabir bin Abdullah and asked him about the Hajj of the Prophet. He told us that the Prophet said: "Allah of Arafat is the place of standing."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا يعقوب بن إبراهيم، قال حدثنا يحيى بن سعيد، قال حدثنا جعفر بن محمد، قال حدثنا أبي قال، أتينا جابر بن عبد الله فسألناه عن حجة النبي، صلى الله عليه وسلم فحدثنا أن نبي الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ عرفة كلها موقف ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (RA): The Messenger of Allaah(saw) said to me while he was at Dhu'l-Hijjah or in some other year, "O son of my brother! Go and perform Hajj." I went out with the people until we reached a place called Thaniyat. Then I returned from there without performing any pilgrimage because it had become too expensive for me to do so.

chapter: The Book of Adornment - كتاب الزينة من السنن
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Sahl bin Sa'd said:                     "A woman brought a Burdah" - Sahl said: "Do you know what a Burdah is?" They said: "Yes, it is a cloak with two woven borders" - and she said: 'O Messenger of Allah, I wove this with my own hands for you to wear.' The Messenger of Allah [SAW] took it as he had need of it, then he came out to us and he was wearing it as his Izar (lower garment)."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا قتيبة، قال أنبأنا يعقوب، عن أبي حازم، عن سهل بن سعد، قال جاءت امرأة ببردة - قال سهل - هل تدرون ما البردة قالوا نعم هذه الشملة منسوج في حاشيتها ‏.‏ فقالت يا رسول الله إني نسجت هذه بيدي أكسوكها فأخذها رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم محتاجا إليها فخرج إلينا وإنها لإزاره ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Allah's Messenger what he should say if one of his companions died? He replied "Say Inna lillahi wa ina ilahi rajiun" (To Allah we belong and to Him is our return).

chapter: The Book of Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Anas that the Prophet said:                     "Allah has waived meaning half of the prayer and fasting for the traveler, and from pregnant women and the sick. "(Hanas)
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عمر بن محمد بن الحسن بن التل، قال حدثنا أبي قال، حدثنا سفيان الثوري، عن أيوب، عن أبي قلابة، عن أنس، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ إن الله وضع عن المسافر نصف الصلاة والصوم وعن الحبلى والمرضع ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar : The Messenger of Allaah (sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam) said to me while I was fasting in Sha'ban, "O son of my brother! Fast one or two days before Ramadan and then proceed with the month."

chapter: The Book of Menstruation and Istihadah - كتاب الحيض والاستحاضة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:                      "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would tell one of us, if she was menstruating, to tie her Izar (waist wrap) tightly then he would fondle her."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا قتيبة، قال حدثنا أبو الأحوص، عن أبي إسحاق، عن عمرو بن شرحبيل، عن عائشة، قالت كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يأمر إحدانا إذا كانت حائضا أن تشد إزارها ثم يباشرها ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that a man asked Anas b. Malik about his wives who had menstrual discharge while they were in their houses or on some road, and he was afraid of the people to enter upon them? He replied: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out with us one day when we asked him this question. We said: 'O Messenger of Allah! What do you say about a man who has menstrual discharge while he is in his house or on some road? He replied, "If any woman from among the people had menstruation and she was afraid that her husband would enter upon her (in spite of it), let her put something into her vagina. Then if anyone enters upon them they will not be able to detect anything."
Reference: 373

chapter: The Book of Drinks - كتاب الأشربة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin 'Amr that:                     The Prophet [SAW] said: "Whoever drinks Khamr and puts it in his belly, Allah will not accept his Salah for seven (days), if he dies during them" - Muhammad bin Adam (One of the narrators) said: "he will die a Kafir. If he was too intoxicated to offer any of the obligatory" - Ibn Adam said: "or recite Qur'an, his Salah will not be accepted for 40 days, and if he dies during them," And Ibn Adam said: "He will die a Kafir."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرني محمد بن آدم بن سليمان، عن عبد الرحيم، عن يزيد، ح وأنبأنا واصل بن عبد الأعلى، حدثنا ابن فضيل، عن يزيد بن أبي زياد، عن مجاهد، عن عبد الله بن عمرو، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وقال محمد بن آدم عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ من شرب الخمر فجعلها في بطنه لم يقبل الله منه صلاة سبعا إن مات فيها ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وقال ابن آدم ‏"‏ فيهن مات كافرا فإن أذهبت عقله عن شىء من الفرائض ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وقال ابن آدم ‏"‏ القرآن لم تقبل له صلاة أربعين يوما إن مات فيها ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وقال ابن آدم ‏"‏ فيهن مات كافرا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What is more loved to Allah?" He replied: "A slave who has control over himself in pleasure as well as anger."

chapter: The Book of Jumu'ah (Friday Prayer) - كتاب الجمعة
ground_truth_en: Abu Al-Ash'ath narrated that:                     He heard Aws bin Aws, the Companion of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Whoever performs Ghusl on Friday and washes (ghassala), and comes early to the masjid, walking not riding, and sits close to the imam and listens attentively and does not engage in idle speech, for every step he takes he will have (the reward of) a year's worth of good deeds.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرني عمرو بن عثمان بن سعيد بن كثير، قال حدثنا الوليد، عن عبد الرحمن بن يزيد بن جابر، أنه سمع أبا الأشعث، حدثه أنه، سمع أوس بن أوس، صاحب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ من اغتسل يوم الجمعة وغسل وغدا وابتكر ومشى ولم يركب ودنا من الإمام وأنصت ولم يلغ كان له بكل خطوة عمل سنة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari (may Allaah be pleased with him): The Messenger of Allaah (sallallaahu `alayhi wa sallam) said, "Whoever prayed the two Rakat before Jumu'a and then sat until he heard the Adhan for Friday prayer was like a bird that has built its nest on an elm tree. Then when it sees people gathering (for Salah), it flies away."
Reference: 1437

chapter: The Book of Oaths and Vows - كتاب الأيمان والنذور
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:                      "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Do not swear by your fathers, nor by your mothers nor by the idols. Swear only by Allah, and do not swear unless you are sincere.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا أبو بكر بن علي، قال حدثنا عبيد الله بن معاذ، قال حدثنا أبي قال، حدثنا عوف، عن محمد بن سيرين، عن أبي هريرة، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لا تحلفوا بآبائكم ولا بأمهاتكم ولا بالأنداد ولا تحلفوا إلا بالله ولا تحلفوا إلا وأنتم صادقون ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man came to Allah's Apostle while he was at Dhul-Hulaifa on his way from Makkah to Medina with some of his companions and asked, "O Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him), which is the greatest sin?" He said: "To join others in worshiping God." The man further asked: "Which is the next (greatest) sin?" He replied: "To treat an orphan badly." Then he again asked, and for the third time I heard that question of his but there was no reply other than this.

chapter: The Book of Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah said; 'Take Sahur, for in Sahur there is blessing.""
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا علي بن سعيد بن جرير، - نسائي - قال حدثنا أبو الربيع، قال حدثنا منصور بن أبي الأسود، عن عبد الملك بن أبي سليمان، عن عطاء، عن أبي هريرة، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تسحروا فإن في السحور بركة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that his father told him that he had seen a man from Quraish who was fasting in Ramadan while they were with Rasool Allaah (sallaahu `alayhi wa sallam) and the Prophet asked them: "Do you know what this person is doing?"
They said, "No." So he told him to break his fast. The man then broke his fast in front of all those who were present there with Rasool Allaah (sallaahu `alayhi wa sallam).

chapter: The Book of the Times (of Prayer) - كتاب المواقيت
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:                      "Whoever forgets a prayer, let him pray it when he remembers it, for Allah says: and perform the Salah for My remembrance." [1][1] Ta-Ha 20:14.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عمرو بن سواد بن الأسود بن عمرو، قال أنبأنا ابن وهب، قال أنبأنا يونس، عن ابن شهاب، عن سعيد بن المسيب، عن أبي هريرة، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ من نسي صلاة فليصلها إذا ذكرها فإن الله تعالى قال ‏{‏ أقم الصلاة لذكري ‏}‏ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik : The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me while I was playing with my brothers in front of his mosque when it had been built : "O 'Anas, go and call the people for prayer." So I went out calling them. Then he sent someone else after a little time saying: "Go again and tell them that if they do not come to me then Allah will give their places (to others)."

chapter: The Book of Zakah - كتاب الزكاة
ground_truth_en: 'Abdullah bin Umar said:                     "I heard 'Umar, may Allah be pleased with him, say: The Prophet used to give me payment and I would say: Give it to someone who is more, in need of it than I am, until one day he gave me some money and I said to him: Give it to someone who is more in need of it than I am. He said: Take it and keep it or give it in charity. Whatever comes to you of this wealth when you are not hoping for it and not asking for it, take it, and whatever does not, then do not wish for it. "'
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عمرو بن منصور، قال حدثنا الحكم بن نافع، قال أنبأنا شعيب، عن الزهري، قال أخبرني سالم بن عبد الله، أن عبد الله بن عمر، قال سمعت عمر، رضى الله عنه يقول كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يعطيني العطاء فأقول أعطه أفقر إليه مني حتى أعطاني مرة مالا فقلت له أعطه أفقر إليه مني ‏.‏ فقال ‏"‏ خذه فتموله وتصدق به وما جاءك من هذا المال وأنت غير مشرف ولا سائل فخذه وما لا فلا تتبعه نفسك ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more loved to me than my parents?" He replied, "(Your own) mother." The man asked (the same question), and he repeated it for the second time; still he gave him the same answer. Then he asked again and he repeated it for the third time: but this time Allah's Apostle said," Your father"

chapter: The Book of Jumu'ah (Friday Prayer) - كتاب الجمعة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Aws bin Aws that :                     The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "One of the best of your days is Friday. On this day, Adam was created and on this day he died, on this day the Trumpet will be blown, and on this day all creatures will swoon. So send a great deal of salah upon me on this day, for your salah will be presented to me." They said: "O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), how will our salah be presented to you when you have decomposed (after death)?" He said: "Allah (SWT), the Mighty and Sublime, has forbidden the earth to consume the bodies of the prophets, peace be upon them."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا إسحاق بن منصور، قال حدثنا حسين الجعفي، عن عبد الرحمن بن يزيد بن جابر، عن أبي الأشعث الصنعاني، عن أوس بن أوس، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ إن من أفضل أيامكم يوم الجمعة فيه خلق آدم عليه السلام وفيه قبض وفيه النفخة وفيه الصعقة فأكثروا على من الصلاة فإن صلاتكم معروضة على ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قالوا يا رسول الله وكيف تعرض صلاتنا عليك وقد أرمت أى يقولون قد بليت ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ إن الله عز وجل قد حرم على الأرض أن تأكل أجساد الأنبياء عليهم السلام ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid Al'Ansari (Alayhis salaam): The Messenger of Allaah(sallaahu alaiyhi wa sallam) said, "Whoever prayed the two Rakat before Jumu'a and then sat until he heard the Adhan for Friday prayer is as if he had fasted all his life."
Reference: 14/205

chapter: The Book of Qiyam Al-Lail (The Night Prayer) and Voluntary Prayers During the Day - كتاب قيام الليل وتطوع النهار
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:                     "I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) praying while sitting cross-legged."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا هارون بن عبد الله، قال حدثنا أبو داود الحفري، عن حفص، عن حميد، عن عبد الله بن شقيق، عن عائشة، قالت رأيت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يصلي متربعا ‏.‏ قال أبو عبد الرحمن لا أعلم أحدا روى هذا الحديث غير أبي داود وهو ثقة ولا أحسب هذا الحديث إلا خطأ والله تعالى أعلم ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying "The most blessed of all nights to our nation is Laylat al-Qadr." They asked, "O Allah's Apostle! Where is it?" He replied: "Allah and I know best. It is one of the odd nights in the last ten (remaining) nights of Ramadan (i.e., we cannot specify which specific night)."

chapter: The Book of Wills - كتاب الوصايا
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that Sa'd asked the Prophet:                      "My mother died and did not leave a will; shall I give charity on her behalf?" He said: "Yes."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا الحسين بن عيسى، قال أنبأنا سفيان، عن عمرو، عن عكرمة، عن ابن عباس، أن سعدا، سأل النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إن أمي ماتت ولم توص أفأتصدق عنها قال ‏"‏ نعم ‏"‏‏.‏
llm_response:
Abu Hurairah said that a man came to Prophet Muhammad (salla Allahu 'alayhi wa sallam) with his will written in leather saying "O Messenger of God! I have made this for my wife and children." The Prophet replied, "Write it on paper so you can read it easily.
Narrated by Abu Hurairah (radiallahu 'anhu).

chapter: The Book of Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:                     "the Messenger of Allah said: 'Fast when you see it and stop fasting  when you see it, and if it is obscured from you (too cloudy), then count it as thirty (days). "'
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا مؤمل بن هشام، عن إسماعيل، عن شعبة، عن محمد بن زياد، عن أبي هريرة، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ صوموا لرؤيته وأفطروا لرؤيته فإن غم عليكم الشهر فعدوا ثلاثين ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What should I say if my wife dies?" He replied: "If your wife dies, you should say: 'Allahumma barghiniha wa shfa'hu min al-dunya wal jannah bi yadkhilnihi min sharri ayyammin fa ana munakhtarihim.'"
Translation by Yusuf Ali (The Holy Quran)

chapter: The Book of Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah mentioned Ramadan and said:                     "Do not fast until you see the crescent, and do not stop fasting until you see it, and if it is obscured from you (too cloudy), then work it out."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن سلمة، والحارث بن مسكين، قراءة عليه وأنا أسمع، - واللفظ له - عن ابن القاسم، عن مالك، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ذكر رمضان فقال ‏"‏ لا تصوموا حتى تروا الهلال ولا تفطروا حتى تروه فإن غم عليكم فاقدروا له ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What kind of fasting is best?" He replied,"One who does not eat dried dates (before breaking his fast) but breaks it with fresh date."

chapter: The Book of Drinks - كتاب الأشربة
ground_truth_en: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri narrated that:                     The Prophet [SAW] forbade mixing Al-Busr with dried dates, or raisins with dried dates, or raisins with Al-Busr, and he said: "Whoever among you (wants to) drink them, let him drink each one on its own."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرني أحمد بن خالد، قال حدثنا شعيب بن حرب، قال حدثنا إسماعيل بن مسلم، قال حدثنا أبو المتوكل الناجي، قال حدثني أبو سعيد الخدري، أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم نهى أن يخلط بسرا بتمر أو زبيبا بتمر أو زبيبا ببسر وقال ‏"‏ من شرب منكم فليشرب كل واحد منه فردا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال أبو عبد الرحمن هذا أبو المتوكل اسمه علي بن داود ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Yazid Al-Ansari said that he heard Ibn Abbas (RA) say: "The Messenger of Allaah(SAW), may peace be upon him, used to drink wine and then fast."

chapter: The Book of Drinks - كتاب الأشربة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Aishah, may Allah be pleased with her, that :                     The Messenger of Allah [SAW] was asked about mead and he said: "Every drink that intoxicates is unlawful," and mead is made from honey.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا سويد، قال أنبأنا عبد الله، عن معمر، عن الزهري، عن أبي سلمة، عن عائشة، رضى الله عنها أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم سئل عن البتع فقال ‏"‏ كل شراب أسكر فهو حرام والبتع من العسل ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba said that he heard his father say to him while they were on a journey : "O my son ! I have been informed about some of your deeds which you are doing, so beware lest Allah should seal over your heart."

chapter: The Book of Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: An-Nadr bin Shaiban narrated that he met Abu Salamah bin 'Abdur-Rahman and said to him:                     "Tell me of the best thing you heard about the month of Ramadan." Abu Salamah said: "Abdur-Rahman bin 'Awf told me that the Messenger of Allah mentioned Ramadan and said that it is superior to other months, and he said: 'Whoever spends the nights of Ramadan in prayer (Qiyam) out of faith and in the hope of reward, he will emerge from his sins as on the day his mother bore him."'(Daif)Abu 'Abdur-Rahman (An-Nasai) said: This is a mistake, and what is correct is "Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا إسحاق بن إبراهيم، قال حدثنا الفضل بن دكين، قال حدثنا نصر بن علي، قال حدثني النضر بن شيبان، أنه لقي أبا سلمة بن عبد الرحمن فقال له حدثني بأفضل، شىء سمعته يذكر، في شهر رمضان ‏.‏ فقال أبو سلمة حدثني عبد الرحمن بن عوف، عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه ذكر شهر رمضان ففضله على الشهور وقال ‏"‏ من قام رمضان إيمانا واحتسابا خرج من ذنوبه كيوم ولدته أمه ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال أبو عبد الرحمن هذا خطأ والصواب أبو سلمة عن أبي هريرة ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad  about fasting on Friday only; he replied,'It is voluntary but if anyone observes it, then he has done well.'

chapter: The Book of Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Muadh bin Jabal said:                     "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Fasting is a shield."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن المثنى، ومحمد بن بشار، قالا حدثنا محمد، قال حدثنا شعبة، عن الحكم، قال سمعت عروة بن النزال، يحدث عن معاذ، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الصوم جنة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba said that he heard Abu Hurairah say "The Messenger of Allaah (sallaahu alayhi wa sallam) used to fast on a Monday and Thursday."

chapter: The Book of Purification - كتاب الطهارة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Ali said:                      "I felt too shy to ask the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about prostatic fluid because of Fatimah, so I told Al-Miqdad bin Al-Aswad to ask about it, and he (the Prophet (ﷺ)) said: 'Perform Wudu' for that.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن عبد الأعلى، قال حدثنا خالد، عن شعبة، قال أخبرني سليمان، قال سمعت منذرا، عن محمد بن علي، عن علي، قال استحييت أن أسأل النبي، صلى الله عليه وسلم عن المذى من أجل فاطمة فأمرت المقداد بن الأسود فسأله فقال ‏"‏ فيه الوضوء ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What should I say when I perform ablution?" The Prophet replied, "(Say), 'O Lord! I am performing ablution for no other purpose than to worship You."

chapter: The Book of Adornment - كتاب الزينة من السنن
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Razin said:                     "I saw Abu Hurairah clap his hand to his forehead and say: 'O people of Al-'Iraq, you claim that I tell lies about the Messenger of Allah [SAW]. I bear witness that I heard the Messenger of Allah [SAW] say: If the strap of the sandal of one of you breaks, let him not walk in the other until he fixes it.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا إسحاق بن إبراهيم، قال أخبرنا أبو معاوية، قال حدثنا الأعمش، عن أبي رزين، قال رأيت أبا هريرة يضرب بيده على جبهته يقول يا أهل العراق تزعمون أني أكذب على رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أشهد لسمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول ‏"‏ إذا انقطع شسع نعل أحدكم فلا يمش في الأخرى حتى يصلحها ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (Allah be pleased with him) said that Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) forbade a man to wear silk on his head, and he also prohibited the wearing of gold rings.

chapter: The Book of Qiyam Al-Lail (The Night Prayer) and Voluntary Prayers During the Day - كتاب قيام الليل وتطوع النهار
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:                     "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'On the night on which I was taken on the Night Journey, I passed by Musa, peace be upon him, and he was praying in his grave.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا علي بن خشرم، قال حدثنا عيسى، عن سليمان التيمي، عن أنس بن مالك، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مررت ليلة أسري بي على موسى عليه السلام وهو يصلي في قبره ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba' said that he heard Allahs Apostle saying "The most detestable thing to me are those who have a lot of money but they neither give in charity nor even help their relatives."

chapter: The Book of Qiyam Al-Lail (The Night Prayer) and Voluntary Prayers During the Day - كتاب قيام الليل وتطوع النهار
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abdullah said:                     "A man said: 'O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). So-and-so slept and missed the prayer yesterday until morning came.' He said: 'The Shaitan has urinated in that one's ears.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عمرو بن علي، قال حدثنا عبد العزيز بن عبد الصمد، قال حدثنا منصور، عن أبي وائل، عن عبد الله، أن رجلا، قال يا رسول الله إن فلانا نام عن الصلاة البارحة حتى أصبح ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ ذاك شيطان بال في أذنيه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba'ah Al-Ansari (may Allaahu be pleased with him): I heard Anas Bin Malik (May Allaah Be Pleased With Him) say, "The Messenger of Allaah (sallallahu alaihi wa sallam) used to sleep on his right side and turn over upon his left. Then he would lie down in that position until the time for prayer."

chapter: The Book of Eclipses - كتاب الكسوف
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from An-Nu'man bin Bashir that :                     The Prophet (ﷺ) came rushing out to the masjid one day when the sun eclipsed, and he prayed until the eclipse ended, then he said: "The people of Jahilliyyah used to say that eclipses of the sun and the moon only happened when some great man on earth died. But eclipses of the sun and the moon do not happen for the death or birth of anyone. Rather they are two of the creations of Allah (SWT) and Allah (SWT) causes to happen in His creation what He wills. Whichever of them becomes eclipsed, pray until it is over or Allah (SWT) causes something to happen."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن بشار، قال حدثنا معاذ بن هشام، قال حدثني أبي، عن قتادة، عن الحسن، عن النعمان بن بشير، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه خرج يوما مستعجلا إلى المسجد وقد انكسفت الشمس فصلى حتى انجلت ثم قال ‏"‏ إن أهل الجاهلية كانوا يقولون إن الشمس والقمر لا ينخسفان إلا لموت عظيم من عظماء أهل الأرض وإن الشمس والقمر لا ينخسفان لموت أحد ولا لحياته ولكنهما خليقتان من خلقه يحدث الله في خلقه ما يشاء فأيهما انخسف فصلوا حتى ينجلي أو يحدث الله أمرا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Anas bin Malik said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was informed about a solar eclipse while he was with some people in their houses so they came out running and prostrating till they reached him, whereupon he stood up until all of them had joined him.
Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Praise be to Allah."

chapter: The Book of Wills - كتاب الوصايا
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Muhammad bin Sa'd, from his father Sa'd bin Malik, that the Prophet came to him when he was sick and he said:                      "I do not have any children apart from one daughter. Shall I bequeath all my wealth?" The Prophet said: "No." He said: "Shall I bequeath half of it?" The Prophet said: "No." He said: "Shall I bequeath one-third of it?" He said: "One-third, and one-third is much or large."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن المثنى، قال حدثنا حجاج بن المنهال، قال حدثنا همام، عن قتادة، عن يونس بن جبير، عن محمد بن سعد، عن أبيه، سعد بن مالك أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم جاءه وهو مريض فقال إنه ليس لي ولد إلا ابنة واحدة فأوصي بمالي كله قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لا ‏"‏‏.‏ قال فأوصي بنصفه قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لا ‏"‏‏.‏ قال فأوصي بثلثه قال ‏"‏ الثلث والثلث كثير ‏"‏‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) who had died leaving ten daughters only without any property; so he asked him saying "What about their inheritance?" The Prophet replied, "(Their share is the same as of one daughter)."
Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) who had died leaving ten daughters only without any property; so he asked him saying "What about their inheritance?" The Prophet replied, "(Their share is the same as of one daughter)."

chapter: The Book of Drinks - كتاب الأشربة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Sulaiman At-Taimi and Ibrahim bin Maisarah said:                     "We heard Tawus say: 'A man came to Ibn 'Umar and said: Did the Messenger of Allah [SAW] forbid soaking (fruits) in earthenware jars? He said: 'Yes.' Ibrahim added in his Hadith: "And Ad-Dubba' (gourds).'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا هارون بن زيد بن يزيد بن أبي الزرقاء، قال حدثني أبي قال، حدثنا شعبة، عن سليمان التيمي، وإبراهيم بن ميسرة، قالا سمعنا طاوسا، يقول جاء رجل إلى ابن عمر قال أنهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن نبيذ الجر قال نعم ‏.‏ زاد إبراهيم في حديثه والدباء ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas (may Allaah be pleased with him) say to his wife who had asked for divorce, "I have been married to you and I am not going to give a piece of my body as an inheritance."
Reference: 5615

chapter: The Book of Qiyam Al-Lail (The Night Prayer) and Voluntary Prayers During the Day - كتاب قيام الليل وتطوع النهار
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Aishah that:                     The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to pray witr with nine and pray two rak'ahs sitting down.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن بشار، قال حدثنا حجاج، قال حدثنا حماد، عن قتادة، عن الحسن، عن سعد بن هشام، عن عائشة، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان يوتر بتسع ويركع ركعتين وهو جالس ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Anas b. Malik say to his wife while they were on a journey with their son who was suckling him, "O my mother! Do not give the boy any food until I ask for it." So she did so and when evening came (and) 'Abdullah asked her for some of that which he had given as alms to his wife in charity. She gave a date or two from what was left, but they were too few; whereupon Anas said: "I have not eaten the food you fed me since morning."
So I went back with him and found Khadija bint Khuwaylid at their place (and) she had prepared some of that which he gave as alms to his wife in charity, so they ate all but two or three dates.

chapter: The Book of Wills - كتاب الوصايا
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Aishah that a man said to the Messenger of Allah:                      "My mother died unexpectedly; if she had been able to speak she would have given charity. Should I give charity on her behalf?" The Messenger of Allah said: "Yes." So he gave charity on her behalf.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن سلمة، قال حدثنا ابن القاسم، عن مالك، عن هشام بن عروة، عن أبيه، عن عائشة، أن رجلا، قال لرسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إن أمي افتلتت نفسها وإنها لو تكلمت تصدقت أفأتصدق عنها فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ نعم ‏"‏‏.‏ فتصدق عنها‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar...

chapter: The Book of Purification - كتاب الطهارة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Talhah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:                      "Perform Wudu' from that which has been altered by fire."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عبيد الله بن سعيد، وهارون بن عبد الله، قالا حدثنا حرمي، - وهو ابن عمارة بن أبي حفصة - قال حدثنا شعبة، عن عمرو بن دينار، قال سمعت يحيى بن جعدة، يحدث عن عبد الله بن عمرو القاري، عن أبي طلحة، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ توضئوا مما غيرت النار ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Allahs Apostle saying, "Allah has made My (Sacred) Mosque like one of you in respect of cleanliness from urine."

chapter: The Book of Cutting off the Hand of the Thief - كتاب قطع السارق
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Aishah that the Messenger of Allah said:                     "(The thief's hand) is not to be cut off except for the price of a shield, one-third of a Dinar or half of Dinar, or more."
ground_truth_ar: أنبأنا هارون بن سعيد، قال حدثني خالد بن نزار، قال حدثنا القاسم بن مبرور، عن يونس، عن ابن شهاب، أخبرني عروة، عن عائشة، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ لا تقطع اليد إلا في ثمن المجن ثلث دينار أو نصف دينار فصاعدا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade us to eat of seven animals which are wild beasts having claws or fangs; they include a dog, an ox with horns and the hare.

chapter: The Book of The At-Tatbiq (Clasping One's Hands Together) - كتاب التطبيق
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that:                     The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "I have been commanded to prostrate on seven bones: on the forehead"- and he pointed with his hand- "on the nose, the hands, the knees and the ends of the feet."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عمرو بن منصور النسائي، قال حدثنا المعلى بن أسد، قال حدثنا وهيب، عن عبد الله بن طاوس، عن أبيه، عن ابن عباس، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ أمرت أن أسجد على سبعة أعظم على الجبهة وأشار بيده على الأنف واليدين والركبتين وأطراف القدمين ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba'ah Al-Ansaari said that he heard Anas Bin Malik say to his wife when she had given birth to a child: "O woman! Do you see this? This is the reward of your patience."

chapter: The Book of Eclipses - كتاب الكسوف
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Aishah said:                     "There was an eclipse of the sun during the time of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He stood and prayed, standing for a very long time, then he bowed for a very long time. Then he stood up and (remained standing) for a very long time, but shorter than the first time. Then he bowed for a very long time, but shorter than the first time. Then he prostrated, then he raised his head and stood for a long time, but it was shorter than the first time. The he stood up and (remained standing) for a long time, but it was shorter than the first time. Then he prostrated, and when he finished his prayer, the eclipse had ended. He addressed the people and praised and glorified Allah, then he said: 'The sun and the moon do not become eclipsed for the death or birth of anyone. If you see that then pray, give in charity, and remember Allah, the Mighty and Sublime.' And he said: 'O Ummah of Muhammad! There is no one who is more jealous than Allah (SWT) when His male or female slave commits Zina. O Ummah of Muhammad, if you knew what I know, you would laugh little and weep much.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا إسحاق بن إبراهيم، قال حدثنا عبدة، قال حدثنا هشام بن عروة، عن أبيه، عن عائشة، قالت خسفت الشمس على عهد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقام فصلى فأطال القيام جدا ثم ركع فأطال الركوع جدا ثم رفع فأطال القيام جدا وهو دون القيام الأول ثم ركع فأطال الركوع وهو دون الركوع الأول ثم سجد ثم رفع رأسه فأطال القيام وهو دون القيام الأول ثم ركع فأطال الركوع وهو دون الركوع الأول ثم رفع فأطال القيام وهو دون القيام الأول ثم ركع فأطال الركوع وهو دون الركوع الأول ثم سجد ففرغ من صلاته وقد جلي عن الشمس فخطب الناس فحمد الله وأثنى عليه ثم قال ‏"‏ إن الشمس والقمر لا ينكسفان لموت أحد ولا لحياته فإذا رأيتم ذلك فصلوا وتصدقوا واذكروا الله عز وجل ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وقال ‏"‏ يا أمة محمد إنه ليس أحد أغير من الله عز وجل أن يزني عبده أو أمته يا أمة محمد لو تعلمون ما أعلم لضحكتم قليلا ولبكيتم كثيرا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that a man asked Anas b. Malik about an eclipse of the moon so he went to him at his home in Medina and found there some people who were sitting with him, among them was Abu Hurairah (radhiyallahu 'anhum). So when they saw me they got up from their seats and made way for me. Anas b. Malik then said: "O son of the Prophet! What is this that you have done? They were sitting with us."
Anas replied, "They are not like those who sit in order to listen but rather they came so as to see what I would do and thus be able to go back (to their people) and tell them about it. So when the eclipse of the moon occurred he said: 'The sun and the moon is one.'"
Anas b. Malik then went on saying, "I was with Abu Talha in Sham so we were sitting at nighttime eating together." Anas continued to say that they had a great amount of food before them but none would eat until I did (so as not to be deprived). So when it became time for me to begin eating, he said: 'Eat and do not refrain.'"
Anas then went on saying "I was with Abu Talha in Sham

chapter: The Book of Divorce - كتاب الطلاق
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Humaid bin Nafi' that Zainab bint Abi Salamah told him these three Hadiths. Zainab said:                      "I entered upon Umm Habibah, the wife of the Prophet, when her father Abu Sufyan bin Harb died. Umm Habibah called for some perfume and put some on a young girl, then she put some on her cheeks. Then she said: 'By Allah, I do not have any need for perfume but I heard the Messenger of Allah say: It is not permissible for any woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to mourn for anyone who dies for more than three days, except for a husband, (for whom the mourning period is) four months and ten days.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن سلمة، والحارث بن مسكين، قراءة عليه وأنا أسمع، - واللفظ له - قال أنبأنا ابن القاسم، عن مالك، عن عبد الله بن أبي بكر، عن حميد بن نافع، عن زينب بنت أبي سلمة، أنها أخبرته بهذه الأحاديث الثلاثة، قالت زينب دخلت على أم حبيبة زوج النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم حين توفي أبوها أبو سفيان بن حرب فدعت أم حبيبة بطيب فدهنت منه جارية ثم مست بعارضيها ثم قالت والله ما لي بالطيب من حاجة غير أني سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ لا يحل لامرأة تؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر تحد على ميت فوق ثلاث ليال إلا على زوج أربعة أشهر وعشرا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar...

chapter: The Book of Financial Transactions - كتاب البيوع
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Salim that his father said:                     "The Messenger of Allah forbade two kinds of garments, and he forbade two kinds of transactions for us: Munabadhah and Mulamasah, which are kinds of transactions which were common during the Jahiliyyah."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا هارون بن زيد بن أبي الزرقاء، قال حدثنا أبي قال، حدثنا جعفر بن برقان، قال بلغني عن الزهري، عن سالم، عن أبيه، قال نهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن لبستين ونهانا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن بيعتين عن المنابذة والملامسة وهي بيوع كانوا يتبايعون بها في الجاهلية ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba said that he heard his father say to him while they were on a journey in which there was no water except what is found with them or by carrying it from place to place, "O my son! Do not drink of the urine (of camels) for indeed I have seen some people who did so and then died."

chapter: The Book of Zakah - كتاب الزكاة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Abdullah bin 'Amr said:                     "When the Messenger of Allah conquered Makkah, he stood up to address the people and said in his Khutbah; 'It is not permissible for a woman to give anything without her husband's permission."' (He narrated it) in abridged from.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا إسماعيل بن مسعود، قال حدثنا خالد بن الحارث، قال حدثنا حسين المعلم، عن عمرو بن شعيب، أن أباه، حدثه عن عبد الله بن عمرو، قال لما فتح رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم مكة قام خطيبا فقال في خطبته ‏"‏ لا يجوز لامرأة عطية إلا بإذن زوجها ‏"‏ ‏.‏ مختصر ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Anas bin Malik said that he saw a man who was leading his camel with its rope tied to one of its legs so as it could walk on three feet only; then Ibn Umar passed by and slapped him saying, "May Allah have mercy upon you! Leave the animal's leg alone."
Narrated Anas bin Malik said that he saw a man who was leading his camel with its rope tied to one of its legs so as it could walk on three feet only; then Ibn Umar passed by and slapped him saying, "May Allah have mercy upon you! Leave the animal's leg alone."

chapter: The Book of Purification - كتاب الطهارة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out from the toilet and food was brought to him. They said:                      "Shall we not bring water for Wudu'?" He said: "I have only been commanded to perform Wudu' when I want to pray."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا زياد بن أيوب، قال حدثنا ابن علية، قال حدثنا أيوب، عن ابن أبي مليكة، عن ابن عباس، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم خرج من الخلاء فقرب إليه طعام فقالوا ألا نأتيك بوضوء فقال ‏"‏ إنما أمرت بالوضوء إذا قمت إلى الصلاة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What should I say when I perform ablution?" The Prophet replied, "(Say), 'O Lord! You are all knowing about my state and (my need) of purifying myself for prayer. So please forgive me if you know anything in my heart or outside it which is not right."

chapter: The Book of Drinks - كتاب الأشربة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Bassam said:                     "I asked Abu Ja'far about Nabidh and he said: " 'Ali bin Husain, may Allah be pleased with him, would have Nabidh made for him at night, and he would drink it in the morning, and he would have Nabidh made in the morning and he would drink it at night.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا سويد، قال أنبأنا عبد الله، عن بسام، قال سألت أبا جعفر عن النبيذ، قال كان علي بن حسين رضى الله عنه ينبذ له من الليل فيشربه غدوة وينبذ له غدوة فيشربه من الليل ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying: "O Allah's Apostle! What is more rewarding? Fasting or Jihad in the way of Allah?" He replied, "(There are) two things and between them there lies another thing. The other day you fasted all through till evening while here I asked my Lord (Allah), 'O Allah! Make me a man who will be given nothing but Jihad.' So it was so ordained for him."

chapter: The Book of The At-Tatbiq (Clasping One's Hands Together) - كتاب التطبيق
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'When one of you prostrates, let him put his hands down before his knees, and not kneel like a camel.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا هارون بن محمد بن بكار بن بلال، من كتابه قال حدثنا مروان بن محمد، قال حدثنا عبد العزيز بن محمد، قال حدثنا محمد بن عبد الله بن الحسن، عن أبي الزناد، عن الأعرج، عن أبي هريرة، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إذا سجد أحدكم فليضع يديه قبل ركبتيه ولا يبرك بروك البعير ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him): The Messenger of Allaah (sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam) said to me while I was clasping my hands together, "Separate your fingers."

chapter: The Book of Oaths (qasamah), Retaliation and Blood Money - كتاب القسامة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas:                     "This and this are the same: The little finger and the thumb (sahih)
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا نصر بن علي، قال حدثنا يزيد بن زريع، قال حدثنا شعبة، عن قتادة، عن عكرمة، عن ابن عباس، فهذه وهذه سواء الإبهام والخنصر ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) who was at an upper room of one of his houses or in the mosque while we were with him, and he complained about pains which distressed him. The Prophet asked: "What treatment have you taken?" He replied that a physician had treated him but it did not help much; so I spat (on my wound) seven times till I was afraid lest the people would think me mad."

chapter: The Book of Cutting off the Hand of the Thief - كتاب قطع السارق
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Aishah that Quraish were worried about the Mkahzumi woman who had stolen. They said;Who will speak to the Messenger of Allah concerning her?" They said:                      "Who would dare to do that except Usamah bin Zaid, the beloved of the Messenger of Allah?" so Usamah spoke to him and the Messenger of Allah said: "Are you interceding concerning one of the Hadd punishments decreed by Allah?" Then he stood up and addressed (the people) and said: "Those who came before you were destroyed because, whenever a noble person among them stole, they would let him go. But if a person who was weak stole, they would carry out the punishment on him. By Allah, if Fatimah the daughter of Muhammad were to steal, I would cut off her hnad."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا قتيبة، قال حدثنا الليث، عن ابن شهاب، عن عروة، عن عائشة، أن قريشا، أهمهم شأن المخزومية التي سرقت فقالوا من يكلم فيها رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قالوا ومن يجترئ عليه إلا أسامة بن زيد حب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فكلمه أسامة فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أتشفع في حد من حدود الله ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثم قام فخطب فقال ‏"‏ إنما هلك الذين قبلكم أنهم كانوا إذا سرق فيهم الشريف تركوه وإذا سرق فيهم الضعيف أقاموا عليه الحد وايم الله لو أن فاطمة بنت محمد سرقت لقطعت يدها ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Yazid Al-Ansari (Allaah be pleased with him) said that he heard from his father who had been a Companion of Prophet Muhammad (sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam): "I was present at the time when they cut off the hand and foot of one person, but I did not see it. Then later on, we were with Allah's Messenger (sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam) in a journey; he asked us about that so-and-so who had his hands and feet cutoff." We replied: "Allaah's Messenger! He was one of those people whom you ordered to be stoned, but we did not see it. So Allah forgave him!"
He (the Prophet) said:"If he would have repented before that I had seen his hand and foot cutoff."

chapter: The Book of Zakah - كتاب الزكاة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:                     "The Messenger of Allah enjoined Sadaqatul Fitr upon young and old, male and female, free and slave; a Sa' of dates or a Sa' of barley,"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا إسحاق بن إبراهيم، قال أنبأنا عيسى، قال حدثنا عبيد الله، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر، قال فرض رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم صدقة الفطر على الصغير والكبير والذكر والأنثى والحر والعبد صاعا من تمر أو صاعا من شعير ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man came to Allah's Apostle with his son who had an eye disease which made him blind in one of his eyes while he was looking at what is between two mountains, and it became so bad that the boy could not see anything. The Prophet asked for water and sprinkled over the face of the boy (with water) three times saying: "May Allah's Name cure you."
The narrator said: I saw him after he had been treated with this medicine, looking at what is between two mountains as if there was no mountain in his eye.

chapter: The Book of Qiyam Al-Lail (The Night Prayer) and Voluntary Prayers During the Day - كتاب قيام الليل وتطوع النهار
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Al-Hasan bin Ali said:                     "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) taught me these words in witr. He said: Say: Allahumma ihdini fiman hadayta wa 'afini fiman afayta wa tawallani fiman tawallayta wa barik li fima a'tayta, wa qini sharra ma qadayta, fa innaka taqdi wa la yuqda 'alayk, wa innahu la yadhilluman walayta, tabarakta Rabbana wa at'alayt. Wa salla Allahu ala al-Nabi Muhammad (O Allah, guide me among those whom You have guided, pardon me among those You have pardoned, turn to me in friendship among those on whom You have turned in friendship, and bless me in what You have bestowed, and save me from the evil of what You have decreed. For verily You decree and none can influence You; and he is not humiliated whom You have befriended. Blessed are You, O Lord, and Exalted. And may Allah (SWT) send salah upon the Prophet Muhammad)'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن سلمة، قال حدثنا ابن وهب، عن يحيى بن عبد الله بن سالم، عن موسى بن عقبة، عن عبد الله بن علي، عن الحسن بن علي، قال علمني رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم هؤلاء الكلمات في الوتر قال ‏"‏ اللهم اهدني فيمن هديت وبارك لي فيما أعطيت وتولني فيمن توليت وقني شر ما قضيت فإنك تقضي ولا يقضى عليك وإنه لا يذل من واليت تباركت ربنا وتعاليت وصلى الله على النبي محمد ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him): The Messenger of Allaah (sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam) said to me while he was on a camel, "O son of my brother! Stand up." So I stood up and the Prophet (peace be upon him), mounted behind me. Then we went until we reached some people who were engaged in conversation about something which they had heard from someone else that night prayer is not required at all; so he said, "O son of my brother! Go ahead with your camel." So I rode away on it and the Prophet (peace be upon him) remained there.

chapter: The Book of the Times (of Prayer) - كتاب المواقيت
ground_truth_en: 'Imran bin Hudair said:                      "I asked Lahiq about the two Rak'ahs before sunset. He said: "Abdullah bin Az-Zubair used to pray them, and Mu'awiyah sent word to him asking: 'What are these two Rak'ahs at sunset?' He had to refer to Umm Salamah, and Umm Salamah said: 'The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to pray two Rak'ahs before 'Asr, then he was distracted and did not pray them, so he prayed them when the sun set, and I never saw him pray them before or after that.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عثمان بن عبد الله، قال حدثنا عبيد الله بن معاذ، قال أنبأنا أبي قال، حدثنا عمران بن حدير، قال سألت لاحقا عن الركعتين، قبل غروب الشمس فقال كان عبد الله بن الزبير يصليهما فأرسل إليه معاوية ما هاتان الركعتان عند غروب الشمس فاضطر الحديث إلى أم سلمة فقالت أم سلمة إن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان يصلي ركعتين قبل العصر فشغل عنهما فركعهما حين غابت الشمس فلم أره يصليهما قبل ولا بعد ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying "The prayer is two Rakat."

chapter: The Book of Hajj - كتاب مناسك الحج
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Nafi said:                     "Abdullah bin Umar went out and he came to Dhul-Hulaifah he entered Ihram for Umrah. Then he traveled a short distance. Then he was afraid that he might be prevented from reaching the House. He said: 'If I am prevented I will do what the Messenger of Allah did.' He said: 'By Allah, Hajj is jut like Umrah; I ask you to bear witness that I have resolved to do Hajj with my Umrah.' He traveled on until he reached Qudaid, where he bought a Hadi. Then he came to Makkah, and circumambulated the House seven times, and performed Sai between As-Safa and Al-Marwah and said: 'This is what I saw the Messenger of Allah doing.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا علي بن ميمون الرقي، قال حدثنا سفيان، عن أيوب السختياني، وأيوب بن موسى، وإسماعيل بن أمية، وعبيد الله بن عمر، عن نافع، قال خرج عبد الله بن عمر فلما أتى ذا الحليفة أهل بالعمرة فسار قليلا فخشي أن يصد عن البيت فقال إن صددت صنعت كما صنع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال والله ما سبيل الحج إلا سبيل العمرة أشهدكم أني قد أوجبت مع عمرتي حجا ‏.‏ فسار حتى أتى قديدا فاشترى منها هديا ثم قدم مكة فطاف بالبيت سبعا وبين الصفا والمروة وقال هكذا رأيت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فعل ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik (RA) that he heard Allah's Messenger (SAW) say:"The Hajj of a person who does what I have done is to be completed by his own followers."

chapter: The Book of Purification - كتاب الطهارة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Al-Miqdad bin Al-Aswad that 'Ali told him to ask the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about a man who comes close to his wife and prostatic fluid comes out of him - what should he do? ('Ali said:                     ) For his daughter is married to me and I feel too shy to ask him. So I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about that and he said: "If any one of you experiences that, let him sprinkle water on his private part and perform Wudu' as for Salah."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عتبة بن عبد الله المروزي، عن مالك، - وهو ابن أنس - عن أبي النضر، عن سليمان بن يسار، عن المقداد بن الأسود، أن عليا، أمره أن يسأل، رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن الرجل إذا دنا من أهله فخرج منه المذى ماذا عليه فإن عندي ابنته وأنا أستحي أن أسأله فسألت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن ذلك فقال ‏"‏ إذا وجد أحدكم ذلك فلينضح فرجه ويتوضأ وضوءه للصلاة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) "What should I say when I perform ablution?" He replied, "(Say), 'O Lord! You are all knowing; nothing whatever is hidden from you. Verily none but You can purify me and forgive my sins."

chapter: The Book of Purification - كتاب الطهارة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:                      "I used to sleep in front of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and my feet were in the direction of his Qiblah. When he prostrated he nudged me and I drew up my feet, then when he stood up I stretched them out again. And there were no lamps in the houses at the time."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا قتيبة، عن مالك، عن أبي النضر، عن أبي سلمة، عن عائشة، قالت كنت أنام بين يدى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ورجلاى في قبلته فإذا سجد غمزني فقبضت رجلى فإذا قام بسطتهما والبيوت يومئذ ليس فيها مصابيح ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying a Hadith like this which means:"The most blessed of water is the muddy water from an udder."

chapter: The Book of The At-Tatbiq (Clasping One's Hands Together) - كتاب التطبيق
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:                     "The Prophet (ﷺ) was commanded to prostrate on seven bones and was forbidden to tuck up his hair and garment."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن منصور المكي، عن سفيان، عن عمرو، عن طاوس، عن ابن عباس، قال أمر النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أن يسجد على سبعة أعظم ونهي أن يكف الشعر والثياب ‏.‏
llm_response: NARRATED IKHSHID AL-JUFRI said: "I heard Abu Hurairah say this in a sermon he was delivering to us on Friday at Mina": THE PROPHET, may Allah bless him and grant Him peace, came out from the mosque of his people when it had become dark. He saw me standing with my companions between two men who were quarrelling over some camels which they owned in partnership; so he asked them: "What is this?" They said to him:" We have a dispute about these animals." The Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant Him peace, then ordered me to bring the people together. He got up on their assembly (the men) until all of us were gathered around him; he told them: "O my brothers! Do not quarrel over your property or you will be divided." Then he said:" O Ikhshid al-Jufri, do you know what is the best thing in this matter?" He replied to me: "No. May Allah bless and grant Him peace!" The Prophet then told them that they should make a partition between their camels; so each of them would take his share from it (and leave) without any dispute."

chapter: The Book of Drinks - كتاب الأشربة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that:                     A man asked about drinks and he said: "Avoid everything that intoxicates."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا سويد بن نصر، قال أنبأنا عبد الله، عن أبي عوانة، عن زيد بن جبير، عن ابن عمر، أن رجلا، سأل عن الأشربة، فقال اجتنب كل شىء ينش ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba said to his father (Shaba): "O my father! What did Allah's Messenger  mean by saying that he would be a warner like Noah and a bearer of glad tidings like the prophets who had come before him?"
My father replied: "He meant what I heard from 'Aisha, may Allaah be pleased with her. She said:" The Messenger  came to me while he was on his camel saddle in my house and asked for water."

chapter: The Book of Cutting off the Hand of the Thief - كتاب قطع السارق
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Rafi bin Khadij said:                     "I heard the Messenger of Allah say: 'The hand is not to be cut off for (stealing) produce or the spadix of palm trees."' (Sahih)   Abu 'Abdur-Rahman (An-Nasai) said: This is a mistake, and I do not know who Abu Maimun (one of the narrators) is.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن علي بن ميمون، قال حدثنا سعيد بن منصور، قال حدثنا عبد العزيز بن محمد، عن يحيى بن سعيد، عن محمد بن يحيى بن حبان، عن أبي ميمون، عن رافع بن خديج، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ لا قطع في ثمر ولا كثر ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال أبو عبد الرحمن هذا خطأ أبو ميمون لا أعرفه ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Yazid al-Ansari said that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying a Hadith like which I have narrated to you before, and added "Allah has made the foot of the horse in Paradise as wide as distance between Mecca and Syria."

chapter: The Book of Hajj - كتاب مناسك الحج
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Muhammad bin Ibrahim bin Al-Muntashir that his father said:                     "I heard Ibn 'Umar say: 'If I were to wake up daubed with tar, that would be dearer to me than waking up and entering Ihram smelling strongly of perfume.' I entered upon 'Aishah and told her what he had said. She said: 'I put perfume on the Messenger of Allah and he went around among his wives, then the next morning he entered Ihram.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا هناد بن السري، عن وكيع، عن مسعر، وسفيان، عن إبراهيم بن محمد بن المنتشر، عن أبيه، قال سمعت ابن عمر، يقول لأن أصبح مطليا بقطران أحب إلى من أن أصبح محرما أنضح طيبا ‏.‏ فدخلت على عائشة فأخبرتها بقوله فقالت طيبت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فطاف في نسائه ثم أصبح محرما ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said "The Hajj of a person who has sexual relations with his wife while he is in Ihram will be rejected."

chapter: The Book of the Prayer for the Two 'Eids - كتاب صلاة العيدين
ground_truth_en: Abdur-Rahman bin 'Abbas said:                     "I heard 'Abbas when a man said to him: 'Did you go out (to the Eid prayer) with the Messenger of Allah?' He said: 'Yes, and were it not for my kinship (position) with him I would not have done so'"-meaning due to him being so young- "He (the Prophet (ﷺ)) went to the mark near the house of Kathir bin As-Salt and prayed, then delivered a Khutbah. Then he went to the women. He exhorted them and reminded them and told them to give charity. So a woman would bring her hand near her neck and take off her necklace and put it in the garment of Bilal."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عمرو بن علي، قال حدثنا يحيى، قال حدثنا سفيان، قال حدثنا عبد الرحمن بن عابس، قال سمعت ابن عباس، قال له رجل شهدت الخروج مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال نعم ولولا مكاني منه ما شهدته يعني من صغره أتى العلم الذي عند دار كثير بن الصلت فصلى ثم خطب ثم أتى النساء فوعظهن وذكرهن وأمرهن أن يتصدقن فجعلت المرأة تهوي بيدها إلى حلقها تلقي في ثوب بلال ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (RA): The Messenger of Allaah(saw) said: "The prayer is two rak'at before the Eid prayer."

chapter: The Book of al-Bay'ah - كتاب البيعة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Kab bin Ujrah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah came out to us, and there were nine of us. He said; 'After me there will be rulers, whoever believes in their lies and helps them in their wrongdoing is not of me, and I am not of him, and he will not come to me at the Cistern. Whoever does not believe their lies and does not help them in their wrongdoing, he is of me, and I am of hi, and he will come to me at the Cistern."'
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عمرو بن علي، قال حدثنا يحيى، عن سفيان، عن أبي حصين، عن الشعبي، عن عاصم العدوي، عن كعب بن عجرة، قال خرج علينا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ونحن تسعة فقال ‏"‏ إنه ستكون بعدي أمراء من صدقهم بكذبهم وأعانهم على ظلمهم فليس مني ولست منه وليس بوارد على الحوض ومن لم يصدقهم بكذبهم ولم يعنهم على ظلمهم فهو مني وأنا منه وهو وارد على الحوض ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar...

chapter: The Book of Oaths and Vows - كتاب الأيمان والنذور
ground_truth_en: Thabit bin Ad-Dahhak narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:                      "Whoever swears by a religion other than Islam, telling a lie, will be as he said, and whoever kills himself with something will be punished with it in the Hereafter."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرني محمود بن خالد، قال حدثنا الوليد، قال حدثنا أبو عمرو، عن يحيى، أنه حدثه قال حدثني أبو قلابة، قال حدثني ثابت بن الضحاك، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ من حلف بملة سوى الإسلام كاذبا فهو كما قال ومن قتل نفسه بشىء عذب به في الآخرة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar...

chapter: The Book of Funerals - كتاب الجنائز
ground_truth_en: It is was narrated from 'Abdullah bin Buraidah  that his father said:                     "The Messenger of Allah said: 'I forbade you to visit graves but now visit them; and I forbade you to eat the sacrificial meat after three days, but now keep it as long as you want; and I forbade you to make Nabidh I anything but a water-skin but now drink it from any kind of container, but do not drink intoxicants."'
ground_truth_ar: أخبرني محمد بن آدم، عن ابن فضيل، عن أبي سنان، عن محارب بن دثار، عن عبد الله بن بريدة، عن أبيه، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏"‏ نهيتكم عن زيارة القبور فزوروها، ونهيتكم عن لحوم الأضاحي فوق ثلاثة أيام فأمسكوا ما بدا لكم، ونهيتكم عن النبيذ إلا في سقاء فاشربوا في الأسقية كلها، ولا تشربوا مسكرا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Anas b. Malik say to Abu Talha (or some other person) who was sitting with him in a funeral procession, "Our Prophet ﷺ used to stand at the grave of his brother and cry until it seemed as if there were something coming out from between his eyes."
Reference: Sunan an-Nasa'i - Book of Funerals (Kitab al-Jinah)

chapter: The Book of Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah said:                     "There is no good deed that the son of Adam does, but between ten and seven hundred Hasanahs will be recorded for him. Allah, the mighty and sublime, said: 'Except fasing, for it is for me and I shall reward for it. He gives up his desires and his food for my sake. Fasting is a shield, and the fasting person has two moments of joy. One when he breaks his fast and another when he meets his Lord. And the smell that comes from the mouth of the fasting person is better before Allah than the fragrance of musk." '
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا إسحاق بن إبراهيم، قال أنبأنا جرير، عن الأعمش، عن أبي صالح، عن أبي هريرة، عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ ما من حسنة عملها ابن آدم إلا كتب له عشر حسنات إلى سبعمائة ضعف قال الله عز وجل إلا الصيام فإنه لي وأنا أجزي به يدع شهوته وطعامه من أجلي الصيام جنة للصائم فرحتان فرحة عند فطره وفرحة عند لقاء ربه ولخلوف فم الصائم أطيب عند الله من ريح المسك ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad(sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam): "What should I say if anyone asks me about my fasting?" He replied, "Say: `Allaah has made it obligatory upon us and we are commanded to observe the fast."

chapter: The Book of Purification - كتاب الطهارة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Humaid bin 'Abdur-Rahman said:                      "I met a man who accompanied the Prophet (ﷺ) as Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him), accompanied him for four years. He said: 'The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade any one of us to comb his hair each day,[1] or to urinate in the place where he performs Ghusl, or for a man to perform Ghusl using the leftover water of a women, or a woman to perform Ghusl using the leftover water of a man - they should scoop it out together.'"[1] It is said this is to prevent him from making his physical appearance his main aim.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا قتيبة، قال حدثنا أبو عوانة، عن داود الأودي، عن حميد بن عبد الرحمن، قال لقيت رجلا صحب النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم كما صحبه أبو هريرة - رضى الله عنه - أربع سنين قال نهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أن يمتشط أحدنا كل يوم أو يبول في مغتسله أو يغتسل الرجل بفضل المرأة والمرأة بفضل الرجل وليغترفا جميعا ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Allah's Messenger what he should say if it rained on him while he was praying? He replied: Say: "Allaah willing, I seek refuge with you from every calamity."

chapter: The Book of Oaths and Vows - كتاب الأيمان والنذور
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Jabir said:                      "The Messenger of Allah forbade Al-Mukhabarah, Al-Muhaqalah and Al-Muzabanah."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرني محمد بن عامر، قال حدثنا سريج، قال حدثنا محمد بن مسلم، عن عمرو بن دينار، عن جابر، قال نهاني رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن المخابرة والمحاقلة والمزابنة‏.‏‏ جمع سفيان بن عيينة الحديثين فقال عن ابن عمر وجابر‏.‏‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him): The Messenger of Allaah(sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam) said to me when I was a boy, "O son of my brother! Ask for anything you wish." So I asked: "What is the most blessed thing in Islam?" He (the Prophet)(sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam) replied by saying that it was faith.
I said to him: "Then what is next after faith?" He(sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam) then told me the following, and I asked again about the third thing until he had mentioned five things in all."

chapter: The Book of Purification - كتاب الطهارة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Tariq that a man became Junub and did not pray, then he came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and mentioned that to him. He said:                      "You did the right thing." Another man became Junub and performed Tayammum and prayed, and he came to him and he said something similar to what he had told the other man - meaning, you did the right thing.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن عبد الأعلى، قال حدثنا أمية بن خالد، قال أنبأنا شعبة، أن مخارقا، أخبرهم عن طارق، أن رجلا، أجنب فلم يصل فأتى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فذكر ذلك له فقال ‏"‏ أصبت ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فأجنب رجل آخر فتيمم وصلى فأتاه فقال نحو ما قال للآخر يعني ‏"‏ أصبت ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said : The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to us in a state which was like that of one who had been frightened; he stood up between two men, and then asked for water so as to perform ablution. Then we gave him some water with which he performed the ablutions twice or thrice. He said : "I saw what you did not see." We said: What is it? He replied : I was shown Hell-fire; its like a boiling pot, and I have been shown Paradise; its like a cool spring of clear water"

chapter: The Book of Salah - كتاب الصلاة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin Buraidah that his father said:                      "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'The covenant that stands between us and them is the Salah; whoever abandons it, he has committed disbelief.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا الحسين بن حريث، قال أنبأنا الفضل بن موسى، عن الحسين بن واقد، عن عبد الله بن بريدة، عن أبيه، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إن العهد الذي بيننا وبينهم الصلاة فمن تركها فقد كفر ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (RA): The Messenger of Allaah(saw) said:"The best deeds are those that bring most benefit to mankind."

chapter: The Book of al-'Aqiqah - كتاب العقيقة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Umm Kurz that the Messenger of Allah said:                     "For a boy two sheep, Mukafaatan (of equal age), and for a girl, one sheep,
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عبيد الله بن سعيد، قال حدثنا سفيان، قال قال عمرو عن عطاء، عن حبيبة بنت ميسرة، عن أم كرز، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ عن الغلام شاتان مكافأتان وعن الجارية شاة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) who had been performing ablution at a well but he did not find any water there so he dipped his hands in sand and rubbed them over his face. The Prophet (ﷺ) saw him doing this, and then said: "O man! If you do not get anything else to perform the ablution with, even if it is a rock or an egg shell, use that."
Reference : 4216

chapter: The Book of Marriage - كتاب النكاح
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:                      "The Messenger of Allah forbade taking a woman as a co-wife to her paternal aunt or her maternal aunt."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا إسحاق بن إبراهيم، قال أنبأنا المعتمر، عن داود بن أبي هند، عن الشعبي، عن أبي هريرة، قال نهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أن تنكح المرأة على عمتها والعمة على بنت أخيها ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba said that his father told him "I went to a man who was sitting with some people in their assembly (majlis) so I asked them about the Messenger of Allaah sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam and they started talking. So, when he saw me approaching, one amongst them said: 'This is Abdullah bin Shabba who has come to ask us questions.'
So, as soon as I sat down with him (the man), the Prophet sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam came and greeted everyone there. Then he asked me about my family saying: 'How is your father?' So, when I told them that he was well, they said to me: 'O son of Shabba! Your father has been a good man.'
Then the Prophet sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam turned towards him and asked about his family. Then after mentioning each one by name (of those present), he mentioned my mother saying: 'And how is your wife?' So, when I told them that she was well too, they said to me: 'O son of Shabba! Your father has married a good woman.'
Then the Prophet sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam turned towards him and asked about his family. Then after mentioning each one

chapter: The Book of Qiyam Al-Lail (The Night Prayer) and Voluntary Prayers During the Day - كتاب قيام الليل وتطوع النهار
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Hafsah that:                     When the call for Subh prayer was given, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would pray two brief rak'ahs before going to the prayer.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا قتيبة بن سعيد، قال حدثنا الليث، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر، عن حفصة، عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه كان إذا نودي لصلاة الصبح ركع ركعتين خفيفتين قبل أن يقوم إلى الصلاة ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik: The Messenger of Allah (sallaahu alayhi wa sallam) said to me while I was playing with my brothers in front of him: "O son, O an-Na'im! Do not make your play too long."

chapter: The Book of Endowments - كتاب الإحباس
ground_truth_en: A similar report was narrated from Abu Ishaq Al-Fazari, from (Ayyub) bin 'Awn, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, from 'Umar, may Allah be pleased with him, from the Prophet.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرني هارون بن عبد الله، قال حدثنا معاوية بن عمرو، عن أبي إسحاق الفزاري، عن ابن عون، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر، عن عمر، رضى الله عنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم نحوه ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar...

chapter: The Book of Drinks - كتاب الأشربة
ground_truth_en: Jabir bin 'Abdullah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah [SAW] forbade dried dates and raisins, and he forbade dried dates and Al-Busr, if they are soaked together."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا قريش بن عبد الرحمن الباوردي، عن علي بن الحسن، قال أنبأنا الحسين بن واقد، قال حدثني عمرو بن دينار، قال سمعت جابر بن عبد الله، يقول نهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن التمر والزبيب ونهى عن التمر والبسر أن ينبذا جميعا‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying "The most blessed of water is Zamzam Water, and whosoever drinks it will not be given any other kind of water."

chapter: The Book of Hajj - كتاب مناسك الحج
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Aishah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah said: 'There are five kinds of vermin that may be killed in the Haram: Scorpions, mice, crows, vicious dogs, and kites." (Sahih)Chaper 120. The Prohibition Of Disturbing The Game Of The Haram
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا أحمد بن عبدة، قال أنبأنا حماد، قال حدثنا هشام، - وهو ابن عروة - عن أبيه، عن عائشة، قالت قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ خمس فواسق يقتلن في الحرم العقرب والفأرة والغراب والكلب العقور والحدأة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (RA): The Messenger of Allaah(saw) said to me when I was a young boy, "O son of my brother! Do you know what fasting is?" He asked again and then he repeated it for the third time.
I replied: Yes, O Prophet of Allah (SAW). You told us that if one man were to observe fast on behalf of another person who was not present there, his fast would be invalidated.

chapter: The Book of Funerals - كتاب الجنائز
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Sa'eed said:                     "The Messenger of Allah said: 'When you see a funeral, stand up, and whoever follows it, let him not sit down until (the body) is placed (in the grave)."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا علي بن حجر، قال حدثنا إسماعيل، عن هشام، ح وأخبرنا إسماعيل بن مسعود، قال حدثنا خالد، قال حدثنا هشام، عن يحيى، عن أبي سلمة، عن أبي سعيد، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إذا رأيتم الجنازة فقوموا فمن تبعها فلا يقعد حتى توضع ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid Al'Ansari (may Allaah be pleased with him): I heard Saa`d bin Abi Waqqas say that he was present at a funeral where there were two men of the Ansaar, one from Badr and another from Uhud. The man who had been killed in Badr said to his companion: "O so-and-so! Do not forget me when you are with Allaah's Messenger (صلى الله عليه وسلم) at al-Madinah."
The other one replied, saying: "Never shall I do that. By the One who sent thee!" Then he said to him again and a third time until they were four times in succession; then it was as if his companion had not heard what he used to say before. He (the dead man) asked for water so that he could perform ablution, but when he performed Wudhoo' he found no strength at all.
He said: "O Allaah! I have never seen a more severe punishment than this." Then the other one went to him and saw what had happened with his companion; then it was as if nothing of that which used to happen before had taken place, so much did he feel ashamed for having disobeyed.
Then they both said: "O Allaah! We bear witness (to this) in

chapter: The Book of Hajj - كتاب مناسك الحج
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Mu'adh bin Abdur-Rahman At-Taimi that his father said:                     "we were with Talhah bin Ubaidullah and we were Ihram. A birth was given to him when he was asleep, and some of us at from it and others refrained. Talhah woke up and agreed with those who had eaten it, and said: 'We ate it with Messenger of Allah.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عمرو بن علي، قال حدثنا يحيى بن سعيد، قال حدثنا ابن جريج، قال حدثني محمد بن المنكدر، عن معاذ بن عبد الرحمن التيمي، عن أبيه، قال كنا مع طلحة بن عبيد الله ونحن محرمون فأهدي له طير وهو راقد فأكل بعضنا وتورع بعضنا فاستيقظ طلحة فوفق من أكله وقال أكلناه مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Anas b. Malik say to his wife when she had given birth to a child: "Do you know what this is?" She replied, "No." He then asked her and the people of Madinah who were present there at that time about it (i.e., circumcision) so they said, "Yes," but he did not do anything with him till Allah's Messenger arrived in Medina. Anas b. Malik told me this story as if I had seen the Prophet performing circumcising his son and saying: "Circumcise (your child) and get it shaved."
Reference : 2817

chapter: The Book of the Kind Treatment of Women - كتاب عشرة النساء
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:                      "Nothing was dearer to the Messenger of Allah after women than horses."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا أحمد بن حفص بن عبد الله، قال حدثني أبي قال، حدثني إبراهيم بن طهمان، عن سعيد بن أبي عروبة، عن قتادة، عن أنس بن مالك، قال لم يكن شىء أحب إلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بعد النساء من الخيل ‏.‏
llm_response:
NARRATED IKHSHID AL-JUFRI said: Narrated Anas bin Malik that a woman came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) who was at home wearing thin clothes and her head uncovered, so she complained about oppression by her husband.
Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), looking towards the sky said: "O Lord! To a wife of mine?" Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) then called for water; he washed his hands and face thrice or twice, and prayed long prayer though it had not yet become obligatory. Then he offered the prayer while standing up in her presence."

chapter: The Book of the Times (of Prayer) - كتاب المواقيت
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عمرو بن علي، قال حدثنا يحيى بن سعيد، قال حدثنا هشام، قال أخبرني أبي قال، أخبرني ابن عمر، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ لا تتحروا بصلاتكم طلوع الشمس ولا غروبها فإنها تطلع بين قرنى شيطان ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Allahs Apostle saying "The prayer is two Rakat (units of prayers) Ablution is to be made once only."

chapter: The Book of Jumu'ah (Friday Prayer) - كتاب الجمعة
ground_truth_en: Iyas bin Al-Akwa' narrated that his father said:                     "We used to  pray jumu'ah with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then we would go back, and the walls had no shadow in which shade could be sought."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا شعيب بن يوسف، قال أنبأنا عبد الرحمن، عن يعلى بن الحارث، قال سمعت إياس بن سلمة بن الأكوع، يحدث عن أبيه، قال كنا نصلي مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم الجمعة ثم نرجع وليس للحيطان فىء يستظل به ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik (RA): The Prophet () used to offer two Rak'ahs of Esha prayer in congregational prayers on a traveler who was present or absent; but he did so only once after that, and then it became obligatory.

chapter: The Book of Hajj - كتاب مناسك الحج
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Ibn Abbas:                     That when the Messenger of Allah came to Dhul-Huaifah he marked the Hadi on the right side of its hump, then removed the blood from it, then he garlanded it with two shoes and mounted his she-camel. When it stood up with him in Al-Baida, he began the Talbiyah for Hajj and he entered Ihram at noon.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا يعقوب بن إبراهيم، قال حدثنا ابن علية، قال حدثنا هشام الدستوائي، عن قتادة، عن أبي حسان الأعرج، عن ابن عباس، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم لما أتى ذا الحليفة أشعر الهدى من جانب السنام الأيمن ثم أماط عنه الدم ثم قلده نعلين ثم ركب ناقته فلما استوت به البيداء أحرم بالحج وأحرم عند الظهر وأهل بالحج ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : What is more rewards? He replied "To be patient in distress."

chapter: The Book of Drinks - كتاب الأشربة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Ata' that :                     He said, concerning juice: "Drink it unless it is bubbling."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا سويد، قال أنبأنا عبد الله، عن عبد الملك، عن عطاء، في العصير قال اشربه حتى يغلي ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that his father told us about a man who had been sent to some people of olden times by their chiefs saying, "I have come from your chiefs to ask you not to drink wine. They say if any one among you is caught in the act he should be flogged and then exiled." The men said (to him), "We will neither give up our wine nor shall we leave this place of our own accord, but as for a man who gets drunk or anyone else who drinks it against his wish, let us tie him to an iron chain. Then he is not like one of ourselves and if you do that then there would be no difference between the person who does so willingly and those whom we catch in the act."

chapter: The Book of Adornment - كتاب الزينة من السنن
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that:                     The Messenger of Allah [SAW] cursed the woman who affixes hair extensions.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عبيد الله بن سعيد، قال حدثنا يحيى، عن عبيد الله، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم لعن الواصلة ‏.‏
llm_response:
