chapter: The Book of Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Aishah said that the Prophet said:                     "Fasting is a shield against the Fire. Whoever starts the day of fasting, let him not act in an ignorant manner during that day. If anyone treats him in an ignorant maner, let him not insult him or curse him, rather let him say: "I am fasting.' By the One in whole hand is the soul of Muhammad, the smell that comes from the mouth of a fasting person is better before Allah than the fragrance of musk."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن يزيد الآدمي، قال حدثنا معن، عن خارجة بن سليمان، عن يزيد بن رومان، عن عروة، عن عائشة، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ الصيام جنة من النار فمن أصبح صائما فلا يجهل يومئذ وإن امرؤ جهل عليه فلا يشتمه ولا يسبه وليقل إني صائم والذي نفس محمد بيده لخلوف فم الصائم أطيب عند الله من ريح المسك ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that a man asked Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) about fasting on Monday and Thursday only, so he told us the Hadith of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): "He who does not leave falsehood in his speech nor acts unlawfully will enter Paradise."

chapter: The Book of Divorce - كتاب الطلاق
ground_truth_en: Abu Salamah bin 'Abdur-Rahman said:                      "While Abu Hurairah and I were with Ibn 'Abbas, a woman came and said that her husband had died while she was pregnant, then she had given birth less than four months after the day he died. Ibn 'Abbas said: '(You have to wait) for the longer of the two periods.'" Abu Salamah said: "A man from among the Companions of the Prophet told me that Subai'ah Al-Aslamiyyah came to the Messenger of Allah and said that her husband died while she was pregnant, and she gave birth less than four months after he died. The Messenger of Allah told her to get married. Abu Hurairah said: 'And I bear witness to that.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا إسحاق بن إبراهيم، قال أنبأنا عبد الرزاق، قال أنبأنا ابن جريج، قال أخبرني داود بن أبي عاصم، أن أبا سلمة بن عبد الرحمن، أخبره قال بينما أنا وأبو هريرة عند ابن عباس إذ جاءته امرأة فقالت توفي عنها زوجها وهي حامل فولدت لأدنى من أربعة أشهر من يوم مات ‏.‏ فقال ابن عباس آخر الأجلين ‏.‏ فقال أبو سلمة أخبرني رجل من أصحاب النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أن سبيعة الأسلمية جاءت إلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقالت توفي عنها زوجها وهي حامل فولدت لأدنى من أربعة أشهر فأمرها رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أن تتزوج ‏.‏ قال أبو هريرة وأنا أشهد على ذلك ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Aslami said that he heard Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas (may Allaah be pleased with him) say to his wife who had divorced her husband thrice, "If you do not repent from this action of yours and if I find out about it again then I will stone you."

chapter: The Book Of Faith and its Signs - كتاب الإيمان وشرائعه
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Amir bin Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas that his father said:                     "The Prophet [SAW] gave a share (of some spoils of war) to some men and not to others. Sa'd said: 'O Messenger of Allah [SAW], you gave to so-and-so and so-and-so, but you did not give anything to so-and-so, and he is a believer.' The Prophet [SAW] said: 'Or a Muslim,' until Sa'd had repeated it three times, and the Prophet [SAW] said: 'I give to some men, and leave those who are dearer to me, without giving them anything, lest (the former) be thrown into Hell on their faces.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن عبد الأعلى، قال حدثنا محمد، - وهو ابن ثور - قال معمر وأخبرني الزهري، عن عامر بن سعد بن أبي وقاص، عن أبيه، قال أعطى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم رجالا ولم يعط رجلا منهم شيئا قال سعد يا رسول الله أعطيت فلانا وفلانا ولم تعط فلانا شيئا وهو مؤمن ‏.‏ فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أو مسلم ‏"‏ ‏.‏ حتى أعادها سعد ثلاثا والنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول ‏"‏ أو مسلم ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثم قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إني لأعطي رجالا وأدع من هو أحب إلى منهم لا أعطيه شيئا مخافة أن يكبوا في النار على وجوههم ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What deeds are loved most by Allah?" He replied, "A smiling face which is ever cheerful."

chapter: The Book of Qiyam Al-Lail (The Night Prayer) and Voluntary Prayers During the Day - كتاب قيام الليل وتطوع النهار
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Imran bin Husain said:                     "I asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about one who prays sitting down. He said: 'Whoever prays standing up is better, and one who prays sitting down will have half the reward of one who prays standing up. And whoever prays lying down will have half the reward of one who prays sitting down.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا حميد بن مسعدة، عن سفيان بن حبيب، عن حسين المعلم، عن عبد الله بن بريدة، عن عمران بن حصين، قال سألت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم عن الذي يصلي قاعدا قال ‏"‏ من صلى قائما فهو أفضل ومن صلى قاعدا فله نصف أجر القائم ومن صلى نائما فله نصف أجر القاعد ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying "Our Lord descends every night to the lowest heaven when it is last of the night and says, 'Is there anyone who asks for My forgiveness or supplicates or speaks good words so as to be eligible for a reward from Me? Or someone seeks refuge with me lest evil should overtake him?' Then he ascends (to Heaven) saying: "Who is it that asked for my Forgiveness, Who is it who spoke good word and sought shelter of Me?"

chapter: The Book of Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Silah bin Zufar said:                     "I had Sahur with Hudhaifah, then we went out to the Masjid. We prayed the two Rakahs of Fajr, then the Iqamah for prayer was made, and we prayed."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عمرو بن علي، قال حدثنا محمد بن فضيل، قال حدثنا أبو يعفور، قال حدثنا إبراهيم، عن صلة بن زفر، قال تسحرت مع حذيفة ثم خرجنا إلى المسجد فصلينا ركعتى الفجر ثم أقيمت الصلاة فصلينا ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard his father say to a man who was fasting on Monday and Tuesday of Shawwal while they were in Medina, "O son of Kisra! Do you not know what day this is?" He replied: No. So 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that his father told him to tell the man who was fasting on Monday and Tuesday of Shawwal while they were in Medina, "This is a month which Allaah has made sacred for you; so do not make your own hands impure by killing animals or birds. And when you reach Mecca then shave off all your hair."
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that his father told him, "I heard the Messenger of Allaah say: 'Whoever fasts on Monday and Tuesday will be forgiven.'"

chapter: The Book of The At-Tatbiq (Clasping One's Hands Together) - كتاب التطبيق
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say when bowing and prostrating: 'Subhanaka Allahumma, Rabbana wa bihamdik. Allahumma-ghfirli (Glory be to You O Allah, Our Lord, and praise. O Allah, forgive me," following the command of the Quran.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمود بن غيلان، قال حدثنا وكيع، عن سفيان، عن منصور، عن أبي الضحى، عن مسروق، عن عائشة، قالت كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول في ركوعه وسجوده ‏"‏ سبحانك اللهم ربنا وبحمدك اللهم اغفر لي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يتأول القرآن ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard his father say to him while they were going together on a journey: "O my son! Do you know who I am?" He replied, "No." So he asked again and repeated it the third time. Then he (the narrator) said, "I do not know except that your name is Zaid bin Thabit al-Ansari."
He then added: 'My father was a man from Ansar who had come to us in Medina with his family before Islam and they were among the people of Bani Qainuqa' tribe. He said, "I am one of those (who killed) that person on behalf of Allah."

chapter: The Book of Divorce - كتاب الطلاق
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Al-Miswar bin Makhramah that the Prophet commanded Sabai'ah to get married when her Nifas ended.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا نصر بن علي بن نصر، عن عبد الله بن داود، عن هشام بن عروة، عن أبيه، عن المسور بن مخرمة، أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أمر سبيعة أن تنكح إذا تعلت من نفاسها ‏.‏
llm_response:

ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Hafsah, from Umm 'Atiyyah, from the Prophet, that he granted a concession to the woman whose husband has died, allowing her to use Qust and Azfar when purifying herself following her menses.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا العباس بن محمد، - هو الدوري - قال حدثنا الأسود بن عامر، عن زائدة، عن هشام، عن حفصة، عن أم عطية، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه رخص للمتوفى عنها عند طهرها في القسط والأظفار ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar...

chapter: The Book of Fighting [The Prohibition of Bloodshed] - كتاب تحريم الدم
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Abudllah bin 'Amr said:                     "The Messenger of Allah [SAW] said: 'Whoever is killed defending his wealth, he is a martyr.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا جعفر بن محمد بن الهذيل، قال حدثنا عاصم بن يوسف، قال حدثنا سعير بن الخمس، عن عبد الله بن الحسن، عن عكرمة، عن عبد الله بن عمرو، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ من قتل دون ماله فهو شهيد ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said : The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade us to eat in vessels made from gold or silver.

chapter: The Book of the Times (of Prayer) - كتاب المواقيت
ground_truth_en: Khalid bin Dinar Abu Khaldah said:                      "I heard Anas bin Malik say: 'When it was hot, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would wait until it cooled down to pray, and when it was cold he would hasten to pray.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عبيد الله بن سعيد، قال حدثنا أبو سعيد، مولى بني هاشم قال حدثنا خالد بن دينار أبو خلدة، قال سمعت أنس بن مالك، قال كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا كان الحر أبرد بالصلاة وإذا كان البرد عجل ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Abu Hurairah said : The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to us in a state of anger while we were with him at Dhu'l-Hulayfa so he stood up and addressed the people saying, "O you assembly ! I have been informed that there is among you someone who has killed his father. If it be as alleged then as soon as the prayer is over kill him."
Then a man got up and said : O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) do not put us to trial, for we are indeed one body; when any part complains another trembles with fear lest he should suffer what his brother suffers.

chapter: The Book of Oaths (qasamah), Retaliation and Blood Money - كتاب القسامة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Anas that:                     the Messenger of Allah ruled that Qisas should be given for a tooth. The Messenger of Allah said: "The Messenger of Allah said: "What Allah has decreed is retaliation."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا إسحاق بن إبراهيم، قال أنبأنا أبو خالد، سليمان بن حيان قال حدثنا حميد، عن أنس، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قضى بالقصاص في السن وقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ كتاب الله القصاص ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man from Quraish came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) with his brother or son who had been stabbed by an Ansari in the marketplace and he was asking for blood-wit. The Prophet of Allah asked him, "Did you find anything on it?" He said: No. Then I heard a man from Quraish saying to another one (of his companions), "I saw something." So they both came forward till the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was between them and their swords were drawn, each trying to make an oath by invoking God's name. The Prophet said: "Do you swear by God in whose Hands is your life?" They replied: Yes. He asked the man who had seen something about his evidence; he told him that it was a black hair which looked like a camel's tail and then they both turned away, each of them saying to the other (in anger): "Go back."
The Hadith is in Arabic language but I have translated it into English.

chapter: The Book of ad-Dahaya (Sacrifices) - كتاب الضحايا
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin 'Umar that:                     the Messenger of Allah offered the sacrifice obn the Day of Sacrifice in Al-Madinah. He said: "if he did not offer the Nahr (sacrifice a camel) he would have offered Dhabihah (Sacrificed a sheep) at the prayer place."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا علي بن عثمان النفيلي، قال حدثنا سعيد بن عيسى، قال حدثنا المفضل بن فضالة، قال حدثني عبد الله بن سليمان، قال حدثني نافع، عن عبد الله بن عمر، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم نحر يوم الأضحى بالمدينة - قال - وقد كان إذا لم ينحر يذبح بالمصلى ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Allah's Apostle what he should say if a horse or an ox fell on him while riding it? He replied: "Say praise be to God Who has given me this good health."

chapter: The Book of ad-Dahaya (Sacrifices) - كتاب الضحايا
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:                     "The Messenger of Allah cursed those who take anything that has a soul as a target." (Sahih )
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا قتيبة بن سعيد، قال حدثنا هشيم، عن أبي بشر، عن سعيد بن جبير، عن ابن عمر، قال لعن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم من اتخذ شيئا فيه الروح غرضا ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Hudhaifa said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more loved to me than my father?" He replied, "Your mother." The man asked (the same) question twice and he replied similarly each time. Then the man asked for his brother and then for his wife and then for his offspring and every one of them was given a similar reply till he said: "Who is most loved to you among all?" He replied, "(Allah's name) Azwajal-Mutaharat (i.e., the two mates)."
Ruling by Shaikh al Islam Ibn Taymiyya - May Allaah have mercy upon him: 
> 
> This Hadith is a proof for those who say that women are not equal to men in righteousness. It shows the love of parents and children, wife or husband etc., but it does not mean that they all attain the same level of good deeds as each one has different qualities; therefore some may be better than others...

chapter: The Book Of Faith and its Signs - كتاب الإيمان وشرائعه
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Sa'd that :                     The Messenger of Allah [SAW] distributed (some spoils of war) and gave to some people but withheld from others. I said: "O Messenger of Allah, you gave to so-and-so and so-and-so, and you withheld from so-and-so, who is a beliver." He said: "Do not say 'a believer,' say 'a Muslim.'" Ibn Shihab (one of the narrators) said: The Bedouins say: "We believe".
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عمرو بن منصور، قال حدثنا هشام بن عبد الملك، قال حدثنا سلام بن أبي مطيع، قال سمعت معمرا، عن الزهري، عن عامر بن سعد، عن سعد، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قسم قسما فأعطى ناسا ومنع آخرين فقلت يا رسول الله أعطيت فلانا ومنعت فلانا وهو مؤمن ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ لا تقل مؤمن وقل مسلم ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال ابن شهاب ‏{‏ قالت الأعراب آمنا ‏}‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Messenger : What should I say if my wife dies? He replied: Say "Al-Hamdulillah (All praise is due to Allâh)"

chapter: The Book of Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Abdullah bin 'Amr said:                     'Amr said: "I spoke to the Prophet and he said: 'Fast one day out of ten and you will have the reward of the other nine.' I said: 'I am able to do more than that.' He said: 'Fast one day out of eight and you will have the reward of the other eight.' I said: 'I am able to do more than that.' He said: 'Fast one day out of eight and you will have the reward of the other seven.' I said: 'I am able to do more than that.' 'Fast one day and not the next."'
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن عبد الأعلى، قال حدثنا المعتمر، عن أبيه، قال حدثنا أبو العلاء، عن مطرف، عن ابن أبي ربيعة، عن عبد الله بن عمرو، قال ذكرت للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم الصوم فقال ‏"‏ صم من كل عشرة أيام يوما ولك أجر تلك التسعة ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فقلت إني أقوى من ذلك ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ صم من كل تسعة أيام يوما ولك أجر تلك الثمانية ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قلت إني أقوى من ذلك ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ فصم من كل ثمانية أيام يوما ولك أجر تلك السبعة ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قلت إني أقوى من ذلك قال فلم يزل حتى قال ‏"‏ صم يوما وأفطر يوما ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What should I say if my wife is sick?" He replied, "If your wife gets up at night while you are asleep (and urinates the bed sheet) then say four times: 'At thy beck and call.'"

chapter: The Book of Divorce - كتاب الطلاق
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Safiyyah bint Abi 'Ubaid from one of the wives of the Prophet, and from Umm Salamah, that the Prophet said:                      "It is not permissible for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to mourn for anyone who dies for more than three days except for a husband; she should mourn for him for four months and ten (days)."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عبد الله بن الصباح، قال حدثنا محمد بن سواء، قال أنبأنا سعيد، عن أيوب، عن نافع، عن صفية بنت أبي عبيد، عن بعض، أزواج النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وعن أم سلمة أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ لا يحل لامرأة تؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر تحد على ميت أكثر من ثلاثة أيام إلا على زوج فإنها تحد عليه أربعة أشهر وعشرا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (Allah be pleased with him) said that a man came to Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon him), "I have nothing but this cloak of mine and my wife." He asked the Prophet (may peace be upon him): What should I do? The Prophet (may peace be upon him) told him: Divorce her.

chapter: The Book of al-Fara' and al-'Atirah - كتاب الفرع والعتيرة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Nubaishah Al-Hudhaili said:                     "A man said: 'O Messenger of Allah, we used to sacrifice the 'Atirah during the Jahiliyyah in Rajab; what do you command us to do?' He said: 'Sacrifice to Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, whatever month it is, do good for the sake of Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, and feed (the poor)."'
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا يعقوب بن إبراهيم، عن ابن علية، عن خالد، قال حدثني أبو قلابة، عن أبي المليح، فلقيت أبا المليح فسألته فحدثني عن نبيشة الهذلي، قال قال رجل يا رسول الله إنا كنا نعتر عتيرة في الجاهلية فما تأمرنا قال ‏"‏ اذبحوا لله عز وجل في أى شهر ما كان وبروا الله عز وجل وأطعموا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) with his brother who was in debt so he asked him to bear witness against himself as regards what is due on behalf of the person for whom there remained some debts. So, when it was time for prayer, one of them prayed and then went away while other did not come out till after a long period had elapsed; whereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: "O so-and-so! Your brother has just now gone to Hell."
Hadith 4232

chapter: The Book of Oaths (qasamah), Retaliation and Blood Money - كتاب القسامة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Bushair bin Yasar that:                     'Abdullah bin Sahl Al-Ansari and Muhayysah bin Mas'ud went out to Khaibar, where they went their separate ways to go about their business. 'Abdullah bin Sahl was killed, and Muhayysah came (to Madinah) and went with his brother Huwayysah and 'Abdur-Rahman bin Sahl to the Messenger of Allah. 'Abdur-Rahaman started to speak, because of his position as brother (of the slain man) but the Messenger of Allah said: "Let the elders speak first." So Huyysah and Muhayysah spoken, and told him about what happened to 'Abdullah bin Sahl. The Messenger of Allah said to them: "Will you sewer fifty oaths, then you will receive compensation or be entitled to retaliate?" (In his narration) Malik said: "Yahya said: 'Bushair said that the Messenger of Allah paid the blood money himself, but Sa'eed bin 'Ubaid At-Ta'l disagreed with them (in reporting that).''
ground_truth_ar: قال الحارث بن مسكين قراءة عليه وأنا أسمع، عن ابن القاسم، حدثني مالك، عن يحيى بن سعيد، عن بشير بن يسار، أنه أخبره أن عبد الله بن سهل الأنصاري ومحيصة بن مسعود خرجا إلى خيبر فتفرقا في حوائجهما فقتل عبد الله بن سهل فقدم محيصة فأتى هو وأخوه حويصة وعبد الرحمن بن سهل إلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فذهب عبد الرحمن ليتكلم لمكانه من أخيه فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ كبر كبر ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فتكلم حويصة ومحيصة فذكروا شأن عبد الله بن سهل فقال لهم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أتحلفون خمسين يمينا وتستحقون دم صاحبكم أو قاتلكم ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال مالك قال يحيى فزعم بشير أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وداه من عنده ‏.‏ خالفهم سعيد بن عبيد الطائي ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar...

chapter: The Book of Hajj - كتاب مناسك الحج
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Ibn Abbas said:                     "The Messenger ofAllah sent us young boys of Banu Abdul-Muttalib on donkeys, stalping our things and saying "O my sons, do not stone Jamratulal Aqabah until the sun has risen. (Daif)
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن عبد الله بن يزيد المقرئ، قال حدثنا سفيان، عن سفيان الثوري، عن سلمة بن كهيل، عن الحسن العرني، عن ابن عباس، قال بعثنا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أغيلمة بني عبد المطلب على حمرات يلطح أفخاذنا ويقول ‏"‏ أبيني لا ترموا جمرة العقبة حتى تطلع الشمس ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) offered prayer at Muzdhalifa in Ramadan on a Thursday night after midnight or near it; so he did not perform the Tawaf around the Ka`ba.

chapter: The Book of Oaths and Vows - كتاب الأيمان والنذور
ground_truth_en: Jabir narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:                      "Whoever has land, let him cultivate it or give it to his brother to cultivate, and not lease it to his brother."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرني أحمد بن يحيى، قال حدثنا أبو نعيم، قال حدثنا همام بن يحيى، قال سأل عطاء سليمان بن موسى قال حدث جابر، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏‏"‏‏ من كانت له أرض فليزرعها أو ليزرعها أخاه ولا يكريها أخاه ‏‏"‏‏‏.‏‏ وقد روى النهى عن المحاقلة يزيد بن نعيم عن جابر بن عبد الله‏.‏‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to say when he got up from sleeping at night or after a nap during daytime, "None has the right to be worshipped except Allâh; and He has no partner. To Him belongs all praise till there is nothing whatsoever left of blessings."

chapter: The Book of the Commencement of the Prayer - كتاب الافتتاح
ground_truth_en: Abu Hurairah narrated that:                     The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) heard the recitation of Abu Musa and said: He has been given a Mizmar among the Mazamir of the family of Dawud, peace be upon him."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا سليمان بن داود، عن ابن وهب، قال أخبرني عمرو بن الحارث، أن ابن شهاب، أخبره أن أبا سلمة أخبره أن أبا هريرة حدثه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم سمع قراءة أبي موسى فقال ‏"‏ لقد أوتي مزمارا من مزامير آل داود عليه السلام ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased him) reported that Prophet Muhammad () said to his Companions while they were praying in congregational prayer on Friday: "O people! Do you know what day this is?" They replied, saying, "Allaah and His Messenger know best." He then asked them again. So he repeated the question three times until it was as if their hearts would come out of their bodies from fear that they might be wrong in answering him. Then one man among his Companions said: "It is Friday," so Prophet Muhammad () replied, saying: "O people! If you knew what day this is and how much Allaah has given it preference over other days then none of you would come to any mosque except the Mosque of Makkah until he had offered two prayers there."
Narrated by Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased him)

chapter: The Book Of Faith and its Signs - كتاب الإيمان وشرائعه
ground_truth_en: Abu Hurairah said:                     "I heard the Messenger of Allah [SAW] say: 'Allah has promised the one who goes out in His cause 'and does not go out except with faith in Me and for Jihad in My cause,' that he is guaranteed to enter Paradise no matter how, either he is killed, or he dies, or he will be brought back to his home from which he departed having acquired whatever he acquired of reward or spoils of war.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا قتيبة قال حدثنا الليث عن سعيد عن عطاء بن ميناء سمع أبا هريرة يقول  سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول انتدب الله لمن يخرج في سبيله لا يخرجه إلا الإيمان بي والجهاد في سبيلي أنه ضامن حتى أدخله الجنة بأيهما كان إما بقتل وإما وفاة أو أن يرده إلى مسكنه الذي خرج منه ينال ما نال من أجر أو غنيمة
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What deeds are loved most by Allah?" He replied:"A smiling face."

chapter: The Book of the Times (of Prayer) - كتاب المواقيت
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:                      "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) delayed A;-'Atamah one night, and 'Umar, may Allah be pleased with him, called out to him: 'The women and children have gone to sleep.' The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out and said: 'No one is waiting for it except you.' At that time no prayer was offered except in Al-Madinah. Then he said: 'Pray it between the time when the twilight disappears and when one-third of the night has passed.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرني عمرو بن عثمان، قال حدثنا ابن حمير، قال حدثنا ابن أبي عبلة، عن الزهري، وأخبرني عمرو بن عثمان، قال حدثني أبي، عن شعيب، عن الزهري، عن عروة، عن عائشة، قالت أعتم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ليلة بالعتمة فناداه عمر رضى الله عنه نام النساء والصبيان ‏.‏ فخرج رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وقال ‏"‏ ما ينتظرها غيركم ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ولم يكن يصلى يومئذ إلا بالمدينة ثم قال ‏"‏ صلوها فيما بين أن يغيب الشفق إلى ثلث الليل ‏"‏ ‏.‏ واللفظ لابن حمير ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba'ah Al-Ansari said that he heard Anas Bin Malik say to his wife while they were on their way from Makkah to Madinah, "O woman! Do not ask me for anything until we reach our destination." She asked him why. He replied: "I fear lest I be tempted by something and then you will have nothing left with which to buy food or drink when the time of prayer comes upon us."
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba'ah Al-Ansari said that he heard Anas Bin Malik say to his wife while they were on their way from Makkah to Madinah, "O woman! Do not ask me for anything until we reach our destination. She asked him why? He replied: I fear lest I be tempted by something and then you will have nothing left with which to buy food or drink when the time of prayer comes upon us."

chapter: The Book of Funerals - كتاب الجنائز
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Aishah said:                     "The Prophet was shrouded in three white Suhuli garments."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا قتيبة، عن مالك، عن هشام بن عروة، عن أبيه، عن عائشة، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كفن في ثلاثة أثواب بيض سحولية ليس فيها قميص ولا عمامة ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "The reward of one Sadaqah Jariyah is equivalent to the rewards of all other types of charity."

chapter: The Book of Zakah - كتاب الزكاة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:                     "The Messenger of Allah said to Mu'adh when he sent him to Yemen: 'You are going to some of the People of the book. When you come to them, call them to testify that there is none worthy of worship except Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. If they obey you in that, then tell them that Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, has enjoined on them a charity (Zakah) to be taken from their rich and given to their poor. If they obey you in that, then beware of the supplication of the oppressed person."'
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن عبد الله بن عمار الموصلي، عن المعافى، عن زكريا بن إسحاق المكي، قال حدثنا يحيى بن عبد الله بن صيفي، عن أبي معبد، عن ابن عباس، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم لمعاذ حين بعثه إلى اليمن ‏"‏ إنك تأتي قوما أهل كتاب فإذا جئتهم فادعهم إلى أن يشهدوا أن لا إله إلا الله وأن محمدا رسول الله فإن هم أطاعوك بذلك فأخبرهم أن الله عز وجل فرض عليهم خمس صلوات في يوم وليلة فإن هم - يعني أطاعوك بذلك - فأخبرهم أن الله عز وجل فرض عليهم صدقة تؤخذ من أغنيائهم فترد على فقرائهم فإن هم أطاعوك بذلك فاتق دعوة المظلوم ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying "The best among you is one who learns from his brother."

chapter: The Book of Oaths (qasamah), Retaliation and Blood Money - كتاب القسامة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Safwan bin Ya'la that his father said:                     "I went on the campaign to Tabuk with the Messenger of Allah, and I hired a worker. My hired man fought with another man. The other one bit him, and his front tooth fell out. He went to the Prophet and told him about that, but the Prophet considered it to bin vain.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا إسحاق بن إبراهيم، قال أنبأنا سفيان، عن ابن جريج، عن عطاء، عن صفوان بن يعلى، عن أبيه، قال غزوت مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في غزوة تبوك فاستأجرت أجيرا فقاتل أجيري رجلا فعض الآخر فسقطت ثنيته فأتى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فذكر له فأهدره النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Yazid Al-Ansari (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that a man came to Rasoolullaa(sallallaahu alayhi wasalam), and he had been falsely accused of theft. He asked for an oath, so Rasoolullaa(sallallaahu alayhi wasallah) took his hand in both hands and said: "O Allaah! This is a man who has never stolen anything from anyone."
Reference : 4768

chapter: The Book of ad-Dahaya (Sacrifices) - كتاب الضحايا
ground_truth_en: 'Ali said:                     "Messenger of Allah forbade us from sacrificing an animal with a broken horn." I (the narrator) mentioned that to Sa'eed bin Al_Musayyab and he said: "Yes, m unless half or more of the horn is missing."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا حميد بن مسعدة، عن سفيان، - وهو ابن حبيب - عن شعبة، عن قتادة، عن جرى بن كليب، قال سمعت عليا، يقول نهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أن يضحى بأعضب القرن ‏.‏ فذكرت ذلك لسعيد بن المسيب قال نعم إلا عضب النصف وأكثر من ذلك ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man came to Allah's Apostle while he was at Dhu al-Hulayfa (a well known place on the way from Makkah to Madinah) and asked him about his right over his wife. The Prophet told him: "If she will perform all her duties as you like, then that is her share which God has written for her; otherwise take her back in kindness or set her free with kind treatment."

chapter: The Book of The At-Tatbiq (Clasping One's Hands Together) - كتاب التطبيق
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Ali said:                     "The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade me from wearing gold rings, from reciting the Qur'an when bowing, and from wearing Al-Qassi, and clothes dyed with safflower."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عبيد الله بن سعيد، قال حدثنا يحيى بن سعيد، عن ابن عجلان، عن إبراهيم بن عبد الله بن حنين، عن أبيه، عن ابن عباس، عن علي، قال نهاني النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم عن خاتم الذهب وعن القراءة راكعا وعن القسي والمعصفر ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba said that he heard his father saying that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him "O my son! Do you know anyone who is more beloved to me than your mother?" I replied, "No." He then asked the same question twice and on both occasions I gave the same answer. Then he told me: "Your two maternal aunts are dearer to me than either of them (i.e., your parents)."

chapter: The Book of Qiyam Al-Lail (The Night Prayer) and Voluntary Prayers During the Day - كتاب قيام الليل وتطوع النهار
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Salamah and Nafi', from Ibn Umar, from Hafsah that:                     The Prophet (ﷺ) used to pray two brief rak'ahs between the call (The adhan) and the Iqamah, the two rak'ahs of Fajr.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا هشام بن عمار، قال حدثنا يحيى، - يعني ابن حمزة - قال حدثنا الأوزاعي، عن يحيى، عن أبي سلمة، قال هو ونافع عن ابن عمر، عن حفصة، أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم كان يصلي بين النداء والإقامة ركعتين خفيفتين ركعتى الفجر ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that a man asked Anas b. Malik about something he had heard from his father or grandfather (or both) which was in fact an error, and the Prophet of Allaah ﷺ used to say: "O you who believe! Do not enter upon women by their private parts."
So I went out looking for Anas b. Malik until he came back from a journey or expedition (or both) which had been sent on, and then asked him about it again; so he said the same as before.

chapter: The Book of Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: Abu Hurairah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah said: 'When Ramadan comes, the gates of mercy are opened, the gates of Hell are closed, and the devils are chained up."'
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن خالد، قال حدثنا بشر بن شعيب، عن أبيه، عن الزهري، قال حدثني ابن أبي أنس، مولى التيميين أن أباه، حدثه أنه، سمع أبا هريرة، يقول قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إذا جاء رمضان فتحت أبواب الرحمة وغلقت أبواب جهنم وسلسلت الشياطين ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man came to Allah's Apostle while he was in his house with some of his wives at night when they were asleep. The Prophet got up from sleep and went out, leaving them there. Then the man asked for water so she (the wife) brought him water. He then said: "I ask you by Allah Who has sent me to you that if I have done any wrong in your sight or anything else which is not right, please forgive it." She replied: "Yes," and he got up and went out with her carrying the pitcher of water (for ablution).
The Prophet said while still standing at his place where she had left him for prayer: "O you people! Do any one of you know who this man is?" They answered in reply to that. He then asked them again and they gave a similar answer as before, but he was not satisfied with their answers till the third time when some men among those present there said (to each other): "This person must be an insane." The Prophet said: "No! By Allah Who has sent me to you. He is one of your brothers who had been astray and then came back, but he did not know that we were asleep in the house at night when she (the wife) brought him water for ablution after I left her there."

chapter: The Book of Qiyam Al-Lail (The Night Prayer) and Voluntary Prayers During the Day - كتاب قيام الليل وتطوع النهار
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Ibrahim bin Muhammad Al-Muntashir, from his father, that:                     He was in the masjid of 'Amr bin Shurahbil and the iqamah for prayer was said, and they were waiting. He came and said: "I was praying witr." Abdullah was asked: "Is there any witr after the adhan?" He said: "Yes, and after the Iqamah." And he narrated that the Prophet (ﷺ) once slept and missed the prayer until the sun had risen, then he prayed.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا يحيى بن حكيم، قال حدثنا ابن أبي عدي، عن شعبة، عن إبراهيم بن محمد بن المنتشر، عن أبيه، أنه كان في مسجد عمرو بن شرحبيل فأقيمت الصلاة فجعلوا ينتظرونه فجاء فقال إني كنت أوتر ‏.‏ قال وسئل عبد الله هل بعد الأذان وتر قال نعم وبعد الإقامة ‏.‏ وحدث عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه نام عن الصلاة حتى طلعت الشمس ثم صلى ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba'h Al-Ansari (Allaah be pleased with him): The Messenger of Allaah (sallallaahu `alayhi wa sallam) said, "Whoever performs the night prayer and then sleeps before its time has committed a sin."

chapter: The Book of Hajj - كتاب مناسك الحج
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Usmah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah came out of the House and prayed two Rakahs in front of the Kabah, then he said: 'This is the Qiblah.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا إسماعيل بن مسعود، قال حدثنا خالد، عن عبد الملك، عن عطاء، عن أسامة، قال خرج رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم من البيت صلى ركعتين في قبل الكعبة ثم قال ‏"‏ هذه القبلة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "While a man was walking along with two of his companions they asked him to lead them in prayer but he refused and told them about some other person who would be better than him. So the three of them went out looking for that particular person till they found him praying at the corner of an orchard, so one of those men stood up behind him (to perform ablution) while another man took hold of his garment and said to him, 'O Allah's Messenger! Lead us in prayer.' He turned around and recognized them but he did not lead any of the two prayers. Then they went back home disappointed."

chapter: The Book of al-'Aqiqah - كتاب العقيقة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Habib bin Ash-Shahid:                     "Muhammad bin Sirin said to me: 'Ask Al-Hasan (Al-Basri) from whom he heard this Hadith about the 'Aqiqah.' I asked him about that and he said: 'I heard it from Samurh."'
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا هارون بن عبد الله، قال حدثنا قريش بن أنس، عن حبيب بن الشهيد، قال لي محمد بن سيرين سل الحسن ممن سمع حديثه، في العقيقة ‏.‏ فسألته عن ذلك، فقال سمعته من، سمرة ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that his father told me : The Messenger of Allaah(sallaahu alayhi wa sallam)( may Allaah exalt His mention )said, "The first thing to start from is the 'Aqiqah.
It was narrated by An-Nasaa'i (may Allah have mercy upon him) in his Sunan with a chain that reaches Abdullah bin Umar and it has been authenticated as stated above

chapter: The Book of Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Usamah bin Zaid:                     That the Messenger of Allah used to fast continually and it ws said that he would not break his fast, and he used not to fast and it was said that he would not fast.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا أحمد بن سليمان، قال حدثنا زيد بن الحباب، قال أخبرني ثابت بن قيس الغفاري، قال حدثني أبو سعيد المقبري، قال حدثني أبو هريرة، عن أسامة بن زيد، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان يسرد الصوم فيقال لا يفطر ويفطر فيقال لا يصوم ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that his father told me : The Messenger of Allaah(sallaahu alayhi wa sallam)( may Allaah exalted His mention )said, "Fasting is to Me as woolling is to you."
Ibn Umar (may Allah be pleased with him) said that his father told me : The Messenger of Allaah(sallaahu alayhi wa sallam)( may Allaah exalted His mention )said, "Fasting is to Me as woolling is to you."

chapter: The Book of Fighting [The Prohibition of Bloodshed] - كتاب تحريم الدم
ground_truth_en: it was narrated that Sharik bin Shihab said:                     "I used to wish that I could meet a man among the Companions of the Prophet [SAW] and ask him about the Khawarij. Then I met Abu Barzah on the day of 'Id, with a number of his companions. I said to him: 'Did you hear the Messenger of Allah [SAW] mention the Khawarij?' He said: 'Yes. I heard the Messenger of Allah [SAW] with my own ears, and saw him with my own eyes. Some wealth was brought to the Messenger of Allah [SAW] and he distributed it to those on his right and on his left, but he did not give anything to those who were behind him. Then a man stood behind him and said: "O Muhammad! You have not been just in your division!" He was a man with black patchy (shaved) hair, wearing two white garments. So Allah's Messenger [SAW] became very angry and said: "By Allah! You will not find a man after me who is more just than me." Then he said: "A people will come at the end of time; as if he is one of them, reciting the Qur'an without it passing beyond their throats. They will go through Islam just as the arrow goes through the target. Their distinction will be shaving. They will not cease to appear until the last of them comes with Al-Masih Ad-Dajjal. So when you meet them, then kill them, they are the worst of created beings."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن معمر البصري الحراني، قال حدثنا أبو داود الطيالسي، قال حدثنا حماد بن سلمة، عن الأزرق بن قيس، عن شريك بن شهاب، قال كنت أتمنى أن ألقى، رجلا من أصحاب النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أسأله عن الخوارج فلقيت أبا برزة في يوم عيد في نفر من أصحابه فقلت له هل سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يذكر الخوارج فقال نعم سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بأذني ورأيته بعيني أتي رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بمال فقسمه فأعطى من عن يمينه ومن عن شماله ولم يعط من وراءه شيئا فقام رجل من ورائه فقال يا محمد ما عدلت في القسمة ‏.‏ رجل أسود مطموم الشعر عليه ثوبان أبيضان فغضب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم غضبا شديدا وقال ‏"‏ والله لا تجدون بعدي رجلا هو أعدل مني ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثم قال ‏"‏ يخرج في آخر الزمان قوم كأن هذا منهم يقرءون القرآن لا يجاوز تراقيهم يمرقون من الإسلام كما يمرق السهم من الرمية سيماهم التحليق لا يزالون يخرجون حتى يخرج آخرهم مع المسيح الدجال فإذا لقيتموهم فاقتلوهم هم شر الخلق والخليقة ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال أبو عبد الرحمن رحمه الله شريك بن شهاب ليس بذلك المشهور ‏.‏
llm_response:
NARRATED BY ABU HURAIRAH RAADIYAH BIN AL-ASHA'ATH (ALSO KNOWN AS ABU 'ABS) AND OTHER MEN FROM THE PROPHET MOHAMMED SALLALLAHOELAYHEWASALLAM
ON A DAY OF JUMMAH WHILE HE WAS STANDING IN FRONT OF HIS TENT, THERE CAME TO MEET HIM AN ASRAA' (AN UNCERTAIN MEN) AND SAID: "O MOHAMMED SALLALLAHOELAYHEWASALLAM WHAT DO YOU MAKE UP IN THE CASE OF A WAR?" HE RESPONDED TO HIM, "WHY DID THIS ASRAA' COME?!" SAYS ONE MAN: I CAUGHT MY FIRST BROTHER WITH ME AND SHE IS NOT FROM OUR TRIBE. SO THE PROPHET MOHAMMAM SALLALLAHOELAYHEWASALLAM RESPONDED TO HIM, "IF YOU CATCH A MAN OF ENEMY IN BATTLE THEN KILL HIS FIRST ONLY." SAYS THERE WAS AN OLD MEN WITH THE ASRAA'

chapter: The Book of the Times (of Prayer) - كتاب المواقيت
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Amr bin 'Abasah said:                      "I came to the Messenger of Allah, who became Muslim with you?' He said: 'Free men and slaves.' I said: 'Is there any moment which brings one closer to Allah than another?' He said: 'Yes, the last part of the night, so pray as much as you want until you pray Subh, then stop until the sun has risen until and it looks like a shield and (its shinning)spreads. Then pray as much as you want until an object's shadow is at its shortest, then stop until the sun passes its zenith, for Hell is stoked at midday. Then pray 'Asr, then stop until you pray 'Asr, then stop until the sun has set, for it sets between the horns of a Shaitan and rises between the horns of a Shaitan.'" [1][1] Similar has been recorded by Muslim.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرني الحسن بن إسماعيل بن سليمان، وأيوب بن محمد، قالا حدثنا حجاج بن محمد، قال أيوب حدثنا وقال، حسن أخبرني شعبة، عن يعلى بن عطاء، عن يزيد بن طلق، عن عبد الرحمن بن البيلماني، عن عمرو بن عبسة، قال أتيت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقلت يا رسول الله من أسلم معك قال ‏"‏ حر وعبد ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قلت هل من ساعة أقرب إلى الله عز وجل من أخرى قال ‏"‏ نعم جوف الليل الآخر فصل ما بدا لك حتى تصلي الصبح ثم انته حتى تطلع الشمس وما دامت ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وقال أيوب فما دامت ‏"‏ كأنها حجفة حتى تنتشر ثم صل ما بدا لك حتى يقوم العمود على ظله ثم انته حتى تزول الشمس فإن جهنم تسجر نصف النهار ثم صل ما بدا لك حتى تصلي العصر ثم انته حتى تغرب الشمس فإنها تغرب بين قرنى شيطان وتطلع بين قرنى شيطان ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari (may Allaah be pleased with him): The Messenger of Allaah(sallallaahu `alayhi wa sallam) said, "The prayer is two Rakat."

chapter: The Book of Drinks - كتاب الأشربة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Suwiad bin Ghafalah said:                     "Umar bin Al-Khattab wrote to some of his workers saying: 'Give to the Muslims thickened grape juice when two thirds of it have gone and one-third is left.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن عبد الأعلى، قال حدثنا المعتمر، قال سمعت منصورا، عن إبراهيم، عن نباتة، عن سويد بن غفلة، قال كتب عمر بن الخطاب إلى بعض عماله أن ارزق، المسلمين من الطلاء ما ذهب ثلثاه وبقي ثلثه ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) who had been performing Ihram for Umra so he asked him what prevented you from finishing your Hajj? He replied, "I did not have the means of transportation." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Go back and finish your Hajj.

chapter: The Book of Divorce - كتاب الطلاق
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:                      "Mention of Li'an was made in the presence of the Messenger of Allah and 'Asim bin 'Adiyy said something about that, then he went away. A man from among his people came to him, complaining that he had found a man with his wife. 'Asim said: 'I was only put to this test because of what I said.' He took him to the Messenger of Allah and told him of the situation in which he found his wife. That man was pale and slim with straight hair, and the one whom he claimed to have found with his wife was dark and well-built. The Messenger of Allah said: 'O Allah, make it clear to me.' Then she gave birth to a child who resembled the one whom her husband said he had found with her. So the Messenger of Allah conducted the procedure of Li'an between them." A man in the gathering said to Ibn 'Abbas: "Was she the one of whom the Messenger of Allah said: 'If I were to have stoned anyone without evidence I would have stoned this one?'" Ibn 'Abbas said: "No, that was a woman who used to do mischief even after becoming Muslim."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عيسى بن حماد، قال أنبأنا الليث، عن يحيى بن سعيد، عن عبد الرحمن بن القاسم، عن القاسم بن محمد، عن ابن عباس، أنه قال ذكر التلاعن عند رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال عاصم بن عدي في ذلك قولا ثم انصرف فأتاه رجل من قومه يشكو إليه أنه وجد مع امرأته رجلا قال عاصم ما ابتليت بهذا إلا بقولي فذهب به إلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فأخبره بالذي وجد عليه امرأته وكان ذلك الرجل مصفرا قليل اللحم سبط الشعر وكان الذي ادعى عليه أنه وجده عند أهله آدم خدلا كثير اللحم ‏.‏ فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اللهم بين ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فوضعت شبيها بالرجل الذي ذكر زوجها أنه وجده عندها فلاعن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بينهما ‏.‏ فقال رجل لابن عباس في المجلس أهي التي قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لو رجمت أحدا بغير بينة رجمت هذه ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال ابن عباس لا تلك امرأة كانت تظهر في الإسلام الشر ‏.‏
llm_response: NarratedAbdullah bin Umar (RA) said that a man asked Allah's Messenger(SAW): "What is more rightful with you in your family?" He replied:"That which I choose."

chapter: The Book of Drinks - كتاب الأشربة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:                     "The Messenger of Allah [SAW] forbade Al-Hantam. I (the narrator) said: "What is Al-Hantam?" He said: "The earthenware jar."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا علي بن الحسين، قال حدثنا أمية، عن شعبة، عن جبلة بن سحيم، عن ابن عمر، قال نهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن الحنتم قلت ما الحنتم قال الجر ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying "Alcohol is a great affliction; it prevents one from his prayer and makes him forget what he says."

chapter: The Book of Presents - كتاب النحل
ground_truth_en: An-Nu'man bin Bashir delivered a Khutbah and said:                      "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Treat your children fairly, treat your children fairly.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا يعقوب بن سفيان، قال حدثنا سليمان بن حرب، قال حدثنا حماد بن زيد، عن حاجب بن المفضل بن المهلب، عن أبيه، قال سمعت النعمان بن بشير، يخطب قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اعدلوا بين أبنائكم اعدلوا بين أبنائكم ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdur Rahman bin Yazid al-'Aswad said that he heard Abu Hurairah say to a man who was asking him about some matter of religion (religious affairs) and had been given the choice between two things, one better than another. He replied: "I have not seen any thing more excellent for you than what I used to see in my Lord's Messenger ."
He said: What is that?
Said Abu Hurairah : "The Prophet was given a gift and he would say, 'This has been sent by some of your brethren.' And if it were not for this I should have thought that you had no friend in the world."

chapter: The Book of Qiyam Al-Lail (The Night Prayer) and Voluntary Prayers During the Day - كتاب قيام الليل وتطوع النهار
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that Hafsah told him:                     "When he was called to Subh prayer, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would do two prostrations before Subh prayer."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن عبد الله بن عبد الحكم، قال أنبأنا إسحاق بن الفرات، عن يحيى بن أيوب، قال حدثني يحيى بن سعيد، قال أنبأنا نافع، عن ابن عمر، عن حفصة، أنها أخبرته أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان إذا نودي لصلاة الصبح سجد سجدتين قبل صلاة الصبح ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more loved by God?" He replied, "(Faith) followed by Jihad (holy fighting in Allah's Cause), and then emigration to the land which has been fought so as to make it Muslim or else an invitation to Islam. Then he asked what was next." The Prophet said: "It is the act of kindness done to your neighbor"

chapter: The Book of Fighting [The Prohibition of Bloodshed] - كتاب تحريم الدم
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Urwah bin Az-Zubair said:                     "Some people from 'Uraynah raided the milk camels of the Messenger of Allah [SAW] and drove them off, and killed a slave of his. The Messenger of Allah [SAW] sent (men) after them, and they were caught, and he had their hands and feet cut off, and their eyes gouged out."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا أحمد بن عمرو بن السرح، قال أنبأنا ابن وهب، قال وأخبرني يحيى بن عبد الله بن سالم، وسعيد بن عبد الرحمن، وذكر، آخر عن هشام بن عروة، عن عروة بن الزبير، أنه قال أغار ناس من عرينة على لقاح رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم واستاقوها وقتلوا غلاما له فبعث رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في آثارهم فأخذوا فقطع أيديهم وأرجلهم وسمل أعينهم ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad  about fighting in which there is no booty or reward other than Paradise? The Messenger of Allaah, the praised and amended said: "Go out for Jihad as you would go to any other battlefield seeking only your share from Paradise."
Reference: Book #37 - Hadith 4041

chapter: The Book of Adornment - كتاب الزينة من السنن
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Ali said:                     "I made some food and invited the Prophet [SAW] (to come and eat). He came and entered, then he saw a curtain on which there were images, so he went out and said: 'The Angels do not enter a house in which there are images.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا مسعود بن جويرية، قال حدثنا وكيع، عن هشام، عن قتادة، عن سعيد بن المسيب، عن علي، قال صنعت طعاما فدعوت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فجاء فدخل فرأى سترا فيه تصاوير فخرج وقال ‏"‏ إن الملائكة لا تدخل بيتا فيه تصاوير ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba said that he heard Abu Hurairah say: The Messenger of Allaah (sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam) came to us in a state which was not like his usual state and we did not know what had happened. He stood up between the two rows, then praised Allah and glorified Him and said:"O people! Do you know why I have come?". We replied: "Allaah knows best." Then he (sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam) told us that a man from our nation had killed another person. He did not tell us his name, but described him to such an extent that we knew who it was and said:"I have come for this reason only". We asked: "O Messenger of Allaah! What do you want?" He (sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam) replied: "Do not harm the blood which has become lawful to us by killing."
Reference : 5349

chapter: The Book of Hajj - كتاب مناسك الحج
ground_truth_en: 'Ubaidullah bin 'Abdullah bin 'Umar narrated that his father said:                     "The Messenger of Allah stayed overnight in dhul-Hulaifah, where he started his Hajj with this action, and he prayed in the Masjid there.''(sahih)
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عيسى بن إبراهيم بن مثرود، عن ابن وهب، قال أخبرني يونس، قال ابن شهاب أخبرني عبيد الله بن عبد الله بن عمر، أن أباه، قال بات رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بذي الحليفة ببيداء وصلى في مسجدها ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that his father told me : The Messenger of Allaah(sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam)( may Allaah exalt the mention of our Noble Prophet, and grant him peace ) came to us in the year (of Hijrah), when we were at 'Arafat. He stood up between As-Safa' and Marwah( two hills near Makkah ).
He said : "O people! Do not stand between these two mountains." Then he went around them seven times, saying: "Allaahu Akbar" ( Allah is the Greatest ) .

chapter: The Book of Divorce - كتاب الطلاق
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Ibn Mas'ud, that he was asked about a man who married a woman, but did not name a Mahr or consummate the marriage before he died. Ibn Mas'ud said:                      "She should have a Mahr like that of women like her, no less and no more; she has to observe the 'Iddah, and she is entitled to inherit." Ma'qil bin Sinan Al-Ashja'i stood up and said: "The Messenger of Allah passed a similar judgment among us concerning Birwa' bint Washiq." And Ibn Masud rejoiced at that.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمود بن غيلان، قال حدثنا زيد بن الحباب، قال حدثنا سفيان، عن منصور، عن إبراهيم، عن علقمة، عن ابن مسعود، أنه سئل عن رجل، تزوج امرأة ولم يفرض لها صداقا ولم يدخل بها حتى مات قال ابن مسعود لها مثل صداق نسائها لا وكس ولا شطط وعليها العدة ولها الميراث ‏.‏ فقام معقل بن سنان الأشجعي فقال قضى فينا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في بروع بنت واشق - امرأة منا - مثل ما قضيت ‏.‏ ففرح ابن مسعود رضى الله عنه ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Aslami said that he heard Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas (may Allaah be pleased with him) say to his wife who had divorced herself three times, "If you do not stop from doing so then I will stone you."

chapter: The Book of Oaths (qasamah), Retaliation and Blood Money - كتاب القسامة
ground_truth_en: It was narrate that Az-Zuhri said:                     "Abu Bakr bin Hazm brought me a letter on a piece of leather (which was ) from the Messenger of Allah: 'This is a statement from Allah and His Messenger: 'O you who believe! Fulfill (your obligations. And he quoted some Verses from it. Then he said: 'For a soul, one hundred camels; for an eye, fifty camels; for a hand, fifty; for a foot, fifty; for a blow to the head that reaches the brain, one-third of the Diyah: for a hand, fifty; for a stab wound that penetrates deeply, one-third of the Diyah; for a blow that breaks a bone, fifteen camels; for fingers, ten each; for teeth, five each; for a wound that exposes the bone, five. (Daif)
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا أحمد بن عبد الواحد، قال حدثنا مروان بن محمد، قال حدثنا سعيد، - وهو ابن عبد العزيز - عن الزهري، قال جاءني أبو بكر بن حزم بكتاب في رقعة من أدم عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هذا بيان من الله ورسوله ‏{‏ يا أيها الذين آمنوا أوفوا بالعقود ‏}‏ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فتلا منها آيات ثم قال ‏"‏ في النفس مائة من الإبل وفي العين خمسون وفي اليد خمسون وفي الرجل خمسون وفي المأمومة ثلث الدية وفي الجائفة ثلث الدية وفي المنقلة خمس عشرة فريضة وفي الأصابع عشر عشر وفي الأسنان خمس خمس وفي الموضحة خمس ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more loved to me?" He replied," Your mother." The man asked thrice in one breathing, and each time he was given the same reply till it became clear (to him) that his question had been repeated.

chapter: The Book of Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah said:                     "When the month of Ramadan begins, the gates of Paradise are opened and the gates of Hell are shut, and the devils are fettered."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا علي بن حجر، قال حدثنا إسماعيل، قال حدثنا أبو سهيل، عن أبيه، عن أبي هريرة، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ إذا دخل شهر رمضان فتحت أبواب الجنة وغلقت أبواب النار وصفدت الشياطين ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What should I say when breaking my fast?" He replied," Say 'I bear witness that there is no god but Allah; and Muhammad is His slave, and His apostle.'"

chapter: The Book of Drinks - كتاب الأشربة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Ibn Shubrumah said:                     "Talhah said to the people of Al-Kufah concerning Nabidh: 'It is a test whereby a young man may benefit but an old man may be harmed.' If there was a wedding among them, Talhah and Zubaid would offer milk and honey to drink. It was said to Talhah: 'Why don't you offer Nabidh?' He said: 'I would not like a Muslim to become intoxicated because of me.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا إسحاق بن إبراهيم، قال أنبأنا جرير، عن ابن شبرمة، قال قال طلحة لأهل الكوفة في النبيذ فتنة يربو فيها الصغير ويهرم فيها الكبير قال وكان إذا كان فيهم عرس كان طلحة وزبير يسقيان اللبن والعسل ‏.‏ فقيل لطلحة ألا تسقيهم النبيذ قال إني أكره أن يسكر مسلم في سببي ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (RA): The Messenger of Allaah(saw) said:"If anyone drinks wine then he should wash his mouth three times."

chapter: The Book of Ghusl and Tayammum - كتاب الغسل والتيمم
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:                      "None of you should urinate into standing water which does not flow and then perform Ghusl with it." (One of the narrators) Sufyan said: "They said to Hisham - meaning Ibn Hassan - 'Ayyub only attributed this Hadith to Abu Hurairah?' So he said: 'If Ayyub is not able to raise up a narration then he does not raise it.'" [1][1] That is, he narrated it from Abu Hurairah, rather than from him from the Prophet (ﷺ) while others narrated it in Marfu' form or "raised" to the Prophet (ﷺ) And perhaps by: "If he is able to not raise it" he means: "If he is not able to raise it." And Allah knows best.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا قتيبة، قال حدثنا سفيان، عن أيوب، عن ابن سيرين، عن أبي هريرة، قال لا يبولن أحدكم في الماء الدائم الذي لا يجري ثم يغتسل منه ‏‏.‏‏ قال سفيان قالوا لهشام - يعني ابن حسان - أن أيوب إنما ينتهي بهذا الحديث إلى أبي هريرة فقال إن أيوب لو استطاع أن لا يرفع حديثا لم يرفعه ‏‏.‏‏
llm_response: Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased him) reported that a man asked Prophet Muhammad () about fasting on three days of every month; he said:"Fast one day or two days." He then added, "If you can't do it regularly, then once in the middle and once towards the end. And if you cannot even do this much, then just a little bit".

chapter: The Book of Funerals - كتاب الجنائز
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:                     "I heard the Messenger of Allah delivering a Khutbah from the Minbar and he said: 'You will meet Allah barefoot, naked and uncircumcised."'
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا قتيبة، قال حدثنا سفيان، عن عمرو، عن سعيد بن جبير، عن ابن عباس، قال سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يخطب على المنبر يقول ‏"‏ إنكم ملاقو الله عز وجل حفاة عراة غرلا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that a man asked Anas b. Malik about the Messenger of Allaah (sallAllaahu alihi wa sallam) and he was not aware, so I went to him and told him: "The Prophet (sallaAllah 'alaihi wa Salaam), said this." He replied that it is a lie.
I then asked Anas b. Malik about the Messenger of Allaah (sallAllaahu alihi wa sallam) and he was not aware, so I went to him again and told him: "The Prophet (sallaAllah 'alaihi wa Salaam), said this." He replied that it is a lie.
