chapter: The Book of Marriage - كتاب النكاح
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Anas said:                      "When the 'Iddah of Zainab was over, the Messenger of Allah said to Zaid: 'Propose marriage to her on my behalf.' Zaid went and said: 'O Zainab, rejoice, for the Messenger of Allah has sent me to you to propose marriage on his behalf.' She said: 'I will not do anything until I consult my Lord.' She went to her prayer place and Qur'an was revealed, then the Messenger of Allah came and entered upon her without any formalities."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا سويد بن نصر، قال أنبأنا عبد الله، قال حدثنا سليمان بن المغيرة، عن ثابت، عن أنس، قال لما انقضت عدة زينب قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم لزيد ‏"‏ اذكرها على ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال زيد فانطلقت فقلت يا زينب أبشري أرسلني إليك رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يذكرك ‏.‏ فقالت ما أنا بصانعة شيئا حتى أستأمر ربي فقامت إلى مسجدها ونزل القرآن وجاء رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فدخل بغير أمر ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم about his wife who had died before he did; whether she would have intercourse and bear children for him in the Hereafter. The Messenger of Allaah, peace and blessings upon him, replied: "Yes."

chapter: The Book of Financial Transactions - كتاب البيوع
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Fadalah bin 'Ubad said:                     "On the Day of Khaibar I got a necklace containing gold and gems, and I wanted to sell it. Mention of that was made to the Prophet and he said: 'Take it apart, and then sell it."'
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عمرو بن منصور، قال حدثنا محمد بن محبوب، قال حدثنا هشيم، قال أنبأنا الليث بن سعد، عن خالد بن أبي عمران، عن حنش الصنعاني، عن فضالة بن عبيد، قال أصبت يوم خيبر قلادة فيها ذهب وخرز فأردت أن أبيعها فذكر ذلك للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال ‏"‏ افصل بعضها من بعض ثم بعها ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Hudhaifa said that he heard Allah's Apostle saying "The ink of a scholar is more sacred than the blood of a martyr."

chapter: The Book of Forgetfulness (In Prayer) - كتاب السهو
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'The tasbih is for men and clapping is for women.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا قتيبة، قال حدثنا الفضيل بن عياض، عن الأعمش، ح وأنبأنا سويد بن نصر، قال أنبأنا عبد الله، عن سليمان الأعمش، عن أبي صالح، عن أبي هريرة، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ التسبيح للرجال والتصفيق للنساء ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad about his prayer while he was asleep? He replied "If any of you should sleep before praying then let him get up for fear lest Allah will punish him."

chapter: The Book of Leading the Prayer (Al-Imamah) - كتاب الإمامة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Ibn Abbas said:                      "I stayed overnight with my maternal aunt Maimunah, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got up to pray at night. I stood on his left, so he did this to me: He took me by the head and made me stand on his right."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا يعقوب بن إبراهيم، قال حدثنا ابن علية، عن أيوب، عن عبد الله بن سعيد بن جبير، عن أبيه، عن ابن عباس، قال بت عند خالتي ميمونة فقام رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يصلي من الليل فقمت عن شماله فقال بي هكذا فأخذ برأسي فأقامني عن يمينه ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Allah's Messenger what deeds are most loved by Allah? He replied "To feed (the hungry) in the morning."

chapter: The Book of the Fear Prayer - كتاب صلاة الخوف
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Jabir said:                     "We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) in a palm grove and the enemy was between us and the Qiblah. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said the takbir and we all said the takbir. Then he bowed and we all bowed. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) and the row that was closest to him prostrated, while the others remained standing, guarding us. When we stood up, the others prostrated where we were, then they moved forward and he bowed and they all bowed, then he stood up and they all stood up. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) and the row that was closest to him prostrated, and the others remained standing, guarding them. When they had prostrated and were sitting, the others prostrated where they were, then he said the salam." Jabir said: "As your leaders do."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عمرو بن علي، قال حدثنا عبد الرحمن، عن سفيان، عن أبي الزبير، عن جابر، قال كنا مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بنخل والعدو بيننا وبين القبلة فكبر رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فكبروا جميعا ثم ركع فركعوا جميعا ثم سجد النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم والصف الذي يليه والآخرون قيام يحرسونهم فلما قاموا سجد الآخرون مكانهم الذين كانوا فيه ثم تقدم هؤلاء إلى مصاف هؤلاء فركع فركعوا جميعا ثم رفع فرفعوا جميعا ثم سجد النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم والصف الذين يلونه والآخرون قيام يحرسونهم فلما سجدوا وجلسوا سجد الآخرون مكانهم ثم سلم ‏.‏ قال جابر كما يفعل أمراؤكم ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Anas b. Malik say to his wife when she asked him about a thing which had been forbidden by Allaah and His Messenger (sallAllaahu alihi wa sallam) "Do you not know that the Prophet (sallahu alaiyhsi saleem), said, 'Whoever swears an oath in order to deceive another person has committed a sin.'"
Ruling: This Hadith is Hasan Saheeh.

chapter: The Book of ad-Dahaya (Sacrifices) - كتاب الضحايا
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Amr bin Sharid said:                     "I heard Sharid say: 'I herd the Messenger of Allah say: Whoever kills a small bird for no reason, it will beseech Allah on the Day of Resurrection saying: O Lord, so and so killed me for no reason. And he did not kill me for any beneficial purpose."'
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن داود المصيصي، قال حدثنا أحمد بن حنبل، قال حدثنا أبو عبيدة عبد الواحد بن واصل، عن خلف، - يعني ابن مهران - قال حدثنا عامر الأحول، عن صالح بن دينار، عن عمرو بن الشريد، قال سمعت الشريد، يقول سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول ‏"‏ من قتل عصفورا عبثا عج إلى الله عز وجل يوم القيامة يقول يا رب إن فلانا قتلني عبثا ولم يقتلني لمنفعة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم about sacrificing an animal from his own property or one he had bought, and whether it was permissible for the owner of the land to eat its meat.
Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم replied: "No."

chapter: The Book of Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Arfajah said;'We visited 'Utbah bin Farqad (when he was ill) and we talked about the month of Ramadan. He said; 'What are you talking about?' We said:                      'The month of Ramadan. He said: "I heard the Messenger of Allah say: In it the gates of Paradise are opened and the gates of the Fire are closed, and the devils are chained up, and a caller calls out every night: O doer of good, proceed; O doer of evil, desist!"'
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن منصور، قال حدثنا سفيان، عن عطاء بن السائب، عن عرفجة، قال عدنا عتبة بن فرقد فتذاكرنا شهر رمضان فقال ما تذكرون قلنا شهر رمضان ‏.‏ قال سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول ‏"‏ تفتح فيه أبواب الجنة وتغلق فيه أبواب النار وتغل فيه الشياطين وينادي مناد كل ليلة يا باغي الخير هلم ويا باغي الشر أقصر ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال أبو عبد الرحمن هذا خطأ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that his father told me : The Messenger of Allaah(sallaahu alayhi wa sallam)( may Allaah exalt His mention )said, "Fasting is to Me as the ring on your hand. If you fast , then do not look at what is forbidden for you . And if anyone looks at it (i.e., his wife), he should refrain from looking."

chapter: The Book of Hunting and Slaughtering - كتاب الصيد والذبائح
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Adiyy bin Hatim said:                     "I asked the Messenger of Allah: 'I release my dog. He said: 'If you release your dog and mention the name of Allah, then eat. But it he has eaten some of it, the do not eats, for the caught it for himself. If you release your dog then you find another dog with it, then do not eat, for you said the name of Allah over your dog, and not over any other.""
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا سليمان بن عبيد الله بن عمرو الغيلاني البصري، قال حدثنا بهز، قال حدثنا شعبة، قال حدثنا عبد الله بن أبي السفر، عن عامر الشعبي، عن عدي بن حاتم، قال سألت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قلت أرسل كلبي ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ إذا أرسلت كلبك فسميت فكل وإن أكل منه فلا تأكل فإنما أمسك على نفسه وإذا أرسلت كلبك فوجدت معه غيره فلا تأكل فإنك إنما سميت على كلبك ولم تسم على غيره ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man came to Allah's Apostle with his brother or son (the narrator is doubtful) who was insolent to him and he asked for separation between them, so they were separated by the order of an arbitration panel.

chapter: The Book of Financial Transactions - كتاب البيوع
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Salim that his father said:                     "I saw people being beaten (in punishment) at the time of the Messenger of Allah for buying food unmeasured and selling it before bringing it to their own camp."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا نصر بن علي، قال حدثنا يزيد، عن معمر، عن الزهري، عن سالم، عن أبيه، قال رأيت الناس يضربون على عهد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا اشتروا الطعام جزافا أن يبيعوه حتى يئووه إلى رحالهم ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba' said that he heard his father say to him while they were on a journey : "O my son ! I have been informed about some of your deeds which you are doing, and if this is the case then do not be hasty in speech."

chapter: The Book of Oaths (qasamah), Retaliation and Blood Money - كتاب القسامة
ground_truth_en: It was narrataed from Al-Ashtar that he said to 'Ali:                     "What the people have been hearing from you has become widespread. If the Messenger of Allah told you anything, then tell us," He said: "The Messenger of Allah did not tell me anything that he did not tell the people, except that in the sheath of my sword there is a sheet, in which it says: 'The lives of the believers are equal in value, and they hasten to support the asylum granted by the least of them. But no believer may be killed in return for a disbeliever, nor one with a covenant while his covenant is in effect."' It is an abridgement of it.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا أحمد بن حفص، قال حدثني أبي قال، حدثني إبراهيم بن طهمان، عن الحجاج بن الحجاج، عن قتادة، عن أبي حسان الأعرج، عن الأشتر، أنه قال لعلي إن الناس قد تفشغ بهم ما يسمعون فإن كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عهد إليك عهدا فحدثنا به ‏.‏ قال ما عهد إلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عهدا لم يعهده إلى الناس غير أن في قراب سيفي صحيفة فإذا فيها ‏"‏ المؤمنون تتكافأ دماؤهم يسعى بذمتهم أدناهم لا يقتل مؤمن بكافر ولا ذو عهد في عهده ‏"‏ ‏.‏ مختصر ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba'ah Al-Ansari said that he heard a man asked Ibn Abbas about an oath which was taken in his presence by one of them who had been guilty, and what is the punishment for him? He replied to him.

chapter: The Book of Purification - كتاب الطهارة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Ammar said:                      "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stopped to rest at the end of the night in Uwlat Al-Jaish. His wife 'Aishah was with him and her necklace of Zifar beads [1] broke and fell. The army was detained looking for that necklace of hers until the break of the light of dawn and the people had no water with them. Abu Bakr got angry with her and said: 'You have detained the people and they do not have any water.' Then Allah the Mighty and Sublime revealed the concession allowing Tayammum with clean earth. So the Muslims got up with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and struck with their hands, then they raised their hands and did not strike them together to knock off any dust, then they wiped their faces and arms up to the shoulders, and from the inner side of their of their arms up to the armpits."[1] Black and white Yemeni beads.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن يحيى بن عبد الله، قال حدثنا يعقوب بن إبراهيم، قال حدثنا أبي، عن صالح، عن ابن شهاب، قال حدثني عبيد الله بن عبد الله بن عتبة، عن ابن عباس، عن عمار، قال عرس رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بأولات الجيش ومعه عائشة زوجته فانقطع عقدها من جزع ظفار فحبس الناس ابتغاء عقدها ذلك حتى أضاء الفجر وليس مع الناس ماء فتغيظ عليها أبو بكر فقال حبست الناس وليس معهم ماء فأنزل الله عز وجل رخصة التيمم بالصعيد قال فقام المسلمون مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فضربوا بأيديهم الأرض ثم رفعوا أيديهم ولم ينفضوا من التراب شيئا فمسحوا بها وجوههم وأيديهم إلى المناكب ومن بطون أيديهم إلى الآباط ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about his wives whom he had married in Medina before Islam; so he told him to have nothing to do with them until they performed Taharat.

chapter: The Book of Seeking Refuge with Allah - كتاب الاستعاذة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Dharr said:                     "I entered the Masjid and the Messenger of Allah [SAW] was there, so I came and sat before him and he said: 'O Abu Dharr, seek refuge with Allah from the evils of the devils among the Jinn and mankind.' I said: 'Are there devils among mankind?' He said: 'Yes.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا أحمد بن سليمان، قال حدثنا جعفر بن عون، قال حدثنا عبد الرحمن بن عبد الله، عن أبي عمر، عن عبيد بن خشخاش، عن أبي ذر، قال دخلت المسجد ورسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فيه فجئت فجلست إليه فقال ‏"‏ يا أبا ذر تعوذ بالله من شر شياطين الجن والإنس ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قلت أوللإنس شياطين قال ‏"‏ نعم ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying "O Allah's Apostle! What should I say when I seek refuge with you?" He replied, "(Say), 'Allahu Akbar!' and then mention the Name of your Lord once or twice."

chapter: The Book of Marriage - كتاب النكاح
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:                      "One of the things that Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, revealed" -(one of the narrators) Al-Harith said (in his narration): "One of the things that were revealed in the Qur'an"- "was that ten known breast-feedings make marriage prohibited, then that was abrogated and changed to five known breast-feedings. Then the Messenger of Allah passed away when this was something that was still being recited in the Qur'an."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرني هارون بن عبد الله، قال حدثنا معن، قال حدثنا مالك، والحارث بن مسكين، قراءة عليه وأنا أسمع، عن ابن القاسم، قال حدثني مالك، عن عبد الله بن أبي بكر، عن عمرة، عن عائشة، قالت كان فيما أنزل الله عز وجل - وقال الحارث فيما أنزل من القرآن - عشر رضعات معلومات يحرمن ثم نسخن بخمس معلومات فتوفي رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وهي مما يقرأ من القرآن ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas say to his wife while she was on a journey with him in which they were riding two camels, one behind the other and their children between them. He asked her: "What is your age?" She replied: "I am twenty years old." So 'Abdullah said: "You are not like those who have reached puberty but you still look as if you had just entered into it (i.e., a virgin)."

chapter: The Book of Hajj - كتاب مناسك الحج
ground_truth_en: It was narrated the Usmah bin Zaid said:                     "I entered the House with the Messenger of Allah. He sat and praised Allah, and recited the Takbir, and the Tahlil. Then he went to the wall of the House that was in front of him, and placed his chest, cheek and hands on it, then he recited the Takbir, and the Tahlil, and supplicated. And he did that in all the corners, then he came out, and turned to face the Qiblah while he was in front of the door, and he said: 'This is the Qiblah, this is the Qiblah.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا يعقوب بن إبراهيم، قال حدثنا هشيم، قال أنبأنا عبد الملك، عن عطاء، عن أسامة بن زيد، قال دخلت مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم البيت فجلس فحمد الله وأثنى عليه وكبر وهلل ثم مال إلى ما بين يديه من البيت فوضع صدره عليه وخده ويديه ثم كبر وهلل ودعا فعل ذلك بالأركان كلها ثم خرج فأقبل على القبلة وهو على الباب فقال ‏"‏ هذه القبلة هذه القبلة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Aslami said that he heard Abu Hurairah say: The Messenger of Allaah (sallaahu aleyhi wa sallam) came to us and we were with him in the mosque. He asked, "What is this?" We replied, "It was something which our forefathers used to do."
He said, "Do not you know that every innovation is misguidance? And all misguidance leads to Hell except what I have brought and my followers will act upon it.

chapter: The Book of Zakah - كتاب الزكاة
ground_truth_en: Abu Hurairah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah said: '(On the Day of Resurrection) camels will come to their owner in the best state of health that they ever had (in this world) and if he did not pay what was due on them, they will trample him with their hooves. Sheep willcome to their owner in the best state of health that they ever had (in this world) and if he did not pay what was due on them, they will trample him with their cloven hooves and gore him with their horns. And among their rights are that they should be milked with water in the front of them. I do not want any one of you to come on the Day of Resurrection with a groaning camel on his neck, saying , O Muhammad, and I will say: I cannot do anything for you, I conveyed the message. I do not  want any one of you to come on the Day of Resurrection with a bleating sheep on his neck, saying, "O Muhammad," and I will say: "I cannot do anything for you, I conveyed the message." And on the Day of Resurrection the hoarded treasure of one of you will be a blad-headed Shujaa[1]from which its owner will flee, but it will chase him (saying), I am your hoarded treasure, and it will keep (chasing him) until he gives it his finger to swallow."'
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عمران بن بكار، قال حدثنا علي بن عياش، قال حدثنا شعيب، قال حدثني أبو الزناد، مما حدثه عبد الرحمن الأعرج، مما ذكر أنه سمع أبا هريرة، يحدث به قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تأتي الإبل على ربها على خير ما كانت إذا هي لم يعط فيها حقها تطؤه بأخفافها وتأتي الغنم على ربها على خير ما كانت إذا لم يعط فيها حقها تطؤه بأظلافها وتنطحه بقرونها - قال - ومن حقها أن تحلب على الماء ألا لا يأتين أحدكم يوم القيامة ببعير يحمله على رقبته له رغاء فيقول يا محمد ‏.‏ فأقول لا أملك لك شيئا قد بلغت ‏.‏ ألا لا يأتين أحدكم يوم القيامة بشاة يحملها على رقبته لها يعار فيقول يا محمد ‏.‏ فأقول لا أملك لك شيئا قد بلغت - قال - ويكون كنز أحدهم يوم القيامة شجاعا أقرع يفر منه صاحبه ويطلبه أنا كنزك فلا يزال حتى يلقمه أصبعه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that a man asked Anas b. Malik about Zakat of camels (Zakah). He replied: "The Messenger of Allaah(sallallaahu `alayhi wa sallam) used to give the zakat of his camel and he would not eat its meat."

chapter: The Book of Qiyam Al-Lail (The Night Prayer) and Voluntary Prayers During the Day - كتاب قيام الليل وتطوع النهار
ground_truth_en: Mansur reported from Salamah bin Kuhail, from Sa'eed bin Abdur-Rahman bin Abza, from his father, who said:                     "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite in witr: Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High;" and "Say: O you disbelievers!;' and 'Say: He is Allah, (the) One.' And when he said the taslim, he would say: Subhanal-Malikil-Quddus (Glory be to the Sovereign, the Most Holy) three times, elongating his words the third time."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن قدامة، عن جرير، عن منصور، عن سلمة بن كهيل، عن سعيد بن عبد الرحمن بن أبزى، عن أبيه، قال كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يوتر ب ‏{‏ سبح اسم ربك الأعلى ‏}‏ و ‏{‏ قل يا أيها الكافرون ‏}‏ و ‏{‏ قل هو الله أحد ‏}‏ وكان إذا سلم وفرغ قال ‏"‏ سبحان الملك القدوس ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثلاثا طول في الثالثة ‏.‏ ورواه عبد الملك بن أبي سليمان عن زبيد ولم يذكر ذرا ‏.‏
llm_response:
NARRATED BY ABU HURAIRAH RAWDA BIN AL-MUGHILA AND OTHERS; SAID ABDU SALAM ON BEHALF OF HIS FATHER, THAT THE Messenger of ALLAH (sallAllahu alayhi wa sallam) said:
"Whoever observes the night prayer in a group and then leaves it out for fear that he will not be able to perform all his prayers on time; or because there is no one else who can observe with him, but rather he should leave them (the remaining prayers of the day), so as to continue performing the Night Prayer until morning."

chapter: The Book of Hajj - كتاب مناسك الحج
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Shuraih, that he said to Amr bin Sad when he was sending troops in batches to Makkah:                     "O Commander! Permit me to tell you of a statement that the Messenger of Allah said the day after the Conquest of Makkah, which my ears heard, my hear understood, and my eyes saw, when he said it. He (the Prophet) praised Allah, then he said: 'Makkah has been made sacred by Allah, not by the people. It is not permissible for any man who believes in Allah and the Last Day to shed blood in it, or to cut its trees. If any one seeks permission to fight in it because the Messenger of Allah fought in it, say to him: Allah allowed his Messenger (to fight therein) but He did not allow you. Rather permission was given to me (to fight therein) for a short period one day, and now its sanctity has been restored as it as before. Let those who are present convey (this mews) to those who are absent.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا قتيبة، قال حدثنا الليث، عن سعيد بن أبي سعيد، عن أبي شريح، أنه قال لعمرو بن سعيد وهو يبعث البعوث إلى مكة ائذن لي أيها الأمير أحدثك قولا قام به رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم الغد من يوم الفتح سمعته أذناى ووعاه قلبي وأبصرته عيناى حين تكلم به حمد الله وأثنى عليه ثم قال ‏"‏ إن مكة حرمها الله ولم يحرمها الناس ولا يحل لامرئ يؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر أن يسفك بها دما ولا يعضد بها شجرا فإن ترخص أحد لقتال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فيها فقولوا له إن الله أذن لرسوله ولم يأذن لكم وإنما أذن لي فيها ساعة من نهار وقد عادت حرمتها اليوم كحرمتها بالأمس وليبلغ الشاهد الغائب ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
NARRATED IKHSHID AL-JUFRI said : We were with 'Aisha when a man came to her while she was in prayer so he stood up waiting till she had finished praying and then sat down beside her, whereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) turned round towards him saying: "O son of Khuzaymah ! Sit at my right hand."
So 'Aisha said : I have never seen a man more ashamed than that one.

chapter: The Book of Purification - كتاب الطهارة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Hazim said:                      "I was behind Abu Hurairah when he performed Wudu' for Salah. He washed his hand up to the armpit, and I said: 'O Abu Hurairah! What is this Wudu'?' He said to me: 'O Banu Farrukh! You are here! If I had known that you were here I would not have performed Wudu' like this. I heard my close friend (i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)) says: "The jewelry of the believer will reach as far as his Wudu reached."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا قتيبة، عن خلف، - وهو ابن خليفة - عن أبي مالك الأشجعي، عن أبي حازم، قال كنت خلف أبي هريرة وهو يتوضأ للصلاة وكان يغسل يديه حتى يبلغ إبطيه فقلت يا أبا هريرة ما هذا الوضوء فقال لي يا بني فروخ أنتم ها هنا لو علمت أنكم ها هنا ما توضأت هذا الوضوء سمعت خليلي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول ‏"‏ تبلغ حلية المؤمن حيث يبلغ الوضوء ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Abu Hurairah said : The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to us in a state which was like that of one who had just performed ablution but he did not perform any ablution and then sat down on the mat. Then we were called for prayer, so I went ahead with him as if it was my duty.
He said : "O Abu Hurairah! Do you know how to do wudoo'?" (I replied) : No by Allah ! He repeated this thrice and then he performed ablution in the same way that a person performs when intending for prayer, but there was no water.
Then I said: "O Messenger of Allah! You have just done wudoo'?" (He replied) : Yes."

chapter: The Book of Qiyam Al-Lail (The Night Prayer) and Voluntary Prayers During the Day - كتاب قيام الليل وتطوع النهار
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Umm Habibah that:                     The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Whoever prays twelve rak'ahs during the day and night, a house will be built for him in Paradise."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن إسماعيل بن إبراهيم، قال حدثنا يزيد بن هارون، قال أنبأنا إسماعيل، عن المسيب بن رافع، عن عنبسة بن أبي سفيان، عن أم حبيبة، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ من صلى في اليوم والليلة ثنتى عشرة ركعة بني له بيت في الجنة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that a man asked Anas b. Malik about night prayer (Tahajjud). He replied to him saying: "O my brother! I do not know anything more than what the Messenger of Allaah, peace and blessings be upon him, taught me."
The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: "[While] you are in your beds (in bed), say:" O'Allah! I am a Muslim. My Lord is the only one who has no partner with Him; He created everything for His glory alone. You have given me my sustenance from before and to this day." Then he added: "O Allaah, bless us in our wives and offspring (children) as Thou didst bless Abraham and Isaac - a progeny of righteous people who worship Thee with sincerity. O'Allah! Bless me with the love for them." Then he added: "O Allaah, I am in need of Your mercy; so do not leave me alone (in this world)."

chapter: The Book of the Times (of Prayer) - كتاب المواقيت
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:                      "Whoever catches up with a prostration of Subh before the sun rises, then he has caught up with it; and whoever catches up with a prostration of 'Asr before the sun sets, then he has caught up with it."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا إبراهيم بن محمد، ومحمد بن المثنى، - واللفظ له - قالا حدثنا يحيى، عن عبد الله بن سعيد، قال حدثني عبد الرحمن الأعرج، عن أبي هريرة، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ من أدرك سجدة من الصبح قبل أن تطلع الشمس فقد أدركها ومن أدرك سجدة من العصر قبل أن تغرب الشمس فقد أدركها ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Anas b. Malik say to his wife while they were on a journey : "I will go out for prayer (to pray) and you stay here with the children."

chapter: The Book of Purification - كتاب الطهارة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas from the Prophet (ﷺ) concerning a man who has had intercourse while she was menstruating:                      "Let him give a Dinar or half a Dinar in charity."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عمرو بن علي، قال حدثنا يحيى، عن شعبة، عن الحكم، عن عبد الحميد، عن مقسم، عن ابن عباس، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم في الرجل يأتي امرأته وهي حائض يتصدق بدينار أو بنصف دينار ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar...

chapter: The Book of Financial Transactions - كتاب البيوع
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Rafi said:                     "The Messenger of Allah said" "The neighbor has more right to property that is near."'
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا علي بن حجر، قال حدثنا سفيان، عن إبراهيم بن ميسرة، عن عمرو بن الشريد، عن أبي رافع، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الجار أحق بسقبه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Aslami said that he heard Anas b. Malik say to his wife while they were on a journey with some of their family members who had come from Makkah, "O my sister! Do not let anyone know about our having met the Messenger (of Allah) and what we have seen." She replied: I will do so if you wish.

chapter: The Book Of Faith and its Signs - كتاب الإيمان وشرائعه
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah [SAW] said: 'Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, has guaranteed to the one who goes out in His cause, 'and he does not go out for any other purpose except Jihad in My cause and faith in Me, believing in My Messengers, but he is guaranteed that I will admit him to Paradise or I will send him back to his dwelling from which he set out, having acquired whatever he acquired of reward or spoils of war.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن قدامة قال حدثنا جرير عن عمارة بن القعقاع عن أبي زرعة عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال   قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم تضمن الله عز وجل لمن خرج في سبيله لا يخرجه إلا الجهاد في سبيلي وإيمان بي وتصديق برسلي فهو ضامن أن أدخله الجنة أو أرجعه إلى مسكنه الذي خرج منه نال ما نال من أجر أو غنيمة
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said "The example of a believer in his Shariah is like that of rain-water; it befalls on wheresoever it reaches."

chapter: The Book of Purification - كتاب الطهارة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:                      "I used to wash the Janabah from the garment of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he would go out to pray, with traces of water on his garment."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا سويد بن نصر، قال أنبأنا عبد الله، عن عمرو بن ميمون الجزري، عن سليمان بن يسار، عن عائشة، قالت كنت أغسل الجنابة من ثوب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فيخرج إلى الصلاة وإن بقع الماء لفي ثوبه ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying "If anyone of you is fasting in daytime then let him break his fast by drinking water."

chapter: The Book of Forgetfulness (In Prayer) - كتاب السهو
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Ibrahim said:                     "They used to say: 'If one is not sure of what he estimates is correct, then prostrate twice.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا سويد بن نصر، قال أنبأنا عبد الله، عن ابن عون، عن إبراهيم، قال كانوا يقولون إذا أوهم يتحرى الصواب ثم يسجد سجدتين ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying a Hadith like which I narrate to you but with slight differences and added in it, "O people! Do not make your Salat too long. For indeed the best of those who perform Salah is one whose heart trembles when he performs his Salah."
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying a Hadith like which I narrate to you but with slight differences and added in it, "O people! Do not make your Salat too long. For indeed the best of those who perform Salah is one whose heart trembles when he performs his Salah."

chapter: The Book of Leading the Prayer (Al-Imamah) - كتاب الإمامة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Anas that the Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) fell from a horse onto his right side.They came to visit him and the time for prayer came. When the prayer was over he said:                      "The Imam is appointed to be followed. When he bows, then bow, when he stands up, then stand up, when he prostrates, then prostrate, and when he says Sami' Alldhu liman hamidah (Allah hears the one who praises Him), then say, Rabbanrilakal-hamd (Our Lord, to You be the praise)."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا هناد بن السري، عن ابن عيينة، عن الزهري، عن أنس، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم سقط من فرس على شقه الأيمن فدخلوا عليه يعودونه فحضرت الصلاة فلما قضى الصلاة قال ‏"‏ إنما جعل الإمام ليؤتم به فإذا ركع فاركعوا وإذا رفع فارفعوا وإذا سجد فاسجدوا وإذا قال سمع الله لمن حمده فقولوا ربنا لك الحمد ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid Al-'Ansari (may Allaah be pleased with him): I heard Anas Bin Malik (May Allaah Be Merciful Upon Him) say, "I saw the Messenger of Allaah (sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam), and he was leading us in prayer. He did not turn his back to anyone."

chapter: The Book of Gifts - كتاب الهبة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin 'Abbas that the Messenger of Allah said:                      "The likeness of the one who takes back his gift is that of a dog which vomits, then goes back to its vomit." (One of the narrators) Al-Awza'i said: "I heard him narrating this Hadith to 'Ata bin Abi Rabah."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا الهيثم بن مروان بن الهيثم بن عمران، قال حدثنا محمد، - وهو ابن بكار بن بلال - قال حدثنا يحيى، عن الأوزاعي، أن محمد بن علي بن الحسين، حدثه عن سعيد بن المسيب، عن عبد الله بن عباس، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ مثل الذي يرجع في صدقته كمثل الكلب يقيء ثم يعود في قيئه ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال الأوزاعي سمعته يحدث عطاء بن أبي رباح بهذا الحديث ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar...

chapter: The Book of Hajj - كتاب مناسك الحج
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Ibn Abbas said:                     "The Messenger of Allah came on the fourth day of Dhul-Hijjah having entered Ihram for Hajj. He prayed Subh in Al-Batha and said: 'Whoever wants to make it Umrah, let him do so.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن بشار، عن يحيى بن كثير أبو غسان، قال حدثنا شعبة، عن أيوب، عن أبي العالية البراء، عن ابن عباس، قال قدم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم لأربع مضين من ذي الحجة وقد أهل بالحج فصلى الصبح بالبطحاء وقال ‏"‏ من شاء أن يجعلها عمرة فليفعل ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Anas bin Malik said that he heard Allah's Apostle saying "O people! There is a gate of Paradise called 'Ar-Rahmaan'. It will be opened tomorrow (on Eid day) and nobody will enter it except the one who has none to ransom for him, either father or brother or son.
Narrated Anas bin Malik said that he heard Allah's Apostle saying "O people! There is a gate of Paradise called 'Ar-Rahmaan'. It will be opened tomorrow (on Eid day) and nobody will enter it except the one who has none to ransom for him, either father or brother or son.

chapter: The Book of the Commencement of the Prayer - كتاب الافتتاح
ground_truth_en: Sa'eed bin Sam'an said Abu Hurairah came to the Masjid of Banu Zuraiq and said:                     "There are three things that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to do and the people have abandoned; he used to raise his hands extended when praying, and he would fall silent briefly, and say takbir when he prostrated and when he sat up."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عمرو بن علي، قال حدثنا يحيى، قال حدثنا ابن أبي ذئب، قال حدثنا سعيد بن سمعان، قال جاء أبو هريرة إلى مسجد بني زريق فقال ثلاث كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يعمل بهن تركهن الناس كان يرفع يديه في الصلاة مدا ويسكت هنيهة ويكبر إذا سجد وإذا رفع ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid Al-'Ansari said that he heard Anas Bin Malik say to his wife when she was sick "I will go out with my brother Abu Talha, and I shall come back soon." So they went together. When it became evening time, the people came looking for them but did not find them anywhere except at a well where there is an old tree which has been cut down by its roots so that one can enter into it from below to drink water out of it.
They asked Anas Bin Malik's wife "Where are your husband and brother?" She said, "I do not know." They told her about the place they found them at but she did not recognize their faces because darkness had covered them up so that one could hardly see anything except a little light from the fire.
They asked Anas Bin Malik's wife again to tell him what happened and he said, "I went out with my brother Abu Talha for an hour or two when I returned home at night time." She then told them about his saying that she would go out with her husband so they could come back soon.
They asked Anas Bin Malik's wife again to tell him what happened and he said, "I went out with my brother Abu Talha for an hour or two when I returned home at night time." She then told them about his saying that she would go

chapter: The Book of Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: Zirr bin Hubaish said:                     "I had Sahur with Hudhaifah, then we went out to pray. When we came to the Masjid we prayed two Rakahs, then the Iqamah for prayer was said, and there was only a short time between them." Abu Hurairah said : "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Eat Sahur, for in Sahur there is blessing."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن بشار، قال حدثنا محمد، قال حدثنا شعبة، عن عدي، قال سمعت زر بن حبيش، قال تسحرت مع حذيفة ثم خرجنا إلى الصلاة فلما أتينا المسجد صلينا ركعتين وأقيمت الصلاة وليس بينهما إلا هنيهة ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Allahs Apostle saying, "While a man was walking along with two of his companions, they became hungry and asked him for some food to eat (as it was very cold). So the person who had been fasting gave them his ration. When they finished eating, one of those persons said to their companion, 'I will tell you what I heard a man saying in the mosque yesterday.' He told that he overheard a man telling another about some matter which was not good."

chapter: The Book of Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Uqbah bin 'Amir that the Messenger of Allah said:                     "Whoever fasts one day in the cause of Allah, the mighty and sublime, Allah will separate him the distance of one hundred years from the fire."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمود بن خالد، عن محمد بن شعيب، قال أخبرني يحيى بن الحارث، عن القاسم أبي عبد الرحمن، أنه حدثه عن عقبة بن عامر، عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ من صام يوما في سبيل الله عز وجل باعد الله منه جهنم مسيرة مائة عام ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What should I say if my wife is sick?" He replied, "(Say), 'Allah Oft-Praised and All Praiseworthy.'"

chapter: The Book of Forgetfulness (In Prayer) - كتاب السهو
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forgot and said the taslim after two rak'ahs. Dhul-Shimalain said to him: 'Has the prayer been shortened or did you forget, O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)?' The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Is Dhul-Yadain speaking the truth?' They said: "Yes." So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood up and completed the prayer."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا هارون بن موسى الفروي، قال حدثني أبو ضمرة، عن يونس، عن ابن شهاب، قال أخبرني أبو سلمة، عن أبي هريرة، قال نسي رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فسلم في سجدتين ‏.‏ فقال له ذو الشمالين أقصرت الصلاة أم نسيت يا رسول الله قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أصدق ذو اليدين ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قالوا نعم ‏.‏ فقام رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فأتم الصلاة ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (RA): The Messenger of Allaah(saw) said to me while he was pointing his hand towards Yemen:"O' son! Do you see that land? That is the place where they will be gathered."

chapter: The Book of Zakah - كتاب الزكاة
ground_truth_en: Bahz bin Hakim narrated from his father that his grandfather said:                     "If something was brought to him, the prophet would ask whether it was a gift or charity. If it was said that if was charity, he would not eat, and if it was said that it was a gift, he would stretch forth his hand."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا زياد بن أيوب، قال حدثنا عبد الواحد بن واصل، قال حدثنا بهز بن حكيم، عن أبيه، عن جده، قال كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا أتي بشىء سأل عنه ‏"‏ أهدية أم صدقة ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فإن قيل صدقة لم يأكل وإن قيل هدية بسط يده ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Anas b. Malik say to a man who asked him about Zakat (charity tax): "I have got nothing but this handful of dates."

chapter: The Book of Endowments - كتاب الإحباس
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Umar said:                      "I asked the Messenger of Allah about some land of mine in Thamgh. He said: 'Freeze it and donate its fruits.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن مصفى بن بهلول، قال حدثنا بقية، عن سعيد بن سالم المكي، عن عبيد الله بن عمر، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر، عن عمر، قال سألت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن أرض لي بثمغ قال ‏"‏ احبس أصلها وسبل ثمرتها ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba'ah Al-Ansari said that he heard his father say to him while they were on a journey : "O my son! Do you know who is your nearest neighbour ?" He replied, "My mother." Then I asked the same question of Abu Hudhaifa and 'Abdur Rahman bin Awf. Both of them told me that their wives are their closest neighbours (to whom they could go for help).
I said to both of them : "Do you know who is your nearest neighbour ?" They replied, "O son! We do not consider any one except our Lord."

chapter: The Book of Zakah - كتاب الزكاة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah said:                     "There are four whom Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, hates: The vendor who sells his wares by means of false oaths, the poor man who shows off, the old man who commits Zina and the Imam who is unjust."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا أبو داود، قال حدثنا عارم، قال حدثنا حماد، قال حدثنا عبيد الله بن عمر، عن سعيد المقبري، عن أبي هريرة، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ أربعة يبغضهم الله عز وجل البياع الحلاف والفقير المختال والشيخ الزاني والإمام الجائر ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more loved to me?" He replied, "(To love) your brother." The man asked (the same), for he repeated it thrice and every time the Prophet told him similar answer. Then the man asked again and this final reply was: 'That you should be one of those who will enter Paradise.'

chapter: The Book of Adornment - كتاب الزينة من السنن
ground_truth_en: 'Abdullah bin 'Amr narrated that:                     The Messenger of Allah [SAW] saw him wearing two garments dyed with safflower and he said: "This is the clothing of disbelievers; do not wear it."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا إسماعيل بن مسعود، قال حدثنا خالد، - وهو ابن الحارث - قال حدثنا هشام، عن يحيى بن أبي كثير، عن محمد بن إبراهيم، أن خالد بن معدان، أخبره أن جبير بن نفير أخبره أن عبد الله بن عمرو أخبره أنه، رآه رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وعليه ثوبان معصفران فقال ‏"‏ هذه ثياب الكفار فلا تلبسها ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Aslami said that he heard Anas b. Malik say to a man who asked him about his clothes (i.e., whether they were new or old): "I have not seen any of the Messenger of Allaah r saying anything regarding this matter."

chapter: The Book of Fighting [The Prohibition of Bloodshed] - كتاب تحريم الدم
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Abdullah said:                     "I asked the Messenger of Allah [SAW], which sin is most grievous?" He said: "Shirk, setting up a rival to Allah, committing adultery with your neighbor's wife, and killing your child for fear of poverty, and that he may eat with you." Then 'Abdullah recited the Verse: "And those who invoke not any other Ilah (god) along with Allah."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عبدة، قال أنبأنا يزيد، قال أنبأنا شعبة، عن عاصم، عن أبي وائل، عن عبد الله، قال سألت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أى الذنب أعظم قال ‏"‏ الشرك أن تجعل لله ندا وأن تزاني بحليلة جارك وأن تقتل ولدك مخافة الفقر أن يأكل معك ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثم قرأ عبد الله ‏{‏ والذين لا يدعون مع الله إلها آخر ‏}‏ ‏.‏ قال أبو عبد الرحمن هذا خطأ والصواب الذي قبله وحديث يزيد هذا خطأ إنما هو واصل والله تعالى أعلم ‏.‏

llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What should I say if my wife is sick?" He replied: Say: 'Insha-Allaah (God willing).

llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Yazid Al-Ansari said that he heard a man from Quraish say to his brother who was with him in the mosque of Medina (the Prophet) is at home, so I went out and met Abu Bakr. He asked me about my family and told me not to leave them alone for they would be needy people.

chapter: The Book of Oaths and Vows - كتاب الأيمان والنذور
ground_truth_en: Rafi' bin Khadij said:                      "The Messenger of Allah came out to us and forbade something for us that had been beneficial for us. He said: 'Whoever has land, let him cultivate it or give it to someone else (to cultivate), or leave it.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عمرو بن علي، عن خالد، - وهو ابن الحارث - قال حدثنا شعبة، عن عبد الملك، عن مجاهد، قال حدث رافع بن خديج، قال خرج إلينا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فنهانا عن أمر كان لنا نافعا فقال ‏‏"‏‏ من كان له أرض فليزرعها أو يمنحها أو يذرها ‏‏"‏‏‏.‏‏

chapter: The Book of Marriage - كتاب النكاح
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Khansa' bint Khidham that her father married her off when she had been previously married, and she was unwilling. She went to the Messenger of Allah and he annulled the marriage.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا هارون بن عبد الله، قال حدثنا معن، قال حدثنا مالك، عن عبد الرحمن بن القاسم، وأنبأنا محمد بن سلمة، قال حدثنا عبد الرحمن بن القاسم، عن مالك، قال حدثني عبد الرحمن بن القاسم، عن أبيه، عن عبد الرحمن، ومجمع، ابنى يزيد بن جارية الأنصاري عن خنساء بنت خذام، أن أباها، زوجها وهي ثيب فكرهت ذلك فأتت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فرد نكاحه ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba'h Al-Dhuhli said that he heard Abu Hurairah (RA) say to his wife while they were on a journey : "O my wife, if I asked you before we set out for this Journey and told you not to eat of the meat until it is cooked well or roasted over fire, would you have obeyed me ?" She said: No. He then added saying : "I am telling you now that do not eat any of its flesh till I return."
So by Allah! If he returns and finds her eating some of the meat before it is cooked well or roasted over fire, she will be put in Hell for ever.

chapter: The Book of Hajj - كتاب مناسك الحج

ground_truth_ar: أخبرني أبو بكر بن إسحاق، قال حدثنا إبراهيم بن محمد بن عرعرة، قال حدثنا معاذ بن هشام، قال حدثني أبي، عن قتادة، عن سعيد بن المسيب، أن امرأة، دخلت على عائشة وبيدها عكاز فقالت ما هذا فقالت لهذه الوزغ لأن نبي الله صلى الله عليه وسلم حدثنا ‏"‏ أنه لم يكن شىء إلا يطفئ على إبراهيم عليه السلام إلا هذه الدابة ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فأمرنا بقتلها ونهى عن قتل الجنان إلا ذا الطفيتين والأبتر فإنهما يطمسان البصر ويسقطان ما في بطون النساء ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more excellent in Islam?" He replied, "(Faith) followed by (good) deeds."

chapter: The Book of the Commencement of the Prayer - كتاب الافتتاح
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Musa bin Umair Al-Anbari and Qais bin Sulaim Al-Anbari said:                     "Alqamah bin Wa'il told us that his father said: "I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), when he was standing in prayer, holding his left hand with his right.'"

llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Allah's Apostle saying "If anyone of you is praying while a dog passes between him (and the Qibla) and it was not aware of his prayer, then let him turn to another side."

chapter: The Book of Drinks - كتاب الأشربة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Anas said:                     Umm Sulaim had a wooden cup and she said: "I gave the Messenger of Allah [SAW] all kinds of things to drink in it: Water, honey, milk and Nabidh."

llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Yazid Al-Ansari said that he heard a man asking Ibn Abbas about drinking wine in one's stomach or intestines? He replied, "I do not know."
