chapter: The Book of the Times (of Prayer) - كتاب المواقيت
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Ibn Juraij said:                      "I said to 'Ata': 'What is the best time you think I should pray Al-'Atamah, either in congregation or on my own?' He said: 'I heard Ibn 'Abbas say: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) delayed Al-'Atamah one night until the people had slept and woken up, then slept and woken up again. Then 'Umar got up and said: 'The prayer, the prayer!'" 'Ata' said: 'Ibn 'Abbas said: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out, and it is as if I can see him now, with water dripping from his head, putting his hand on the side of his head. [He said: "And he indicated (how)"].'" I checked with 'Ata' how the Prophet (ﷺ) put his hand on his head, and he showed me the same way as Ibn 'Abbas had done. 'Ata' spread his fingers a little, then placed them with the tips of his fingers on his forehead, then he drew his fingers together on his head until his thumb touched the edge of the ear that is next to the face, then moved it to his temple and forehead, then he said: 'Were it not that I would impose too much difficulty for my Ummah, I would have commanded them to offer this prayer only at this time.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرني إبراهيم بن الحسن، ويوسف بن سعيد، - واللفظ له - قالا حدثنا حجاج، عن ابن جريج، قال قلت لعطاء أى حين أحب إليك أن أصلي العتمة إماما أو خلوا قال سمعت ابن عباس يقول أعتم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ذات ليلة بالعتمة حتى رقد الناس واستيقظوا ورقدوا واستيقظوا فقام عمر فقال الصلاة الصلاة قال عطاء قال ابن عباس خرج نبي الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كأني أنظر إليه الآن يقطر رأسه ماء واضعا يده على شق رأسه قال وأشار فاستثبت عطاء كيف وضع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يده على رأسه فأومأ إلى كما أشار ابن عباس فبدد لي عطاء بين أصابعه بشىء من تبديد ثم وضعها فانتهى أطراف أصابعه إلى مقدم الرأس ثم ضمها يمر بها كذلك على الرأس حتى مست إبهاماه طرف الأذن مما يلي الوجه ثم على الصدغ وناحية الجبين لا يقصر ولا يبطش شيئا إلا كذلك ثم قال ‏"‏ لولا أن أشق على أمتي لأمرتهم أن لا يصلوها إلا هكذا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid Al'Ansari said that he heard Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas (Al-Azdi) say to me while I was sitting with him in his house at Medina, "O son of my brother! Do you know how the Messenger of Allaah(sallallaahu 'alayhi wa sallam)( may Allah be pleased with him ) used to perform ablution?"
I said: No. He then told me that he had heard it from his father, who was a Companion (of Prophet Muhammad) and the Messenger of Allaah(sallaahu 'alayhi wa sallam)( may Allah be pleased with him ) used to perform ablution in this way.
He then took hold of my hand and led me into his house, where he had a basin containing water for washing the hands; so I performed Wudu' (ablution) as he did it. Then we went out again until we came upon some people who were performing ablutions in front of their houses.
He said: "Do you know how they perform ablution?" So, one of them looked at me and asked him to tell us what the Messenger(sallaahu 'alayhi wa sallam)( may Allah be pleased with him ) used to do so that we

chapter: The Book of Wills - كتاب الوصايا
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah said:                      "When a man dies all his good deeds come to an end except three: Ongoing charity (Sadaqah Jariyah), beneficial knowledge and a righteous son who prays for him."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا علي بن حجر، قال حدثنا إسماعيل، قال حدثنا العلاء، عن أبيه، عن أبي هريرة، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ إذا مات الإنسان انقطع عمله إلا من ثلاثة من صدقة جارية وعلم ينتفع به وولد صالح يدعو له ‏"‏‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar...

chapter: The Book of Seeking Refuge with Allah - كتاب الاستعاذة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Anas that:                     The Messenger of Allah [SAW] used to say: "Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-'ajzi, wal-kasali, wal-bukhli, wal-harami, 'adhabil-qabr wa fitnatil-mahya wal-mamat (O Allah, I seek refuge in You from incapacity and laziness, and miserliness and old age, and the torment of the grave, and the trials of life and death.)"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن المثنى، عن معاذ بن هشام، قال حدثنا أبي، عن قتادة، عن أنس، أن نبي الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان يقول ‏"‏ اللهم إني أعوذ بك من العجز والكسل والبخل والهرم وعذاب القبر وفتنة المحيا والممات ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that a man asked the Messenger of Allaah (sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam): "What is more superior?" He replied, "(The one who has) Taqwa." The Prophet (sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam) then recited: [Qur'an 28/76]
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar said that a man asked the Messenger of Allaah (sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam): "What is more superior?" He replied, "(The one who has) Taqwa." The Prophet (sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam) then recited: [Qur'an 28/76]

chapter: The Book of The At-Tatbiq (Clasping One's Hands Together) - كتاب التطبيق
ground_truth_en: 'Asim bin Humaid said:                     "I heard 'Awf bin Malik say: 'I prayed Qiyam with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) one night, and when he bowed, he stayed as long as it takes to recite Surat Al-Baqarah, saying: "Subhana Dhil-jabaruti wal-malakuti wal-kibriya' wal-'azamah (Glory be to the One Who has all power, sovereignty, magnificence and might)."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عمرو بن منصور، - يعني النسائي - قال حدثنا آدم بن أبي إياس، قال حدثنا الليث، عن معاوية، - يعني ابن صالح - عن أبي قيس الكندي، - وهو عمرو بن قيس - قال سمعت عاصم بن حميد، قال سمعت عوف بن مالك، يقول قمت مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ليلة فلما ركع مكث قدر سورة البقرة يقول في ركوعه ‏"‏ سبحان ذي الجبروت والملكوت والكبرياء والعظمة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba said that he heard his father saying that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more loved by God?" He replied, "(To love) your brother." The man then asked (the same question), whereupon the Prophet replied: "Your mother," and again the man repeated it for the third time. Where upon he said, 'That is enough! Your father.'

chapter: The Book of 'Umra - كتاب العمرى
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Zaid bin Thabit said:                      The Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever gives a life-long gift, it belongs to the one to whom he gave it, both during his life and after his death. And do not give things on the basis of Ruqba, for whoever is given something on the basis of Ruqba, it becomes part of his estate."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن عبيد الله بن يزيد بن إبراهيم، قال أخبرني أبي أنه، عرض على معقل عن عمرو بن دينار، عن حجر المدري، عن زيد بن ثابت، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ من أعمر شيئا فهو لمعمره محياه ومماته ولا ترقبوا فمن أرقب شيئا فهو لسبيله ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased him) reported that a man asked Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings of Allaah upon him): "Which is better? Fasting one day or fasting two days?" He said, "(Fasting) three days." The man then went on to ask: "Is there any good in fasting four days at a time?" And he replied by saying that it was best.
Narrated Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased him): A person asked the Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings of Allaah upon him) which is better: Fast one day or two? He said, "Fast three days." The man then went on to ask: Is there any good in fasting four days at a time?" And he replied by saying that it was best.

chapter: The Book of Ghusl and Tayammum - كتاب الغسل والتيمم
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Ali said:                      "I felt too shy to ask the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about Madhi because of Fatimah, so I told Al-Miqdad to ask him, and he said: 'Wudu' (is required) for that.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن عبد الأعلى، قال حدثنا خالد بن الحارث، قال حدثنا شعبة، قال أخبرني سليمان الأعمش، قال سمعت منذرا، عن محمد بن علي، عن علي، - رضى الله عنه - قال استحييت أن أسأل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن المذى من أجل فاطمة فأمرت المقداد فسأله فقال ‏"‏ فيه الوضوء ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that he heard Anas b. Malik say to his wife while they were on a journey, "I adjure you by God not to fast until we reach the city of Madinah." She replied: I am afraid lest my eyesight should leave me and then it would become difficult for me to see your face (i.e., sexual intercourse). He said: If that is so, do what pleases you but if there was anything wrong with fasting in the way of Allaah, I would not have forbidden it."

chapter: The Book of the Times (of Prayer) - كتاب المواقيت
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Muhammad bin 'Amr bin Hasan said:                      "Al-Hajjaj arrived, and we asked Jabir bin 'Abdullah, who said: 'The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prayed Zuhr at the time of intense heat, [1] and 'Asr when the sun was white and clear, and Maghrib when the sun set, and with 'Isha' it would depend - if he saw that the people had gathered, he would pray early, and if he saw that they had not come yet, he would delay it.'"[1] Meaning, at the earliest time.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عمرو بن علي، ومحمد بن بشار، قالا حدثنا محمد، قال حدثنا شعبة، عن سعد بن إبراهيم، عن محمد بن عمرو بن حسن، قال قدم الحجاج فسألنا جابر بن عبد الله قال كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يصلي الظهر بالهاجرة والعصر والشمس بيضاء نقية والمغرب إذا وجبت الشمس والعشاء أحيانا كان إذا رآهم قد اجتمعوا عجل وإذا رآهم قد أبطئوا أخر ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Allah's Messenger what to say if he found nothing with which to perform ablution (i.e., wash his face) when there is no water available? The Prophet replied, "Pour on him dust and pebbles."

chapter: The Book of the Fear Prayer - كتاب صلاة الخوف
ground_truth_en: Shu'bah narrated from Mansur who said:                     "I heard Mujahid narrating from Abu Ayyash Az-Zuraqi"- Shu'bah said: "He had written it for me, and I read it before him, and I heard him narrating it; rather, I even memorized it." Ibn Bashshar said: "I memorized it from the book"- "The Prophet (ﷺ) was drawing up ranks facing the enemy in 'Usfan when the idolaters were led by Khalid bin Al-Walid. The Prophet (ﷺ) led them in praying Zuhr. The idolaters said: 'They have a prayer after this that is dearer to them than their wealth and sons.' Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led them in praying 'Asr. He divided them into two rows, behind him. He led them all in bowing, then when they raised their heads he led the row that was closest to him in prostrating, while the others remained standing. When they raised their heads from prostration, the second row prostrated, as they had already bowed with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Then the front row moved forward, so each of them took the place of his companion. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led them all in bowing, then when they raised their heads from bowing, the row that was closest to him prostrated while the others remained standing, then when they had finished prostrating, the others prostrated, then the Prophet (ﷺ) said the taslim for all of them together.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن المثنى، ومحمد بن بشار، عن محمد، قال حدثنا شعبة، عن منصور، قال سمعت مجاهدا، يحدث عن أبي عياش الزرقي، قال شعبة كتب به إلى وقرأته عليه وسمعته منه يحدث ولكني حفظته قال ابن بشار في حديثه حفظي من الكتاب أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم كان مصاف العدو بعسفان وعلى المشركين خالد بن الوليد فصلى بهم النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم الظهر قال المشركون إن لهم صلاة بعد هذه هي أحب إليهم من أموالهم وأبنائهم فصلى بهم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم العصر فصفهم صفين خلفه فركع بهم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم جميعا فلما رفعوا رءوسهم سجد بالصف الذي يليه وقام الآخرون فلما رفعوا رءوسهم من السجود سجد الصف المؤخر بركوعهم مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ثم تأخر الصف المقدم وتقدم الصف المؤخر فقام كل واحد منهم في مقام صاحبه ثم ركع بهم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم جميعا فلما رفعوا رءوسهم من الركوع سجد الصف الذي يليه وقام الآخرون فلما فرغوا من سجودهم سجد الآخرون ثم سلم النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم عليهم ‏.‏
llm_response: Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased him) reported that a man asked Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings of Allaah be upon him): "Which deed is most beloved to Allaah?" He said, "That which is done with the fear of Allaah."

chapter: The Book of Zakah - كتاب الزكاة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Mu'adh said:                     That when the Messenger of Allah sent him to Yemen, he commanded him to take from every thirty, cattle a male or female Tabi'(two-year-old), and from every forty, a Musinnah (three-year-old), and from every person who had reached the age of puberty a Dinar or is equivalent in Ma'afir. (Da 'if)
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا أحمد بن حرب، قال حدثنا أبو معاوية، عن الأعمش، عن إبراهيم، عن مسروق، عن معاذ، قال لما بعثه رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إلى اليمن أمره أن يأخذ من كل ثلاثين من البقر تبيعا أو تبيعة ومن كل أربعين مسنة ومن كل حالم دينارا أو عدله معافر ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Anas b. Malik say to his wife when she asked him about a man who had died without leaving anything for her, "If I were you and this happened with me then I would not ask anyone."

chapter: The Book of Divorce - كتاب الطلاق
ground_truth_en: Nafi' narrated from 'Abdullah, that he divorced his wife while she was menstruating. 'Umar asked the Messenger of Allah about that and said:                      "Abdullah has divorced his wife while she was menstruating." He said: "Tell 'Abdullah to take her back, then leave her until she becomes pure from this menstrual period, then menstruates again, then when she becomes pure again, if he wishes he may separate from her before having intercourse with her, or if he wishes he may keep her. This is the time when Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, has stated that women may be divorced."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عبيد الله بن سعيد السرخسي، قال حدثنا يحيى بن سعيد القطان، عن عبيد الله بن عمر، قال أخبرني نافع، عن عبد الله، أنه طلق امرأته وهي حائض فاستفتى عمر رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال إن عبد الله طلق امرأته وهي حائض فقال ‏"‏ مر عبد الله فليراجعها ثم يدعها حتى تطهر من حيضتها هذه ثم تحيض حيضة أخرى فإذا طهرت فإن شاء فليفارقها قبل أن يجامعها وإن شاء فليمسكها فإنها العدة التي أمر الله عز وجل أن تطلق لها النساء ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that a man came to the Prophet () asking about his wife who had been divorced three times before he married her and then she was pregnant, so he wanted to know whether it is permissible for him to have intercourse with her or not. The Messenger of Allaah (peace be upon him) said: "No."

chapter: The Book of Menstruation and Istihadah - كتاب الحيض والاستحاضة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:                      "The head of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would rest in the lap of one of us when she was menstruating, and he would recite Qur'an."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا إسحاق بن إبراهيم، وعلي بن حجر، - واللفظ له - قالا حدثنا سفيان، عن منصور، عن أمه، عن عائشة، قالت كان رأس رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في حجر إحدانا وهي حائض وهو يقرأ القرآن ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Ibn Abbas said that a man asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) "Which deeds are best?" He replied, "(Faithfulness to parents), followed by kind treatment of relatives and good neighbourliness." The Prophet added saying, "Good neighborliness is a virtue of the faith"
Narrated Abu Huraira said Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'The best deeds are those which bring most benefit to mankind.'

chapter: The Book of Qiyam Al-Lail (The Night Prayer) and Voluntary Prayers During the Day - كتاب قيام الليل وتطوع النهار
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Sa'd bin Ishaq bin Ka'b bin Ujrah, from his father, that:                     His grandfather said: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prayed Maghrib in the masjid of Banu 'Abdul-Ashhal, and when he finished praying some people stood up and offered Nafl prayers. The Prophet (ﷺ) said: 'You should offer this prayer in your houses.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن بشار، قال أنبأنا إبراهيم بن أبي الوزير، قال حدثنا محمد بن موسى الفطري، عن سعد بن إسحاق بن كعب بن عجرة، عن أبيه، عن جده، قال صلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم صلاة المغرب في مسجد بني عبد الأشهل فلما صلى قام ناس يتنفلون فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ عليكم بهذه الصلاة في البيوت ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "The most beloved prayer to Allah is what He Himself has chosen."

chapter: The Book of the Fear Prayer - كتاب صلاة الخوف
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Salih bin Khawwat, from Sahl bin Abi Hathmah that:                     The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led them in offering the fear prayer. Some formed a row behind him and some formed a row facing the enemy. He led them in praying one rak'ah, then they moved away and the others came, and he led them in praying one rak'ah, then they got up and each (group) made up the other rak'ah.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عمرو بن علي، قال حدثنا يحيى، قال حدثنا شعبة، عن عبد الرحمن بن القاسم، عن أبيه، عن صالح بن خوات، عن سهل بن أبي حثمة، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم صلى بهم صلاة الخوف فصف صفا خلفه وصفا مصافو العدو فصلى بهم ركعة ثم ذهب هؤلاء وجاء أولئك فصلى بهم ركعة ثم قاموا فقضوا ركعة ركعة ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What is more loved to Allah?" He replied:"A slave who restrains himself from anger."

chapter: The Book of Jumu'ah (Friday Prayer) - كتاب الجمعة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Abdullah that:                     The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to deliver two khutbahs standing, and he would separate them by sitting.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا إسماعيل بن مسعود، قال حدثنا بشر بن المفضل، قال حدثنا عبيد الله، عن نافع، عن عبد الله، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان يخطب الخطبتين وهو قائم وكان يفصل بينهما بجلوس ‏.‏
llm_response: NarratedAbdullah bin Umar (RA) said that his father Umar(RADILAH) had a pulpit made of silver in front of him when he was at Makkah for Friday prayer and it is still there today, but the people do not use it.

chapter: The Book of Ghusl and Tayammum - كتاب الغسل والتيمم
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:                      "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to like to start with the right as much as he could when purifying himself, putting on sandals and combing his hair" - and he (the narrator) said in Wasit (a place in Iraq): "And in all his affairs."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا سويد بن نصر، قال أنبأنا عبد الله، عن شعبة، عن الأشعث بن أبي الشعثاء، عن أبيه، عن مسروق، عن عائشة، قالت كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يحب التيمن ما استطاع في طهوره وتنعله وترجله وقال بواسط في شأنه كله ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered upon a woman who was sitting in her house with some of her family members and she had no veil on her head, so he covered it for her saying "May I not be able to do any good deed."

chapter: The Book of Qiyam Al-Lail (The Night Prayer) and Voluntary Prayers During the Day - كتاب قيام الليل وتطوع النهار
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abdullah said:                     "Mention was made in the presence of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about a man who slept all night until morning. He said: 'That is a man in whose ear the Shaitan has urinated.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا إسحاق بن إبراهيم، قال أنبأنا جرير، عن منصور، عن أبي وائل، عن عبد الله، قال ذكر عند رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم رجل نام ليلة حتى أصبح قال ‏"‏ ذاك رجل بال الشيطان في أذنيه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to offer prayer at night till his feet swelled up as if they were in a potter's bucket because of excess water, and then he would walk on them.

chapter: The Book of Cutting off the Hand of the Thief - كتاب قطع السارق
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Ayman said:                     "The hand of a thief would not be cut off during the time of the Messenger of Allah except for the value of a shield, which in those days was a Dinar." (Daif)
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن بشار، قال حدثنا عبد الرحمن، قال حدثنا سفيان، عن منصور، عن مجاهد، عن أيمن، قال لم تكن تقطع اليد على عهد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إلا في ثمن المجن وقيمته يومئذ دينار ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar...

chapter: The Book of Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Al-'Awwam bin Hawshab said:                     "I said to Mujahid: 'What about fasting while traveling?' He said: 'The Messenger of Allah used to fast (sometimes) and not fast (sometimes)."'
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا حميد بن مسعدة، قال حدثنا سفيان، عن العوام بن حوشب، قال قلت لمجاهد الصوم في السفر قال كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يصوم ويفطر ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid Al'Ansari said that he heard a man asking Ibn Umar about fasting on Monday or Tuesday of Sha'ban so as to make up for Ramadan, and whether it was permissible. So, they went to the Prophet (ﷺ) who asked him: "What is your occupation?" He replied that he had a camel which used to carry his load on its back while he himself would ride behind it." The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), said:" If you fast, then do not make up for the missed days by eating more than usual. And if you eat in excess during your meals so that they are as large as a well's bucket and you have to dip into them like one dips his hand into water."
Reference: 2314

chapter: The Book of Forgetfulness (In Prayer) - كتاب السهو
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Humaid As-Sa'idi said:                     "At the end of the last two rak'ahs of the prayer, the Prophet (ﷺ) would move his left foot forward and sit on his left buttock, Mutawarrikan, then he would say the taslim.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا يعقوب بن إبراهيم الدورقي، ومحمد بن بشار، بندار - واللفظ له - قالا حدثنا يحيى بن سعيد، قال حدثنا عبد الحميد بن جعفر، قال حدثني محمد بن عمرو بن عطاء، عن أبي حميد الساعدي، قال كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا كان في الركعتين اللتين تنقضي فيهما الصلاة أخر رجله اليسرى وقعد على شقه متوركا ثم سلم ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Allah's Apostle what he should say if he forgot while praying? The Prophet told him to repeat it when he remembered (the prayer).

chapter: The Book of The At-Tatbiq (Clasping One's Hands Together) - كتاب التطبيق
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Ibn Mas'ud said:                     "We used to pray with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and we would say: "Peace (As-Salam) be upon Allah (SWT), peace be upon Jibril, peace be upon Mika'il.' The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Do not say "Peace (As-Salam) be upon Allah, for Allah is As-Salam." Rather say: "At-tahiyyatu lillahi was-salawatu wat-tayyibat, as-salamu 'alaika ayyuhan-Nabiyyu wa rahmatAllahi wa baraktuhu. As-salamu 'alaina wa 'ala 'ibad illahis-salihin, ashahdu an la illaha ill-Allah wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluhu (Allah compliments, prayers and pure words are due to Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah (SWT) and his blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous slaves of Allah (SWT). I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger)."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا إسماعيل بن مسعود، قال حدثنا خالد، قال حدثنا هشام، - هو الدستوائي - عن حماد، عن أبي وائل، عن ابن مسعود، قال كنا نصلي مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فنقول السلام على الله السلام على جبريل السلام على ميكائيل ‏.‏ فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لا تقولوا السلام على الله فإن الله هو السلام ولكن قولوا التحيات لله والصلوات والطيبات السلام عليك أيها النبي ورحمة الله وبركاته السلام علينا وعلى عباد الله الصالحين أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وأشهد أن محمدا عبده ورسوله ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba said that he heard his father saying: "I was with Ibn Umar (radhiyallahu anhum) at a place where there were two men who had been killed in one day, and they had not yet buried. So we asked them to bury the bodies of those people."
They replied by saying that their relatives would come from distant places for burials, so it was necessary to wait until then. We said: "We will help you with digging graves," but they refused our offer and told us not to do anything in this regard because we were strangers (to them).
Then Ibn Umar asked me about the reason why those people had been killed, so I informed him that one of their relatives was a man who used to steal. He would come at night when everyone slept and take whatever he wanted from his neighbors' houses without being noticed by anyone except for God (subhanahu wa taala).
One day while the thief was sleeping in someone else's house, one of those people found him there so they killed that person. Afterwards other relatives came to know about it and started killing everyone who had anything to do with this man until all his family members were dead except for a few children whose parents died before them."

chapter: The Book of Divorce - كتاب الطلاق
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu As-Sanabil said:                      "Subai'ah gave birth twenty-three or twenty-five days after her husband died, and when her Nifas ended she expressed her wish to remarry and was criticized for that. Mention of that was made to the Messenger of Allah and he said: 'There is nothing to stop her; her term has ended.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرني محمد بن قدامة، قال أخبرني جرير، عن منصور، عن إبراهيم، عن الأسود، عن أبي السنابل، قال وضعت سبيعة حملها بعد وفاة زوجها بثلاثة وعشرين أو خمسة وعشرين ليلة فلما تعلت تشوفت للأزواج فعيب ذلك عليها فذكر ذلك لرسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال ‏"‏ ما يمنعها قد انقضى أجلها ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (Allah be pleased with them): The Messenger of Allaah (sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam) said to me while I was sitting in his company, "O son of my brother! Give your wife her divorce before you go on a journey."

chapter: The Book of Adornment - كتاب الزينة من السنن
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Ali said:                     "The Prophet [SAW] forbade me from wearing gold rings, reciting Qur'an while I am bowing, and from Al-Qassi, and garments dyed with safflower."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا يعقوب بن إبراهيم، قال حدثنا يحيى، عن ابن عجلان، قال أخبرني إبراهيم بن عبد الله بن حنين، عن أبيه، عن ابن عباس، عن علي، قال نهاني النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم عن خاتم الذهب وأن أقرأ القرآن وأنا راكع وعن القسي وعن المعصفر ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas (RA) say to his wife when she asked him about a thing which had been forbidden by Allaah and His Messenger, "Do not ask me; for I have seen the Prophet of Allah in my dream last night." She said: What did he do? He replied: "He took hold of something like an ostrich plume (or a feather) from his head and threw it away.
Ibn Khuzaimah, Abu Ya'laa al-Sarraani in 'Kitab Al Adhkar', Nasaai with slight differences; Ibn Hibban said: "He is trustworthy."

chapter: The Book of the Qiblah - كتاب القبلة
ground_truth_en: Narrated Kathir bin Kathir:                     It was narrated from Kathir bin Kathir, from his father, that his grandfather said: "I saw the Messenger of Allsh(ﷺ) circumambulate the House seven times, then he prayed two Rak'ahs at the edge of the Maqam, and there was nothing between him and the people who were performing Tawaf."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا إسحاق بن إبراهيم، قال أنبأنا عيسى بن يونس، قال حدثنا عبد الملك بن عبد العزيز بن جريج، عن كثير بن كثير، عن أبيه، عن جده، قال رأيت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم طاف بالبيت سبعا ثم صلى ركعتين بحذائه في حاشية المقام وليس بينه وبين الطواف أحد ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Abu Hurairah said : The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood up at midday so he could face us all in one row; then he turned his back to Jerusalem and faced towards Yathrib, saying that it was the Qibla. Then again he turned around facing Syria, saying: "This is also a direction from which Allah has guided me."
Then for the third time he stood up so we could face him all in one row; then he said :"O people! This is indeed the Qibla of your Lord that you have been given. Do not follow other directions, and do not turn away therefrom lest it lead to a great punishment."
Then Allah revealed: (Verily We have seen aqilah turning her back towards Mekkah) [80/14]

chapter: The Book of Horses, Races and Shooting - كتاب الخيل
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Jarir said:                      "I saw the Messenger of Allah twisting the forelock of a horse with his two fingers, and saying: 'Goodness is tied to the forelocks of horses until the Day of Resurrection: Reward and spoils of war.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عمران بن موسى، قال حدثنا عبد الوارث، قال حدثنا يونس، عن عمرو بن سعيد، عن أبي زرعة بن عمرو بن جرير، عن جرير، قال رأيت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يفتل ناصية فرس بين أصبعيه ويقول ‏"‏ الخيل معقود في نواصيها الخير إلى يوم القيامة الأجر والغنيمة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Hudhaifa said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade us to eat of seven animals which are wild game. He prohibited every beast having a split hoof and chewing the cud, except what is mentioned in this Hadith.
Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet said, "Allah has made everything for you (to enjoy), but death is not permissible for you."

chapter: The Book of Fighting [The Prohibition of Bloodshed] - كتاب تحريم الدم
ground_truth_en: Ibn 'Abbas narrated that :                     There was a blind man during the time of the Messenger of Allah [SAW] who had an Umm Walad by whom he had two sons. She used to slander and defame the Messenger of Allah [SAW] a great deal, and he would rebuke her, but she would not pay heed, and he would forbid her to do that, but she ignored him. (The blind man said) One night I mentioned the Prophet [SAW], and she slandered him. I could not bear it so I went and got a dagger which I thrust into her stomach and leaned upon it, and killed her. In the morning she was found slain. Mention of that was made to the Prophet [SAW] and he gathered the people and said: "I adjure by Allah; a man over whom I have the right, that he should obey me, and he did what he did, to stand up." The blind man started to tremble and said: "O Messenger of Allah [SAW], I am the one who killed her. She was my Umm Walad and she was kind and gentle toward me, and I have two sons like pearls from her, but she used to slander and defame you a great deal. I forbade her, but she did not stop, and I rebuked her, but she did not pay heed. Finally, I mentioned your name and she slandered you, so I went and got a dagger which I thrust into her stomach, and leaned on it until I killed her. The Messenger of Allah [SAW] said: "I bear witness that her blood is permissible."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عثمان بن عبد الله، قال حدثنا عباد بن موسى، قال حدثنا إسماعيل بن جعفر، قال حدثني إسرائيل، عن عثمان الشحام، قال كنت أقود رجلا أعمى فانتهيت إلى عكرمة فأنشأ يحدثنا قال حدثني ابن عباس أن أعمى كان على عهد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وكانت له أم ولد وكان له منها ابنان وكانت تكثر الوقيعة برسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وتسبه فيزجرها فلا تنزجر وينهاها فلا تنتهي فلما كان ذات ليلة ذكرت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فوقعت فيه فلم أصبر أن قمت إلى المغول فوضعته في بطنها فاتكأت عليه فقتلتها فأصبحت قتيلا فذكر ذلك للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فجمع الناس وقال ‏"‏ أنشد الله رجلا لي عليه حق فعل ما فعل إلا قام ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فأقبل الأعمى يتدلدل فقال يا رسول الله أنا صاحبها كانت أم ولدي وكانت بي لطيفة رفيقة ولي منها ابنان مثل اللؤلؤتين ولكنها كانت تكثر الوقيعة فيك وتشتمك فأنهاها فلا تنتهي وأزجرها فلا تنزجر فلما كانت البارحة ذكرتك فوقعت فيك فقمت إلى المغول فوضعته في بطنها فاتكأت عليها حتى قتلتها ‏.‏ فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ألا اشهدوا أن دمها هدر ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What is more loved to Allah?" He replied: "A smiling face."

chapter: The Book of Purification - كتاب الطهارة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Abdullah As-Sunabihi that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:                      "When the believing slave performs Wudu' and rinses his mouth, his sins come out from his mouth. When he sniffs water into his nose and blows it out, his sins come from his nose. When he washes his face, his sins come out from his face, even from beneath his eyelashes. When he washes his hands, his sins come out from his hands, even from beneath his fingernails. When he wipes his head, his sins come out from his head, even from his ears. When washes his feet, his sins come from his feet, even from beneath his toenails. Then his walking to the Masjid and his Salah will earn extra merit for him."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا قتيبة، وعتبة بن عبد الله، عن مالك، عن زيد بن أسلم، عن عطاء بن يسار، عن عبد الله الصنابحي، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ إذا توضأ العبد المؤمن فتمضمض خرجت الخطايا من فيه فإذا استنثر خرجت الخطايا من أنفه فإذا غسل وجهه خرجت الخطايا من وجهه حتى تخرج من تحت أشفار عينيه فإذا غسل يديه خرجت الخطايا من يديه حتى تخرج من تحت أظفار يديه فإذا مسح برأسه خرجت الخطايا من رأسه حتى تخرج من أذنيه فإذا غسل رجليه خرجت الخطايا من رجليه حتى تخرج من تحت أظفار رجليه ثم كان مشيه إلى المسجد وصلاته نافلة له ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال قتيبة عن الصنابحي أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad(sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam): "What is purification?" He replied, "(It means to free yourself from the impurity of your own urine and stool)."

chapter: The Book of the Adhan (The Call to Prayer) - كتاب الأذان
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Alqamah bin Waqqas said:                      "I was with Mu'awiyah when the Mu'adhdhin called the Adhan. Muawiyah said what the Mu'adhdhin said, but when he said: 'Hayya 'alas-salah (come to prayer),' he said: 'La hawla wa la quwwata illa Billah (There is no power and no strength except with Allah);' and when he said: 'Hayya 'alal-falah (come to prosperity),' he said: 'La hawla wa la quwwata illa Billah (There is no power and no strength except with Allah).' After that he said what the Mu'adhdhin said, then he said: 'I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying exactly like that.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا مجاهد بن موسى، وإبراهيم بن الحسن المقسمي، قالا حدثنا حجاج، قال ابن جريج أخبرني عمرو بن يحيى، أن عيسى بن عمر، أخبره عن عبد الله بن علقمة بن وقاص، عن علقمة بن وقاص، قال إني عند معاوية إذ أذن مؤذنه فقال معاوية كما قال المؤذن حتى إذا قال حى على الصلاة قال لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله فلما قال حى على الفلاح قال لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله وقال بعد ذلك ما قال المؤذن ثم قال سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول مثل ذلك ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What should I say when an Imam gives permission to perform ablution?" The Prophet replied, "(Say) 'If you have no urine in your masturbation then go for the prayer.'"

chapter: The Book of Jumu'ah (Friday Prayer) - كتاب الجمعة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Muhammad bin 'Abdur-Rahman that:                     The daughter of Harithah bin An-Nu'man said: "I memorized 'Qaf. By the Glorious Qur'an.'" From the mouth of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) when he was on the minbar on Friday."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن المثنى، قال حدثنا هارون بن إسماعيل، قال حدثنا علي، - وهو ابن المبارك - عن يحيى، عن محمد بن عبد الرحمن، عن ابنة حارثة بن النعمان، قالت حفظت ‏{‏ ق والقرآن المجيد ‏}‏ من في رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وهو على المنبر يوم الجمعة ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid Al'Ansari (may Allaah be pleased with him): The Messenger of Allaah(sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam) said, "Whoever prayed the morning prayer on time and then went to sleep until noon did not sin."

chapter: The Book of Hunting and Slaughtering - كتاب الصيد والذبائح
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Amr said:                     "I heard Jabir say: 'The Messenger of Allah sent us, three hundred riders led by "Ubaidah bin al-Jarrah, to lie in wait for the caravan of the Quraish. We stayed on the coast and became very hungry, so much so that we ate Khabat. Then the sea cast ashore a beast called (Al-'Anbar), and we ate from it for half a month, and daubed our bodies with its fat, and our health was restored. Abu 'Ubaidah took one it its ribs and looked for the tallest camel man and the tallest man in the army, and he passed beneath it. Then they got hungry again and a man slaughtyered three camels, the they got hungry and a man slaughtered three camels, then they got hungry and a man slaughtered three camels, then they got hungry and a man slaughtered three camels. Then Abu 'Ubaidah told him not to do that."(One of the narrators) Sufyan said:"Abu Az-Zubair said, narrating form Jabir: "We asked the Prophet and he said: 'Do you have anything left of it?"' he said; "We took out, such-and -such an amount of a fat from its (the whale's) eyes, and four men could fit into its eye socket. Abu 'Ubaidah had a sack of dates and he used to give them out by the handful, then he started to give one date at a time, and when we ran our of dates it became very difficult for us."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن منصور، عن سفيان، عن عمرو، قال سمعت جابرا، يقول بعثنا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ثلاثمائة راكب أميرنا أبو عبيدة بن الجراح نرصد عير قريش فأقمنا بالساحل فأصابنا جوع شديد حتى أكلنا الخبط - قال - فألقى البحر دابة يقال لها العنبر فأكلنا منه نصف شهر وادهنا من ودكه فثابت أجسامنا وأخذ أبو عبيدة ضلعا من أضلاعه فنظر إلى أطول جمل وأطول رجل في الجيش فمر تحته ثم جاعوا فنحر رجل ثلاث جزائر ثم جاعوا فنحر رجل ثلاث جزائر ثم جاعوا فنحر رجل ثلاث جزائر ثم نهاه أبو عبيدة ‏.‏ قال سفيان قال أبو الزبير عن جابر فسألنا النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال ‏"‏ هل معكم منه شىء ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال فأخرجنا من عينيه كذا وكذا قلة من ودك ونزل في حجاج عينه أربعة نفر وكان مع أبي عبيدة جراب فيه تمر فكان يعطينا القبضة ثم صار إلى التمرة فلما فقدناها وجدنا فقدها ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What is more loved to Allah?" He replied: "A smiling face."

chapter: The Book of Hajj - كتاب مناسك الحج
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that:                     the Messenger of Allah saw a man driving a Badanah (Sacrificial camel) and said: "Ride it." He said: "O Messenger of Allah, it is a Badanah." He said: "Ride it, woe to you!" the second or third time.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا قتيبة، عن مالك، عن أبي الزناد، عن الأعرج، عن أبي هريرة، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم رأى رجلا يسوق بدنة قال ‏"‏ اركبها ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال يا رسول الله إنها بدنة قال ‏"‏ اركبها ويلك ‏"‏ ‏.‏ في الثانية أو في الثالثة ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What is more loved by Allah?" He replied:"A slave who has control over himself in pleasure as well as anger."

chapter: The Book of Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:                     "Hamzah asked the Messenger of Allah: 'O Messenger of Allah, should I fast while then fast and if you wish then do not fast."'
ground_truth_ar: أخبرني عمرو بن هشام، قال حدثنا محمد بن سلمة، عن ابن عجلان، عن هشام بن عروة، عن أبيه، عن عائشة، قالت إن حمزة سأل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال يا رسول الله أصوم في السفر فقال ‏"‏ إن شئت فصم وإن شئت فأفطر ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Saud bin Qusay say to his wife Um Salamah bint Abu Aziz who was fasting in Ramadan, "O my mother! Do not eat until I come back." Then she sent a dish of soup and some dates. He came back while they were eating the food which he had left for them before that time.
Um Salamah said to him: What prevented you from coming? Saud bin Qusay replied, "I was afraid lest I should eat in Ramadan."

chapter: The Book of Purification - كتاب الطهارة
ground_truth_en: Anas bin Malik said:                      "When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would go to the toilet, I and another boy like me would bring a small leather vessel of water and he would clean himself with water."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا إسحاق بن إبراهيم، قال أنبأنا النضر، قال أنبأنا شعبة، عن عطاء بن أبي ميمونة، قال سمعت أنس بن مالك، يقول كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا دخل الخلاء أحمل أنا وغلام معي نحوي إداوة من ماء فيستنجي بالماء ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba said that he saw a man in front of him who was performing ablution but did not pour water over his head so as to rinse it off; instead, he poured some water on the palms and then rubbed them together. The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by while they were doing this and said: "Wash your hands thoroughly."
Reference: Book 1 - Hadith Number 45

chapter: The Book of the Qiblah - كتاب القبلة
ground_truth_en: Narrated Al Bara bin Azib:                     Al Bara bin Azib said: The messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) came to Al-Madinah and prayed toward Bait-al-Maqdis for sixteen months, then he was commanded to pray toward the Ka'bah. A man who had prayed with the prophet (peace be upon him)passed by some of the Ansar and said: "I bear witness that the messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) has been commanded to face toward the Ka'bah. So they turned to face the Ka'bah".
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن إسماعيل بن إبراهيم، قال حدثنا إسحاق بن يوسف الأزرق، عن زكريا بن أبي زائدة، عن أبي إسحاق، عن البراء بن عازب، قال قدم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم المدينة فصلى نحو بيت المقدس ستة عشر شهرا ثم وجه إلى الكعبة فمر رجل قد كان صلى مع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم على قوم من الأنصار فقال أشهد أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قد وجه إلى الكعبة ‏.‏ فانحرفوا إلى الكعبة ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar...

chapter: The Book of Adornment - كتاب الزينة من السنن
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that:                     The Messenger of Allah [SAW] said: "Whoever is offered perfume, let him not refuse it for it is easy to carry, and smells good."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرني عبيد الله بن فضالة بن إبراهيم، قال أنبأنا عبد الله بن يزيد المقرئ، قال حدثنا سعيد، قال حدثني عبيد الله بن أبي جعفر، عن الأعرج، عن أبي هريرة، عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ من عرض عليه طيب فلا يرده فإنه خفيف المحمل طيب الرائحة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased him) reported that he heard Messenger of Allaah () saying:"The best among you is who has most Taqwaa."

chapter: The Book of Zakah - كتاب الزكاة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that:                     the Messenger of Allah enjoined that Sadaqatul Fitr should be given before the people go out to pray. (One of the narratorsP: Ibn Bazi'said: "Zakatul-Fitr."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن معدان بن عيسى، قال حدثنا الحسن، حدثنا زهير، حدثنا موسى، ح قال وأنبأنا محمد بن عبد الله بن بزيع، قال حدثنا الفضيل، قال حدثنا موسى، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أمر بصدقة الفطر أن تؤدى قبل خروج الناس إلى الصلاة ‏.‏ قال ابن بزيع بزكاة الفطر ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who had been performing ablution likewise every time he urinates or defecate since his youth till this day, and asked him whether it would be sufficient for him. So the Prophet of God (ﷺ) said: "No."
Narrated Anas bin Malik that a man came to Allah's Messenger who had been performing ablution likewise every time he urinates or defecate since his youth till this day, and asked him whether it would be sufficient for him. So the Prophet of God (ﷺ) said: "No."

chapter: The Book of Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: Abu Hurairah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah said: '(Allah says) Every deed of the son of Adam is for him, except fasting; it is for me and I shall reward for it. Fasting is a shield. If any one of you is fasting, let him no utter obscene talk or raise his voice in anger, and if anyone insults him or wants to fight, let him say: I am fasting. By the One in whose hand is the soul of Muhammad, the smell coming from the mouth of the fasting person is better before Allah than the fragrance of musk. The fasting person has two moments of joy: When he breaks his fast he rejoices at breaking his fast and when he meets his Lord, the Mighty and Sublime, he will rejoice at having fasted." '
ground_truth_ar: أخبرني إبراهيم بن الحسن، عن حجاج، قال قال ابن جريج أخبرني عطاء، عن أبي صالح الزيات، أنه سمع أبا هريرة، يقول قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ كل عمل ابن آدم له إلا الصيام هو لي وأنا أجزي به والصيام جنة إذا كان يوم صيام أحدكم فلا يرفث ولا يصخب فإن شاتمه أحد أو قاتله فليقل إني صائم والذي نفس محمد بيده لخلوف فم الصائم أطيب عند الله يوم القيامة من ريح المسك للصائم فرحتان يفرحهما إذا أفطر فرح بفطره وإذا لقي ربه عز وجل فرح بصومه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him): The Messenger of Allaah(sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam) said to me when I was a young boy, "O son of my brother! Fast every Tuesday and Thursday."

chapter: The Book of Purification - كتاب الطهارة

ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا قتيبة بن سعيد، عن مالك، ح وأنبأنا علي بن شعيب، قال حدثنا معن، قال حدثنا مالك، عن الزهري، عن عروة، عن عائشة، - رضى الله عنها - مثل ذلك ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying a Hadith like this but with slight differences which conveyed to him the same meaning as narrated above and added, "I saw it in my dream."

chapter: The Book of Purification - كتاب الطهارة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Al-Hakam bin Sufyan said:                      "I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) performing Wudu' and sprinkling his private area (with water)."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا العباس بن محمد الدوري، قال حدثنا الأحوص بن جواب، حدثنا عمار بن رزيق، عن منصور، ح وأنبأنا أحمد بن حرب، قال حدثنا قاسم، - وهو ابن يزيد الجرمي - قال حدثنا سفيان، قال حدثنا منصور، عن مجاهد، عن الحكم بن سفيان، قال رأيت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم توضأ ونضح فرجه ‏.‏ قال أحمد فنضح فرجه ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari (may Allaah be pleased with him): I heard Anas ibn Malik say that he was asked about a man who had been fasting and then broke his fast in the morning, so he went to perform Hajj. He said: "I do not know of anything more abominable than this."

chapter: The Book of Adornment - كتاب الزينة من السنن
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Asma' that:                     A woman came to the Messenger of Allah [SAW] and said: "O Messenger of Allah [SAW], a daughter of mine is going to get married. She got sick and her hair fell out. Is there any sin on me if I give her hair extensions?" He said: "Allah has cursed the woman who affixes hair extensions and the one who has that done."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن المثنى، قال حدثنا يحيى، عن هشام، قال حدثتني فاطمة، عن أسماء، أن امرأة، جاءت إلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقالت يا رسول الله إن بنتا لي عروس وإنها اشتكت فتمزق شعرها فهل على جناح إن وصلت لها فيه فقال ‏"‏ لعن الله الواصلة والمستوصلة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more loved to me than my parents?" He replied, "(Parents) are most dearest to you." The man then repeated his question thrice and the Prophet gave him similar answer each time.

chapter: The Book of Endowments - كتاب الإحباس
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:                      "Umar said to the Prophet: 'The one hundred shares that I acquired in Khaibar -I have never acquired any wealth that I like more than that, and I want to give it in charity.' The Prophet said: Freeze it and donate its fruits."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا سعيد بن عبد الرحمن، قال حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة، عن عبيد الله بن عمر، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر، قال قال عمر للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إن المائة سهم التي لي بخيبر لم أصب مالا قط أعجب إلى منها قد أردت أن أتصدق بها ‏.‏ فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ احبس أصلها وسبل ثمرتها ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more loved to me?" He replied," Your mother." The man asked thrice in one day each time saying like before, and every time he was given the same reply until on the third occasion when his father came.
The Prophet (ﷺ) said: 'Your own parents.'

chapter: The Book of Oaths (qasamah), Retaliation and Blood Money - كتاب القسامة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Imran bin Husain that:                     Ya'la said, concerning the one who bit (another), and his front tooth fell out, that the Prophet said: "There is no Diyah for you." (Sahih )
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا سويد بن نصر، قال أنبأنا عبد الله، عن شعبة، عن قتادة، عن زرارة، عن عمران بن حصين، أن يعلى، قال في الذي عض فندرت ثنيته أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ لا دية لك ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that a man came to Rasoolullaa(sallallaahu alayhi wasalam)(the Prophet of allah ) and asked, "O Messenger of allah , what is the greatest sin?"
He replied: "To associate others with Allaah in worship."

chapter: The Book of Funerals - كتاب الجنائز
ground_truth_en: Qais said:                     "I entered upon Khabbab when he had been cauterized on his stomach seven times. He said: 'Were it not that the Messenger of Allah forbade us to pray for death, I would have prayed for it."'

chapter: The Book of the Adhan (The Call to Prayer) - كتاب الأذان
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Mujammi' bin Yahya Al-Ansari said:                      "I was sitting with Abu Umamah bin Sahl bin Hunaif when the Mu'adhdhin called the Adhan. He said: 'Allahu akbar; Allahu Akbar (Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest),' and he (also) pronounced the takbir twice. Then he said: 'Ashhadu an la ialaha ill-Allah (I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except Allah),' and he also sent the testimony twice.  Then he said: 'Ashhadu anna Muhammadan Rasul-Allah (I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah),' and he (also) sent the testimony twice. Then he said: 'This is what Mu'awiyah bin Abi Sufyan told me, narrating from statement of the Messenger of Allah.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا سويد بن نصر، أنبأنا عبد الله بن المبارك، عن مجمع بن يحيى الأنصاري، قال كنت جالسا عند أبي أمامة بن سهل بن حنيف فأذن المؤذن فقال الله أكبر الله أكبر فكبر اثنتين فقال أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله فتشهد اثنتين فقال أشهد أن محمدا رسول الله فتشهد اثنتين ثم قال حدثني هكذا معاوية بن أبي سفيان عن قول رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying "If anyone of you likes to have his prayer offered in a group then let him pray before the Imam and if anybody like to offer it individually, then let him do so."

chapter: The Book of Menstruation and Istihadah - كتاب الحيض والاستحاضة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Aishah that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:                      "When the time of menstruation comes, stop praying, and when it goes, perform Ghusl."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا هشام بن عمار، قال حدثنا سهل بن هاشم، قال حدثنا الأوزاعي، عن الزهري، عن عروة، عن عائشة، أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ إذا أقبلت الحيضة فدعي الصلاة وإذا أدبرت فاغتسلي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that a man asked Anas b. Malik about menstruating women who are in prayer? He replied to him saying "They should leave their place of worship and pray at home or they can pray standing."

chapter: The Book of Funerals - كتاب الجنائز
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Rashid bin Sa'd, that a man among the Companions of the Prophet said:                     "O Messenger of Allah, why will the believers be tested in their graves except the martyr?" He said: "The flashing of the swords above his head is trial enough."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا إبراهيم بن الحسن، قال حدثنا حجاج، عن ليث بن سعد، عن معاوية بن صالح، أن صفوان بن عمرو، حدثه عن راشد بن سعد، عن رجل، من أصحاب النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أن رجلا قال يا رسول الله ما بال المؤمنين يفتنون في قبورهم إلا الشهيد قال ‏"‏ كفى ببارقة السيوف على رأسه فتنة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that a man came to Rasoolullaahe Salallaahu alayhi wasallam and asked for his daughter's hand in marriage, so he gave her away. Then the Prophet (peace and blessings of Allaah be upon him) sent someone who brought back the girl from where she had gone with that man to a place which is not lawful for women to go alone without permission or escort.
The Messenger of Allah said: "Go away, leave her."

chapter: The Book of Oaths (qasamah), Retaliation and Blood Money - كتاب القسامة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abi Hassan said:                     "Ali said: 'The Messenger of Allah did not tell me anything that he did not tell the people, except what is in a sheet in the sheath of my word.' They did not leave him alone until he brought out the sheet, and in it (were the words): 'The lives of the believers are equal in value, and they hasten to support the asylum granted by the least of them, and they are one against others. But no believer may be killed in return for a disbeliever, nor one with a covenant while his covenant is in effect."

chapter: The Book of Financial Transactions - كتاب البيوع
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah said:                     "Dinar for Dinar Dirham for Dirham, no difference between them."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا قتيبة بن سعيد، عن مالك، عن موسى بن أبي تميم، عن سعيد بن يسار، عن أبي هريرة، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ الدينار بالدينار والدرهم بالدرهم لا فضل بينهما ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba'ah Al-Ansari said that he heard Anas b. Malik say to his wife while they were on a journey : "I will give you something of gold, so do not sell it until we reach the city." She sold some of it and then came back to him saying: I have done what you ordered me (to do). He said : Do not tell anyone about that.

chapter: The Book of Hunting and Slaughtering - كتاب الصيد والذبائح
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Jabir said:                     "The Messenger of Allah allowed us to eat the flesh or horses but he forbade the flesh of donkeys."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا قتيبة، قال حدثنا سفيان، عن عمرو، عن جابر، قال أطعمنا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم لحوم الخيل ونهانا عن لحوم الحمر ‏.‏
llm_response: NARRATED BY ABU HURAIRAH RAWDA BIN AL-AUS SA'AD IGNORANT OF ARABIC AND SPEECHLESS WHEN HE SPOKE; THAT THE PROPHET, PUBLICLY APPOINTED ONE OR TWO MEN TO BE AMBASSADORS FOR HIM.

chapter: The Book of Cutting off the Hand of the Thief - كتاب قطع السارق

chapter: The Book of Divorce - كتاب الطلاق

chapter: The Book of Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: Samurah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah said; 'DO not be confused by the Adhan of Bilal, or by this whiteness, until dawn appears like this" - meaning horizontally. (One of the narrators) Abu Dawud said: "And he spread out his hands gesturing to the right and left."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمود بن غيلان، قال حدثنا أبو داود، قال حدثنا شعبة، أنبأنا سوادة بن حنظلة، قال سمعت سمرة، يقول قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لا يغرنكم أذان بلال ولا هذا البياض حتى ينفجر الفجر هكذا وهكذا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يعني معترضا ‏.‏ قال أبو داود وبسط بيديه يمينا وشمالا مادا يديه ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Messenger what he should say if one of his companions had to leave him in order to perform Hajj (pilgrimage) and then died before performing Umrah, so the Prophet replied saying "Say: 'Allahu Akbar! All praise is for Allah who has given me my companion as a reward. I am pleased with what he did.'"

chapter: The Book of Marriage - كتاب النكاح
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:                      "A man of the Ansar came to the Messenger of Allah and said: 'I have married a woman.' He said: 'Did you look at her? For there is something in the eyes of the Ansar.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا محمد بن آدم، قال حدثنا علي بن هاشم بن البريد، عن يزيد بن كيسان، عن أبي حازم، عن أبي هريرة، قال جاء رجل من الأنصار إلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال إني تزوجت امرأة ‏.‏ فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ألا نظرت إليها فإن في أعين الأنصار شيئا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال أبو عبد الرحمن وجدت هذا الحديث في موضع آخر عن يزيد بن كيسان أن جابر بن عبد الله حدث والصواب أبو هريرة ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "Messenger of Allah what is more loved to me than my parents?" He replied:" Your mother." The man then repeated his question three times and each time the reply was, your mother.

chapter: The Book of Marriage - كتاب النكاح
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Zainab bint Abi Salamah that Umm Habibah, the wife of the Prophet said:                      "O Messenger of Allah, marry the daughter of my father" - meaning her sister. The Messenger of Allah said: "Would you like that?" She said: "Yes; I do not have you all to myself, and I would like to share this goodness with my sister." The Prophet said: "That is not permissible for me." Umm Habibah said: "O Messenger of Allah, by Allah, we have been saying that you want to marry Durrah bint Abi Salamah." He said: "The daughter of Umm Salamah?" I said: "Yes." He said: "By Allah, even if she were not my stepdaughter who is in my care, she would not be permissible for me (to marry), because she is the daughter of my brother through breast-feeding. Thuwaibah breastfed Abu Salamah and I. So do not offer your daughters or sisters to me in marriage."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا وهب بن بيان، قال حدثنا ابن وهب، قال أخبرني يونس، عن ابن شهاب، أن عروة بن الزبير، حدثه عن زينب بنت أبي سلمة، أن أم حبيبة، زوج النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قالت يا رسول الله أنكح بنت أبي تعني أختها ‏.‏ فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وتحبين ذلك ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قالت نعم لست لك بمخلية وأحب من شركتني في خير أختي ‏.‏ فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إن ذلك لا يحل ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قالت أم حبيبة يا رسول الله والله لقد تحدثنا أنك تنكح درة بنت أبي سلمة ‏.‏ فقال ‏"‏ بنت أم سلمة ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قالت أم حبيبة نعم ‏.‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فوالله لو أنها لم تكن ربيبتي في حجري ما حلت إنها لابنة أخي من الرضاعة أرضعتني وأبا سلمة ثويبة فلا تعرضن على بناتكن ولا أخواتكن ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more rightly due from me?" The Prophet replied, "(Faith) to please (Allah), and Jihad in His Cause with your wealth and yourself."

chapter: The Book of the Commencement of the Prayer - كتاب الافتتاح
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Ja'far bin Al-Muttalib bin Abi Wada'ah that:                     His father said: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited Surat An-Najm in Makkah and prostrated, and those who were with him prostrated. I raised my head and refused to prostrate." At that time Al-Muttalib had not yet accepted Islam.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عبد الملك بن عبد الحميد بن ميمون بن مهران، قال حدثنا ابن حنبل، قال حدثنا إبراهيم بن خالد، قال حدثنا رباح، عن معمر، عن ابن طاوس، عن عكرمة بن خالد، عن جعفر بن المطلب بن أبي وداعة، عن أبيه، قال قرأ رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بمكة سورة النجم فسجد وسجد من عنده فرفعت رأسي وأبيت أن أسجد ولم يكن يومئذ أسلم المطلب ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What is more loved to Allah?" He replied: "A slave who restrains himself from anger."

chapter: The Book of the Etiquette of Judges - كتاب آداب القضاة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Sulaiman bin Yasar that Ibn 'Abbas told him:                     "A woman from Khath'am asked the Messenger of Allah [SAW] a question when Al-Fadl was riding behind the Messenger of Allah [SAW]. She said: 'O Messenger of Allah, the command of Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, to His slaves to perform Hajj has come while my father is an old man, he cannot sit upright in the saddle. Will it suffice if I perform Hajj on his behalf?' He said: 'Yes.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرني عمرو بن عثمان، قال حدثنا الوليد، عن الأوزاعي، قال أخبرني ابن شهاب، ح وأخبرني محمود بن خالد، قال حدثنا عمر، عن الأوزاعي، حدثني الزهري، عن سليمان بن يسار، أن ابن عباس، أخبره أن امرأة من خثعم استفتت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم والفضل رديف رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقالت يا رسول الله إن فريضة الله عز وجل في الحج على عباده أدركت أبي شيخا كبيرا لا يستطيع أن يستوي على الراحلة فهل يجزئ قال محمود فهل يقضي - أن أحج عنه فقال لها ‏"‏ نعم ‏"‏‏.‏ قال أبو عبد الرحمن وقد روى هذا الحديث غير واحد عن الزهري فلم يذكر فيه ما ذكر الوليد بن مسلم‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying "The best among you is who has patience against himself."

chapter: The Book of Hajj - كتاب مناسك الحج
ground_truth_en: Ibn 'abbas said:                     "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Perform Hajj and 'Umrah consecutively; for they remove poverty and sin as the bellows removes impurity from iron.'''
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا أبو داود، قال حدثنا أبو عتاب، قال حدثنا عزرة بن ثابت، عن عمرو بن دينار، قال قال ابن عباس قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تابعوا بين الحج والعمرة فإنهما ينفيان الفقر والذنوب كما ينفي الكير خبث الحديد ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Anas b. Malik say to his wife while they were on their way from Makkah to Madinah in a litter, "O woman of Khatham! Do not make the journey too long for us." She replied: I am making it short as you wish and we are going at an easy pace so that our camel may be able to keep up with your riding animal.
So he said: What is this? And she told him about a man who had been asked by his Lord, "How many lashes do you think I should inflict on the one who commits fornication?" He replied: "One hundred." So it was written down as one hundred and then read out to them.
Then he said: What is this? And she told him about a man who had been asked by his Lord, "How many lashes do you think I should inflict on the one who steals from my treasures?" He replied: "One thousand." So it was written down as one thousand and then read out to them.
Then he said: What is this? And she told him about a man who had been asked by his Lord, "How many lashes do you think I should inflict on the one who drinks wine?" He replied: "One hundred." So it was written down as

chapter: The Book of Seeking Refuge with Allah - كتاب الاستعاذة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Farwah bin Nawfal said:                     "I asked the Mother of the Believers 'Aishah about what the Messenger of Allah [SAW] used to say in his supplication. She said: 'He used to say: A'udhu bika min sharri ma 'amiltu wa min sharri ma lam a'mal ba'd (I seek refuge with You from the evil of what I have done and the evil of what I have not done yet.)'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرني محمد بن قدامة، عن جرير، عن منصور، عن هلال بن يساف، عن فروة بن نوفل، قال سألت أم المؤمنين عائشة عما كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يدعو قالت كان يقول ‏"‏ أعوذ بك من شر ما عملت ومن شر ما لم أعمل ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who was at an upper room of one of his houses or in a mosque while he had been reclining on a mat and covering himself with a mantle. The Prophet (ﷺ): "What is it?" He said: I am so-and-so, whereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked him to come nearer; then he took hold of his hand and placed it between his shoulder blades and moved them about saying: 'Move your shoulders.' Then he put one knee on another. He said: Move your left leg over the right, move your right foot out from under you so that they may be equal in length."

chapter: The Book of Seeking Refuge with Allah - كتاب الاستعاذة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Sulaiman bin Yasar that he heard Abu Hurairah say:                     "I heard the Messenger of Allah [SAW] say in his supplication: 'Allahumma, inni a'udhu bika min fitnatil-qabri, wa fitnatid-dajjali, wa fitnatil-mahya wal-mamat (O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the trial of the grave, and the tribulation of the Dajjal, and the trials of life and death.)'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا أبو عاصم، قال حدثنا القاسم بن كثير المقرئ، عن الليث بن سعد، عن يزيد بن أبي حبيب، عن سليمان بن يسار، أنه سمع أبا هريرة، يقول سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول في دعائه ‏"‏ اللهم إني أعوذ بك من فتنة القبر وفتنة الدجال وفتنة المحيا والممات ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال أبو عبد الرحمن هذا خطأ والصواب سليمان بن سنان ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man came to Allah's Apostle . The Prophet asked him about his family i.e., how many were they? He replied as such-and-such, and added "I have two slaves who are like brethren (in the sense) of one another."
The narrator said: I think he meant that those two persons had a share in common which was divided between them equally or alternately.

chapter: The Book of Funerals - كتاب الجنائز
ground_truth_en: Abu lyas Mu'awiyah bin 'Qurrah narrated from his father that:                     a man came to the Prophet accompanied by a son of his. He said to him: "Do you love him?" He said: "May Allah love you as I love him." Then he (the son) died and he noticed his absence and asked about him. He said: "Will it not make you happy to know that you will not come to any of the gates of Paradise but you will find him there, trying to open it for you?"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عمرو بن علي، قال حدثنا يحيى، قال حدثنا شعبة، قال حدثنا أبو إياس، - وهو معاوية بن قرة - عن أبيه، رضى الله عنه أن رجلا، أتى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ومعه ابن له فقال له ‏"‏ أتحبه ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فقال أحبك الله كما أحبه ‏.‏ فمات ففقده فسأل عنه فقال ‏"‏ ما يسرك أن لا تأتي بابا من أبواب الجنة إلا وجدته عنده يسعى يفتح لك ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that a man asked the Prophet (sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam): "What should I say when someone dies?" He replied, "(Say), May Allaah have mercy on you and forgive you."

chapter: The Book of Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It was narrated form Muhammad bin Sad Abi Waqqas, from his father, that:                     the Prophet struck one hand with the other and said: "The month is like this and like this and like this," retaining one finger the third time.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا إسحاق بن إبراهيم، قال حدثنا محمد بن بشر، عن إسماعيل بن أبي خالد، عن محمد بن سعد بن أبي وقاص، عن أبيه، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه ضرب بيده على الأخرى وقال ‏"‏ الشهر هكذا وهكذا وهكذا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ونقص في الثالثة إصبعا ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said "The reward of a prayer in its proper time is fifty prayers."

chapter: The Book of Drinks - كتاب الأشربة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Ash-Sha'bi said:                     "Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, used to give the people thickened grape juice into which flies would fall and not be able to get out again."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا سويد، قال أنبأنا عبد الله، عن جرير، عن مغيرة، عن الشعبي، قال كان علي رضى الله عنه يرزق الناس الطلاء يقع فيه الذباب ولا يستطيع أن يخرج منه ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas (may Allaah be pleased with him) say to me while I was sitting on his bedstead, "O son of Zayd! Do you know how the Messenger of Allaah(sallallaahu 'alaihi wa sallam)( may Allah exalt His mention ) used to drink?"
I said: Yes. He would say: "Drink on an empty stomach."

chapter: Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)said:                     “Whoever does not fast one day in Ramadan without having aconcession allowing that, fasting for a lifetime will not make up forthat.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وعلي بن محمد، قالا حدثنا وكيع، عن سفيان، عن حبيب بن أبي ثابت، عن ابن المطوس، عن أبيه المطوس، عن أبي هريرة، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ من أفطر يوما من رمضان من غير رخصة لم يجزه صيام الدهر ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Ibn Abbas said that a man asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) "Which deeds are better?" He replied, "(As regards the prayers), All perfect prayer is what I have described to you." And as for Jihad in the cause of God then it is an obligatory act for every able-bodied man.

chapter: Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that ‘Aishah said:                      “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) usedtobring his head towards me when he was next door (observingI’tikaf),and I would wash it and comb his hair, when I was in myapartment andI was menstruating, and he was in the mosque.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا علي بن محمد، حدثنا وكيع، عن هشام بن عروة، عن أبيه، عن عائشة، قالت كان رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يدني إلى رأسه وهو مجاور فأغسله وأرجله وأنا في حجرتي وأنا حائض وهو في المسجد ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said : The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade us to eat onions while we were fasting

chapter: The Chapters on Business Transactions - كتاب التجارات
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade two kinds of transactions: Mulimasah and Mundbadhah.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا عبد الله بن نمير، وأبو أسامة عن عبيد الله بن عمر، عن خبيب بن عبد الرحمن، عن حفص بن عاصم، عن أبي هريرة، قال نهى رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  عن بيعتين عن الملامسة والمنابذة ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man came to Allah's Apostle while he was at Dhu al-Hulayfa (a well known place on the way to Sham) with his camel laden with dates and asked him for something. The Prophet replied, "Go away; come back next year."
The narrator said: I heard Abu Hurairah say that a man came from Yemen asking Allah's Apostle (for some thing), but he did not tell me what it was which the person asked him for and then added. The Prophet replied, "Go away; come back next year."

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that ‘Ali bin Abu Talib said:                      “When the Prophet (ﷺ)stood up to offer a prescribed prayer, he said Allahu Akbar andraisedhis hands until they were parallel to his shoulders. When hewanted tobow he did likewise; when he raised his head from bowing hedidlikewise; and when he stood up after the two prostrations he didlikewise.”*
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا العباس بن عبد العظيم العنبري، حدثنا سليمان بن داود أبو أيوب الهاشمي، حدثنا عبد الرحمن بن أبي الزناد، عن موسى بن عقبة، عن عبد الله بن الفضل، عن عبد الرحمن الأعرج، عن عبيد الله بن أبي رافع، عن علي بن أبي طالب، قال كان النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  إذا قام إلى الصلاة المكتوبة كبر ورفع يديه حتى يكونا حذو منكبيه وإذا أراد أن يركع فعل مثل ذلك وإذا رفع رأسه من الركوع فعل مثل ذلك وإذا قام من السجدتين فعل مثل ذلك ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What kind of prayer is best?" He replied, "(Perform it) either (performed) early morning or late evening."

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that ‘Abdullah bin Sa’ib said:                      “I attended the ‘Eidprayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He led us in offering the‘Eid prayer, then he said: ‘I have finished the prayer. Whoeverwantsto sit (and listen to) the sermon, then let him sit, andwhoever wantsto leave, then let him leave.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا هدية بن عبد الوهاب، وعمرو بن رافع البجلي، قالا حدثنا الفضل بن موسى، حدثنا ابن جريج، عن عطاء، عن عبد الله بن السائب، قال حضرت العيد مع رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  فصلى بنا العيد ثم قال ‏"‏ قد قضينا الصلاة فمن أحب أن يجلس للخطبة فليجلس ومن أحب أن يذهب فليذهب ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "Messenger of Allah! What type of deeds are most beloved to God?" He replied: "A smiling face."

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Ammar bin Yasir said:                     "I saw the Messenger of Allah running his fingers through his beard."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن أبي عمر العدني، حدثنا سفيان، عن عبد الكريم أبي أمية، عن حسان بن بلال، عن عمار بن ياسر، ح وحدثنا ابن أبي عمر، قال حدثنا سفيان، عن سعيد بن أبي عروبة، عن قتادة، عن حسان بن بلال، عن عمار بن ياسر، قال رأيت رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يخلل لحيته ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that a man asked Anas b. Malik about wudu'. He replied to him saying, "O my brother! I have seen Allah's Apostle making ablution like this." Then he pointed out the actions of his right hand and left hand separately.

chapter: Etiquette - كتاب الأدب
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Usaid Sa'idi said:                     "The Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) said to Abbas ibn Abdul Muttalib, when he entered upon them: "Assalamu alaikum'. They said: 'Wa alaikas salamu wa ahmatullahi wa barakatuhu.' He said: 'How are you this morning?' They said: ' Well, praise is to Allah. And how are you this morning, may our fathers and mothers be ransomed for you, O Messenger of Allah?!' He said: 'I am well, praise is to Allah.'"(Daif)
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو إسحاق الهروي، إبراهيم بن عبد الله بن حاتم حدثنا عبد الله بن عثمان بن إسحاق بن سعد بن أبي وقاص، حدثني جدي أبو أمي، مالك بن حمزة بن أبي أسيد الساعدي عن أبيه، عن جده أبي أسيد الساعدي، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  للعباس بن عبد المطلب ودخل عليهم فقال ‏"‏ السلام عليكم ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قالوا وعليك السلام ورحمة الله وبركاته ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ كيف أصبحتم ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قالوا بخير نحمد الله فكيف أصبحت بأبينا وأمنا يا رسول الله قال ‏"‏ أصبحت بخير أحمد الله ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid Al'Ansari said that he heard Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas say to his son while they were on a journey "O my son! Do you know who I am?" He replied, "No." So he told him and then added:
I was with the Prophet in an army of 300 men. We had no provision except that which we used to carry on our backs from home; so when it became evening time, none but two persons were left along with me (and they both died) leaving nothing behind them and I remained alone as if there was a mountain between myself and the rest of people."
Then he added: "I went out in search for water. Soon after that Allah sent down manna on us from heaven, so it became like mountains around our tents (and we were able to eat)."

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Abu Dharr that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:                      “Offerprayeron time, and if you reached the Imam leading them in prayers(ontime), then perform it with them, and you will be safe with yourprayer, otherwise it will be voluntary for you.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن بشار، حدثنا محمد بن جعفر، حدثنا شعبة، عن أبي عمران الجوني، عن عبد الله بن الصامت، عن أبي ذر، عن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال ‏"‏ صل الصلاة لوقتها فإن أدركت الإمام يصلي بهم فصل معهم وقد أحرزت صلاتك وإلا فهي نافلة لك ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
NARRATED IKHSHID AL-JA'FRI said: THE Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) SAW me at a place where there was no water to perform ablution and he asked for it, so they brought him some. Then the Prophet (ﷺ), while performing ablution with his right hand, wiped over his head twice or thrice saying: "I saw Allah's Messenger doing this."
RATIONALE IKHSHID AL-Ja'fri is a companion of the Prophet (ﷺ) and he was asked to narrate what happened between him and the Prophet. The Hadith tells us that there were no water available for ablution, so they brought some for him. He performed his wudu with one hand only as it is not necessary to use both hands in performing wudhu. After completing his wudoo he said: "I saw Allah's Messenger doing this."

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Umm Salamah said:                     "At the time of the Messenger of Allah, women in postnatal bleeding (after childbirth) used to wait for forty days, and we used to put Wars on our faces because of freckles."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا نصر بن علي الجهضمي، حدثنا شجاع بن الوليد، عن علي بن عبد الأعلى، عن أبي سهل، عن مسة الأزدية، عن أم سلمة، قالت كانت النفساء على عهد رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  تجلس أربعين يوما وكنا نطلي وجوهنا بالورس من الكلف ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "The most blessed of all food is date."

chapter: Chapters Regarding Funerals - كتاب الجنائز
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Umm Salamah from the Prophet (ﷺ) regarding:                     “Andthat they will not disobey you in Ma’ruf (all that is good inIslam);” he said: “(It is about) wailing.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا وكيع، عن يزيد بن عبد الله، مولى الصهباء عن شهر بن حوشب، عن أم سلمة، عن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏{ولا يعصينك في معروف}‏ قال ‏"‏ النوح ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said "The most blessed of words are those with an admonition or a forgiveness; praise for someone who has done something good, and censure for one who does evil."

chapter: The Chapters on Legal Punishments - كتاب الحدود
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Salamah bin Muhabbiq said:                     “When the Verse of legal punishments was revealed, it was said to Abu Thabit Sa'd bin Ubadah, who was a jealous man: ‘If you found another man with your wife, what would you do?’ He said: “I would strike them both wife the sword; do you think I should wait until I bring four (witness) and he has satisfied himself and gone away? Or should I say I saw such and such, and you will carry out the legal punishment punishment on me (for slander) and never accept my testimony thereafter?' Mention of that was made to the prophet (ﷺ) and he said: “The sword is sufficient as a witness.' Then he said: 'No (on second thought) I am afraid that the drunkard and the jealous would pursue that.” (Da'if)Abu Abdullah - meaning Ibn Majah - said: “I heard Abu Zurah saying: “This is a Hadith of Ali bin Muhammad At-Tanafisi, I did not hear it from him.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا علي بن محمد، حدثنا وكيع، عن الفضل بن دلهم، عن الحسن، عن قبيصة بن حريث، عن سلمة بن المحبق، قال قيل لأبي ثابت سعد بن عبادة حين نزلت آية الحدود وكان رجلا غيورا أرأيت لو أنك وجدت مع أم ثابت رجلا أى شىء كنت تصنع قال كنت ضاربهما بالسيف أنتظر حتى أجيء بأربعة إلى ما ذاك قد قضى حاجته وذهب ‏.‏ أو أقول رأيت كذا وكذا فتضربوني الحد ولا تقبلوا لي شهادة أبدا ‏.‏ قال فذكر ذلك للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال ‏"‏ كفى بالسيف شاهدا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثم قال ‏"‏ لا إني أخاف أن يتتايع في ذلك السكران والغيران ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال أبو عبد الله يعني ابن ماجه سمعت أبا زرعة يقول هذا حديث علي بن محمد الطنافسي وفاتني منه ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more loved to me?" The Prophet replied, "(To love) your brother." He repeated it thrice (and added), "And whoever loves his brother has followed the right path.
