ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Muhammad bin ‘Ubaidullah bin Abu Rafi’, from hisfather, from his grandfather, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) usedto come to ‘Eid prayers walking.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن الصباح، حدثنا عبد العزيز بن الخطاب، حدثنا مندل، عن محمد بن عبيد الله بن أبي رافع، عن أبيه، عن جده، أن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  كان يأتي العيد ماشيا ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to us while we were playing with pebbles in our hands; so he took a handful from all of them and threw it away, saying: "O 'Abdullah! Do not play with these. They are the graves of men who would be killed."

chapter: Chapters on Drinks - كتاب الأشربة
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that ‘Abdur-Rahman bin Ya’mar said:                      “The Messenger ofAllah (ﷺ) forbade Dubba’ and Hantam.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر، والعباس بن عبد العظيم العنبري، قالا حدثنا شبابة، عن شعبة، عن بكير بن عطاء، عن عبد الرحمن بن يعمر، قال نهى رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  عن الدباء والحنتم ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Anas bin Malik said that he was asked about wine (Khamr) which is forbidden by Allah? He replied: "I have heard it from a man who has been with RasulAllaah, and I do not know whether what he told me is true or false.
He narrated on the authority of Abu Hurairah that RasulAllaah said:"Every intoxicant is unlawful."

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: Abu Samh said:                     "I was a servant of the Prophet, and Hasan and Husain was brought to him and (the infant) urinated on his chest. They wanted to wash it, but the Messenger of Allah said: 'Sprinkle water on it, for the urine of a girl should be washed, but the urine of a boy should be sprinkled over with water.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عمرو بن علي، ومجاهد بن موسى، والعباس بن عبد العظيم، قالوا حدثنا عبد الرحمن بن مهدي، حدثنا يحيى بن الوليد، حدثنا محل بن خليفة، أخبرنا أبو السمح، قال كنت خادم النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  فجيء بالحسن أو الحسين فبال على صدره فأرادوا أن يغسلوه فقال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ رشه فإنه يغسل بول الجارية ويرش على بول الغلام ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What should I say when I perform ablution?" The Prophet told him to begin with saying, 'Allahu Akbar (Allah is Most Great) and then wash your hands three times. Then pour water on each of your limbs up to the elbows or knees twice; thereafter take a miswak and clean all that part of mouth which comes in contact with it."

chapter: The Book On The Mosques And The Congregations - كتاب المساجد والجماعات
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that:                     The Messenger of Allah said: "The prayer in congregation is twenty-five times more virtuous than the prayer of anyone of you on his own."

ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from ‘Adi bin Thabit that his father said:                      “When theProphet (ﷺ) stood on the pulpit, his Companions would turn to facehim.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن يحيى، حدثنا الهيثم بن جميل، حدثنا ابن المبارك، عن أبان بن تغلب، عن عدي بن ثابت، عن أبيه، قال كان النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  إذا قام على المنبر استقبله أصحابه بوجوههم ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Anas bin Malik said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered upon a woman who was sitting with her head shaven and she had nothing on but one garment which covered her from the upper part of her body to halfway down her leg. He asked, "What prevented you?" She replied: "I became ill."
He said, "If that is so then do not cut your hair as a punishment for yourself; rather fast two meals during each month and give one shirt (to the poor)."

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah would fall asleep until he was breathing deeply, then he would get up and offer the prayer, andhe did not perform ablution." (Hasan)Tanafisi said: "Waki' said" 'She meant while he was prostrating (he would sleep).'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وعلي بن محمد، قالا حدثنا وكيع، حدثنا الأعمش، عن إبراهيم، عن الأسود، عن عائشة، قالت كان رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ينام حتى ينفخ ثم يقوم فيصلي ولا يتوضأ ‏.‏ قال الطنافسي قال وكيع تعني وهو ساجد ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba said that he heard Abu Hurairah (Radhiyallahu Anhu) say, "The Messenhah was sent down to us on a Monday."

chapter: Chapters on Medicine - كتاب الطب
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Abu Sa’eed said:                      “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)usedto seek refuge from the evil eye of the jinn and of mankind. WhentheMu’awwidhatain* were revealed, he started to recite them andstopped reciting anything else.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا سعيد بن سليمان، عن عباد، عن الجريري، عن أبي نضرة، عن أبي سعيد، قال كان رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يتعوذ من عين الجان وأعين الإنس فلما نزلت المعوذتان أخذهما وترك ما سوى ذلك ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What kind of deeds are loved most by God?" He replied, "(To answer) when he is mentioned; (to help him) if he asks for help; and to speak the truth before him."

chapter: Chapters on Hajj Rituals - كتاب المناسك
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Jabir bin ‘Abdullah said:                      “We began our Talbiyahfor Hajj only with Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ), and we did not mix itwith‘Umrah. We arrived in Makkah when four nights of Dhul-Hijjahhadpassed, and when we had performed Tawaf around the Ka’bah andSa’ybetween Safa and Marwah, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)commanded us tomake it ‘Umrah, and to come out of Ihram and haverelations with ourwives. We said: ‘There are only five (days)until ‘Arafah. Will we gout to it with our male organs drippingwith semen?’ The Messenger ofAllah (ﷺ) said: ‘I am the mostrighteous and truthful among you, andwere it not for the sacrificialanimal, I would have exited Ihram.’Suraqah bin Malik said: ‘Isthis Tamattu’ for this year only orforever?’ He said: ‘No, itis forever and ever.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عبد الرحمن بن إبراهيم الدمشقي، حدثنا الوليد بن مسلم، حدثنا الأوزاعي، عن عطاء، عن جابر بن عبد الله، قال أهللنا مع رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  بالحج خالصا لا نخلطه بعمرة فقدمنا مكة لأربع ليال خلون من ذي الحجة فلما طفنا بالبيت وسعينا بين الصفا والمروة أمرنا رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أن نجعلها عمرة وأن نحل إلى النساء ‏.‏ فقلنا ما بيننا ليس بيننا وبين عرفة إلا خمس فنخرج إليها ومذاكيرنا تقطر منيا فقال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ إني لأبركم وأصدقكم ولولا الهدى لأحللت ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فقال سراقة بن مالك أمتعتنا هذه لعامنا هذا أم لأبد فقال ‏"‏ لا بل لأبد الأبد ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid Al-'Ansari (Allaah be pleased with him) said that he heard Sa'ad Bin Abi Waqqas (may peace be upon him), who was one of those who had the honour to accompany the Holy Prophet Muhammad(s.a.w.) in all his journeys, say:
I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying: "Which is better for me? To perform Hajj only or to offer both 'Umrah and Hajj?" He replied: "Perform Umra before the season of pilgrimage." I said, "If it becomes too much trouble for me then should I not do even that (i.e., leave out)?" Thereupon he added saying: "You will be rewarded with a reward equal to Hajj if you perform 'Umrah and thereafter depart from Makkah."
I said, "If it becomes too much trouble for me then should I not do even that (i.e., leave out)?" He replied by saying: "Perform Umra before the season of pilgrimage; otherwise you will be rewarded with a reward equal to Hajj if you perform 'Umrah and thereafter depart from Makkah."

chapter: The Chapters on Jihad - كتاب الجهاد
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Bara’ bin ‘Azib said:                      “We were talking abouthow,on the Day of Badr, the Companions of the Messenger of Allah(ﷺ)numbered three hundred ten and something, the same number as theCompanions of (Talut) who crossed the river with him, and no onecrossed the river with him but a believer.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن بشار، حدثنا أبو عامر، حدثنا سفيان، عن أبي إسحاق، عن البراء بن عازب، قال كنا نتحدث أن أصحاب، رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كانوا يوم بدر ثلاثمائة وبضعة عشر على عدة أصحاب طالوت من جاز معه النهر وما جاز معه إلا مؤمن ‏.‏

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Amr heard Kuraib saying:                     "I heard Ibn 'Abbas say: 'I stayed overnight with my maternal aunt Maimunah, and the Prophet got up and performed ablution from an old water skin, and he did a brief ablution. Then I got up and did the same as he had done."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو إسحاق الشافعي، إبراهيم بن محمد بن العباس حدثنا سفيان، عن عمرو، سمع كريبا، يقول سمعت ابن عباس، يقول بت عند خالتي ميمونة فقام النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  فتوضأ من شنة وضوءا يقلله فقمت فصنعت كما صنع ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Allah's Messenger what he should say if one of his companions had to go out in need? He replied "Say O Allah! I seek refuge with You from the lowering of my fortune and from bad luck."

chapter: The Chapters on Business Transactions - كتاب التجارات
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:                     "O Allah, bless my nation early in the morning of Thursday.' "

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Whoever seeks knowledge in order to argue with the foolish, or to show off before the scholars, or to attract people's attention, Allah will admit him to Hell.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن إسماعيل، أنبأنا وهب بن إسماعيل الأسدي، حدثنا عبد الله بن سعيد المقبري، عن جده، عن أبي هريرة، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ من تعلم العلم ليباهي به العلماء ويماري به السفهاء ويصرف به وجوه الناس إليه أدخله الله جهنم ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man came to Allah's Apostle while he was at Dhul-Hulaifa on his way from Makkah to Madinah with some of his wives and children, asking (for permission) for the sexual relation. The Prophet asked him how many were there who sought your right? He replied that they were four or five. Then he said: Go back by which you have come; then turn round and go back again so that it may not be a burden on one of them (to refuse).

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:                     "The Messenger of Allah said: 'At the end of time or among this nation (Ummah) there will appear people who will recite the Qur'an but it will not go any deeper than their collarbones or their throats. Their distinguishing feature will be their shaved heads. If you see them, or meet them, then kill them.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا بكر بن خلف أبو بشر، حدثنا عبد الرزاق، عن معمر، عن قتادة، عن أنس بن مالك، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ يخرج قوم في آخر الزمان - أو في هذه الأمة - يقرءون القرآن لا يجاوز تراقيهم - أو حلقومهم سيماهم التحليق إذا رأيتموهم - أو إذا لقيتموهم - فاقتلوهم ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba'ah Al-Ansari said that he heard his father say to him while they were on a journey with their family members: "O my son! Do you know what is meant by the Messenger of Allaah (sallallaahu alayhi wasalam) saying, 'The best deeds are those done in the early morning hours'?"
I asked his father and he said to me: "Yes."

chapter: The Chapters on Divorce - كتاب الطلاق
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:                     "No woman asks for divorce when it is not absolutely necessary, but she will never smell the fragrance of paradise, although its fragrance can be detected from a distance of forty years' travel. "
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا بكر بن خلف أبو بشر، حدثنا أبو عاصم، عن جعفر بن يحيى بن ثوبان، عن عمه، عمارة بن ثوبان عن عطاء، عن ابن عباس، أن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال ‏"‏ لا تسأل المرأة زوجها الطلاق في غير كنهه فتجد ريح الجنة ‏.‏ وإن ريحها ليوجد من مسيرة أربعين عاما ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba' said that he asked Abu Said Al Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) about a man who divorced his wife three times before entering into her, and then she conceived in the fourth year. He said, "I do not know whether there is any harm or no."

chapter: Etiquette - كتاب الأدب
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Jawdan that the Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) said:                     "If a man makes an excuse to his bother and he does not accept it, he will bear a burden of sin like that of the tax-collector."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا علي بن محمد، حدثنا وكيع، حدثنا سفيان، عن ابن جريج، عن ابن ميناء، عن جودان، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ من اعتذر إلى أخيه بمعذرة فلم يقبلها كان عليه مثل خطيئة صاحب مكس ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What deeds are loved most by Allah?" He replied: "O man! Go on foot to visit your brother; then you will come back with rewards."

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Jabor bin 'Abdullah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah said: 'While the people of Paradise are enjoying their blessings, a light will shine upon them, and they will raise their heads, and they will see their Lord looking upon them from above. He will say: "Peace be upon you, O people of Paradise." This is what Allah says in the Verse: "Salam (peace be upon you) - a Word from the Lord (Allah), The Most Merciful." He will look at them, and they will look at Him, and they will not pay any attention to the delights (of Paradise) so long as they look at Him, until He will screen Himself from them. But His light and blessing will remain with them in their bodies.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن عبد الملك بن أبي الشوارب، حدثنا أبو عاصم العباداني، حدثنا الفضل الرقاشي، عن محمد بن المنكدر، عن جابر بن عبد الله، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ بينا أهل الجنة في نعيمهم إذ سطع لهم نور فرفعوا رءوسهم فإذا الرب قد أشرف عليهم من فوقهم فقال السلام عليكم يا أهل الجنة ‏.‏ قال وذلك قول الله ‏{سلام قولا من رب رحيم}‏ قال فينظر إليهم وينظرون إليه فلا يلتفتون إلى شىء من النعيم ما داموا ينظرون إليه حتى يحتجب عنهم ويبقى نوره وبركته عليهم في ديارهم ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) offered prayer at midday with two Rakat only when he was fasting

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_en: Waki' bin Hudus narrated that his paternal uncle Abu Razin said:                     "I said: 'O Messenger of Allah, will we see Allah on the Day of Resurrection? And what is the sign of that in His creation?' He said: 'O Abu Razin, do each of you not see the moon individually?' I said: 'Of course.' He said: 'Allah is Greater, and that is His sign in His creation.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا يزيد بن هارون، أنبأنا حماد بن سلمة، عن يعلى بن عطاء، عن وكيع بن حدس، عن عمه أبي رزين، قال قلت يا رسول الله أكلنا يرى الله يوم القيامة وما آية ذلك في خلقه قال ‏"‏ يا أبا رزين أليس كلكم يرى القمر مخليا به ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال قلت بلى ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ فالله أعظم وذلك آيته في خلقه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What deeds are loved most by Allah?" He replied: "O man! Go on foot to visit your brother; then you will come back with rewards."

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from ‘Aishah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saidtheTakbir seven and five times in (the prayer for ‘Eid) Fitr andAdha,apart from the Takbir for Ruku’ (bowing).
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا حرملة بن يحيى، حدثنا عبد الله بن وهب، أخبرني ابن لهيعة، عن خالد بن يزيد، وعقيل، عن ابن شهاب، عن عروة، عن عائشة، أن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  كبر في الفطر والأضحى سبعا وخمسا سوى تكبيرتى الركوع ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to offer two Rakat of the Zuhr prayer before the Imam offered his prayer.

chapter: The Chapters on Charity - كتاب الصدقات
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Umar bin Khattab that:                     the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Do not take back your charity.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا وكيع، حدثنا هشام بن سعد، عن زيد بن أسلم، عن أبيه، عن عمر بن الخطاب، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ لا تعد في صدقتك ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What deeds are loved most by Allah?" He replied:"Patience in adversity."

chapter: Chapters on Hunting - كتاب الصيد
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Abu Hurairah said:                      “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)forbade killing shrikes*, frogs, ants and hoopoes.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن بشار، وعبد الرحمن بن عبد الوهاب، قالا حدثنا أبو عامر العقدي، حدثنا إبراهيم بن الفضل، عن سعيد المقبري، عن أبي هريرة، قال نهى رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  عن قتل الصرد والضفدع والنملة والهدهد ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more loved to me than my family?" He replied, "(The) prayer at its (appointed time)."

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Ali bin Abu Talib said:                     "Your mouths are the paths of the Qur'an, so perfume them with the tooth stick."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن عبد العزيز، حدثنا مسلم بن إبراهيم، حدثنا بحر بن كنيز، عن عثمان بن ساج، عن سعيد بن جبير، عن علي بن أبي طالب، قال إن أفواهكم طرق للقرآن فطيبوها بالسواك ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him) said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings of Allaah upon him): "What is more loved to you?" He replied, "A long life." The man then asked again. So he repeated the same answer: "Long life." Then for the third time he answered in exactly the same way until it was clear that this question had been put three times and each time his reply was the same.
The Prophet (peace and blessings of Allaah upon him) then said, "If you are asked about your Lord's love for me more than once or twice, say: 'I do not know; I only follow what is revealed to me.'"

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Jabir bin 'Abdullah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'The Magicians of this Ummah are those who deny the decrees of Allah. If they fall sick, do not visit them; if they die, do not attend their funerals; and if you meet them, do not greet them with Salam.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن المصفى الحمصي، حدثنا بقية بن الوليد، عن الأوزاعي، عن ابن جريج، عن أبي الزبير، عن جابر بن عبد الله، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ إن مجوس هذه الأمة المكذبون بأقدار الله إن مرضوا فلا تعودوهم وإن ماتوا فلا تشهدوهم وإن لقيتموهم فلا تسلموا عليهم ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me "O son of my brother! I have more right over you than your father."

chapter: Chapters on Slaughtering - كتاب الذبائح
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Bara’ bin ‘Azib said:                      “The Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) commanded us to throw away the meat of domesticated donkeys,rawor cooked, then he did not say anything to us about it afterthat.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا سويد بن سعيد، حدثنا علي بن مسهر، عن عاصم، عن الشعبي، عن البراء بن عازب، قال أمرنا رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أن نلقي لحوم الحمر الأهلية نيئة ونضيجة ثم لم يأمرنا به بعد ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What should I say if my mother or father died?" He replied, "Say 'Allahumma abbuhummaghfirli waabrduhu into the fire.'"

chapter: The Chapters on Legal Punishments - كتاب الحدود
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Ibn`Umar said:                     “I was presented to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the day of Uhud, when I was fourteen years old, but he did not permit me (to fight). I was presented to him on the Day of Khandaq when I was fifteen years old, and he permitted me (to fight).' ”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا علي بن محمد، حدثنا عبد الله بن نمير، وأبو معاوية وأبو أسامة قالوا حدثنا عبيد الله بن عمر، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر، قال عرضت على رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يوم أحد وأنا ابن أربع عشرة سنة فلم يجزني وعرضت عليه يوم الخندق وأنا ابن خمس عشرة سنة فأجازني ‏.‏ قال نافع فحدثت به عمر بن عبد العزيز في خلافته فقال هذا فصل ما بين الصغير والكبير ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "Messenger of Allah! What is more loved to you?" He replied: "A long life." The man then asked him, saying: "If I am given the choice between two things and one of them causes me to die immediately while the other does not cause my death but makes it easier for me in this worldly life," which would he choose?
He said : "The latter.

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:                     "A baby boy was brought to the Prophet who then urinated on him. He sprinkled over it with water and did not wash it."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وعلي بن محمد، قالا حدثنا وكيع، حدثنا هشام بن عروة، عن أبيه، عن عائشة، قالت أتي النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  بصبي فبال عليه فأتبعه الماء ولم يغسله ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What should I say when I perform ablution?" The Prophet replied, "(Say), 'O Allah! I am performing ablution for no other purpose than to worship You."

chapter: Chapters Regarding Funerals - كتاب الجنائز
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that the Prophet (ﷺ) recited theOpeningof the Book (Al-Fatihah) in the funeral prayer.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أحمد بن منيع، حدثنا زيد بن الحباب، حدثنا إبراهيم بن عثمان، عن الحكم، عن مقسم، عن ابن عباس، أن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قرأ على الجنازة بفاتحة الكتاب ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying "The best among you are those who behave well to their wives."

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakrah, from his father, that:                     The Prophet granted a concession to travelers: "If a traveler performed ablution and put on leather socks, then he performed a fresh ablution, he could wipe over the leather socks for three days and nights; the resident could do so for one day and one night."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن بشار، وبشر بن هلال الصواف، قالا حدثنا عبد الوهاب بن عبد المجيد، قال حدثنا المهاجر أبو مخلد، عن عبد الرحمن بن أبي بكرة، عن أبيه، عن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أنه رخص للمسافر إذا توضأ ولبس خفيه ثم أحدث وضوءا أن يمسح ثلاثة أيام ولياليهن وللمقيم يوما وليلة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that he heard Anas ibn Malik say to a man who had asked about wiping over socks, "Go and ask the Messenger of Allaah (sallallaahu 'alaihi wa sallam)." So I went out running until I caught up with the Prophet (sallallaahu 'alaihi wa sallam) at al-Masjid an-Nabawi. He was in his house and he had just finished wiping over socks, or sandals, for prayer."

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Nusair bin Dhu'luq said:                     "Ibn 'Umar used to say: 'Do not revile the Companions of Muhammed, for the stay of anyone of them for a brief period (with the Prophet) is better than all the good deeds that anyone of you does in his lifetime.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا علي بن محمد، وعمرو بن عبد الله، قالا حدثنا وكيع، قال حدثنا سفيان، عن نسير بن ذعلوق، قال كان ابن عمر يقول لا تسبوا أصحاب محمد  صلى الله عليه وسلم  فلمقام أحدهم ساعة خير من عمل أحدكم عمره ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man came to Allah's Apostle while he was at Dhu al-Hulayfa on his way from Sham (Syria) and asked him for something, but I do not remember whether it was the water or anything else. The Prophet said: "If you ask me that also, then give one share to your brother."
The man agreed to this condition of Allah's Apostle .

chapter: The Chapters on Marriage - كتاب النكاح
ground_truth_en: Shurahbil bin Muslim said:                     "I heard Abu Um Amah Al-Bahili say: 'I heard the Messenger of Allah say: "The child is for the bed and the fornicator gets nothing."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا هشام بن عمار، حدثنا إسماعيل بن عياش، حدثنا شرحبيل بن مسلم، قال سمعت أبا أمامة الباهلي، يقول سمعت رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول ‏"‏ الولد للفراش وللعاهر الحجر ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba' said that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying "The best among you is one who in his character has the highest rank."

chapter: Interpretation of Dreams - كتاب تعبير الرؤيا
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Jabir that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:                     “Ifanyone of you has a bad dream, he should not tell people about howSatan played with him in his dream.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن رمح، أنبأنا الليث بن سعد، عن أبي الزبير، عن جابر، عن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال ‏"‏ إذا حلم أحدكم فلا يخبر الناس بتلعب الشيطان به في المنام ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (RA) said that a man came to Allah's Apostle (SAW)...

chapter: The Chapters on Marriage - كتاب النكاح
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن الصباح، أنبأنا معمر بن سليمان الرقي، عن زيد بن حبان، عن أيوب السختياني، عن عكرمة، عن ابن عباس، عن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  مثله ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said "If anyone keeps back anything from his brother who has a right to it or denies him what is due to him, then that will be taken away from the one with whom he kept it and added to the possession of the man in whose property it should have been."

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from ‘Abdullah bin ‘Amir bin Rabi’ah that his fathersaid:                      “We were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on a journey, andthesky was overcast so it was difficult for us to determine theQiblah.So we performed prayer, and we marked the location.* Later,when thesun reappeared, we realized that we had prayed facing adirectionother than the Qiblah. We mentioned that to the Prophet(ﷺ), thenthe Words were revealed: ‘So wherever you turn there isthe Face ofAllah.’” [2:115]
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا يحيى بن حكيم، حدثنا أبو داود، حدثنا أشعث بن سعيد أبو الربيع السمان، عن عاصم بن عبيد الله، عن عبد الله بن عامر بن ربيعة، عن أبيه، قال كنا مع رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  في سفر فتغيمت السماء وأشكلت علينا القبلة فصلينا وأعلمنا فلما طلعت الشمس إذا نحن قد صلينا لغير القبلة فذكرنا ذلك للنبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  فأنزل الله ‏{فأينما تولوا فثم وجه الله}‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to offer two Rakat of Tahajjud prayer before sleeping.

chapter: Etiquette - كتاب الأدب
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Ubbay bin Ka'b that the Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) said:                     "In some poetry there is wisdom."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر، حدثنا عبد الله بن المبارك، عن يونس، عن الزهري، حدثنا أبو بكر بن عبد الرحمن بن الحارث، عن مروان بن الحكم، عن عبد الرحمن بن الأسود بن عبد يغوث، عن أبى بن كعب، أن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال ‏"‏ إن من الشعر لحكمة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What deeds are loved most by Allah?" He replied, "A smiling face which is ever cheerful."

chapter: Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)said:                     “Eat Suhur, for in Suhur there is a blessing.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أحمد بن عبدة، أنبأنا حماد بن زيد، عن عبد العزيز بن صهيب، عن أنس بن مالك، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ تسحروا فإن في السحور بركة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What should I say if anyone sits between me (in Salat)?" The Prophet replied, "(Say), 'I am not able to make room for another person.'"

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Ali bin Abu Talib said:                     "I was sitting with the Prophet, and 'Ammar bin Yasir asked permission to enter. The Prophet said: 'Let him in, welcome to the good and the purified.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عثمان بن أبي شيبة، وعلي بن محمد، قالا حدثنا وكيع، حدثنا سفيان، عن أبي إسحاق، عن هانئ بن هانئ، عن علي بن أبي طالب، قال كنت جالسا عند النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  فاستأذن عمار بن ياسر فقال النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ ائذنوا له مرحبا بالطيب المطيب ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Abu Hurairah said : The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to me while I was asleep in my house at night so that he could go somewhere else . He woke up and found a piece of leather on his shoulder. So, he took it off from the place where it had been put by someone who wanted him not to get hurt or something like this.
Then he said : "O son of Hurairah ! Do you know what I have done ?" 
I replied: No . He then told me that Allah has forgiven all my sins except one sin which is the sin of having killed a person who had embraced Islam after hearing about it.

chapter: The Chapters on Pawning - كتاب الرهون
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:                     “No one of you should withhold surplus water from common pastureland.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا هشام بن عمار، حدثنا سفيان، عن أبي الزناد، عن الأعرج، عن أبي هريرة، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ لا يمنع أحدكم فضل ماء ليمنع به الكلأ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said : The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited us from taking interest and consuming Riba .

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Abu Hurairah said:                      “We prostrated with theMessengerof Allah (ﷺ) in “When the heaven is split asunder” [84:1]and“Read! In the Name of your Lord.” [96:1]
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة، عن أيوب بن موسى، عن عطاء بن ميناء، عن أبي هريرة، قال سجدنا مع رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  في ‏{إذا السماء انشقت}‏ و ‏{اقرأ باسم ربك}‏
llm_response:
Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What kind of prayer is it when one prays in his house?" He replied, "(It) is two Rakat (units of prayer)." The man further asked, "If he adds another two rak`a-t for the noon and evening prayers?" Again Allah's Apostle said: "(They are four)"
The narrator then added that this was how they were taught.

chapter: Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Muhammad bin Sa’d bin Abu Waqqas that his fathersaid:                      “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: ‘The month is like thatandlike that and like that,’ and he showed nine fingers on thethird timeto indicate twenty-nine.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير، حدثنا محمد بن بشر، عن إسماعيل بن أبي خالد، عن محمد بن سعد بن أبي وقاص، عن أبيه، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ الشهر هكذا وهكذا وهكذا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وعقد تسعا وعشرين في الثالثة ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What should I say when I enter my house?" The Prophet replied, "(Say), 'Allahu Akbar (Allah is Greater) and At-Tahiyaan (I am at your service)."

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Sa'eed Khudri that he heard :                     The Messenger of Allah say: "Shall I not tell you of something by means of which Allah expiates for sins and increases good deeds?" They said: "Yes, O Messenger of Allah." He said: "Perform ablution properly despite difficulties, increasing the number of steps one takes towards the mosque and waiting for the next prayer after prayer.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا يحيى بن أبي بكير، حدثنا زهير بن محمد، عن عبد الله بن محمد بن عقيل، عن سعيد بن المسيب، عن أبي سعيد الخدري، أنه سمع رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال ‏"‏ ألا أدلكم على ما يكفر الله به الخطايا ويزيد به في الحسنات ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قالوا بلى يا رسول الله ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ إسباغ الوضوء على المكاره وكثرة الخطا إلى المساجد وانتظار الصلاة بعد الصلاة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What should I say if it (urine) gets into my clothes?" The Prophet replied, "(Say), 'As-salamu alaikum wa rahmatulahil-kubra.'"

chapter: The Chapters on Rulings - كتاب الأحكام
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Ali said:                     “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent me to Yemen. I said: 'O Messenger of Allah, you are sending me to judge between them while I am a young man, and I do not know how to judge.' He struck me on the chest with his hand and said: 'O Allah, guide his heart and make his tongue steadfast.' And after that I never doubted in passing judgment between two people.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا علي بن محمد، حدثنا يعلى، وأبو معاوية عن الأعمش، عن عمرو بن مرة، عن أبي البختري، عن علي، قال بعثني رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إلى اليمن فقلت يا رسول الله تبعثني وأنا شاب أقضي بينهم ولا أدري ما القضاء قال فضرب في صدري بيده ثم قال ‏"‏ اللهم اهد قلبه وثبت لسانه ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال فما شككت بعد في قضاء بين اثنين ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad about his wives how many of them were in Paradise? He replied "None except those who have neither taken more than their right nor slain any soul unjustly."

chapter: Chapters on Sacrifices - كتاب الأضاحي
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Abu Sarihah said:                      “My family started to putpressureon me after I came to know the Sunnah. People used tosacrifice oneor two sheep, but now our neighbors call us stingy.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا إسحاق بن منصور، أنبأنا عبد الرحمن بن مهدي، ومحمد بن يوسف، ح وحدثنا محمد بن يحيى، حدثنا عبد الرزاق، جميعا عن سفيان الثوري، عن بيان، عن الشعبي، عن أبي سريحة، قال حملني أهلي على الجفاء بعدما علمت من السنة كان أهل البيت يضحون بالشاة والشاتين والآن يبخلنا جيراننا ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) offered a camel as sacrifice which was to be slaughtered at night but he did not find anyone who could slaughter it, so Ibn Umm Mulaikah came and slaughtered the animal.

chapter: The Chapters on Charity - كتاب الصدقات
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:                     Whoever  is easy with (a debtor) who is in difficulty, Allah will be easy with him in this world and in the Hereafter.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا أبو معاوية، عن الأعمش، عن أبي صالح، عن أبي هريرة، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ من يسر على معسر يسر الله عليه في الدنيا والآخرة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man came to Allah's Apostle with his child who was suffering from an eye disease or had leprosy in it (or both) so he asked him, "Is there anything else?" He replied, "No." So the Prophet took hold of its ear and pulled out something like a lump.

chapter: The Chapters on Pawning - كتاب الرهون
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:                     “Whoever has land, let him cultivate it (himself) or let him give it to his brother (for free, to cultivate it), and if he does not want to do that, let him keep his land.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا إبراهيم بن سعيد الجوهري، حدثنا أبو توبة الربيع بن نافع، حدثنا معاوية بن سلام، عن يحيى بن أبي كثير، عن أبي سلمة، عن أبي هريرة، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ من كانت له أرض فليزرعها أو ليمنحها أخاه فإن أبى فليمسك أرضه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more loved to me?" He replied, "(To love) your brother." The man asked (the same question) for one and two times whereupon the Prophet said, "Feed him when he is hungry; clothe him when you find him naked. Treat him with kindness as long as you are not compensated in return but if you get any reward from him then help your brother."

ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)prayed‘Eid at the prayer place, using a small spear as a Sutrah.

chapter: The Chapters on Pawning - كتاب الرهون
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Rafi` bin Khadij said:                     “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Whoever cultivates people`s land without their permission, he has no right to any produce, but he should be recompensed for his expenditure.' ”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عبد الله بن عامر بن زرارة، حدثنا شريك، عن أبي إسحاق، عن عطاء، عن رافع بن خديج، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ من زرع في أرض قوم بغير إذنهم فليس له من الزرع شىء وترد عليه نفقته ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What is more loved to Allah?" He replied: "A slave who has control over himself in pleasures."

chapter: Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)said:                     “There are people who fast and get nothing from their fastexcepthunger, and there are those who pray and get nothing from theirprayer but a sleepless night.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عمرو بن رافع، حدثنا عبد الله بن المبارك، عن أسامة بن زيد، عن سعيد المقبري، عن أبي هريرة، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ رب صائم ليس له من صيامه إلا الجوع ورب قائم ليس له من قيامه إلا السهر ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What type of fasting is best?" He replied:"Fasting on alternate days."

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Sahl bin Hunaif said:                     "I used to suffer from a great deal of prostatic fluid, and I took many baths because of that. I asked the messenger of Allah about that, and he said: 'Ablution is sufficient for you in this case.' I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! What about the prostatic fluid that gets onto my clothes?' he said: 'it is sufficient for you to pour a handful of water on the part of your clothes wherever you see it has reached.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو كريب، حدثنا عبد الله بن المبارك، وعبدة بن سليمان، عن محمد بن إسحاق، حدثنا سعيد بن عبيد بن السباق، عن أبيه، عن سهل بن حنيف، قال كنت ألقى من المذى شدة فأكثر منه الاغتسال فسألت رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  فقال ‏"‏ إنما يجزيك من ذلك الوضوء ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قلت يا رسول الله كيف بما يصيب ثوبي قال ‏"‏ إنما يكفيك كف من ماء تنضح به من ثوبك حيث ترى أنه أصاب ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that a man asked Anas b. Malik about wiping over socks (khamr) which were worn on feet? He replied, "I do not know."

chapter: Tribulations - كتاب الفتن
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Sa’eed Al-Khudri that the Messenger ofAllah (ﷺ) stood up to deliver a sermon, and one of the things hesaid was:                      “Indeed, fear of people should not prevent a man from speakingthe truth, if he knows it.”Then Abu Sa'eed wept and said: "By Allah, we have seen things that made us scared (and we did not speak up)."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عمران بن موسى، أنبأنا حماد بن زيد، حدثنا علي بن زيد بن جدعان، عن أبي نضرة، عن أبي سعيد الخدري، أن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قام خطيبا فكان فيما قال ‏"‏ ألا لا يمنعن رجلا هيبة الناس أن يقول بحق إذا علمه ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال فبكى أبو سعيد وقال قد والله رأينا أشياء فهبنا ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) who was wearing an iron-greave on his leg which caused him pain so he asked for permission to remove it and put another one in its place, whereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) allowed him.

chapter: Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:                      “Ifanyoneof you is invited to eat when he is fasting, let him say: ‘I amfasting.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، ومحمد بن الصباح، قالا حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة، عن أبي الزناد، عن الأعرج، عن أبي هريرة، عن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال ‏"‏ إذا دعي أحدكم إلى طعام وهو صائم فليقل إني صائم ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid Al'Ansari said that a man asked Anas b. Malik about fasting on Monday or Tuesday (of two days) in Ramadan so as to make up for the missed day of Friday, and he replied by saying "I do not know whether it was because I did not eat anything at all during those nights that Allah's Messenger ﷺ said: 'Whoever does this will have his fast invalidated.'"

chapter: The Chapters on Marriage - كتاب النكاح
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas:                     that the Prophet cursed men who imitate women and woman who imitate men.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن خلاد الباهلي، حدثنا خالد بن الحارث، حدثنا شعبة، عن قتادة، عن عكرمة، عن ابن عباس، أن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  لعن المتشبهين من الرجال بالنساء ولعن المتشبهات من النساء بالرجال ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba said that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying "The best among you is the one who has control over his anger."

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Samurah bin Jundab said:                      “There are two pausesinwhich I memorized from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), but ‘Imran binHusain denied that. We wrote to Ubayy bin Ka’b in Al-Madinah, andhewrote that Samurah had indeed memorized them.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا جميل بن الحسن بن جميل العتكي، حدثنا عبد الأعلى، حدثنا سعيد، عن قتادة، عن الحسن، عن سمرة بن جندب، قال سكتتان حفظتهما عن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏.‏ فأنكر ذلك عمران بن الحصين فكتبنا إلى أبى بن كعب بالمدينة فكتب أن سمرة قد حفظ ‏.‏ قال سعيد فقلنا لقتادة ما هاتان السكتتان قال إذا دخل في صلاته وإذا فرغ من القراءة ‏.‏ ثم قال بعد وإذا قرأ ‏{غير المغضوب عليهم ولا الضالين}‏ ‏.‏ قال وكان يعجبهم إذا فرغ من القراءة أن يسكت حتى يتراد إليه نفسه ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "O Messenger of Allah! Which deeds are better? Please inform me." The Prophet replied by saying: "A good word or kind speech and helping someone who has lost something when you find it.

chapter: Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Anas bin Malik said:                      “The Messenger of Allah(ﷺ)granted a concession to pregnant women who fear for themselves,allowing them not to fast, and to nursing mothers who fear for theirinfants.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا هشام بن عمار الدمشقي، حدثنا الربيع بن بدر، عن الجريري، عن الحسن، عن أنس بن مالك، قال رخص رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  للحبلى التي تخاف على نفسها أن تفطر وللمرضع التي تخاف على ولدها ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) used to fast on a piece of iron which he would tie round his neck like an amulet.

chapter: Chapters Regarding Funerals - كتاب الجنائز
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from ‘Uthman bin ‘Affan that the Prophet (ﷺ)offeredthe funeral prayer for ‘Uthman bin Maz’un, and he said fourTakbir over him.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا يعقوب بن حميد بن كاسب، حدثنا المغيرة بن عبد الرحمن، حدثنا خالد بن إلياس، عن إسماعيل بن عمرو بن سعيد بن العاص، عن عثمان بن عبد الله بن الحكم بن الحارث، عن عثمان بن عفان، ‏.‏ أن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  صلى على عثمان بن مظعون وكبر عليه أربعا ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What is more loved to Allah?" He replied: "A slave who restrains himself from anger."

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: 'Abdul-Muhaimin bin 'Abbas bin Sahl bin Sa'd As-Sa'di narraed from his father, from his grandfather, that:                     The Messenger of Allah said: "Rinse your mouths after drinking milk, for it has some greasiness in it."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو مصعب، حدثنا عبد المهيمن بن عباس بن سهل بن سعد الساعدي، عن أبيه، عن جده، أن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال ‏"‏ مضمضوا من اللبن فإن له دسما ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What is more loved to Allah?" He replied, "A smiling face."

chapter: The Chapters on Business Transactions - كتاب التجارات
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud said:                     "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade. meeting the owners of goods (away from the market)."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا يحيى بن حكيم، حدثنا يحيى بن سعيد، وحماد بن مسعدة، عن سليمان التيمي، ح وحدثنا إسحاق بن إبراهيم بن حبيب بن الشهيد، حدثنا معتمر بن سليمان، قال سمعت أبي قال، حدثنا أبو عثمان النهدي، عن عبد الله بن مسعود، قال نهى رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  عن تلقي البيوع ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Allah's Apostle what he should say if one of his camels died or was stolen on way while it was in joint possession with others?

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Laila Al-Kindi said:                     "Khabbab came to 'Umar and said: 'Come close, for no one deserves this meeting more than you, except that 'Ammar.' Then Khabbab started to show him the marks on his back that the idolaters had tortured him."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا علي بن محمد، وعمرو بن عبد الله، قالا حدثنا وكيع، حدثنا سفيان، عن أبي إسحاق، عن أبي ليلى الكندي، قال جاء خباب إلى عمر فقال ادن فما أحد أحق بهذا المجلس منك إلا عمار ‏.‏ فجعل خباب يريه آثارا بظهره مما عذبه المشركون ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man came to Allah's Apostle while he was at Dhu-lHulayfa (a place on the Red Sea shore) with his family asking for some water, and they did not give him any water. The Prophet asked them: "Why don't you give water to this person who has come?" They said: "He is an unbeliever." He said: "Do not refuse him; give him a full bucket of water."
