chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Malik bin Huwairith said that when the MessengerofAllah (ﷺ) said Allahu Akbar, he would raise his hands until theywere close to his ears; when he bowed in Ruku’ he did likewise, andwhen he raised his head from Ruku’ he did likewise.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا حميد بن مسعدة، حدثنا يزيد بن زريع، حدثنا هشام، عن قتادة، عن نصر بن عاصم، عن مالك بن الحويرث، أن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  كان إذا كبر رفع يديه حتى يجعلهما قريبا من أذنيه وإذا ركع صنع مثل ذلك وإذا رفع رأسه من الركوع صنع مثل ذلك ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What deeds are loved most by Allah?" He replied: "On my part I love those who follow up what is neglected (of religious obligations) when others forget."

chapter: The Chapters on Expiation - كتاب الكفارات
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Umar bin Khattab said:                     "I made a vow during the Ignorance period and I asked the Prophet (ﷺ) (about it) after I became Muslim. He told me to fulfill my vow."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا حفص بن غياث، عن عبيد الله بن عمر، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر، عن عمر بن الخطاب، قال نذرت نذرا في الجاهلية فسألت النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  بعد ما أسلمت فأمرني أن أوفي بنذري ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud said that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "The inmates of Paradise will be those who have neither been extravagant nor miserly; and they would not sleep but with a consort. They are the people who do what is necessary for their livelihood."

chapter: The Chapters on Jihad - كتاب الجهاد
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani that the Messenger ofAllah(ﷺ) said:                      “Whoever equips a warrior in the cause of Allah, hewill have a reward like his, without that detracting from thewarrior’s reward in the slightest.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عبد الله بن سعيد، حدثنا عبدة بن سليمان، عن عبد الملك بن أبي سليمان، عن عطاء، عن زيد بن خالد الجهني، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ من جهز غازيا في سبيل الله كان له مثل أجره من غير أن ينقص من أجر الغازي شيئا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man came to Allah's Apostle saying, "O Allah's Apostle! What will be my reward if I fast all the month of Ramadan?" The Prophet replied, "(You have) for each good deed ten multiples."

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from that Jabir said:                     "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Whoever tells lies about me deliberately, let him take his place in Hell."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو خيثمة، زهير بن حرب حدثنا هشيم، عن أبي الزبير، عن جابر، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ من كذب على متعمدا فليتبوأ مقعده من النار ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more loved to me than my own self?" He replied, "(The love of) your wife." The man then asked for something else and he repeated the same reply till ten times. Then he added, "If you have no other (wife), then your riding camel which comes every morning with good news from its journey is more loved to you than yourself"

chapter: The Book On The Mosques And The Congregations - كتاب المساجد والجماعات
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:                     "Allah's Messenger prohibited prayer from being performed in seven places: The garbage dump, the slaughtering area, the graveyard, the commonly used road, the bathroom, in the area that camels rest at, and above the Ka'bah."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن إبراهيم الدمشقي، حدثنا عبد الله بن يزيد، عن يحيى بن أيوب، عن زيد بن جبيرة، عن داود بن الحصين، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر، قال نهى رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أن يصلى في سبع مواطن في المزبلة والمجزرة والمقبرة وقارعة الطريق والحمام ومعاطن الإبل وفوق الكعبة ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "Which deeds are most beloved to Allah?" He replied: "A smiling face."

chapter: Chapters Regarding Funerals - كتاب الجنائز
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Abu Qatadah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)said:                      “Ifanyone of you is charged with taking care of his brother(afterdeath), let him shroud him well.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن بشار، حدثنا عمر بن يونس، حدثنا عكرمة بن عمار، عن هشام بن حسان، عن محمد بن سيرين، عن أبي قتادة، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ إذا ولي أحدكم أخاه فليحسن كفنه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) with his dead son in his arms saying "If you had advised me I would have taken him to one of those who treat the sick."

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_en: Amr bin Shu'aib narrated that:                     His father said: "Mu'awiyah stood up to deliver a sermon and said: 'Where are your scholars? Where are your scholars?  For I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: The Hour will not begin until a group of my Ummah will prevail over the people, and they will not care who lets them down and who supports them."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا يعقوب بن حميد بن كاسب، حدثنا القاسم بن نافع، حدثنا الحجاج بن أرطاة، عن عمرو بن شعيب، عن أبيه، قال قام معاوية خطيبا فقال أين علماؤكم أين علماؤكم سمعت رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول ‏"‏ لا تقوم الساعة إلا وطائفة من أمتي ظاهرون على الناس لا يبالون من خذلهم ولا من نصرهم ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allaah (peace and blessings of Allaah be upon him) said to me when I was young, "O son of my brother! Do not associate anything else with your Lord lest He should visit you with a punishment."

chapter: The Chapters on Business Transactions - كتاب التجارات
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Ubadah bin Samit said:                     "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ruled that the fruit of a palm tree belongs to the one who pollinated it, and that the wealth of a slave belongs to the one who sold him, unless the purchaser stipulated a condition."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عبد ربه بن خالد النميري أبو المغلس، حدثنا الفضيل بن سليمان، عن موسى بن عقبة، حدثني إسحاق بن يحيى بن الوليد بن عبادة بن الصامت، عن عبادة بن الصامت، قال قضى رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أن ثمر النخل لمن أبرها إلا أن يشترط المبتاع وأن مال المملوك لمن باعه إلا أن يشترط المبتاع ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Allah's Apostle saying "The most burdensome deed to me is a man who has much wealth but no fear of God and no pity."

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: 'Ali bin Yahya bin Khallad narrated, from his father, from his paternal uncle Rifa'ah bin Rafi' that:                     He was sitting with the Prophet who said: 'No person's prayer is complete until he performs ablution properly as Allah has commanded him, washing his face, his arms up to the elbows, wiping his head and his feet up to the ankles.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن يحيى، حدثنا حجاج، حدثنا همام، حدثنا إسحاق بن عبد الله بن أبي طلحة، حدثني علي بن يحيى بن خلاد، عن أبيه، عن عمه، رفاعة بن رافع أنه كان جالسا عند النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  فقال ‏"‏ إنها لا تتم صلاة لأحد حتى يسبغ الوضوء كما أمره الله تعالى يغسل وجهه ويديه إلى المرفقين ويمسح برأسه ورجليه إلى الكعبين ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (RA) said that his father Umar (RA), who was a Companion of Prophet Muhammad (SAW): The Messenger of Allaah, peace and blessings be upon him, used to perform ablution like this: He would start with the right hand. Then he would pour water over it three times. After that, he would put his hands into the bowl once or twice; then he would wash them up until they were clean. Next, he would take a miswak and rub both of his cheeks together using it. He would do this with one hand while holding on to the other side of the miswak in order for him not to drop any water from his mouth onto his beard or hair. After that, he washed his face once; then he performed ablution like a regular person does until all parts were clean except for what remained between his shoulders and around them (i.e., underneath the neck). Then he would pour three handfuls of water on top of it so as to make sure that everything gets wet, including those areas which are not easily reached by one's fingers or hands alone; then he washed both feet once with his right foot being placed over the left. Afterwards, he performed ablution like a regular person does until all parts were clean except for what remained between his shoulders and around

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Abu Sa’eed said:                      “A man entered the mosque whentheProphet (ﷺ) was delivering the sermon. He said: ‘Have youprayed?’ He said: ‘No.’ He said: ‘Then pray two Rak’ah.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن الصباح، أنبأنا سفيان بن عيينة، عن ابن عجلان، عن عياض بن عبد الله، عن أبي سعيد، قال جاء رجل والنبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يخطب فقال ‏"‏ أصليت ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال لا ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ فصل ركعتين ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What is more superior in faith?" He replied by saying, "Not to commit sins." The man then repeated his question three times; each time he was told the same answer.

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Bakrah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah delivered a religious speech on the Day of Sacrifice and said: 'Let those who are present convey to those who are absent. For perhaps the one to whom it is conveyed will understand it better than the one who (first) hears it.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن بشار، حدثنا يحيى بن سعيد القطان، - أملاه علينا - حدثنا قرة بن خالد، حدثنا محمد بن سيرين، عن عبد الرحمن بن أبي بكرة، عن أبيه، وعن رجل، آخر هو أفضل في نفسي من عبد الرحمن عن أبي بكرة قال خطب رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يوم النحر فقال ‏"‏ ليبلغ الشاهد الغائب فإنه رب مبلغ يبلغه أوعى له من سامع ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more loved to me?" He replied, "(To love) your brother." The man asked (the same), for one thing each time and he kept on replying as such. Then the Prophet told him: "Feed in the name of God those who are fasting at home"

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Juhaifah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Whoever introduces a good practice that is followed after him, will have a reward for that and the equivalent of their reward, without that detracting from their reward in the slightest. Whoever introduces an evil practice that is followed after him, will bear the burden of sin for that and the equivalent of their burden of sin, without that detracting from their burden in the slightest.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن يحيى، حدثنا أبو نعيم، حدثنا أبو إسرائيل، عن الحكم، عن أبي جحيفة، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ من سن سنة حسنة فعمل بها بعده كان له أجرها ومثل أجورهم من غير أن ينقص من أجورهم شيئا ومن سن سنة سيئة فعمل بها بعده كان عليه وزره ومثل أوزارهم من غير أن ينقص من أوزارهم شيئا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What deeds are loved most by Allah?" He replied: "O man! Go on foot to your father or mother who is old, and say 'I am at thy service.'"

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Bara' bin 'Azib said:                     "We returned with the Messenger of Allah from his Hajj that he had performed, and we stopped at some point on the road. He commanded that prayer should be performed in congregation, then he took the hand of 'Ali and said: 'Am I not dearer to the believers than their own selves?' They said: 'Yes indeed.' He said: 'Am I not dearer to every believer than his own self?' They said: 'Yes indeed.' He said: 'This man is the friend of those whose master I am.' O Allah, take as friends those who take him as a friend, and take as enemies those who take him as an enemy.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا علي بن محمد، حدثنا أبو الحسين، أخبرني حماد بن سلمة، عن علي بن زيد بن جدعان، عن عدي بن ثابت، عن البراء بن عازب، قال أقبلنا مع رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  في حجته التي حج فنزل في الطريق فأمر الصلاة جامعة فأخذ بيد علي فقال ‏"‏ ألست أولى بالمؤمنين من أنفسهم ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قالوا بلى ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ ألست أولى بكل مؤمن من نفسه ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قالوا بلى ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ فهذا ولي من أنا مولاه اللهم وال من والاه اللهم عاد من عاداه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) used to offer two Rakat of Witr before going to bed.

chapter: The Chapters on Pawning - كتاب الرهون
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Tawus that Ibn`Abbas told that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) merely said:                     “For one of you to give (land) to his brother is better for him than if he were to take a set amount in rent for it.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن خلاد الباهلي، ومحمد بن إسماعيل، قالا حدثنا وكيع، عن سفيان، عن عمرو بن دينار، عن طاوس، قال قال ابن عباس إنما قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لأن يمنح أحدكم أخاه الأرض خير له من أن يأخذ لها خراجا معلوما ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that a man asked Anas b. Malik about an article of clothing which he had pawned with him (Anas being one of his creditors) and the latter did not know its value, so he wrote to Abu Bakr as-Siddiq who was then in Syria: "I have given a man my garment on pledge without knowing its price. I am afraid that it may be more than what is due me." So 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari wrote to him (Anas) and informed him about the matter, so he sent Anas b. Malik a letter which read: "Write down whatever you have given on pledge for us in full detail; then if it is more than what we are due from that man, write to me again." So 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari wrote the above mentioned letter and gave him (Anas) a copy of his own writing. Then Anas b. Malik sent this letter which read: "I have given on pledge for you one hundred dirhams, but I do not know its price."

chapter: The Chapters on Divorce - كتاب الطلاق
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Aishah said:                     "When the following was revealed: 'But if you desire Allah and His Messenger, (ﷺ) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) entered upon me and said: 'O Aishah I want to say something to you, and you do not have to hasten (in making a decision) until you have consulted your parents."' She said: "He knew, by Allah, that my parents would never tell me to leave him." She said: "Then he recited to me: ' O Prophet (Muhammad)! Say to your wives: " If you desire the life of this world, and its glitter.'" I said: 'Do I need to consult my parents about this? I choose Allah and His Messenger."'
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن يحيى، حدثنا عبد الرزاق، أنبأنا معمر، عن الزهري، عن عروة، عن عائشة، قالت لما نزلت ‏{وإن كنتن تردن الله ورسوله}‏ دخل على رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  فقال ‏"‏ يا عائشة إني ذاكر لك أمرا فلا عليك أن لا تعجلي فيه حتى تستأمري أبويك قالت قد علم والله أن أبوى لم يكونا ليأمراني بفراقه ‏.‏ قالت فقرأ على ‏{يا أيها النبي قل لأزواجك إن كنتن تردن الحياة الدنيا وزينتها }‏ ‏.‏ الآيات ‏.‏ فقلت في هذا أستأمر أبوى قد اخترت الله ورسوله ‏.‏
llm_response: NarratedAbdullah bin Shabba said that he heard his father say to a man who had divorced two wives in one breath:"Go back (and take them)." The Prophet of Allaah(salla-Allahu alayhi wa sallam) turned towards him and asked: "Did you tell the truth?" He said, "Yes."

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Anas bin Malik said:                      “The Messenger of Allah(ﷺ),Abu Bakr and ‘Umar used to start their recitation with ‘All thepraises and thanks are to Allah, the Lord of all that exists(Al-hamduLillahi Rabbil-‘Alamin).” [1:2]
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن الصباح، أنبأنا سفيان، عن أيوب، عن قتادة، عن أنس بن مالك، ح وحدثنا جبارة بن المغلس، حدثنا أبو عوانة، عن قتادة، عن أنس بن مالك، قال كان رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  وأبو بكر وعمر يفتتحون القراءة ب ‏{الحمد لله رب العالمين}‏
llm_response:
Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What deeds are loved most by Allah?" He replied: "O man! Go on foot to your father or mother who is old, and say: 'I wish if you were in health I would come to see you but that my feet prevent me.'"
Then he added saying: "He will be given a reward as if he had performed the deed."

chapter: The Chapters on Business Transactions - كتاب التجارات
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن رمح، أنبأنا الليث بن سعد، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر، عن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  بنحوه ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba said that he heard Abu Hurairah say, "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked about a man who had sexual intercourse with his wife during her menses and then she died. He said, 'He should be lashed one hundred stripes.'"

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وسويد بن سعيد، قالا حدثنا أبو الأحوص، عن سماك، عن عكرمة، عن ابن عباس، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ ليقرأن القرآن ناس من أمتي يمرقون من الإسلام كما يمرق السهم من الرمية ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to offer two Rakat of Witr in one bowlful

chapter: Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that ‘Abdullah bin Zubair said:                      “The Messenger ofAllah(ﷺ) broke his fast with Sa’d bin Mu’adh and said: ‘Aftara‘indakumus-saimun, wa akala ta’amakumul-abrar, wa sallat‘alaikumul-mala’ikah (May fasting people break their fast withyou, may therighteous eat your food, and may the angels sendblessing upon you).”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا هشام بن عمار، حدثنا سعيد بن يحيى اللخمي، حدثنا محمد بن عمرو، عن مصعب بن ثابت، عن عبد الله بن الزبير، قال أفطر رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  عند سعد بن معاذ فقال ‏"‏ أفطر عندكم الصائمون وأكل طعامكم الأبرار وصلت عليكم الملائكة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba' said that he heard Allah's Apostle saying "Allah has made My (Holy) Messengers as kings who have no need to fear poverty or ask anyone for help."

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Rifa’ah Al-Juhani said:                      “The Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) said: ‘Allah provides respite until, when half or two thirdsofthe night had passed, He says: “My slave does not ask of anyoneotherthan Me. Whoever calls upon Me, I will answer him; whoever asksof Me,I will give him; whoever asks My forgiveness, I will forgivehim,”until dawn comes.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا محمد بن مصعب، عن الأوزاعي، عن يحيى بن أبي كثير، عن هلال بن أبي ميمونة، عن عطاء بن يسار، عن رفاعة الجهني، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ إن الله يمهل حتى إذا ذهب من الليل نصفه أو ثلثاه قال لا يسألن عبادي غيري من يدعني أستجب له من يسألني أعطه من يستغفرني أغفر له حتى يطلع الفجر ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : What is more superior in faith? He replied: "None of you has greater right to me than your mother." The man then repeated his question three times, and each time the reply was the same.

chapter: The Chapters on Business Transactions - كتاب التجارات
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Samurah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:                     "The two parties to a transaction have the choice (of annulling it) so long as they have not yet parted. "
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن يحيى، وإسحاق بن منصور، قالا حدثنا عبد الصمد، حدثنا شعبة، عن قتادة، عن الحسن، عن سمرة، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ البيعان بالخيار ما لم يتفرقا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Allah's Apostle saying "The most burdensome deed to me is going in the morning early (to have a bath) and at once one has to perform all of his ablations."

chapter: The Chapters on Legal Punishments - كتاب الحدود
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Ubadah bin Samit that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:                     “Whoever among you undergoes a Hadd, his punishment has been brought forward, and it is an expiation for him otherwise his case rests with Allah.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن المثنى، حدثنا عبد الوهاب، وابن أبي عدي، عن خالد الحذاء، عن أبي قلابة، عن أبي الأشعث، عن عبادة بن الصامت، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ من أصاب منكم حدا فعجلت له عقوبته فهو كفارته وإلا فأمره إلى الله ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more loved by God?" He replied,"Faith in Him which inclines one to do good deeds."

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Qais bin ‘Amr said:                      “The Prophet (ﷺ) saw a manpraying two Rak’ah after the Subh prayer and said, ‘Is the Subhprayerto be offered twice?’ The man said to him: ‘I did not praythe twoRak’ah before it, so I prayed them (now).’ The Messengerof Allah(ﷺ) remained silent.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا عبد الله بن نمير، حدثنا سعد بن سعيد، حدثني محمد بن إبراهيم، عن قيس بن عمرو، قال رأى النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  رجلا يصلي بعد صلاة الصبح ركعتين فقال النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ أصلاة الصبح مرتين ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فقال له الرجل إني لم أكن صليت الركعتين اللتين قبلها فصليتهما ‏.‏ قال فسكت النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that he was praying with Allah's Messenger while a man passed by him on his camel between us so as to cut off what is left of my prayer (i.e., I could not complete the rak`ah).

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah would not perform ablution after the bath to cleanse himself from sexual impurity."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وعبد الله بن عامر بن زرارة، وإسماعيل بن موسى السدي، قالوا حدثنا شريك، عن أبي إسحاق، عن الأسود، عن عائشة، قالت كان رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  لا يتوضأ بعد الغسل من الجنابة ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said : The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to us in the mosque while we were reclining on our right side; so he sat down with his back towards the qibla and asked, "What is this?" We replied, "Our Lord!" He then turned away from it.

chapter: Chapters on Hajj Rituals - كتاب المناسك
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا عبد الرحيم بن سليمان، عن يزيد بن أبي زياد، عن سليمان بن عمرو بن الأحوص، عن أم جندب، عن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  بنحوه ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What is more loved by Allah?" He replied: "A smiling face."

chapter: The Chapters on Business Transactions - كتاب التجارات
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Uthman bin 'Affan said:                     "I used to sell dates in the marketplace, and I would say: 'This was such and such an amount (when I bought it).' I Would give the purchaser a specific amount of dates according to the way it had been measured for me, and take my profit. Then I began to have some doubts about that, so I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and he said: ‘When you name the amount, measure it in front of the purchaser."'
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا علي بن ميمون الرقي، حدثنا عبد الله بن يزيد، عن ابن لهيعة، عن موسى بن وردان، عن سعيد بن المسيب، عن عثمان بن عفان، قال كنت أبيع التمر في السوق فأقول كلت في وسقي هذا كذا ‏.‏ فأدفع أوساق التمر بكيله وآخذ شفي فدخلني من ذلك شىء فسألت رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  فقال ‏"‏ إذا سميت الكيل فكله ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba said that he heard Abu Hurairah say to his slave girl who was carrying a tray of water in her hand "O you foolish one! Do not pour out all this water at once, but do it gradually."

chapter: Chapters on Sacrifices - كتاب الأضاحي
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that ‘Ali said:                      “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbadesacrificing the Muqabalah, the Mudabarah, the Sharqa’, the Kharqa’andthe Jad’a’.”*
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن الصباح، حدثنا أبو بكر بن عياش، عن أبي إسحاق، عن شريح بن النعمان، عن علي، قال نهى رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أن يضحى بمقابلة أو مدابرة أو شرقاء أو خرقاء أو جدعاء ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad about his camel which he had slaughtered in Ramadan while it was fasting (i.e., during daylight hours). The Messenger of Allah replied, "If you have not yet eaten from its meat and if the people who are present with you do not eat any part of that animal's flesh or drink anything else other than water then there is nothing wrong in it."
Narrated Abu Hurairah said: A man asked Prophet Muhammad about his camel which he had slaughtered during daylight hours while the animal was fasting. The Messenger of Allah replied, "If you have not yet eaten from its meat and if those who are present with you do not eat any part of that animal's flesh or drink anything else other than water then there is nothing wrong in it."

chapter: Chapters Regarding Funerals - كتاب الجنائز
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Ma’qil bin Yasar that the Messenger of Allah(ﷺ)said:                      “Recite Qur’an near your dying ones,” meaning Ya-Sin.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا علي بن الحسن بن شقيق، عن ابن المبارك، عن سليمان التيمي، عن أبي عثمان، - وليس بالنهدي - عن أبيه، عن معقل بن يسار، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ اقرءوها عند موتاكم ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يعني ‏{يس}‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What is more loved to Allah?" He replied:"A slave who has control over himself in anger."

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Khalid bin Walid, Yazid bin Abu Sufyan, Shurahbil bin Hasanah and 'Amr bin 'As that:                     They all heard the Messenger of Allah say: 'Complete the ablution. Woe to the heels because of Hell-fire."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا العباس بن عثمان، وعثمان بن إسماعيل الدمشقيان، قالا حدثنا الوليد بن مسلم، حدثنا شيبة بن الأحنف، عن أبي سلام الأسود، عن أبي صالح الأشعري، حدثني أبو عبد الله الأشعري، عن خالد بن الوليد، ويزيد بن أبي سفيان، وشرحبيل ابن حسنة، وعمرو بن العاص، كل هؤلاء سمعوا من، رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال ‏"‏ أتموا الوضوء ويل للأعقاب من النار ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to us in a state of Ihram at Dhu al-Qarnain while we were with him on an expedition, and he was riding upon the camel's saddle. He asked for water so that he might perform ablution; then he performed it after entering into his clothes (i.e., Ghusal).

chapter: The Chapters on Marriage - كتاب النكاح
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:                     "When 'Umar bin Khattab was appointed caliph, he addressed the people and said: 'The Messenger of Allah permitted temporary marriage for us three times, then he forbade it. By Allah, If I hear of any married person entering a temporary marriage, I will stone him to death, unless he can bring me four witnesses who will testify that the Messenger of Allah, allowed it after he forbade it'."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن خلف العسقلاني، حدثنا الفريابي، عن أبان بن أبي حازم، عن أبي بكر بن حفص، عن ابن عمر، قال لما ولي عمر بن الخطاب خطب الناس فقال إن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أذن لنا في المتعة ثلاثا ثم حرمها والله لا أعلم أحدا تمتع وهو محصن إلا رجمته بالحجارة إلا أن يأتيني بأربعة يشهدون أن رسول الله أحلها بعد إذ حرمها ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle what he should spend on his wife? He replied,'If you love her then spent on her; otherwise she will be spending on herself from your money.'

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: Zainab the daughter of Umm Salamah narrated from Umm Salamah that:                     She and the Messenger of Allah used to take a bath from a single vessel.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا إسماعيل ابن علية، عن هشام الدستوائي، عن يحيى بن أبي كثير، عن أبي سلمة، عن زينب بنت أم سلمة، عن أم سلمة، أنها كانت ورسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يغتسلان من إناء واحد ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid Al'Ansari (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that he heard Anas Bin Malik (may Allaah be pleased with him), who was serving in the Prophet Muhammad's household, say to his wife when she had just returned from her menses: "Go and take a bath." She replied: "I have not yet purified myself after my menstruation period. I am afraid that if you tell me this again then it will be more difficult for me than before." He said: "If the Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings of Allaah be upon him) had told us to do something, he would have made things easier for us rather than harder; so I am telling you that if your husband tells you this again then it will not become more difficult but you should take a bath."

chapter: Tribulations - كتاب الفتن
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Ziyad bin Labid said:                      “The Prophet (ﷺ)mentioned something and said: ‘That will be at the time whenknowledge(of Qur’an) disappears.’ I said: ‘O Messenger ofAllah, how willknowledge disappear when we read the Qur’an andteach it to ourchildren, until the Day of Resurrection?’ He said:‘May your mother bebereft of you, Ziyad! I thought that you werethe wisest man in Al-Madinah. Is it not the case that these Jews andChristians read theTawrah and the Injil, but they do not act uponanything of what is inthem?’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا وكيع، حدثنا الأعمش، عن سالم بن أبي الجعد، عن زياد بن لبيد، قال ذكر النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  شيئا فقال ‏"‏ ذاك عند أوان ذهاب العلم ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قلت يا رسول الله وكيف يذهب العلم ونحن نقرأ القرآن ونقرئه أبناءنا ويقرئه أبناؤنا أبناءهم إلى يوم القيامة قال ‏"‏ ثكلتك أمك زياد إن كنت لأراك من أفقه رجل بالمدينة أوليس هذه اليهود والنصارى يقرءون التوراة والإنجيل لا يعملون بشىء مما فيهما ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (Allah be pleased with them) said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade us to eat of seven animals which are wild by nature, and he prohibited the sale of their hides.

chapter: The Chapters on Divorce - كتاب الطلاق
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Aishah that:                     she freed Barirah and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) gave her the choice, and she (Barirah) had a free husband.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا حفص بن غياث، عن الأعمش، عن إبراهيم، عن الأسود بن يزيد، عن عائشة، أنها أعتقت بريرة فخيرها رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  وكان لها زوج حر ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle what to say if he intended divorce twice (before consummating his marriage).

chapter: Chapters on Hajj Rituals - كتاب المناسك
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Jabir said:                      “Asma’ bint ‘Umais gave birth toMuhammad bin Abi Bakr and sent word to the Prophet (ﷺ). He told herto take a bath, fasten a cloth around her private part and begin theTalbiyah.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا علي بن محمد، حدثنا يحيى بن آدم، عن سفيان، عن جعفر بن محمد، عن أبيه، عن جابر، قال نفست أسماء بنت عميس بمحمد بن أبي بكر فأرسلت إلى النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  فأمرها أن تغتسل وتستثفر بثوب وتهل ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered upon a woman who was mourning over her dead child in which he had buried him at night. The Prophet asked, "What is this?" She replied, "(It has been) the custom of Jews and Christians." He then ordered for it to be dug up so that they could bury their son with his face towards Qibla (i.e., Ka'ba).

chapter: The Chapters on Charity - كتاب الصدقات
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri said:                     “A Bedouin came to the Prophet (ﷺ) to ask him to pay back a debt that he owed him, and he spoke harshly, saying: 'I will make things difficult for you unless you repay me.' His Companions rebuked him and said: 'Woe to you, do you know who you are speaking to?' He said: 'I am only asking for my rights.' The Prophet (ﷺ) said: 'Why do you not support the one who has a right?' Then he sent word to Khawlah bint Qais, saying to her: 'If you have dates, lend them to us until our dates come, then we will pay you back.' She said: 'Yes, may my father be ransomed for you, O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)!'  So she gave him a loan, and he paid back the Bedouin and fed him. He (the Bedouin) said: 'You have paid me in full, may Allah (SWT) pay you in full.' He (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) said: 'Those are the best of people. May that nation not be cleansed (of sin) among whom the weak cannot get their rights without trouble.' ”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا إبراهيم بن عبد الله بن محمد بن عثمان أبو شيبة، حدثنا ابن أبي عبيدة، - أظنه قال - حدثنا أبي، عن الأعمش، عن أبي صالح، عن أبي سعيد الخدري، قال جاء أعرابي إلى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يتقاضاه دينا كان عليه فاشتد عليه حتى قال له أحرج عليك إلا قضيتني ‏.‏ فانتهره أصحابه وقالوا ويحك تدري من تكلم قال إني أطلب حقي ‏.‏ فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هلا مع صاحب الحق كنتم ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثم أرسل إلى خولة بنت قيس فقال لها ‏"‏ إن كان عندك تمر فأقرضينا حتى يأتينا تمر فنقضيك ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فقالت نعم بأبي أنت يا رسول الله ‏.‏ قال فأقرضته فقضى الأعرابي وأطعمه فقال أوفيت أوفى الله لك ‏.‏ فقال ‏"‏ أولئك خيار الناس إنه لا قدست أمة لا يأخذ الضعيف فيها حقه غير متعتع ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that a man asked Anas b. Malik about charity given to his wife or children, and he replied by saying: "I do not know anything of it." The Prophet (sallallaahu 'alayhi wa sallam) then came in and heard the question being posed, so he said:
"Give them from your property as you give to yourself. If she is a wife for whom her husband has given something, let him not withhold it; if they are children who have been provided for by their father or mother, do not deprive them of what was set aside for them."

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Salamah bin Akwa' said:                     "I saw the Messenger of Allah performing ablution, and he wiped his head once."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن الحارث المصري، حدثنا يحيى بن راشد البصري، عن يزيد، مولى سلمة عن سلمة بن الأكوع، قال رأيت رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  توضأ فمسح رأسه مرة ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him) said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad ﷺ about his prayer in which he had missed some raka'at due to sleeping, and how many days of fasting should one make up for missing them? The Messenger of Allah  ﷺ replied: "Whoever misses the prayer intentionally is as though he has killed someone. Whoever sleeps during his prayers is like a dog licking its own vomit."
Narrated Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him) said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad ﷺ about his prayer in which he had missed some raka'at due to sleeping, and how many days of fasting should one make up for missing them? The Messenger of Allah  ﷳ replied: "Whoever misses the prayer intentionally is as though he has killed someone. Whoever sleeps during his prayers is like a dog licking its own vomit."

chapter: Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Bishr bin Suhaim that:                      The Messenger of Allah(ﷺ)delivered a sermon on the days of Tashriq (11th, 12th,and 13thof Dhul-Hijjah) and said: “No one will enterParadise but a Muslimsoul, and these days are the days of eating anddrinking.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وعلي بن محمد، قالا حدثنا وكيع، عن سفيان، عن حبيب بن أبي ثابت، عن نافع بن جبير بن مطعم، عن بشر بن سحيم، أن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  خطب أيام التشريق فقال ‏"‏ لا يدخل الجنة إلا نفس مسلمة وإن هذه الأيام أيام أكل وشرب ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him) said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad ﷺ saying, "Messenger of Allah! What should I say if anyone asks me to testify against my father or mother as regards faith?" He replied, "Say: 'Allah guide you.'"

chapter: Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Abu Sa’eed Al-Khudri said:                      “We observed I’tikafwith the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) during the middle ten days ofRamadan. He said: ‘I have been shown Lailatul-Qadr, then I wascausedto forget it, so seek it in the last ten night, on theodd-numberednights.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا إسماعيل ابن علية، عن هشام الدستوائي، عن يحيى بن أبي كثير، عن أبي سلمة، عن أبي سعيد الخدري، قال اعتكفنا مع رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  العشر الأوسط من رمضان فقال ‏"‏ إني أريت ليلة القدر فأنسيتها فالتمسوها في العشر الأواخر في الوتر ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Abu Hurairah said : The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to us in the mosque while we were reclining on our left side; so he sat down with his back towards Quba, and then delivered a sermon. He praised Allah, extolled Him and glorified Him as due His rightful place of worship, and said: "O people! Do not swear by your fathers for I have more claim on you than they."
Then he raised his hand towards the sky saying :" O Lord ! You know that we are weak in this world; so forgive us our sins. And do not make it a cause of punishment upon us, and bless us with Your mercy."

chapter: The Chapters on Rulings - كتاب الأحكام
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Dharr that he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say:                     “Whoever claims something that does not belong to him; he is not one of us, so let him take his place in Hell.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عبد الوارث بن عبد الصمد بن عبد الوارث بن سعيد أبو عبيدة، حدثني أبي قال، حدثني أبي، حدثني الحسين بن ذكوان، عن عبد الله بن بريدة، قال حدثني يحيى بن يعمر، أن أبا الأسود الديلي، حدثه عن أبي ذر، أنه سمع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول ‏"‏ من ادعى ما ليس له فليس منا وليتبوأ مقعده من النار ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) with his father who was sitting at home doing nothing but following others saying "O Allah's Messenger! I have come from the farthest place in search of knowledge and my father is not able to move out." The Prophet said, "Go back to your father as he will get double reward for his action (of accompanying you)."

chapter: The Chapters on Wills - كتاب الوصايا
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:                     “Allah (SWT) has been charitable with you over the disposal of one third of your wealth at the time of your death, so that you may be able to add to the record of your good deeds.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا علي بن محمد، حدثنا وكيع، عن طلحة بن عمرو، عن عطاء، عن أبي هريرة، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إن الله تصدق عليكم عند وفاتكم بثلث أموالكم زيادة لكم في أعمالكم ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that a man came to the Prophet () asking about his inheritance from his father's property who had died before he was born, and asked for an answer in writing. The Messenger of Allaah() wrote: "Inheritance is given only to those who are alive."
Reference : 2813

chapter: Etiquette - كتاب الأدب
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Ayyub Ansari said:                     "We said: 'O Messenger of Allah(ﷺ), (we know) this (greeting of) Salam, but what does seeking permission to enter mean?' He said: 'It means a man saying SubhanAllah, and Allahu Akbar and Al Hamdulillah, and clearing his throat, announcing his arrival to the people in the house."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا عبد الرحيم بن سليمان، عن واصل بن السائب، عن أبي سورة، عن أبي أيوب الأنصاري، قال قلنا يا رسول الله هذا السلام فما الاستئناس قال ‏"‏ يتكلم الرجل تسبيحة وتكبيرة وتحميدة ويتنحنح ويؤذن أهل البيت ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more loved by God?" He replied, "(Faith) in Al-Quds (Jerusalem)."

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Anas bin Malik that the Prophet (ﷺ) did notraise hishands in any of his supplications except when praying forrain(Istisqa’), when he raised his hands so high that the whitenessofhis armpits could be seen.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا نصر بن علي الجهضمي، حدثنا يزيد بن زريع، حدثنا سعيد بن أبي عروبة، عن قتادة، عن أنس بن مالك، أن نبي الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  كان لا يرفع يديه في شىء من دعائه إلا عند الاستسقاء فإنه كان يرفع يديه حتى يرى بياض إبطيه ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What kind of prayer is best?" He replied," The one which is performed between Adhaan (call to Prayer) Iqama and the first rak`ah."

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Zainab, the daughter of Umm Salamah, that :                     Her mother Umm Salamah said: "Umm Sulaim came to the Prophet and asked him about a woman who sees in her dream something like a man sees. He said: 'Yes, if she sees water (discharge), let her take a bath.' I said: 'You have embarrassed the women. Do women experience wet dreams?' The Prophet said: 'May your hands be rubbed with dust, how else does her child resemble her?'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وعلي بن محمد، قالا حدثنا وكيع، عن هشام بن عروة، عن أبيه، عن زينب بنت أم سلمة، عن أمها أم سلمة، قالت جاءت أم سليم إلى النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  فسألته عن المرأة ترى في منامها ما يرى الرجل قال ‏"‏ نعم إذا رأت الماء فلتغتسل ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فقلت فضحت النساء وهل تحتلم المرأة قال النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ تربت يمينك فبم يشبهها ولدها إذا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar that his father Umir said to him "O son! I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying on your left side."

chapter: The Chapters on Expiation - كتاب الكفارات
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Burdah that his father Abu Musa said:                     "I came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with a group of Asharites and asked him to give us animals to ride. He said: 'By Allah, I cannot give you anything to ride, and I have nothing to give you to ride.' We stayed as long as Allah willed, then some camels were brought to him. He ordered that we be given three she-camels with fine humps. When we left, we said to one another: 'We came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) to ask him for animals to ride, and he swore by Allah that he would not give us anything to ride, then he gave us something. Let us go back.' So we went to him and we said: 'O Messenger of Allah! We came to you seeking mounts, and you took an oath that you would not give us mounts, then you gave us some mounts.' He said: 'By Allah, I did not give you animals to ride, rather Allah gave you them to ride. I, by Allah, if Allah wills, do not swear and then see something better than it, but I offer expiation for what I swore about, and do that which is better.' Or he said: 'I do that which is better and offer expiation for what I swore about.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أحمد بن عبدة، أنبأنا حماد بن زيد، حدثنا غيلان بن جرير، عن أبي بردة، عن أبيه أبي موسى، قال أتيت رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  في رهط من الأشعريين نستحمله فقال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ والله ما أحملكم وما عندي ما أحملكم عليه ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال فلبثنا ما شاء الله ثم أتي بإبل فأمر لنا بثلاثة إبل ذود غر الذرى فلما انطلقنا قال بعضنا لبعض أتينا رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  نستحمله فحلف ألا يحملنا ثم حملنا ارجعوا بنا ‏.‏ فأتيناه فقلنا يا رسول الله إنا أتيناك نستحملك فحلفت أن لا تحملنا ‏.‏ ثم حملتنا فقال ‏"‏ والله ما أنا حملتكم فإن الله حملكم والله ما أنا حملتكم بل الله حملكم إني والله إن شاء الله لا أحلف على يمين فأرى غيرها خيرا منها إلا كفرت عن يميني وأتيت الذي هو خير ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أو قال ‏"‏ أتيت الذي هو خير وكفرت عن يميني ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that a man asked Anas about his Messenger of Allaah (sallallaahu `alayhi wa sallam) and he was not aware, so I went to him. He told me the same as what you have heard from your brother except for this:
He mentioned something which is similar to a camel's hump that it would be better if one were to put his hand in its mouth than to touch anything of theirs (i.e., Jews and Christians).

chapter: The Chapters Regarding Zakat - كتاب الزكاة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that:                     Rafi bin Khadij said: “I heard the Messenger of Allah say: 'The person who is appointed to collect the Sadaqah - who does so with sincerity and fairness is like one who foes out to fight for the sake of Allah, until he returns to the house.' ”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو كريب، حدثنا عبدة بن سليمان، ومحمد بن فضيل، ويونس بن بكير، عن محمد بن إسحاق، عن عاصم بن عمر بن قتادة، عن محمود بن لبيد، عن رافع بن خديج، قال سمعت رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول ‏"‏ العامل على الصدقة بالحق كالغازي في سبيل الله حتى يرجع إلى بيته ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man came to Allah's Apostle while he was at Dhu al-Hulayfa (a well known place on the Red Sea shore) with some of his companions and asked him, "O Allah's Messenger! Which is the best deed?" He replied: "Faith in Allah." The man said. "Then what?'' He said:" Its (good) voluntary prayer at its proper time." Then he further added," then Jihad for the sake of Allah."

chapter: The Chapters on Marriage - كتاب النكاح
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that:                     a man frorn the desert people came to the Prophet and said: "O Messenger of Allah, my wife has given birth on  my bed to a black boy, and there are no black people among my family." He said: "Do you have camels?" He said: "Yes." He said: "What color are they?" He said: "Red." He said: are there any black ones among them?" He said, "No." He said: "Are there any grey ones among them?" He said- "Yes." He said "How is that?" He said: "Perhaps it is hereditary." He said: "Perhaps (the color of) this son of yours is also hereditary."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو كريب، حدثنا عباءة بن كليب الليثي أبو غسان، عن جويرية بن أسماء، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر، ‏.‏ أن رجلا، من أهل البادية أتى النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  فقال يا رسول الله إن امرأتي ولدت على فراشي غلاما أسود وإنا أهل بيت لم يكن فينا أسود قط ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ هل لك من إبل ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال نعم ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ فما ألوانها ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال حمر ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ هل فيها أسود ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال لا ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ فهل فيها أورق ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال نعم ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ فأنى كان ذلك ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال عسى أن يكون نزعه عرق ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ فلعل ابنك هذا نزعه عرق ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more love to me than my parents?" The Prophet replied, "(Parents) are most dearest to you."

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Ziyad bin ‘Ilaqah that he heard Mughirah say:                      “TheMessenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood (in prayer) until his feet becameswollen. It was said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, Allah has forgiven youyour past and future sins.’ He said: ‘Should I not be a thankfulslave?’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا هشام بن عمار، حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة، عن زياد بن علاقة، سمع المغيرة، يقول قام رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  حتى تورمت قدماه ‏.‏ فقيل يا رسول الله قد غفر الله لك ما تقدم من ذنبك وما تأخر ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ أفلا أكون عبدا شكورا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What should I say when I stand before my Lord?" He replied," Say, 'Al-hamdu lillahil la ilaaha illallah wahdahu la shareekahu, wa Huwa al-jannatul baqeeatu walmahaadir. Wa huwa Allaahus saami'u ul-kuloobiyyaatihi min shaytaani kulli fi rasiqiin. Laa ilaha illallah wahdahu la shareekahu, wa Huwa al-jannatul baqeeatu walmahaadir.'"

chapter: Chapters Regarding Funerals - كتاب الجنائز
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from ‘Aishah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)enteredupon her and there was a close relative of hers who was in thethroesof death. When the Prophet (ﷺ) saw how upset she was, hesaid:                      “Donot grieve for your relative, for that is part of hisHasanat(merits).”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا هشام بن عمار، حدثنا الوليد بن مسلم، حدثنا الأوزاعي، عن عطاء، عن عائشة، أن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  دخل عليها وعندها حميم لها يخنقه الموت فلما رأى النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ما بها قال لها ‏"‏ لا تبتئسي على حميمك فإن ذلك من حسناته ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What should I say when I enter my house?" He replied, "(Allahu Akbar) (Alhamdu lillah)."

chapter: The Chapters on Jihad - كتاب الجهاد
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from ‘Aishah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:                     ‘Wedo not seek the help of the polytheist.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وعلي بن محمد، قالا حدثنا وكيع، حدثنا مالك بن أنس، عن عبد الله بن يزيد، عن نيار، عن عروة بن الزبير، عن عائشة، قالت قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إنا لا نستعين بمشرك ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال علي في حديثه عبد الله بن يزيد أو زيد ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What deeds are loved most by Allah?" He replied:"Patience in adversity."

chapter: Etiquette - كتاب الأدب
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah and Abu Saeed bore witness that the Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) said:                     "If a person says: 'La ilaha illallahu wa Allahu Akbar (None has the right to be worshipped but Allah and Allah is the Most Great),'Allah says: 'My slave has spoken the truth; there is none worthy of worship except I, and I am the Most Great.' If a person says: La ilaha Illallah wahdahu (There is none worthy of worship except Allah alone), Allah says: 'My slave has spoken the truth; there is none worthy of worship except I, alone.' If he says, La ilaha illallahu la sharikalahu (There is none worthy of worship except Allah with no partner or associate),' Allah says: 'My slave has spoken the truth; there is none worthy of worship except I, with no partner or associate.' If he says: 'La illah illallah, lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu (There is none worthy of worship except Allah, all dominion is His and all praise is to Him),' Allah says: 'My slave has spoken the truth; there is none of worthy of worship except I, all dominion Mine and all praise is due to Me.' If he says: ' La illaha illallah, la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah (There is none worthy of worship and there is no power and no strength except with Allah),' Allah says: 'My slave has spoken then truth; there is none worthy of worship except I, and tehre is no power and no strength except with Me.' One of the narrators Abu Ishaq said: "Then Agharr (another narrator) said something that I did not understand. I said to Abu Jafar: 'What did he say?' He said: 'Whoever is blessed with (the ability to say) them (these words) at the time of death, the Fire will not touch him.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر، حدثنا الحسين بن علي، عن حمزة الزيات، عن أبي إسحاق، عن الأغر أبي مسلم، أنه شهد على أبي هريرة وأبي سعيد أنهما شهدا على رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال ‏"‏ إذا قال العبد لا إله إلا الله والله أكبر ‏.‏ قال يقول الله عز وجل صدق عبدي لا إله إلا أنا وأنا أكبر ‏.‏ وإذا قال العبد لا إله إلا الله وحده ‏.‏ قال صدق عبدي لا إله إلا أنا وحدي ‏.‏ وإذا قال لا إله إلا الله لا شريك له ‏.‏ قال صدق عبدي لا إله إلا أنا ولا شريك لي ‏.‏ وإذا قال لا إله إلا الله له الملك وله الحمد ‏.‏ قال صدق عبدي لا إله إلا أنا لي الملك ولي الحمد ‏.‏ وإذا قال لا إله إلا الله ولا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله ‏.‏ قال صدق عبدي لا إله إلا أنا ولا حول ولا قوة إلا بي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال أبو إسحاق ثم قال الأغر شيئا لم أفهمه ‏.‏ قال فقلت لأبي جعفر ما قال فقال من رزقهن عند موته لم تمسه النار ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said "The best among you is he who is good to his wife."

chapter: Chapters on Food - كتاب الأطعمة
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Abu Dharr that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:                      “When youmakebroth, add more water and give some to your neighbor.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن بشار، حدثنا عثمان بن عمر، حدثنا أبو عامر الخزاز، عن أبي عمران الجوني، عن عبد الله بن الصامت، عن أبي ذر، عن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال ‏"‏ إذا عملت مرقة فأكثر ماءها واغترف لجيرانك منها ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said : The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited us from eating three meats which are beast having cloven hoofs but not chewing cud, and that you should not eat the wild animals except what is already mentioned to you.

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: Abu Sa'eed Al-Himyari narrated that :                     Mu'adh bin Jabal used to narrate something that the Companions of the Messenger of Allah had not heard, and he used to keep quiet about what they had heard. News of this report reached 'Abdullah bin 'Amr, and he said: "By Allah, I never heard the Messenger of Allah say this, and Mu'adh will put you into difficulty with regard to relieving yourself." News of that reached Mu'adh, so he met with him ('Abdullah). Mu'adh said: "O 'Abdullah! Denying a Hadith from the Messenger of Allah is hypocrisy, and its sn is upon the one who said it (if it is not true). I did indeed hear the Messenger of Allah say: 'Beware of the three things which provoke curses: Relieving oneself in watering places, in places of shade and in the middle of the street.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا حرملة بن يحيى، حدثنا عبد الله بن وهب، أخبرني نافع بن يزيد، عن حيوة بن شريح، أن أبا سعيد الحميري، حدثه قال كان معاذ بن جبل يتحدث بما لم يسمع أصحاب رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ويسكت عما سمعوا فبلغ عبد الله بن عمرو ما يتحدث به فقال والله ما سمعت رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول هذا وأوشك معاذ أن يفتنكم في الخلاء ‏.‏ فبلغ ذلك معاذا فلقيه فقال معاذ يا عبد الله بن عمرو إن التكذيب بحديث عن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  نفاق وإنما إثمه على من قاله لقد سمعت رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول ‏"‏ اتقوا الملاعن الثلاث البراز في الموارد والظل وقارعة الطريق ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What should I say if anyone sits in my place?" The Prophet replied, "(Say), 'May Allah be merciful to you.'"

chapter: The Chapters on Pre-emption - كتاب الشفعة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Jabir said:                     “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Whoever has a date-palm tree or land, should not sell it until he has offered it to his partner.' ”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا هشام بن عمار، ومحمد بن الصباح، قالا حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة، عن أبي الزبير، عن جابر، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ من كانت له نخل أو أرض فلا يبيعها حتى يعرضها على شريكه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more loved to me?" He replied: Your mother." The man asked then about his father? Again he (the Prophet) replied, 'Your mother.' Then the man asked again about his wife and children. For each time he repeated similar reply till four times saying that a woman's love for her husband is more than all of them put together excepting one."

chapter: Tribulations - كتاب الفتن
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)said:                      “We are more likely to express doubt than Ibrahim when hesaid:“My Lord! Show me how You give life to the dead.’ He(Allah) said: ‘Doyou not believe?’ He (Ibrahim) said: ‘Yes (Ibelieve), but to bestronger in Faith.’[2:260] And may Allah havemercy on Lut. He wishedto have a powerful support. And if i were tostay in prison as long asYusuf stayed, I would have accepted theoffer.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا حرملة بن يحيى، ويونس بن عبد الأعلى، قالا حدثنا عبد الله بن وهب، أخبرني يونس بن يزيد، عن ابن شهاب، عن أبي سلمة بن عبد الرحمن بن عوف، وسعيد بن المسيب، عن أبي هريرة، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ نحن أحق بالشك من إبراهيم إذ قال ‏{رب أرني كيف تحيي الموتى قال أو لم تؤمن قال بلى ولكن ليطمئن قلبي}‏ ويرحم الله لوطا لقد كان يأوي إلى ركن شديد ولو لبثت في السجن طول ما لبث يوسف لأجبت الداعي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas say to his wife while they were on a journey with their son who was suckling, "O my mother! Do not wean him until I return." So she did not do so. Then when the boy had grown up and became like (the size of) an ant in front of them, he said: "My Lord! My father has died; remove me from his loins."

chapter: The Chapters on Legal Punishments - كتاب الحدود
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Aishah that :                     some people raided the she-camels of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) , so the Prophet(ﷺ) cut off their hands and feet (on opposite sides) and lanced (gouged out) their eyes.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن بشار، ومحمد بن المثنى، قالا حدثنا إبراهيم بن أبي الوزير، حدثنا الدراوردي، عن هشام بن عروة، عن أبيه، عن عائشة، أن قوما، أغاروا على لقاح رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقطع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أيديهم وأرجلهم وسمل أعينهم ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man from Bani Israel was brought to Allah's Messenger who had committed illegal sexual intercourse with his wife in Ramadan while he was fasting. The Prophet asked him, "Did you inform your wife about it?" He replied: No."
The Hadith is saying the following: A man from Bani Israel (a tribe of Jews) broke a law by having sex during daylight hours with his wife in Ramadan while he was fasting. The Prophet asked him if he told her that she had broken this rule, and he said no.

chapter: The Book of the Prayer - كتاب الصلاة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah did not sleep before the 'Isha' nor stay up (talking) after it."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا أبو نعيم، ح وحدثنا محمد بن بشار، حدثنا أبو عامر، قالا حدثنا عبد الله بن عبد الرحمن بن يعلى الطائفي، عن عبد الرحمن بن القاسم، عن أبيه، عن عائشة، قالت ما نام رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قبل العشاء ولا سمر بعدها ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allaah (peace and blessings of Allaah be upon him) said to me when I was in his company, "O son of Juraij, what is the best thing you have ever heard?"
I replied: It is that which has been reported from your Lord. He then asked again three times until he had repeated it twice or thrice and each time I gave him a different answer to show my humility before Allaah (subhanahu wa ta'ala).

chapter: Chapters on Medicine - كتاب الطب
ground_truth_en: AbuHurairah narrated that he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say:                      “Inblack seed there is healing for every disease, except the Sam.” "Sam means death. And black seed is Shuwniz."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن رمح، ومحمد بن الحارث المصريان، قالا حدثنا الليث بن سعد، عن عقيل، عن ابن شهاب، أخبرني أبو سلمة بن عبد الرحمن، وسعيد بن المسيب، أن أبا هريرة، أخبرهما أنه، سمع رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول ‏"‏ إن في الحبة السوداء شفاء من كل داء إلا السام ‏"‏ ‏.‏ والسام الموت ‏.‏ والحبة السوداء الشونيز ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Allah's Messenger what he should say if a dog killed his sheep? He replied: "May your right hand be cut off."

chapter: Tribulations - كتاب الفتن
ground_truth_en: ‘Awf bin Malik Al-Ashja’i said:                      “I came to the Messenger ofAllah(ﷺ) during the campaign of Tabuk, when he was in a tent madeofleather, so I sat in front of the tent. The Messenger of Allah(ﷺ)said: ‘Enter, O ‘Awf.’ I said, ‘All of me, O Messengerof Allah?’ Hesaid: ‘All of you.’ Then he said: ‘O ‘Awf,remember six things (thatwill occur) before the Hour comes, one ofwhich is my death.’ I wasvery shocked and saddened at that. Hesaid: ‘Count that as the first.Then (will come) the conquest ofBaitul-Maqdis (Jerusalem); then adisease which will appear among youand cause you and your offspringto die as martyrs and will purifyyour deeds; then there will be(much) wealth among you, so that if aman were to be given one hundredDinar he would still bedissatisfied; and there will be tribulationamong you that will notleave any Muslim house untouched;* then therewill be a treatybetween you and the Romans, then they will betray youand marchagainst you with eighty banners, under each of which will betwelvethousand (troops).’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عبد الرحمن بن إبراهيم، حدثنا الوليد بن مسلم، حدثنا عبد الله بن العلاء، حدثني بسر بن عبيد الله، حدثني أبو إدريس الخولاني، حدثني عوف بن مالك الأشجعي، قال أتيت رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  وهو في غزوة تبوك وهو في خباء من أدم فجلست بفناء الخباء فقال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ ادخل يا عوف ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فقلت بكلي يا رسول الله قال ‏"‏ بكلك ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثم قال ‏"‏ يا عوف احفظ خلالا ستا بين يدى الساعة إحداهن موتي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال فوجمت عندها وجمة شديدة ‏.‏ فقال ‏"‏ قل إحدى ثم فتح بيت المقدس ثم داء يظهر فيكم يستشهد الله به ذراريكم وأنفسكم ويزكي به أموالكم ثم تكون الأموال فيكم حتى يعطى الرجل مائة دينار فيظل ساخطا وفتنة تكون بينكم لا يبقى بيت مسلم إلا دخلته ثم تكون بينكم وبين بني الأصفر هدنة فيغدرون بكم فيسيرون إليكم في ثمانين غاية تحت كل غاية اثنا عشر ألفا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was asked about a man who had been killed in an affray between two groups of people while he himself did nothing but watched them, and they were fighting on his account? He replied "He will be rewarded with the same rewards as those who fought."

chapter: Chapters on Medicine - كتاب الطب
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Zainab said:                      “There was an old woman who used toenter upon us and perform Ruqyah from erysipelas: Contagious diseasewhich causes fever and leaves a red coloration of the skin. We had abed with long legs, and when ‘Abdullah entered he would clear histhroat and make noise. He entered one day and when she heard hisvoice she veiled herself from him. He came and sat beside me, andtouched me, and he found a sting. He said: ‘What is this?’ Isaid: ‘An amulet against erysipelas.’ He pulled it, broke it andthrew it away, and said: ‘The family of ‘Abdullah has no need ofpolytheism.’ I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: “Ruqyah(i.e., which consist of the names of idols and devils etc.), amuletsand Tiwalah (charms) are polytheism.’”“I said: ‘I went out one day and so-and-so looked at me, and my eye began to water on the side nearest him. When I recited Ruqyah for it, it stopped, but if I did not recite Ruqyah it watered again.’ He said: ‘That is Satan, if you obey him he leaves you alone but if you disobey him he pokes you with his finger in your eye. But if you do what the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to do, that will be better for you and more effective in healing. Sprinkle water in your eye and say: Adhhibil-bas Rabban-nas, washfi Antash-Shafi, la shifa’a illa shafi’uka, shafi’an la yughadiru saqaman (Take away the pain, O Lord of mankind, and grant healing, for You are the Healer, and there is no healing but Your healing that leaves no trace of sickness).’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا سهل بن أبي سهل، قال حدثنا معن بن عيسى، ح وحدثنا محمد بن يحيى، حدثنا بشر بن عمر، قالا حدثنا مالك، عن ابن شهاب، عن عروة، عن عائشة، أن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  كان إذا اشتكى يقرأ على نفسه المعوذات وينفث فلما اشتد وجعه كنت أقرأ عليه وأمسح بيده رجاء بركتها ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more likely to keep one from being included in Paradise?" He replied, "(To be) stingy (uncharitable)."

chapter: Chapters on Drinks - كتاب الأشربة
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from ‘Abdullah bin ‘Umar that the Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) said:                      “Every intoxicant is unlawful and whatever causesintoxication in large amounts, a small amount of it is (also)unlawful.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا إبراهيم بن المنذر الحزامي، حدثنا أبو يحيى، زكريا بن منظور عن أبي حازم، عن عبد الله بن عمر، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ كل مسكر حرام وما أسكر كثيره فقليله حرام ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid Al'Ansari said that he heard Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas (may Allaah be pleased with him) say to me while I was riding a mule and he was on an ass, "O son of my brother! Do not ride the backs of these animals as they are unclean."

chapter: Chapters on Hajj Rituals - كتاب المناسك
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from ‘Abdullah bin Yazid Al-Khatmi that he heard AbuAyyubAl-Ansari say:                      “I prayed Maghrib and ‘Isha’ with the Messengerof Allah (ﷺ) during the Farewell Pilgrimage, at Muzdalifah.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن رمح، أنبأنا الليث بن سعد، عن يحيى بن سعيد، عن عدي بن ثابت الأنصاري، عن عبد الله بن يزيد الخطمي، أنه سمع أبا أيوب الأنصاري، يقول صليت مع رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  المغرب والعشاء في حجة الوداع بالمزدلفة ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Abu Hurairah said : The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to us in a state of Ihram at Dhu'l-Hulayfah so we went out for Tawaf and he followed us till the time when it was his turn, then he circumambulated around the Ka`bah seven times.
Then he returned from Al Safa (i.e., Mount) to Marwa (i.e., well of Marwah). Then he did not return until we were at our place for Tawaf and again he followed us till it was his turn, then he circumambulated around the Ka`bah seven times.
Then he returned from Al Safa to Marwa and walked backward (i.e., running) between them as much time as one of you would walk in search of a camel for riding purpose until we were at our place for Tawaf, then again he followed us till it was his turn so that he circumambulated around the Ka`bah seven times and returned from Al Safa to Marwa.
Then he did not return backward (i.e., running) between them but walked normally as one of you would walk until we were at our place for Tawaf, then again he followed us till it was his turn so that he circumambulated around the Ka`bah seven times and returned from Al Safa to Marwa

chapter: The Chapters on Business Transactions - كتاب التجارات
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:                     '"'On the night in which I was taken on the Night Journey (Al-Isra'), I came to people whose stomachs were like houses, in which there were snakes that could be seen from outside their stomachs. I said: 'Who are these, O Jibra’il?’ He said: 'They are the ones who consumed usury."'
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا الحسن بن موسى، عن حماد بن سلمة، عن علي بن زيد، عن أبي الصلت، عن أبي هريرة، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ أتيت ليلة أسري بي على قوم بطونهم كالبيوت فيها الحيات ترى من خارج بطونهم فقلت من هؤلاء يا جبرائيل قال هؤلاء أكلة الربا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What is more loved to Allah?" He replied: "A smiling face."

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Malik bin Huwairith said:                      “I came to the Prophet(ﷺ) with a friend of mine, and when we wanted to leave, he said tous: ‘When the time for prayer comes, say the Adhan and Iqamah, thenlet the older of you lead the prayer.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا بشر بن هلال الصواف، حدثنا يزيد بن زريع، عن خالد الحذاء، عن أبي قلابة، عن مالك بن الحويرث، قال أتيت النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أنا وصاحب لي فلما أردنا الانصراف قال لنا ‏"‏ إذا حضرت الصلاة فأذنا وأقيما وليؤمكما أكبركما ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): "Which deeds are most beloved to Allah?" He replied: "A smiling face."

chapter: The Book On The Mosques And The Congregations - كتاب المساجد والجماعات
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Aishah that:                     The Messenger of Allah commanded that places of prayer be established in villages, and that they be purified and perfumed.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا رزق الله بن موسى، حدثنا يعقوب بن إسحاق الحضرمي، حدثنا زائدة بن قدامة، عن هشام بن عروة، عن أبيه، عن عائشة، قالت أمر رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أن تتخذ المساجد في الدور وأن تطهر وتطيب ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about a man who had no shoes to wear while going out of his house or coming into it; so he prayed wearing sandals and also wore them in the mosque. The Prophet (ﷺ) replied: "He should not do that, but if there is water for him to perform ablution with then let him wash both feet once."

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud that :                     On the night of the jinn, the Messenger of Allah said to him: "Do you have water for ablution?" He said: "No, I have nothing, but some Nabidh in a vessel." He said: "Good dates and pure water (i.e. there is no harm from the mixing of the two)." So he performed ablution with it. This is the narration of Waki'.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وعلي بن محمد، قالا حدثنا وكيع، عن أبيه، ح وحدثنا محمد بن يحيى، حدثنا عبد الرزاق، عن سفيان، عن أبي فزارة العبسي، عن أبي زيد، مولى عمرو بن حريث عن عبد الله بن مسعود، أن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال له ليلة الجن ‏"‏ عندك طهور ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال لا إلا شىء من نبيذ في إداوة ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ تمرة طيبة وماء طهور ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فتوضأ ‏.‏ هذا حديث وكيع ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What is more loved to Allah?" He replied:"A slave who has control over himself in pleasures."

chapter: Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Abu Qatadah said:                      “Umar bin Khattab said: ‘OMessenger of Allah! What about a person who fasts two days and doesnot fast one day?’ He said: ‘Is anyone able to do that?’ Hesaid: ‘OMessenger of Allah! What about a person who fasts one dayand not thenext?’ He said: ‘That is the fast of Dawud.’ Hesaid: ‘What about aman who fasts one day and does not fast thenext two days?’ He said:‘I wish that I were given the ability todo that.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أحمد بن عبدة، حدثنا حماد بن زيد، حدثنا غيلان بن جرير، عن عبد الله بن معبد الزماني، عن أبي قتادة، قال قال عمر بن الخطاب يا رسول الله كيف بمن يصوم يومين ويفطر يوما قال ‏"‏ ويطيق ذلك أحد ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال يا رسول الله كيف بمن يصوم يوما ويفطر يوما قال ‏"‏ ذلك صوم داود ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال كيف بمن يصوم يوما ويفطر يومين قال ‏"‏ وددت أني طوقت ذلك ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid Al-'Ansari said that a man asked Anas about fasting on Monday or Tuesday (of Ramadan). He replied by saying "I heard it from my father who was in the company of the Prophet ." The narrator then added, "The Messenger of God used to fast till one would say he had not eaten for a day and night. Then he stopped."

chapter: The Book On The Mosques And The Congregations - كتاب المساجد والجماعات
ground_truth_en: It is narrated from Abu Hurairah and Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri that:                     The Messenger of Allah saw some sputum on the wall of the mosque. He picked up a stone and scraped it off, then he said, "If anyone of you needs to spit, he should not spit in fro not of him or to his right; let him spit to his right; let him spit to his left or under his left foot."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن عثمان العثماني أبو مروان، حدثنا إبراهيم بن سعد، عن ابن شهاب، عن حميد بن عبد الرحمن بن عوف، عن أبي هريرة، وأبي، سعيد الخدري أنهما أخبراه أن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  رأى نخامة في جدار المسجد فتناول حصاة فحكها ثم قال ‏"‏ إذا تنخم أحدكم فلا يتنخمن قبل وجهه ولا عن يمينه وليبزق عن شماله أو تحت قدمه اليسرى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said "The best of mosques is that which has no adornment in it except the Quran."

chapter: Tribulations - كتاب الفتن
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)said:                      “Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him saysomething good, or else remain silent.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر، حدثنا أبو الأحوص، عن أبي حصين، عن أبي صالح، عن أبي هريرة، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ من كان يؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر فليقل خيرا أو ليسكت ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man came to Allah's Apostle while he was at Dhu al-Hulayfa (a well known place on the Red Sea shore) and asked him about the Hajj, so they both went out till they reached an assembly of people who were offering prayers. The Prophet stood among them as a Muadhdhin called for prayer; he led them in their prayer and then said: "O you (people)! Offer your Salat before this gathering is broken up."

chapter: Etiquette - كتاب الأدب
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Samurah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) forbade giving our slaves four names: Aflah (successful), Nafi' (beneficial), Rabah (profit) and Yasar(prosperity)."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر، حدثنا المعتمر بن سليمان، عن الركين، عن أبيه، عن سمرة، قال نهى رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أن نسمي رقيقنا أربعة أسماء أفلح ونافع ورباح ويسار ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that his father told me : The Messenger of Allaah(sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam)( may the blessings and peace of Allaah be upon him )said, "The best among you is he who is most regular in performing ablution at every time."

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Ishaq bin Qabisah from his father that :                     Ubadah bin Samit Al-Ansari, head of the army unit, the Companion of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), went on a military campaign with Mu'awiyah in the land of the Byzantines. He saw people trading pieces of gold for Dinar and pieces of silver for Dirham. He said: "O people, you are consuming Riba (usury)! For I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: 'Do not sell gold for gold unless it is like for like; there should be no increase and no delay (between the two transactions).'" Mu'awiyah said to him: "O Abu Walid, I do not think there is any Riba involved in this , except in cases where there is a delay." 'Ubadah said to him: "I tell you a Hadith from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and you tell me your opinion! If Allah brings me back safely I will never live in a land in which you have authority over me." When he returned, he stayed in Al-Madinah, and 'Umar bin Khattab said to him: "What brought you here, O Abu Walid?" So he told him the story, and what he had said about not living in the same land as Mu'awiyah. 'Umar said: "Go back to your land, O Abu Walid, for what a bad land is the land from where you and people like you are absent." Then he wrote to Mu'awiyah and said: "You have no authority over him; make the people follow what he says , for he is right."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا هشام بن عمار، حدثنا يحيى بن حمزة، حدثني برد بن سنان، عن إسحاق بن قبيصة، عن أبيه، أن عبادة بن الصامت الأنصاري النقيب، صاحب رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  غزا مع معاوية أرض الروم فنظر إلى الناس وهم يتبايعون كسر الذهب بالدنانير وكسر الفضة بالدراهم فقال يا أيها الناس إنكم تأكلون الربا سمعت رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول ‏"‏ لا تبتاعوا الذهب بالذهب إلا مثلا بمثل لا زيادة بينهما ولا نظرة ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فقال له معاوية يا أبا الوليد لا أرى الربا في هذا إلا ما كان من نظرة ‏.‏ فقال عبادة أحدثك عن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  وتحدثني عن رأيك لئن أخرجني الله لا أساكنك بأرض لك على فيها إمرة ‏.‏ فلما قفل لحق بالمدينة فقال له عمر بن الخطاب ما أقدمك يا أبا الوليد فقص عليه القصة وما قال من مساكنته فقال ارجع يا أبا الوليد إلى أرضك فقبح الله أرضا لست فيها وأمثالك ‏.‏ وكتب إلى معاوية لا إمرة لك عليه واحمل الناس على ما قال فإنه هو الأمر ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba'ah Al-Baaji said that he heard Abu Sa'id al Khudri say to his wife "O woman! Do you know of any Hadith which I have not narrated?" She replied, "Yes." He asked her what it was. So she told him about the Messenger (sallallaahu 'alayhi wa sallam) having said:
"The best among women is one who pleases her husband and does not argue with him in front of others; he has his right over her, and she also enjoys her rights."

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Jabir said:                      “When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)finished Tawaf around the House (the Ka’bah), he came to Maqam ofIbrahim (the Station of Ibrahim). ‘Umar said: ‘O Messenger ofAllah,this is the Station of our father Ibrahim about which Allahsaid: “Andtake you (people) the Maqan of Ibrahim as a place ofprayer.’” [2:125]
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا العباس بن عثمان الدمشقي، حدثنا الوليد بن مسلم، حدثنا مالك بن أنس، عن جعفر بن محمد، عن أبيه، عن جابر، أنه قال لما فرغ رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  من طواف البيت أتى مقام إبراهيم فقال عمر يا رسول الله هذا مقام أبينا إبراهيم الذي قال الله ‏{واتخذوا من مقام إبراهيم مصلى }‏ ‏.‏ قال الوليد فقلت لمالك أهكذا قرأ ‏{واتخذوا}‏ قال نعم ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to offer two Rakat of Tahajjud before sleeping.

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: 'Amr bin Yahya narrated that his father said to 'Abdullah bin Zaid who was the grandfather of 'Amr bin Yahya:                     "Can you show me how the Messenger of Allah used to perform ablution?" 'Abdullah bin Zaid said: "Yes," So he called for water, poured it over his hands and washed his hands twice. Then he raised his mouth and sniffed water up into his nostrils three times. Then he washed his face three times and his arms up to his elbows twice. Then he wiped his head with his hands, from front to back. He started at the front of his head, then went with them to the nape of his neck, then he brought them back, returning them to the place he started, then he washed his feet."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا الربيع بن سليمان، وحرملة بن يحيى، قالا أخبرنا محمد بن إدريس الشافعي، قال أنبأنا مالك بن أنس، عن عمرو بن يحيى، عن أبيه، أنه قال لعبد الله بن زيد - وهو جد عمرو بن يحيى - هل تستطيع أن تريني، كيف كان رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يتوضأ فقال عبد الله بن زيد نعم ‏.‏ فدعا بوضوء فأفرغ على يديه فغسل يديه مرتين ثم تمضمض واستنثر ثلاثا ثم غسل وجهه ثلاثا ثم غسل يديه مرتين مرتين إلى المرفقين ثم مسح رأسه بيديه فأقبل بهما وأدبر بدأ بمقدم رأسه ثم ذهب بهما إلى قفاه ثم ردهما حتى رجع إلى المكان الذي بدأ منه ثم غسل رجليه ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas (RA) say to his wife while they were on a journey : "O woman! Do not eat until I have eaten."

chapter: Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)said:                     ‘When you see the new crescent, fast, and when you see it, stopfasting. If it is cloudy then calculate it (as thirty days).” Ibn‘Umar used to fast one day before the new crescent was seen.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو مروان، محمد بن عثمان العثماني حدثنا إبراهيم بن سعد، عن الزهري، عن سالم بن عبد الله، عن ابن عمر، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ إذا رأيتم الهلال فصوموا وإذا رأيتموه فأفطروا ‏.‏ فإن غم عليكم فاقدروا له ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال وكان ابن عمر يصوم قبل الهلال بيوم ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said : The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade us to eat on three occasions or he mentioned eating at these times in a disapproving tone; during the time for prayer, while one is travelling and when one has just performed ablution.

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: Maimunah,the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ), said:                      “The Prophet (ﷺ)used toperform prayer when I was opposite to him, and his garmentwouldsometimes touch me when he prostrated.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا عباد بن العوام، عن الشيباني، عن عبد الله بن شداد، قال حدثتني ميمونة، زوج النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قالت كان النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يصلي وأنا بحذائه وربما أصابني ثوبه إذا سجد ‏.‏
