chapter: Chapters Regarding Funerals - كتاب الجنائز
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا عفان، عن حماد بن سلمة، عن هشام بن عروة، عن وهب بن كيسان، عن محمد بن عمرو بن عطاء، عن سلمة بن الأزرق، عن أبي هريرة، عن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  بنحوه ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man came to Allah's Apostle with his dead son in his arms asking (for burial). The Prophet asked him, "Did you accompany any funeral procession?" He replied in the negative and added. I wish if we had accompanied any funeral procession so that he might have been washed by a Muslim."

chapter: The Chapters on Jihad - كتاب الجهاد
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Abu Hurairah:                      “Mention of the martyrs was madein thepresence of the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said: ‘The earth does notdryof the blood of the martyr until his two wives rush to him liketwowet nurses who lost their young ones in a stretch of barren land,andin the hand of each one of them will be a Hullah* that is betterthanthis world and everything in it.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا ابن أبي عدي، عن ابن عون، عن هلال بن أبي زينب، عن شهر بن حوشب، عن أبي هريرة، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ذكر الشهداء عند النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال ‏"‏ لا تجف الأرض من دم الشهيد حتى تبتدره زوجتاه كأنهما ظئران أضلتا فصيليهما في براح من الأرض وفي يد كل واحدة منهما حلة خير من الدنيا وما فيها ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more loved by God?" He replied, "(Faith) in Allah (alone)." The man further asked, "Then what?". Again the Prophet of Allah answered, "Fearing (Almighty) Allah." Then he again repeated it thrice.

chapter: Chapters on Food - كتاب الأطعمة
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Umm Ayman that she sifted some flour and made aloaf ofbread for the Prophet (ﷺ). He said:                      “What is this?” Shesaid:“It is food that we make in our land, and I wanted to make aloafof it for you. He said: “Fold it onto itself and knead it.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا يعقوب بن حميد بن كاسب، حدثنا ابن وهب، أخبرني عمرو بن الحارث، أخبرني بكر بن سوادة، أن حنش بن عبد الله، حدثه عن أم أيمن، أنها غربلت دقيقا فصنعته للنبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  رغيفا فقال ‏"‏ ما هذا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قالت طعام نصنعه بأرضنا فأحببت أن أصنع منه لك رغيفا ‏.‏ فقال ‏"‏ رديه فيه ثم اعجنيه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar...

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: Umm Hani' bint Abu Talib narrated that :                     When it was the year of the Conquest (of Makkah), the Messenger of Allah got up to perform a bath and Fatimah screened him. Then he took his garment and wrapped himself in it (such that it became like the towel used to dry oneself).
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن رمح، أنبأنا الليث بن سعد، عن يزيد بن أبي حبيب، عن سعيد بن أبي هند، أن أبا مرة، مولى عقيل حدثه أن أم هانئ بنت أبي طالب حدثته أنه، لما كان عام الفتح قام رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  إلى غسله فسترت عليه فاطمة ثم أخذ ثوبه فالتحف به ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What should I say when I perform ablution?" The Prophet replied, "(Say), 'O Lord! You are ever forgiving and you love to be praised.'"

chapter: Chapters on Dress - كتاب اللباس
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that ‘Aishah said:                      “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prayedin a Khamisah* that had markings on it. Then he said: ‘Thesemarkings distracted me. Take it to Abu Jahm and bring me anAnbijaniyyah.’”**
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة، عن الزهري، عن عروة، عن عائشة، قالت صلى رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  في خميصة لها أعلام فقال ‏"‏ شغلني أعلام هذه اذهبوا بها إلى أبي جهم وائتوني بأنبجانيته ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What is more loved to Allah?" He replied, "A smiling face."

chapter: Tribulations - كتاب الفتن
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Musa that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:                     ‘Allah gives respite to the wrongdoer, then when He seizes him, Hedoes not let him go.” Then he recited: “Such is the Seizure ofyourLord when He seizes the (population of) towns while they aredoingwrong.”[11:102]
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير، وعلي بن محمد، قالا حدثنا أبو معاوية، عن بريد بن عبد الله بن أبي بردة، عن أبي بردة، عن أبي موسى، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ إن الله يملي للظالم فإذا أخذه لم يفلته ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثم قرأ ‏{وكذلك أخذ ربك إذا أخذ القرى وهي ظالمة}‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man came to Allah's Apostle saying, "O Allah's Messenger! I keep on forgetting (the prayer) at its proper time." The Prophet asked him, "Are you afraid of poverty?" He replied in the affirmative. Then he further asked him whether he remembered his supper and breakfast every day? On that he said: Yes. Thereupon Allah's Apostle told him to pray before sleeping (at night).

chapter: Chapters on Hajj Rituals - كتاب المناسك
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Jabir bin ‘Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah(ﷺ)said:                      “There is no Muhrim (pilgrim in Ihram) who exposes himselftothe sun all day for the sake of Allah, reciting the Talbiyah untilthe sun goes down, but his sins will disappear and he will go backlike on the day his mother bore him.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا إبراهيم بن المنذر الحزامي، حدثنا عبد الله بن نافع، وعبد الله بن وهب، ومحمد بن فليح، قالوا حدثنا عاصم بن عمر بن حفص، عن عاصم بن عبيد الله، عن عبد الله بن عامر بن ربيعة، عن جابر بن عبد الله، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ ما من محرم يضحى لله يومه يلبي حتى تغيب الشمس إلا غابت بذنوبه فعاد كما ولدته أمه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying "The Hajj is only to be performed once."

chapter: Chapters on Dress - كتاب اللباس
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Abu ‘Umar, the freed slave of Asma’, said:                      “IsawIbn ‘Umar buying a turban that had some markings, then he calledfor a pair of scissors and cut that off. I entered upon Asma’ andmentioned that to her, and she said: ‘May ‘Abdullah perish, Ogirl!Give me the garment of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).’ Agarment wasbrought that was hemmed with brocade on the sleeves,necklines andopenings (at the front and back).”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا وكيع، عن مغيرة بن زياد، عن أبي عمر، مولى أسماء قال رأيت ابن عمر اشترى عمامة لها علم فدعا بالجلمين فقصه فدخلت على أسماء فذكرت ذلك لها فقالت بؤسا لعبد الله يا جارية هاتي جبة رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏.‏ فجاءت بجبة مكفوفة الكمين والجيب والفرجين بالديباج ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Anas bin Malik said that he saw a man wearing an amulet of iron hanging round his neck in front of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) so he asked him, "What is this?" He replied, "(It is something which protects me from the evil eye)."
Al-Bukhari and Muslim transmitted it.

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri from his father that:                     The Messenger of Allah said: "No woman should look at the nakedness of another woman, and no man should look at the nakedness of another man."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا زيد بن الحباب، عن الضحاك بن عثمان، حدثنا زيد بن أسلم، عن عبد الرحمن بن أبي سعيد الخدري، عن أبيه، أن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال ‏"‏ لا تنظر المرأة إلى عورة المرأة ولا ينظر الرجل إلى عورة الرجل ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Allah's Apostle saying "If anyone of you is fasting in day or night then he should complete his Fast, and if any one breaks (the Fast) deliberately during the month of Ramadan; while standing at Arafat (for Hajj), then let him stand there for a short time. And do not make your Ihram after midnight."

chapter: Etiquette - كتاب الأدب
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Ibn Umar that:                     "a daughter of 'Umar was Asiyah(disobedient) then the Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) named her 'Jamilah' (beautiful)."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر، حدثنا الحسن بن موسى، حدثنا حماد بن سلمة، عن عبيد الله، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر، أن ابنة لعمر، كان يقال لها عاصية فسماها رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  جميلة ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying: "The most blessed of words are those with which an infidel is addressed."

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:                     "If a man had intercourse with his wife while she was menstruating, the Prophet commanded him to give half a Dinar in charity."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عبد الله بن الجراح، حدثنا أبو الأحوص، عن عبد الكريم، عن مقسم، عن ابن عباس، قال كان الرجل إذا وقع على امرأته وهي حائض أمره النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أن يتصدق بنصف دينار ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What deeds are loved most by Allah?" He replied:"Prayer at its early (first) time."

chapter: The Chapters on Jihad - كتاب الجهاد
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)said:                     “There are three to whom Allah will not speak on the Day ofResurrection, not will He look at them nor purify them, and theirswill be a painful torment: A man who has surplus water in the desertand withholds it from a wayfarer; a man who sells a man his productafter ‘Asr, swearing by Allah that he bought it for such and such aprice, and the other believes him, but that is not the case; and amanwho gives his pledge to a ruler, only doing to for the purpose ofworldly gain, and if he is given something he fulfills it, but if heis not given anything he does not fulfill it.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وعلي بن محمد، وأحمد بن سنان، قالوا حدثنا أبو معاوية، عن الأعمش، عن أبي صالح، عن أبي هريرة، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ثلاثة لا يكلمهم الله ولا ينظر إليهم يوم القيامة ولا يزكيهم ولهم عذاب أليم رجل على فضل ماء بالفلاة يمنعه من ابن السبيل ورجل بايع رجلا بسلعة بعد العصر فحلف بالله لأخذها بكذا وكذا فصدقه وهو على غير ذلك ورجل بايع إماما لا يبايعه إلا لدنيا فإن أعطاه منها وفى له وإن لم يعطه منها لم يف له ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar...

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Irbad bin Sariyah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led us in Fajr (morning) prayer, then he turned to us and delivered an eloquent speech". And he mentioned something similar (as no.43)
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا يحيى بن حكيم، حدثنا عبد الملك بن الصباح المسمعي، حدثنا ثور بن يزيد، عن خالد بن معدان، عن عبد الرحمن بن عمرو، عن العرباض بن سارية، قال صلى بنا رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  صلاة الصبح ثم أقبل علينا بوجهه فوعظنا موعظة بليغة ‏.‏ فذكر نحوه ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more loved by God?" He replied, "(Faith) followed by Jihad (holy fighting in Allah's Cause), and then emigration to the land which has been fought so much because there are rewards for it by Him."

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that ‘Abdullah bin ‘Amr said:                      “The Messenger of Allah9saw) said: ‘There are three whose prayer are not accepted: A manwholeads people while they do not like him; a man who does not cometoprayer until its end – meaning after its time has expired –and onewho enslaves a freed person.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو كريب، حدثنا عبدة بن سليمان، وجعفر بن عون، عن الإفريقي، عن عمران بن عبد، عن عبد الله بن عمرو، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ ثلاثة لا تقبل لهم صلاة الرجل يؤم القوم وهم له كارهون والرجل لا يأتي الصلاة إلا دبارا - يعني بعد ما يفوته الوقت - ومن اعتبد محررا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: NARRATED IKHSHID AL-JUFRI said: "I saw Abu Hurairah (RA) in a garden of dates with some people who were eating them."

chapter: Chapters on Hajj Rituals - كتاب المناسك
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that the Prophet 9saw) marked thesacrificial animal on the right side of the hump and wiped away theblood.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وعلي بن محمد، قالا حدثنا وكيع، عن هشام الدستوائي، عن قتادة، عن أبي حسان الأعرج، عن ابن عباس، أن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أشعر الهدى في السنام الأيمن وأماط عنه الدم ‏.‏ وقال علي في حديثه بذي الحليفة وقلد نعلين ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more excellent in Islam?" He replied, "(Faith) followed by (good) deeds."

chapter: Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that ‘Umair bin Anas bin Malik said:                      “My paternalunclesamong the Ansar who were among the Companions of the MessengerofAllah (ﷺ) told me: ‘The new crescent of Shawwal was covered withclouods, so we fasted the next day. Then some riders came at the endof the day and testified to the Prophet (ﷺ) that they had seen thenew crescent the night before. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commandedthem to break their fast and to go out to offer the ‘Eid prayer thefollowing morning.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا هشيم، عن أبي بشر، عن أبي عمير بن أنس بن مالك، قال حدثني عمومتي، من الأنصار من أصحاب رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قالوا أغمي علينا هلال شوال فأصبحنا صياما فجاء ركب من آخر النهار فشهدوا عند النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أنهم رأوا الهلال بالأمس فأمرهم رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أن يفطروا وأن يخرجوا إلى عيدهم من الغد ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What kind of fasting is best?" He replied,"Whoever eats or drinks something then he does not wash his mouth, it is better for him to keep on doing so."

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_en: Yahya bin Abu Muta' said:                     I heard 'Irbad bin Sariyah say: 'One day, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood up among us and delivered a deeply moving speech to us that melted our hearts and caused our eyes to overflow with tears. It was said to him: 'O Messenger of Allah, you have delivered a speech of farewell, so enjoin something upon us.' He said: 'I urge you to fear Allah, and to listen and obey, even if (your leader) is an Abyssinian slave. After I am gone, you will see great conflict. I urge you to adhere to my Sunnah and the path of the Rightly-Guided Caliphs, and cling stubbornly to it. And beware of newly-invented matters, for every innovation is a going astray.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عبد الله بن أحمد بن بشير بن ذكوان الدمشقي، حدثنا الوليد بن مسلم، حدثنا عبد الله بن العلاء، - يعني ابن زبر - حدثني يحيى بن أبي المطاع، قال سمعت العرباض بن سارية، يقول قام فينا رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ذات يوم فوعظنا موعظة بليغة وجلت منها القلوب وذرفت منها العيون فقيل يا رسول الله وعظتنا موعظة مودع فاعهد إلينا بعهد فقال ‏"‏ عليكم بتقوى الله والسمع والطاعة وإن عبدا حبشيا وسترون من بعدي اختلافا شديدا فعليكم بسنتي وسنة الخلفاء الراشدين المهديين عضوا عليها بالنواجذ وإياكم والأمور المحدثات فإن كل بدعة ضلالة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying "The most blessed of all food is dates; they are food from Paradise."

chapter: Tribulations - كتاب الفتن
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Sa’eed Al-Khudri that a man came to theProphet (ﷺ) and said:                      “Which of the people is best?” He said:“A manwho strives in Jihad in the cause of Allah with himself andhiswealth.” He said: “Then who?” He said: “A man in amountain pass whoworships Allah and leaves the people from hisevil.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا هشام بن عمار، حدثنا يحيى بن حمزة، حدثنا الزبيدي، حدثني الزهري، عن عطاء بن يزيد الليثي، عن أبي سعيد الخدري، أن رجلا، أتى النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  فقال أى الناس أفضل قال ‏"‏ رجل مجاهد في سبيل الله بنفسه وماله ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال ثم من قال ‏"‏ ثم امرؤ في شعب من الشعاب يعبد الله عز وجل ويدع الناس من شره ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad (sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam): "What is more burdensome to me?" He replied, "The thing which makes you forget the remembrance of Allaah."

chapter: Tribulations - كتاب الفتن
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from ‘Abdullah bin ‘Umar that the Messenger ofAllah(ﷺ) said:                      “People are like a hundred camels; you can hardlyfind oneworth riding among them.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا هشام بن عمار، حدثنا عبد العزيز بن محمد الدراوردي، حدثنا زيد بن أسلم، عن عبد الله بن عمر، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ الناس كإبل مائة لا تكاد تجد فيها راحلة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more loved to me than my family?" He replied, "(The) prayer at its (appointed time)."

chapter: The Chapters on Pawning - كتاب الرهون
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin Mughaffal that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:                     “Whoever digs a well, is entitled to forty forearms' length surrounding it is as a resting place for his flocks.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا الوليد بن عمرو بن سكين، حدثنا محمد بن عبد الله بن المثنى، ح وحدثنا الحسن بن محمد بن الصباح، حدثنا عبد الوهاب بن عطاء، قالا حدثنا إسماعيل المكي، عن الحسن، عن عبد الله بن مغفل، أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ من حفر بئرا فله أربعون ذراعا عطنا لماشيته ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba said that he saw a man wearing an iron ring in his hand which was like a bracelet on one of his hands. He asked him about it so as to buy it from him and the person replied, "I have pawned this with Allah."

chapter: The Chapters on Blood Money - كتاب الديات
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Uqbah bin Amir Al-Juhani that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:                     “Whoever meets Allah (SWT) not associating anything in worship with him, and not having shed any blood unlawfully, will enter Paradise.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير، حدثنا وكيع، حدثنا إسماعيل بن أبي خالد، عن عبد الرحمن بن عائذ، عن عقبة بن عامر الجهني، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ من لقي الله لا يشرك به شيئا لم يتند بدم حرام دخل الجنة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) who had killed ninety-nine persons and then he repented before he could kill the hundredth, so he was ordered by Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) to fast for two months.
He asked: "Which kind of fasting?" He said: The monthly one; i.e., Ramadan.

chapter: The Chapters on Jihad - كتاب الجهاد
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Iyas bin Salamah bin Awka’, that his fathersaid:                      “Weattacked Hawazin, with Abu Bakr, during the time of theProphet(ﷺ), and we arrived at an oasis belonging to Bani Fazarahduringthe last part of the night. We attacked at dawn, raiding thepeopleof the oasis, and killed them, nine or seven households.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن إسماعيل، أنبأنا وكيع، عن عكرمة بن عمار، عن إياس بن سلمة بن الأكوع، عن أبيه، قال غزونا مع أبي بكر هوازن على عهد النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فأتينا ماء لبني فزارة فعرسنا حتى إذا كان عند الصبح شنناها عليهم غارة فأتينا أهل ماء فبيتناهم فقتلناهم تسعة أو سبعة أبيات ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man came to Allah's Apostle while he was at Dhul-Hulaifa on his way from Makkah to Madinah with some of the companions, and asked him (the Prophet) about the Hajj. The Prophet replied: "Do you have anything else?" He said: No." Then Allah's Apostle ordered a man who was beside me that he should give his riding animal to this person so as not to overtake them and ask him (the questioner).
The narrator added, I asked Anas bin Malik about the name of the person. He said: It is Abu Hudhaifa."

chapter: The Book On The Mosques And The Congregations - كتاب المساجد والجماعات
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Aishah that:                     The Messenger of Allah commanded that mosque to be built in (Ad-Dur) villages, and that they be purified and perfumed.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عبد الرحمن بن بشر بن الحكم، وأحمد بن الأزهر، قالا حدثنا مالك بن سعير، أنبأنا هشام بن عروة، عن أبيه، عن عائشة، أن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أمر بالمساجد أن تبنى في الدور وأن تطهر وتطيب ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that a man asked Anas b. Malik about something which he did not know so he went to his father who was with him in their house and told him the question of the person, then came back and sat between us (i.e., near me) and narrated it from his father as follows:
My mother sent a dish containing meat into the Prophet's dwelling place while I was playing with some boys there around him...

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari that:                     The Messenger of Allah performed ablution and wiped over his socks and his sandals.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن يحيى، حدثنا معلى بن منصور، وبشر بن آدم، قالا حدثنا عيسى بن يونس، عن عيسى بن سنان، عن الضحاك بن عبد الرحمن بن عرزب، عن أبي موسى الأشعري، أن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  توضأ ومسح على الجوربين والنعلين ‏.‏ قال المعلى في حديثه لا أعلمه إلا قال والنعلين ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What should I say when I perform ablution?" The Prophet told him to pronounce (the words) while he was standing for prayer, and then walk on till he reaches the place where one of you performs ablution.

chapter: The Chapters on Divorce - كتاب الطلاق
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Aishah that:                     the Messenger of Allah said. "The Pen has been lifted from three : from the sleeping person until he awakens, from the minor until he grows up, and from the insane person until he comes to his senses."In his narration, (one of the narrators Abu Bakr (Ibn Abu Shaibah) said: "And from the afflicted person, unit he recovers" (1)
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا يزيد بن هارون، ح وحدثنا محمد بن خالد بن خداش، ومحمد بن يحيى، قالا حدثنا عبد الرحمن بن مهدي، حدثنا حماد بن سلمة، عن حماد، عن إبراهيم، عن الأسود، عن عائشة، ‏.‏ أن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال ‏"‏ رفع القلم عن ثلاثة عن النائم حتى يستيقظ وعن الصغير حتى يكبر وعن المجنون حتى يعقل أو يفيق ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال أبو بكر في حديثه ‏"‏ وعن المبتلى حتى يبرأ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zam'ah said that he asked Allahs Apostle "Which is better among deeds - (the one done) in public or (that done) private?" He replied, "One who does the good deed but people do not find out about it will get ten times more reward than those whose good deeds are known to others."

chapter: Chapters on Slaughtering - كتاب الذبائح
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Abu Sa’eed Al-Khudri said:                      “The Prophet (ﷺ)passed by a man who was dragging a sheep by its ear. He said: ‘Leaveits ear alone and hold it by the sides of its neck.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا عقبة بن خالد، عن موسى بن محمد بن إبراهيم التيمي، أخبرني أبي، عن أبي سعيد الخدري، قال مر النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  برجل وهو يجر شاة بأذنها فقال ‏"‏ دع أذنها وخذ بسالفتها ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What should I say when I perform ablution?" The Prophet replied, "(Say), 'O Lord! You are ever forgiving and you love to be praised.'"

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_ar: قال أبو الحسن وحدثنا خازم بن يحيى، حدثنا إبراهيم بن الحجاج السامي، حدثنا حماد بن سلمة، قال أبو الحسن وحدثنا إبراهيم بن نصر الهمداني، صاحب القفيز حدثنا موسى بن إسماعيل، حدثنا حماد بن سلمة، ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) who had been performing Ihram for Umrah only but did not perform Hajj with him while he was at Mina and asked, "O Allah's Prophet! What is my state?" The Prophet said, "You have to slaughter a Hadi (a sacrifice)."
The man then came back again. He had been performing Ihram for Umrah only but did not perform the Hajj with him while he was at Mina and asked Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) saying, "O Allah's Prophet! What is my state?" The Prophet said to him.
The man then came back again for a third time but did not perform the Hajj with him while he was at Mina and asked about his case as before so that every time he returned from Arafat, he would ask (about it) saying: "O Allah's Apostle! What is my state?" The Prophet said to him each time.
The man then came back for the fourth time but did not perform Hajj with him while at Mina and asked about his case as before so that every time he returned from Arafat, he would ask (about it) saying: "O Allah's Apostle!

chapter: Etiquette - كتاب الأدب
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Juwairiyah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) passed by her when he prayed the morning prayer, or after he prayed the morning prayer, and she was remembering Allah.  He came back when the sun had risen" - or he (one of the narrators) said, "at midday - and she was still doing that. He said: 'I have said four words, three times, since I left you, and they are greater and weigh more heavily than what you have said.  They are: Subhan-Allahi 'adada khalqiha, Subhan-Allahi rida nafsihi, Subhan-Allahi zinata 'arshihi, Subhan-Allah midada kalimatihi (Glory is to Allah, as much as the number of His creation, glory is to Allah as much as pleases Him, glory is to Allah as much as the weight of His Throne, glory is to Allah as much as the ink of His words'."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا محمد بن بشر، حدثنا مسعر، حدثني محمد بن عبد الرحمن، عن أبي رشدين، عن ابن عباس، عن جويرية، قالت مر بها رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  حين صلى الغداة أو بعد ما صلى الغداة وهي تذكر الله فرجع حين ارتفع النهار - أو قال انتصف - وهي كذلك فقال ‏"‏ لقد قلت منذ قمت عنك أربع كلمات ثلاث مرات هي أكثر وأرجح - أو أوزن - مما قلت سبحان الله عدد خلقه سبحان الله رضا نفسه سبحان الله زنة عرشه سبحان الله مداد كلماته ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said "If anyone keeps back anything of what is due to a brother or sister in faith he must pay it over except that which was given by way of loan."

chapter: The Chapters on Divorce - كتاب الطلاق
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Umm Salamah that:                     the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) swore to keep away from some of his wives for a month. On the twenty-ninth day, in the evening or the morning, it was said: "O Messenger of Allah, only twenty-nine days have passed." He said: "The month is twenty-nine days."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أحمد بن يوسف السلمي، حدثنا أبو عاصم، عن ابن جريج، عن يحيى بن عبد الله بن محمد بن صيفي، عن عكرمة بن عبد الرحمن، عن أم سلمة، أن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  آلى من بعض نسائه شهرا فلما كان تسعة وعشرين راح أو غدا ‏.‏ فقيل يا رسول الله إنما مضى تسع وعشرون ‏.‏ فقال ‏"‏ الشهر تسع وعشرون ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "Messenger of Allah! What is more rightly due from me to my wife?" He replied:"If you put something into her, then take it out before you lie with her."

chapter: The Chapters on Legal Punishments - كتاب الحدود
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:                     “When my innocence was revealed, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood on the pulpit and mentioned that, and he recited Quran. When he came down, he ordered that the legal punishment (of slandering) be carried out on two men and a woman.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن بشار، حدثنا ابن أبي عدي، عن محمد بن إسحاق، عن عبد الله بن أبي بكر، عن عمرة، عن عائشة، قالت لما نزل عذري قام رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم على المنبر فذكر ذلك وتلا القرآن فلما نزل أمر برجلين وامرأة فضربوا حدهم ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that a man asked the Messenger of Allaah (sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam): "What is more burdensome to me?" He replied, "(The one who has no wife and he does not marry)."

chapter: Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from ‘Abdur-Rahman bin ‘Awf that the Messenger ofAllah(ﷺ) said:                      “The one who fasts Ramadan while traveling is likeonewho breaks his fast when not traveling.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا إبراهيم بن المنذر الحزامي، حدثنا عبد الله بن موسى التيمي، عن أسامة بن زيد، عن ابن شهاب، عن أبي سلمة بن عبد الرحمن، عن أبيه عبد الرحمن بن عوف، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ صائم رمضان في السفر كالمفطر في الحضر ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What kind of fasting is best?" He replied,"Fasting on seeing (the month) Ramadan."

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:                      “It was said to the Prophet(ﷺ):‘The left side of the mosque has been abandoned. The Prophet(ﷺ)said: “Whoever frequents the left side of the mosque, two Kifl*ofreward will be recorded for him.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن أبي الحسين أبو جعفر، حدثنا عمرو بن عثمان الكلابي، حدثنا عبيد الله بن عمرو الرقي، عن ليث بن أبي سليم، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر، قال قيل للنبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  إن ميسرة المسجد تعطلت ‏.‏ فقال النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ من عمر ميسرة المسجد كتب له كفلان من الأجر ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about a man who had been fasting continuously from Ramadan till Shawwal or vice versa? He replied, "He has not done any good deed."

chapter: The Chapters on Rulings - كتاب الأحكام
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Jabir bin 'Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to two Jews:                     “Swear by Allah Who sent the Tawrah down to Musa, peace be upon him.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا علي بن محمد، حدثنا أبو أسامة، عن مجالد، أنبأنا عامر، عن جابر بن عبد الله، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ليهوديين ‏"‏ نشدتكما بالله الذي أنزل التوراة على موسى عليه السلام ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What deeds are loved most by Allah?" He replied:"Patience in adversity."

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_ar: قال شعبة قال عاصم يومئذ وهذا الأعمش يرويه عن أبي وائل عن حذيفة وما حفظه ‏.‏ فسألت عنه منصورا فحدثنيه عن أبي وائل عن حذيفة أن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أتى سباطة قوم فبال قائما ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What should I say when I perform ablution?" The Prophet replied, "(Say), 'O Lord! You are fully aware of what is in my heart and I am not saying it to show off. For you know what is hidden as well as the open."

chapter: Chapters on Hajj Rituals - كتاب المناسك
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Najiyah Al-Khuza’i – in his narration, ‘Amr (oneof the narrators) said that he was the one who looked after thesacrificial animals of the Prophet (ﷺ) – said:                      “I said: ‘OMessengerof Allah, what should I do with those sacrificial animalsthat becomeunfit?’ He said: ‘Slaughter them, dip its sandal inits blood, thenplace it on its side, and leave them for the peopleto eat.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وعلي بن محمد، وعمرو بن عبد الله، قالوا حدثنا وكيع، عن هشام بن عروة، عن أبيه، عن ناجية الخزاعي، - قال عمرو في حديثه وكان صاحب بدن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  - قال قلت يا رسول الله كيف أصنع بما عطب من البدن قال ‏"‏ انحره واغمس نعله في دمه ثم اضرب صفحته وخل بينه وبين الناس فليأكلوه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What is more Earnest in Prayer?" He replied:"Haste to your prayer when its time begins."

chapter: Tribulations - كتاب الفتن
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Abdullah said:                      "While we were with theMessenger of Allah (ﷺ), some youngsters from Banu Hashim camealong.When the Prophet (ﷺ) saw them, his eyes filled with tearsand hiscolor changed. I said: 'We still see something in your facethat wedo not like (to see).' He said: 'We are members of aHousehold forwhom Allah has chosen the Hereafter over this world.The people of myHousehold will face calamity, expulsion and exileafter I am gone,until some people will come from the east carryingblack banners. Theywill ask for something good but will not be givenit. Then they willfight and will be victorious, then they will begiven what theywanted, but they will not accept it and will giveleadership to a manfrom my family. Then they will fill it withjustice just as it wasfilled with injustice. Whoever among you livesto see that, let him goto them even if he has to crawl over snow.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عثمان بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا معاوية بن هشام، حدثنا علي بن صالح، عن يزيد بن أبي زياد، عن إبراهيم، عن علقمة، عن عبد الله، قال بينما نحن عند رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  إذ أقبل فتية من بني هاشم فلما رآهم النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  اغرورقت عيناه وتغير لونه قال فقلت ما نزال نرى في وجهك شيئا نكرهه ‏.‏ فقال ‏"‏ إنا أهل بيت اختار الله لنا الآخرة على الدنيا وإن أهل بيتي سيلقون بعدي بلاء وتشريدا وتطريدا حتى يأتي قوم من قبل المشرق معهم رايات سود فيسألون الخير فلا يعطونه فيقاتلون فينصرون فيعطون ما سألوا فلا يقبلونه حتى يدفعوها إلى رجل من أهل بيتي فيملؤها قسطا كما ملؤوها جورا فمن أدرك ذلك منكم فليأتهم ولو حبوا على الثلج ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more loved to me than my parents?" He replied," Your mother." The man asked then what was next? Again he (the Prophet) replied, "Your Mother". Then the man asked again for the third time and thereafter also the same reply came that your father.

chapter: The Chapters on Business Transactions - كتاب التجارات
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Sa'ib said to the Prophet (ﷺ):                     "You were my partner during the Ignorance period and you were the best of partners, you did not contend or dispute."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عثمان، وأبو بكر ابنا أبي شيبة قالا حدثنا عبد الرحمن بن مهدي، عن سفيان، عن إبراهيم بن مهاجر، عن مجاهد، عن قائد السائب، عن السائب، قال للنبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  كنت شريكي في الجاهلية فكنت خير شريك كنت لا تداريني وكنت لا تماريني ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Shabba' said that he heard Allahs Apostle saying "The most burdensome thing to me is prayer at its appointed time."

chapter: The Chapters on Legal Punishments - كتاب الحدود
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Ishaq bin Abu Talhah:                     “I heard Abu Mundhir, the freed slave of Abu Dharr, say that Abu Umayyah narrated to him, that a thief was brought to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he admitted his crime, although the stolen goods were not found with him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'I do not think you stole them.’ He said: 'Yes I did.' Then he said (again): ‘I do not think that you stole them.’ and he said: 'Yes I did.' Then he ordered that his hand be cut off. The Prophet (ﷺ) ' Say: I seek Allah's forgiveness and I repent to Him.' So he (the thief) said: 'I seek Allah's forgiveness and I repent to him.' He (the Prophet (ﷺ) said twice: 'O Allah! Accept his repentance.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا هشام بن عمار، حدثنا سعيد بن يحيى، حدثنا حماد بن سلمة، عن إسحاق بن أبي طلحة، سمعت أبا المنذر، - مولى أبي ذر - يذكر أن أبا أمية، حدثه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أتي بلص فاعترف اعترافا ولم يوجد معه المتاع فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ما إخالك سرقت ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال بلى ‏.‏ ثم قال ‏"‏ ما إخالك سرقت ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال بلى ‏.‏ فأمر به فقطع ‏.‏ فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ قل أستغفر الله وأتوب إليه ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال أستغفر الله وأتوب إليه ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ اللهم تب عليه ‏"‏ ‏.‏ مرتين ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (RA) said that a man came to Allah's Messenger (SAW)...

chapter: Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Asma’ bint Abu Bakr said:                      “We broke our fast onacloudy day at the time of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), then the sunappeared.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وعلي بن محمد، قالا حدثنا أبو أسامة، عن هشام بن عروة، عن فاطمة بنت المنذر، عن أسماء بنت أبي بكر، قالت أفطرنا على عهد رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  في يوم غيم ثم طلعت الشمس ‏.‏ قلت لهشام أمروا بالقضاء قال لا بد من ذلك ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that a man asked Anas b. Malik about fasting on Monday or Tuesday of two months in succession which was forbidden by Allah and His Messenger (ﷺ).

chapter: The Chapters on Pawning - كتاب الرهون
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Amr bin Dinar said:                     “I heard Ibn 'Umar say: 'We used to lend land for cultivation in return for a share of the harvest, and we did not see anything wrong with that, until we heard Rafi' bin Khadij say: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade it.” Then we stopped because of what he said.' ”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا هشام بن عمار، ومحمد بن الصباح، قالا حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة، عن عمرو بن دينار، قال سمعت ابن عمر، يقول كنا نخابر ولا نرى بذلك بأسا حتى سمعنا رافع بن خديج يقول نهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عنه ‏.‏ فتركناه لقوله ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What is more superior among men?" He replied:" Not one of them."

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:                      “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)stayed for nineteen days in which he shortened his prayer to twoRak’ah. So, whenever we stayed for nineteen days we would shortenourprayer to two Rak’ah, but if we stayed more than that we wouldprayfour Rak’ah.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن عبد الملك بن أبي الشوارب، حدثنا عبد الواحد بن زياد، حدثنا عاصم الأحول، عن عكرمة، عن ابن عباس، قال أقام رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  تسعة عشر يوما يصلي ركعتين ركعتين فنحن إذا أقمنا تسعة عشر يوما نصلي ركعتين ركعتين فإذا أقمنا أكثر من ذلك صلينا أربعا ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered upon a woman who was praying while she had on an iron ring in her right hand which prevented her from prostrating and she did not know it, so he took hold of the ring with his mouth.

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that ‘Abdullah bin ‘Amr said:                      “I memorized the Qur’anand recited it all in one night. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:‘Iam afraid that you may live a long life and that you may getbored.Recite it over the period of a month.’ I said: ‘Let mebenefit from mystrength in my youth.’ He said: ‘Recite it in tendays.’ I said: ‘Letme benefit from my strength and my youth.’He said: ‘Recite it inseven days.’ I said: ‘Let me benefitfrom my strength and my youth,’but he refused (to alter it anyfurther).”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن خلاد الباهلي، حدثنا يحيى بن سعيد، عن ابن جريج، عن ابن أبي مليكة، عن يحيى بن حكيم بن صفوان، عن عبد الله بن عمرو، قال جمعت القرآن فقرأته كله في ليلة فقال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ إني أخشى أن يطول عليك الزمان وأن تمل فاقرأه في شهر ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فقلت دعني أستمتع من قوتي وشبابي ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ فاقرأه في عشرة ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قلت دعني أستمتع من قوتي وشبابي ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ فاقرأه في سبع ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قلت دعني أستمتع من قوتي وشبابي ‏.‏ فأبى ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to offer two Rakat of prayer before the compulsory prayers as well as after them also.

chapter: Chapters on Slaughtering - كتاب الذبائح
ground_truth_en: Jabirbin ‘Abdullah said:                      “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbadekillingany animal when it is tied up (for use as a target).”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا هشام بن عمار، حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة، أنبأنا ابن جريج، حدثنا أبو الزبير، أنه سمع جابر بن عبد الله، يقول نهى رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أن يقتل شىء من الدواب صبرا ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (may Allaah be pleased with him) said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad (sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam): "What is more superior?" He replied, "Faith in the heart which leads to action."

chapter: The Chapters Regarding Zakat - كتاب الزكاة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Ammar bin Sa'eed, the Mu'adhdhin of the Messenger of Allah from his father,:                     that the Messenger of Allah enjoined Sadaqatul-Fitr, one Sa of dates, one Sa of barley, or one Sa of Sult (a kind of barley without skin on it, resembling wheat).
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا هشام بن عمار، حدثنا عبد الرحمن بن سعد بن عمار المؤذن، حدثنا عمر بن حفص، عن عمار بن سعد، مؤذن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أمر بصدقة الفطر صاعا من تمر أو صاعا من شعير أو صاعا من سلت ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Abu Hurairah said : The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to us in the mosque while we were reclining on our right side; so he sat down with his back towards the Qibla and asked, "What is this?" We replied that it was a custom. He then turned away from the direction of the qibla and said:
"O people! Do not turn your faces to what if faced you (in any manner) but keep looking at where Allah's Messenger turns his face."

chapter: The Chapters on Marriage - كتاب النكاح
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:                     "This Verse 'And making peace is better.' was revealed concerning a man who had been married to a woman for a long time, and she had given birth to his children and he wanted to exchange her (for a new wife). She agreed that he would stay with her (the new wife) and would not give her (the first wife) a share of his time. (i.e.) not spend the nights with her)."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا حفص بن عمرو، حدثنا عمر بن علي، عن هشام بن عروة، عن أبيه، عن عائشة، ‏.‏ أنها قالت نزلت هذه الآية ‏{والصلح خير}‏ في رجل كانت تحته امرأة قد طالت صحبتها وولدت منه أولادا فأراد أن يستبدل بها فراضته على أن تقيم عنده ولا يقسم لها ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Allah's Apostle what deeds were most loved by God? He replied: "Our Lord descends every night to the heaven of this world when it is the last third (of the night) where there are no guards and says, 'Who will call on Me so I may answer him? Who asks something of me so I may give him? Who seeks My forgiveness so I may forgive him?' "

chapter: Chapters Regarding Funerals - كتاب الجنائز
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Abu Ghalib said:                      “I saw Anas bin Malik offeringthefuneral prayer for a man, and he stood level with his head. Thenanother funeral was brought, that of a woman, and they said: ‘O AbuHamzah! Offer the funeral prayer for her.’ So he stood level withthemiddle of the bed (the body was upon). ‘Ala’ bin Ziyad saidto him: ‘OAbu Hamzah! Is this how you saw the Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) standingin relation to the body of a man and a woman as youhave stood?’ Hesaid: ‘Yes.’ Then he turned to us and said:‘Remember this.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا نصر بن علي الجهضمي، حدثنا سعيد بن عامر، عن همام، عن أبي غالب، قال رأيت أنس بن مالك صلى على جنازة رجل فقام حيال رأسه فجيء بجنازة أخرى بامرأة فقالوا يا أبا حمزة صل عليها ‏.‏ فقام حيال وسط السرير فقال له العلاء بن زياد يا أبا حمزة هكذا رأيت رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قام من الجنازة مقامك من الرجل وقام من المرأة مقامك من المرأة قال نعم ‏.‏ فأقبل علينا فقال احفظوا ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that a man asked Anas Ibn Malik about his father who had died before him so he did not witness it? He replied to me, "I was with the Messenger of Allaah (sallaahu 'alaihi wa sallam) and we were in our house. The Prophet (sallaahu 'alaihi wa sallam), his wife Khadijah bint Khuwaylid tended to her father who was dying, so she asked the Messenger of Allaah for permission to go attend him." He said: "Go and do not worry about me. I am with my Lord in a better place than you are now." She went out until he died. Then when it was time for prayer they returned home and performed their prayers, then she came back again after the Prophet (sallaahu 'alaihi wa sallam) had finished his prayer so that I could see her face as white from crying over what happened to him."

chapter: Chapters on Medicine - كتاب الطب
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Asma’ bint Abu Bakr that a woman suffering fromfeverwould be brought to her, and she would call for water and pouritonto the neck of her garment. She said:                      The Prophet (ﷺ) said:“Coolit down with water,” and he said: “It is from the heat ofHell-fire.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا عبدة بن سليمان، عن هشام بن عروة، عن فاطمة بنت المنذر، عن أسماء بنت أبي بكر، أنها كانت تؤتى بالمرأة الموعوكة فتدعو بالماء فتصبه في جيبها وتقول إن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال ‏"‏ ابردوها بالماء ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وقال ‏"‏ إنها من فيح جهنم ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him) said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ): "What is the thing which when I do it, enters me in my share from charity?" He replied: "(Part of) your walking."

chapter: Etiquette - كتاب الأدب
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Taiyah said:                     "I heard Anas Bin Malik say: The Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) sed to mix with us so much that he said to al ittle brother of mine: "O Abu Umair, what happened to the Nughair(one of the narratrs Waki said that it means a bird that he used to play with)."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا علي بن محمد، حدثنا وكيع، عن شعبة، عن أبي التياح، قال سمعت أنس بن مالك، يقول كان رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يخالطنا حتى يقول لأخ لي صغير ‏"‏ يا أبا عمير ما فعل النغير ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال وكيع يعني طيرا كان يلعب به ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man came to Allah's Apostle while he was at Dhu al-Hulayfa (a well known place on the way from Makkah to Madinah) and asked him about his wives, how many were they? And who among them had given birth to sons.
The Prophet said: "They are five in number." The man then asked as to which of them was first. He replied that Khadijah bint Khuwaylid was the one with whom he used to be and she gave him (a son) Qasim, who died at the age of six years; and after her it were Saudias bint Mitab, Umaymah bint Zanbila Abu Sufyan bin Harithah's wife, Hafsa bint Umar his cousin's daughter (and she gave birth to Abdur Rahman), Aisha the daughter of Abi Bakr and Maryam بنت Sharik who was known as "the lady" among women.

chapter: The Chapters on Pawning - كتاب الرهون
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin Zubair that :                     a man from among the Ansar had a dispute with Zubair in the presence of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) concerning the streams of the Harrah with which he irrigated his palm trees. The Ansari said: “Let the water flow,” but he refused. So they referred their dispute to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Irrigate (your trees) O Zubair, then let the water flow to your neighbor.” The Ansari became angry and said: “O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), is it because he is your cousin (son of your paternal aunt)?” The expression of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) changed, then he said: “O Zubair, irrigate (your trees) then retain the water until it reaches the walls.” Zubair said: “I think this Verse was revealed concerning that: “But no, by your Lord, they make you (O Muhammad) judge in all disputes between them, and find in themselves no resistance against your decisions, and accept (them) with full submission [1].'” (Sahih)  [1] An-Nisa 4.65
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن رمح، أنبأنا الليث بن سعد، عن ابن شهاب، عن عروة بن الزبير، عن عبد الله بن الزبير، أن رجلا، من الأنصار خاصم الزبير عند رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في شراج الحرة التي يسقون بها النخل فقال الأنصاري سرح الماء يمر ‏.‏ فأبى عليه فاختصما عند رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اسق يا زبير ثم أرسل الماء إلى جارك ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فغضب الأنصاري فقال يا رسول الله أن كان ابن عمتك فتلون وجه رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ثم قال ‏"‏ يا زبير اسق ثم احبس الماء حتى يرجع إلى الجدر ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال فقال الزبير والله إني لأحسب هذه الآية أنزلت في ذلك ‏{‏فلا وربك لا يؤمنون حتى يحكموك فيما شجر بينهم ثم لا يجدوا في أنفسهم حرجا مما قضيت ويسلموا تسليما‏}‏‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Ibn Abbas said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more loved to me?" He replied, "(The one) who loves you most." The Prophet of God then told him, "Your mother," and he repeated it three times.

llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What should I say when I perform ablution?" The Prophet replied, "(Say) 'O Lord! I am performing ablution for no other purpose than to worship You."

chapter: Etiquette - كتاب الأدب
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Aishah that the Prophet(ﷺ) said:                     "Allah is Gentle and loves gentleness in all things."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا محمد بن مصعب، عن الأوزاعي، ح وحدثنا هشام بن عمار، وعبد الرحمن بن إبراهيم، قالا حدثنا الوليد بن مسلم، حدثنا الأوزاعي، عن الزهري، عن عروة، عن عائشة، عن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال ‏"‏ إن الله رفيق يحب الرفق في الأمر كله ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more loved to me than my own self?" He replied, "(The love of) parents." The man further asked, "Then what (is the next thing in order of priority)?" Again he replied: "Parents," and then again for the third time.
And every time Allah's Apostle said: "Your parents."

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Abu Dharr that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:                      “Whoevertakesa bath on a Friday and does it well, and purifies himself anddoes itwell, and puts on his best clothes, and puts on whatever Allahdecrees for him of the perfume of his family, then comes to themosqueand does not engage in idle talk or separate (pushing between)twopeople; he will be forgiven for (his sins) between that day andtheprevious Friday.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا سهل بن أبي سهل، وحوثرة بن محمد، قالا حدثنا يحيى بن سعيد القطان، عن ابن عجلان، عن سعيد المقبري، عن أبيه، عن عبد الله بن وديعة، عن أبي ذر، عن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال ‏"‏ من اغتسل يوم الجمعة فأحسن غسله وتطهر فأحسن طهوره ولبس من أحسن ثيابه ومس ما كتب الله له من طيب أهله ثم أتى الجمعة ولم يلغ ولم يفرق بين اثنين غفر له ما بينه وبين الجمعة الأخرى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Zaid al-'Ansari said that he heard Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas say to his wife who was asking him about a matter of inheritance in which she had some share, "O woman! Do not ask me for anything. I have been given the Book (Quran) and my portion is with it."

chapter: Chapters on Food - كتاب الأطعمة
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Wahb bin Kaisan that he heard ‘Umar bin AbuSalamahsay:                      “I was a boy in the care of the Prophet (ﷺ) and my handusedto wander all over the plate. He said to me: ‘O boy! Say the Nameof Allah, eat with your right hand, and eat from what is in front ofyou.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، ومحمد بن الصباح، قالا حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة، عن الوليد بن كثير، عن وهب بن كيسان، سمعه من، عمر بن أبي سلمة قال كنت غلاما في حجر النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  وكانت يدي تطيش في الصحفة فقال لي ‏"‏ يا غلام سم الله وكل بيمينك وكل مما يليك ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What kind of food is most beloved to Allah?" He replied:"That which I have made lawful."

chapter: Chapters on Dress - كتاب اللباس
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet (ﷺ) said toFatimah, orto Umm Salamah:                      “Let your hem down one forearm’s length.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا يزيد بن هارون، حدثنا حماد بن سلمة، عن أبي المهزم، عن أبي هريرة، ‏.‏ أن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال لفاطمة أو لأم سلمة ‏"‏ ذيلك ذراع ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "What is more loved to Allah?" He replied, "A smiling face."

chapter: Chapters Regarding Funerals - كتاب الجنائز
ground_truth_en: Al-Mughirah bin Shu’bah said:                      “I heard the Messenger of Allah(ﷺ)say: ‘The rider should travel behind the funeral (procession)but theone who is walking may walk wherever he wants.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن بشار، حدثنا روح بن عبادة، حدثنا سعيد بن عبيد الله بن جبير بن حية، حدثني زياد بن جبير بن حية، سمع المغيرة بن شعبة، يقول سمعت رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول ‏"‏ الراكب خلف الجنازة والماشي منها حيث شاء ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What should I say when I enter my house?" The Prophet replied," Say, 'As-Salamu `Alaykum.'" Then he added, "If one of you enters upon another and says to him: AsSalaamu Alaikum,' then the other will answer saying; Wa'Alaikuma Sallami wa Barakatuhu. And if two among you enter on each other and say 'As-Salamu `Alaykum', both of them would be rewarded with a good reward."

ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا إسماعيل بن عياش، عن عبد العزيز بن عبيد الله، عن محمد بن عمرو بن عطاء، قال رأيت السائب بن يزيد يشم ثوبه فقلت مم ذلك قال إني سمعت رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول ‏"‏ لا وضوء إلا من ريح أو سماع ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What should I say when I perform ablution?" The Prophet replied, "(Say), 'O Lord! You are fully aware of what is in my heart and I am not saying it out of arrogance but to seek Your blessings."

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Ali said:                     "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Abu Bakr and 'Umar are the leaders of the mature people of Paradise, and the first and the last, except for the Prophets and Messengers, but do not tell them about that, O 'Ali, as long as they are still alive.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا هشام بن عمار، حدثنا سفيان، عن الحسن بن عمارة، عن فراس، عن الشعبي، عن الحارث، عن علي، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ أبو بكر وعمر سيدا كهول أهل الجنة من الأولين والآخرين إلا النبيين والمرسلين لا تخبرهما يا علي ما داما حيين ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more loved by God?" He replied, "(Faith) followed by Jihad (holy fighting in Allah's Cause), and then emigration to the land which has been fought so as to make it Muslim or else an invitation to Islam. Then he asked another question: What are those things? The Prophet said "The love of As-Safa, the love of Al-Marwa (two mountains in Makkah) is a duty for every Moslem."

llm_response: Narrated Anas bin Malik said that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) used to perform ablution like this when he intended to sleep of his own accord or if he got up at night for any purpose and then lie down in the mosque after performing prayer.

llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Allah's Apostle "What is more loved to me than my parents?" He replied: Your mother." The man asked (again),"Then what?" Again he replied, "Your Mother," and the third time also. So on every occasion his answer was:" your mother".

chapter: The Chapters on Charity - كتاب الصدقات
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:                     “On the night on which I was taken on the Night Journey (Isra), I saw written at the gate of Paradise: 'Charity brings a tenfold reward and a loan brings an eighteen fold reward.' I said: 'O Jibril! Why is a loan better than charity?' He said: 'Because the beggar asks when he has something, but the one who asks for loan does so only because he is in need.' ”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عبيد الله بن عبد الكريم، حدثنا هشام بن خالد، حدثنا خالد بن يزيد بن أبي مالك، وحدثنا أبو حاتم، حدثنا هشام بن خالد، حدثنا خالد بن يزيد بن أبي مالك، عن أبيه، عن أنس بن مالك، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ رأيت ليلة أسري بي على باب الجنة مكتوبا الصدقة بعشر أمثالها والقرض بثمانية عشر ‏.‏ فقلت يا جبريل ما بال القرض أفضل من الصدقة ‏.‏ قال لأن السائل يسأل وعنده والمستقرض لا يستقرض إلا من حاجة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Hurairah said that a man asked Prophet Muhammad : "Messenger of Allah! What type of charity is best?" He replied: "That which you have plenty."
